                        document.getElementById(
                                "selectedAddressCard"
                                );


                const selectedName =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "selectedAddressName"
                                );


                const selectedLine =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "selectedAddressLine"
                                );


                const selectedDefaultBadge =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "selectedDefaultBadge"
                                );


                const noAddressMessage =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "noAddressMessage"
                                );


                const needAddressMessage =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "needAddressMessage"
                                );


                const addressList =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "addressList"
                                );


                const addressListEmpty =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "addressListEmpty"
                                );


                const openAddressModalButton =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "openAddressModalButton"
                                );


                const confirmAddressButton =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "confirmAddressButton"
                                );


                const placeOrderButton =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "placeOrderButton"
                                );


                const modalMessage =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "addressModalMessage"
                                );


                const addressModal =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "addressModal"
                                );


                const addressListFooter =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "addressListFooter"
                                );



                const editAddressForm =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "editAddressForm"
                                );


                const editAddressId =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "editAddressId"
                                );


                const editRecipientName =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "editRecipientName"
                                );


                const editPhoneNumber =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "editPhoneNumber"
                                );


                const editAddressLine =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "editAddressLine"
                                );


                const saveEditAddressButton =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "saveEditAddressButton"
                                );


                const cancelEditAddressButton =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "cancelEditAddressButton"
                                );


                let committedAddressId =
                        addressInput
                        ? addressInput.value
                        : "";


                let addressRequestBusy =
                        false;


                let editingOption =
                        null;



                function showModalMessage(
                        message,
                        success
                        ) {

                    if (!modalMessage) {
                        return;
                    }


                    modalMessage.textContent =
                            message;


                    modalMessage.className =
                            success
                            ? "alert alert-success mx-3 mt-3 mb-0"
                            : "alert alert-danger mx-3 mt-3 mb-0";
                }



                async function postAddressAction(
                        data
                        ) {

                    const response =
                            await fetch(
                                    checkoutUrl,
                                    {
                                        method: "POST",

                                        credentials:
                                                "same-origin",

                                        headers: {

                                            "Accept":
                                                    "application/json",

                                            "Content-Type":
                                                    "application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8"
                                        },

                                        body:
                                                new URLSearchParams(
                                                        data
                                                        ).toString()
                                    }
                            );


                    let result;


                    try {

                        result =
                                await response.json();

                    } catch (e) {

                        throw new Error(
                                "Phản hồi từ server không hợp lệ."
                                );
                    }


                    if (!response.ok
                            || !result.success) {

                        throw new Error(
                                result.message
                                || "Không thể thực hiện thao tác."
                                );
                    }


                    return result;
                }



                function getOptions() {

                    if (!addressList) {
                        return [];
                    }


                    return Array.from(
                            addressList.querySelectorAll(
                                    ".address-option"
                                    )
                            );
                }


                function updateAddressListState() {

                    const options =
                            getOptions();


                    if (addressListEmpty) {

                        addressListEmpty.style.display =
                                options.length === 0
                                ? ""
                                : "none";
                    }


                    if (openAddressModalButton) {

                        openAddressModalButton.disabled =
                                options.length === 0;
                    }


                    if (confirmAddressButton) {

                        confirmAddressButton.disabled =
                                options.length === 0;
                    }
                }



                function updateDeleteButtons() {

                    getOptions().forEach(
                            function (option) {

                                const id =
                                        option.dataset
                                        .addressId;


                                const button =
                                        option.querySelector(
                                                ".delete-address-button"
                                                );


                                if (!button) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                button.disabled =
                                        addressRequestBusy
                                        || id === committedAddressId;
                            }
                    );
                }



                function updateSelectedAddress(
                        address,
                        setDefaultBadge
                        ) {

                    if (!address) {
                        return;
                    }


                    committedAddressId =
                            String(
                                    address.addressId
                                    );


                    if (addressInput) {

                        addressInput.value =
                                committedAddressId;
                    }


                    if (selectedName) {

                        selectedName.textContent =
                                address.recipientName
                                + " | "
                                + address.phoneNumber;
                    }


                    if (selectedLine) {

                        selectedLine.textContent =
                                address.addressLine;
                    }


                    if (selectedCard) {

                        selectedCard.style.display =
                                "";
                    }


                    if (noAddressMessage) {

                        noAddressMessage.style.display =
                                "none";
                    }


                    if (needAddressMessage) {

                        needAddressMessage.style.display =
                                "none";
                    }


                    if (placeOrderButton) {

                        placeOrderButton.disabled =
                                false;
                    }


                    if (selectedDefaultBadge) {

                        selectedDefaultBadge.style.display =
                                setDefaultBadge
                                && address.defaultAddress
                                ? ""
                                : "none";
                    }


                    updateDeleteButtons();
                }



                function closeEditMode() {

                    editingOption =
                            null;


                    if (editAddressForm) {

                        editAddressForm.reset();

                        editAddressForm.classList.add(
                                "d-none"
                                );
                    }


                    if (addressList) {

                        addressList.classList.remove(
                                "d-none"
                                );
                    }


                    if (addressListFooter) {

                        addressListFooter.classList.remove(
                                "d-none"
                                );
                    }


                    if (modalMessage) {

                        modalMessage.className =
                                "alert mx-3 mt-3 mb-0 d-none";
                    }
                }



                if (addressList) {

                    addressList.addEventListener(
                            "click",
                            function (event) {

                                const button =
                                        event.target.closest(
                                                ".edit-address-button"
                                                );


                                if (!button
                                        || addressRequestBusy) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                editingOption =
                                        button.closest(
                                                ".address-option"
                                                );


                                if (!editingOption) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                editAddressId.value =
                                        editingOption.dataset
                                        .addressId;


                                editRecipientName.value =
                                        editingOption
                                        .querySelector(
                                                ".address-recipient"
                                                )
                                        .textContent
                                        .trim();


                                editPhoneNumber.value =
                                        editingOption
                                        .querySelector(
                                                ".address-phone"
                                                )
                                        .textContent
                                        .trim();


                                editAddressLine.value =
                                        editingOption
                                        .querySelector(
                                                ".address-line"
                                                )
                                        .textContent
                                        .trim();


                                addressList.classList.add(
                                        "d-none"
                                        );


                                addressListFooter.classList.add(
                                        "d-none"
                                        );


                                editAddressForm.classList.remove(
                                        "d-none"
                                        );
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (cancelEditAddressButton) {

                    cancelEditAddressButton.addEventListener(
                            "click",
                            function () {

                                closeEditMode();
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (editAddressForm) {

                    editAddressForm.addEventListener(
                            "submit",
                            async function (event) {

                                event.preventDefault();


                                if (addressRequestBusy) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                editRecipientName.value =
                                        editRecipientName.value
                                        .trim();


                                editPhoneNumber.value =
                                        editPhoneNumber.value
                                        .trim();


                                editAddressLine.value =
                                        editAddressLine.value
                                        .trim();


                                if (!editAddressForm
                                        .reportValidity()) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                addressRequestBusy =
                                        true;


                                saveEditAddressButton.disabled =
                                        true;


                                saveEditAddressButton.textContent =
                                        "Đang lưu...";


                                updateDeleteButtons();


                                try {

                                    const result =
                                            await postAddressAction(
                                                    {
                                                        action:
                                                                "editAddress",

                                                        addressId:
                                                                editAddressId.value,

                                                        recipientName:
                                                                editRecipientName.value,

                                                        phoneNumber:
                                                                editPhoneNumber.value,

                                                        addressLine:
                                                                editAddressLine.value,

                                                        addressActionToken:
                                                                addressActionToken
                                                    }
                                            );


                                    const address =
                                            result.address;


                                    editingOption
                                            .querySelector(
                                                    ".address-recipient"
                                                    )
                                            .textContent =
                                            address.recipientName;


                                    editingOption
                                            .querySelector(
                                                    ".address-phone"
                                                    )
                                            .textContent =
                                            address.phoneNumber;


                                    editingOption
                                            .querySelector(
                                                    ".address-line"
                                                    )
                                            .textContent =
                                            address.addressLine;

                                    if (String(
                                            address.addressId
                                            ) === committedAddressId) {

                                        updateSelectedAddress(
                                                address,
                                                false
                                                );
                                    }


                                    closeEditMode();


                                    showModalMessage(
                                            "Đã cập nhật địa chỉ.",
                                            true
                                            );


                                } catch (error) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            error.message,
                                            false
                                            );


                                } finally {

                                    addressRequestBusy =
                                            false;


                                    saveEditAddressButton.disabled =
                                            false;


                                    saveEditAddressButton.textContent =
                                            "Lưu thay đổi";


                                    updateDeleteButtons();
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }


                if (addressModal) {

                    addressModal.addEventListener(
                            "show.bs.modal",
                            function () {

                                closeEditMode();


                                if (addressList) {

                                    addressList
                                            .querySelectorAll(
                                                    'input[name="modalAddressId"]'
                                                    )
                                            .forEach(
                                                    function (radio) {

                                                        radio.checked =
                                                                radio.value
                                                                === committedAddressId;
                                                    }
                                            );


                                    const currentOption =
                                            getOptions()
                                            .find(
                                                    function (option) {

                                                        return option.dataset
                                                                .addressId
                                                                === committedAddressId;
                                                    }
                                            );


                                    if (currentOption) {

                                        addressList.prepend(
                                                currentOption
                                                );
                                    }
                                }


                                updateDeleteButtons();
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (addressList) {

                    addressList.addEventListener(
                            "change",
                            function (event) {

                                if (event.target.matches(
                                        'input[name="modalAddressId"]'
                                        )) {

                                    updateDeleteButtons();
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (confirmAddressButton) {

                    confirmAddressButton.addEventListener(
                            "click",
                            async function () {

                                if (addressRequestBusy
                                        || !addressList) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                const selectedRadio =
                                        addressList
                                        .querySelector(
                                                'input[name="modalAddressId"]:checked'
                                                );


                                if (!selectedRadio) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            "Vui lòng chọn địa chỉ giao hàng.",
                                            false
                                            );

                                    return;
                                }


                                const id =
                                        selectedRadio.value;


                                addressRequestBusy =
                                        true;


                                updateDeleteButtons();


                                try {

                                    const result =
                                            await postAddressAction(
                                                    {
                                                        action:
                                                                "selectAddress",

                                                        addressId:
                                                                id,

                                                        addressActionToken:
                                                                addressActionToken
                                                    }
                                            );


                                    const option =
                                            selectedRadio
                                            .closest(
                                                    ".address-option"
                                                    );


                                    updateSelectedAddress(
                                            result.selectedAddress,
                                            true
                                            );


                                    if (option) {

                                        addressList.prepend(
                                                option
                                                );
                                    }


                                    bootstrap.Modal
                                            .getOrCreateInstance(
                                                    addressModal
                                                    )
                                            .hide();


                                } catch (error) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            error.message,
                                            false
                                            );


                                } finally {

                                    addressRequestBusy =
                                            false;


                                    updateDeleteButtons();
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (addressList) {

                    addressList.addEventListener(
                            "submit",
                            async function (event) {

                                const form =
                                        event.target.closest(
                                                ".delete-address-form"
                                                );


                                if (!form) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                event.preventDefault();


                                if (addressRequestBusy) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                const option =
                                        form.closest(
                                                ".address-option"
                                                );


                                if (!option) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                const id =
                                        option.dataset
                                        .addressId;


                                if (id === committedAddressId) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            "Không thể xóa địa chỉ đang sử dụng. "
                                            + "Vui lòng xác nhận địa chỉ khác trước.",
                                            false
                                            );

                                    return;
                                }


                                if (!window.confirm(
                                        "Bạn chắc chắn muốn xóa địa chỉ này?"
                                        )) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                addressRequestBusy =
                                        true;


                                updateDeleteButtons();


                                try {

                                    await postAddressAction(
                                            {
                                                action:
                                                        "deleteAddress",

                                                addressId:
                                                        id,

                                                addressActionToken:
                                                        addressActionToken
                                            }
                                    );


                                    option.remove();


                                    updateAddressListState();


                                    showModalMessage(
                                            "Đã xóa địa chỉ thành công.",
                                            true
                                            );


                                } catch (error) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            error.message,
                                            false
                                            );


                                } finally {

                                    addressRequestBusy =
                                            false;


                                    updateDeleteButtons();
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }



                const addAddressForm =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "addAddressForm"
                                );


                const saveAddressButton =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "saveAddressButton"
                                );


                if (addAddressForm) {

                    addAddressForm.addEventListener(
                            "submit",
                            function (event) {

                                if (addAddressForm
                                        .dataset
                                        .submitting
                                        === "true") {

                                    event.preventDefault();

                                    return;
                                }


                                if (!addAddressForm
                                        .checkValidity()) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                addAddressForm
                                        .dataset
                                        .submitting =
                                        "true";


                                if (saveAddressButton) {

                                    saveAddressButton.disabled =
                                            true;


                                    saveAddressButton.textContent =
                                            "Đang lưu...";
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }


                const orderForm =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "orderForm"
                                );


                if (orderForm) {

                    orderForm.addEventListener(
                            "submit",
                            function (event) {

                                if (orderForm
                                        .dataset
                                        .submitting
                                        === "true") {

                                    event.preventDefault();

                                    return;
                                }


                                if (!orderForm
                                        .checkValidity()) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                orderForm
                                        .dataset
                                        .submitting =
                                        "true";


                                if (placeOrderButton) {

                                    placeOrderButton.disabled =
                                            true;


                                    placeOrderButton.textContent =
                                            "Đang xử lý đơn hàng...";
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }


                updateAddressListState();

                updateDeleteButtons();

            }
    );

</script>

                        Tiếp tục mua sắm

                    <a href="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/cart"
                       class="btn btn-outline-secondary px-4">
                        <i class="bi bi-cart me-1"></i>
                        Về giỏ hàng

<%@ page pageEncoding="UTF-8" %>
<%@ taglib prefix="c" uri="jakarta.tags.core" %>
<%@ taglib prefix="fmt" uri="jakarta.tags.fmt" %>
<%@ include file="/WEB-INF/include/header.jsp" %>
<jsp:useBean id="paymentClock" class="java.util.Date" scope="page"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/assets/css/payment.css">

    <a class="payment-back" href="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/my-orders/detail?id=${order.orderId}">
        <i class="bi bi-arrow-left" aria-hidden="true"></i> Chi tiết đơn hàng
    </a>

    </div>
    <div class="payment-layout">
        <section class="payment-panel payment-summary" aria-labelledby="payment-summary-title">
            <div class="payment-summary-top">
                <span class="payment-icon"><i class="bi bi-bag-check" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
                <span class="payment-status"><span></span> Chờ thanh toán</span>
            </div>

            </button>

            <button type="button"
                    id="confirmCancelButton"

<script>
    /* =========================
       CUSTOMER TOAST
       ========================= */

    function closeCustomerToast(button) {
        const toast = button.closest(".customer-toast");

        if (toast) {
            toast.classList.add("hide");

            setTimeout(function () {
                toast.remove();
            }, 250);
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        document.querySelectorAll(".customer-toast").forEach(function (toast) {
            setTimeout(function () {
                if (toast.isConnected) {
                    toast.classList.add("hide");

                    setTimeout(function () {
                        toast.remove();
                    }, 250);
                }
            }, 4000);
        });
    });

    /* =========================
       CANCEL ORDER MODAL
       ========================= */

    let cancelForm = null;

    function showCancelModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        cancelForm = event.currentTarget;

        const modal = document.getElementById("cancelModal");
        const confirmButton = document.getElementById("confirmCancelButton");

        if (!modal || !confirmButton) {
            return false;
        }

        confirmButton.disabled = false;
        confirmButton.textContent = "Xác nhận hủy";

        modal.classList.add("show");

        return false;
    }

    function closeCancelModal() {
        const modal = document.getElementById("cancelModal");

        if (modal) {
            modal.classList.remove("show");
        }

        cancelForm = null;
    }

    function confirmCancelOrder() {
        if (!cancelForm) {
            return;
        }

        const form = cancelForm;
        const confirmButton = document.getElementById("confirmCancelButton");

        if (confirmButton) {
            confirmButton.disabled = true;
            confirmButton.textContent = "Đang xử lý...";
        }

        // Khóa nút hủy để tránh gửi form nhiều lần.
        const submitButton = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');

        if (submitButton) {
            submitButton.disabled = true;
            submitButton.textContent = "Đang xử lý...";
        }

        document.getElementById("cancelModal").classList.remove("show");

        // Gửi form trực tiếp, không kích hoạt lại onsubmit.
        HTMLFormElement.prototype.submit.call(form);

        cancelForm = null;
    }

    // Đóng modal khi nhấn ra ngoài vùng nội dung.
    document.getElementById("cancelModal").addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (event.target === this) {
            closeCancelModal();
        }
    });

    // Đóng modal bằng phím Escape.
    document.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Escape") {
            const modal = document.getElementById("cancelModal");

            if (modal && modal.classList.contains("show")) {
                closeCancelModal();
            }
        }
    });
</script>

                   placeholder="Tìm mã đơn, tên sản phẩm hoặc mã SKU">

            <button type="submit">Tìm kiếm</button>
        </form>
    </div>

    <div class="ph-results">
        <span>
            <strong><c:out value="${resultCount}" /></strong> đơn hàng
            <c:if test="${not empty query}">
                cho “<c:out value="${query}" />”
            </c:if>
        </span>

        <c:choose>
            <c:when test="${not empty query}">
                <c:url var="clearUrl" value="/my-orders">
                    <c:param name="status" value="${activeTab}" />
                </c:url>
                <a href="<c:out value='${clearUrl}' />">Xóa tìm kiếm</a>
            </c:when>
            <c:otherwise>
                <span>Mới nhất trước</span>
            </c:otherwise>
        </c:choose>
    </div>

    <c:if test="${empty orders}">
        <section class="ph-empty">
            <i class="bi bi-bag" aria-hidden="true"></i>

            <h2>
                ${empty query
                  ? 'Chưa có đơn hàng ở mục này'
                  : 'Không tìm thấy đơn hàng'}
            </h2>

            <p>
                ${empty query
                  ? 'Các đơn hàng phù hợp sẽ xuất hiện tại đây.'
                  : 'Thử tìm bằng mã đơn hoặc tên sản phẩm khác.'}
            </p>

            <div class="ph-empty-actions">
                <a class="ph-button"
                   href="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/my-orders">
                    Xem tất cả đơn
                </a>
                <a class="ph-secondary"
                   href="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/shop">
                    <i class="bi bi-bag-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                    Tiếp tục mua sắm
                </a>
            </div>
        </section>
    </c:if>

    <c:forEach var="order" items="${orders}">
        <article class="ph-order"
                 aria-label="Đơn hàng ${order.orderId}">

            <div class="ph-order-head">
                <div class="ph-meta">
                    <strong>
                        Đơn #<c:out value="${order.orderId}" />
                    </strong>
                    <span class="ph-date">
                        <fmt:formatDate value="${order.createdAt}"
                                        pattern="dd/MM/yyyy" />
                    </span>
                </div>

                <span class="ph-status
                      ${order.orderStatus == 'CANCELLED'
                        ? 'is-cancelled'
                        : (order.orderStatus == 'COMPLETED'
                        || order.orderStatus == 'DELIVERED'
                        ? 'is-completed' : '')}">
                      <c:out value="${statusLabels[order.orderStatus]}"
                             default="Đang cập nhật" />
                </span>
            </div>

            <div class="ph-products">
                <c:forEach var="item"
                           items="${orderItems[order.orderId]}">
                    <div class="ph-product">
                        <span class="ph-icon">
                            <c:choose>
                                <c:when test="${not empty item.imageUrl}">
                                    <c:url var="productImage" value="/${item.imageUrl}" />
                                    <img src="<c:out value='${productImage}'/>" alt=""
                                         style="width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; border-radius:inherit;" />
                                </c:when>
                                <c:otherwise>
                                    <i class="bi bi-box-seam" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                                </c:otherwise>
                            </c:choose>
                        </span>

                        <div class="ph-info">
                            <h2>
                                <c:out value="${item.productName}"
                                       default="Sản phẩm đã đặt" />
                            </h2>
                            <p>
                                Mã sản phẩm:
                                <c:out value="${item.skuCode}"
                                       default="${item.skuId}" />
                            </p>
                            <span>
                                Số lượng:
                                <c:out value="${item.quantity}" />
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="ph-price">
                            <fmt:formatNumber value="${item.price}"
                                              pattern="#,##0" />đ
                            <small>Đơn giá lúc đặt</small>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </c:forEach>

                <c:if test="${empty orderItems[order.orderId]}">
                    <p class="ph-missing">
                        Chưa có thông tin sản phẩm cho đơn này.
                    </p>
                </c:if>
            </div>

            <div class="ph-order-foot">
                <div class="ph-total">
                    <span>Thành tiền</span>
                    <strong>
                        <fmt:formatNumber value="${order.totalAmount}"
                                          pattern="#,##0" />đ
                    </strong>
                </div>

                <c:url var="detailUrl" value="/my-orders/detail">
                    <c:param name="id" value="${order.orderId}" />
                </c:url>

                <a class="ph-button"
                   href="<c:out value='${detailUrl}' />">
                    <c:choose>
                        <c:when test="${order.orderStatus == 'CANCELLED'
                                        || order.orderStatus == 'COMPLETED'
                                        || order.orderStatus == 'DELIVERED'}">
                                Xem chi tiết
                        </c:when>
                        <c:otherwise>
                            Theo dõi đơn hàng
                        </c:otherwise>
                    </c:choose>
                    <i class="bi bi-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                </a>
            </div>
        </article>
    </c:forEach>

    <c:if test="${pageCount > 1}">
        <nav class="ph-pagination"
             aria-label="Phân trang lịch sử mua hàng">

            <c:if test="${currentPage > 1}">
                <c:url var="prevUrl" value="/my-orders">
                    <c:param name="status" value="${activeTab}" />
                    <c:param name="q" value="${query}" />
                    <c:param name="page" value="${currentPage - 1}" />
                </c:url>

                <a class="ph-secondary"
                   href="<c:out value='${prevUrl}' />">
                    <i class="bi bi-arrow-left" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                    Trang trước
                </a>
            </c:if>

            <span>
                Trang <c:out value="${currentPage}" />
                / <c:out value="${pageCount}" />
            </span>

            <c:if test="${currentPage < pageCount}">
                <c:url var="nextUrl" value="/my-orders">
                    <c:param name="status" value="${activeTab}" />
                    <c:param name="q" value="${query}" />
                    <c:param name="page" value="${currentPage + 1}" />
                </c:url>

                <a class="ph-secondary"
                   href="<c:out value='${nextUrl}' />">
                    Trang sau
                    <i class="bi bi-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                </a>
            </c:if>
        </nav>
    </c:if>

</main>

<script>

    document.querySelectorAll(".notification").forEach(function (message) {
        setTimeout(function () {
            message.classList.add("notification-hide");

            setTimeout(function () {
                message.remove();
            }, 300);
        }, 3500);
    });


    function showValidationToast(message) {
        document.querySelectorAll(".validation-toast").forEach(function (toast) {
            toast.remove();
        });

        const toast = document.createElement("div");
        toast.className = "validation-toast";
        toast.setAttribute("role", "alert");

        const icon = document.createElement("span");
        icon.className = "notification-icon";
        icon.textContent = "!";

        const text = document.createElement("span");
        text.textContent = message;

        toast.appendChild(icon);
        toast.appendChild(text);

        document.querySelector(".return-form-page").appendChild(toast);

        setTimeout(function () {
            toast.classList.add("notification-hide");

            setTimeout(function () {
                toast.remove();
            }, 300);
        }, 3500);
    }


    const requestType = document.getElementById("requestType");
    const form = document.getElementById("returnExchangeForm");

    function updateExchangeFields() {
        const isExchange = requestType.value === "EXCHANGE";

        document.querySelectorAll(".exchange-field").forEach(function (field) {
            field.style.display = isExchange ? "block" : "none";

            const select = field.querySelector("select");

            const checkbox = document.querySelector(
                '.item-checkbox[value="' + field.dataset.orderItemId + '"]'
            );

            select.required = isExchange && checkbox.checked;
            select.disabled = !isExchange;
        });
    }

    document.querySelectorAll(".item-checkbox").forEach(function (checkbox) {
        checkbox.addEventListener("change", function () {
            const field = document.querySelector(
                '.exchange-field[data-order-item-id="' + checkbox.value + '"]'
            );

            if (!field) {
                return;
            }

            const select = field.querySelector("select");

            select.required =
                requestType.value === "EXCHANGE" && checkbox.checked;
        });
    });

    requestType.addEventListener("change", updateExchangeFields);


    form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
        const selectedItems = document.querySelectorAll(
            ".item-checkbox:checked"
        );

        if (selectedItems.length === 0) {
            event.preventDefault();
            showValidationToast("Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một sản phẩm.");
            return;
        }

        if (requestType.value === "EXCHANGE") {
            for (const checkbox of selectedItems) {
                const field = document.querySelector(
                    '.exchange-field[data-order-item-id="' + checkbox.value + '"]'
                );

                if (!field) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    showValidationToast(
                        "Không tìm thấy thông tin phiên bản sản phẩm."
                    );
                    return;
                }

                const select = field.querySelector("select");

                if (!select.value) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    showValidationToast(
                        "Vui lòng chọn phiên bản muốn đổi cho từng sản phẩm."
                    );
                    select.focus();
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
    });

    updateExchangeFields();
</script>

        <script>
            function escapeHTML(str) {
                if (!str)
                    return '';
                return String(str).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, function (tag) {
                    const charsToReplace = {
                        '&': '&amp;',
                        '<': '&lt;',
                        '>': '&gt;',
                        "'": '&#39;',
                        '"': '&quot;'
                    };
                    return charsToReplace[tag] || tag;
                });
            }

            document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
                const searchInput = document.getElementById('headerSearchInput');
                const searchSuggestions = document.getElementById('searchSuggestions');
                let timeoutId = null;

                searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
                    const keyword = this.value.trim();
                    clearTimeout(timeoutId);

                    if (keyword.length < 2) {
                        searchSuggestions.classList.add('d-none');
                        return;
                    }

                    timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                        fetch(`${pageContext.request.contextPath}/api/search?q=` + encodeURIComponent(keyword))
                                .then(response => response.json())
                                .then(data => {
                                    searchSuggestions.innerHTML = '';

                                    if (data.length === 0) {
                                        searchSuggestions.innerHTML = '<div class="suggestion-empty">Không tìm thấy sản phẩm nào!</div>';
                                    } else {
                                        data.forEach(item => {
                                            const priceStr = item.price > 0
                                                    ? new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(item.price) + ' ₫'
                                                    : 'Liên hệ';

                                            const safeName = escapeHTML(item.name);

                                            let imageHtml = '';
                                            if (item.imageUrl && item.imageUrl.trim() !== '') {
                                                const safeImgUrl = escapeHTML(item.imageUrl);
                                                imageHtml = `<img src="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/\${safeImgUrl}" alt="\${safeName}" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 4px;">`;
                                            } else {
                                                imageHtml = `<i class="bi bi-box-seam fs-5 text-secondary"></i>`;
                                            }

                                            const html = `
                                <a href="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/shop?action=detail&id=\${item.id}" class="suggestion-item">
                                    <div class="suggestion-img d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center bg-light border p-1">
                                        \${imageHtml}
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="suggestion-info">
                                        <span class="suggestion-name">\${safeName}</span>
                                        <span class="suggestion-price">\${priceStr}</span>
                                    </div>
                                </a>
                                `;
                                            searchSuggestions.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
                                        });
                                    }
                                    searchSuggestions.classList.remove('d-none');
                                })
                                .catch(err => console.error("Lỗi search API:", err));
                    }, 300);
                });

                document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                    if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !searchSuggestions.contains(e.target)) {
                        searchSuggestions.classList.add('d-none');
                    }
                });

                document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                    if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === 'k') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        searchInput.focus();
                    }
                });
            });
        </script>
        <c:if test="${not empty sessionScope.loggedInUser
                      and sessionScope.loggedInUser.customer}">
              <script>
                  (() => {
                      const contextPath = '${pageContext.request.contextPath}';
                      const bell = document.getElementById('notificationBell');
                      const panel = document.getElementById('notificationPanel');
                      const badge = document.getElementById('notificationBadge');
                      const list = document.getElementById('notificationList');
                      const total = document.getElementById('notificationTotal');

                      if (!bell || !panel || !badge || !list)
                          return;

                      async function loadCount() {
                          try {
                              const response = await fetch(
                                      contextPath + '/notification?action=count',
                                      {credentials: 'same-origin'}
                              );

                              if (!response.ok)
                                  return;

                              const data = await response.json();
                              const count = Number(data.count) || 0;

                              badge.textContent = count > 99 ? '99+' : String(count);
                              badge.hidden = count === 0;
                              total.textContent = count > 0 ? count + ' chưa đọc' : '';
                          } catch (error) {
                              console.error('Cannot load notification count.', error);
                          }
                      }

                      async function loadList() {
                          list.replaceChildren();

                          const loading = document.createElement('p');
                          loading.className = 'notification-empty';
                          loading.textContent = 'Đang tải thông báo...';
                          list.appendChild(loading);

                          try {
                              const response = await fetch(
                                      contextPath + '/notification?action=list',
                                      {credentials: 'same-origin'}
                              );

                              if (!response.ok) {
                                  throw new Error('Không thể tải thông báo.');
                              }

                              const notifications = await response.json();
                              list.replaceChildren();

                              if (notifications.length === 0) {
                                  const empty = document.createElement('p');
                                  empty.className = 'notification-empty';
                                  empty.textContent = 'Bạn chưa có thông báo nào.';
                                  list.appendChild(empty);
                                  total.textContent = '';
                                  return;
                              }

                              await loadCount();

                              notifications.forEach(n => {
                                  const item = document.createElement('button');
                                  item.type = 'button';
                                  item.className = 'notification-item'
                                          + (n.read ? '' : ' unread');

                                  const title = document.createElement('span');
                                  title.className = 'notification-item-title';
                                  title.textContent = n.title || 'Thông báo';

                                  const message = document.createElement('span');
                                  message.className = 'notification-item-message';
                                  message.textContent = n.message || '';

                                  const time = document.createElement('span');
                                  time.className = 'notification-item-time';
                                  time.textContent = n.createdAt || '';

                                  item.append(title, message, time);

                                  item.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                                      try {
                                          const body = new URLSearchParams({
                                              action: 'read',
                                              id: String(n.id)
                                          });

                                          const readResponse = await fetch(
                                                  contextPath + '/notification',
                                                  {
                                                      method: 'POST',
                                                      credentials: 'same-origin',
                                                      headers: {
                                                          'Content-Type':
                                                                  'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                                                      },
                                                      body: body.toString()
                                                  }
                                          );

                                          if (!readResponse.ok) {
                                              throw new Error(
                                                      'Không thể cập nhật trạng thái đã đọc.'
                                                      );
                                          }

                                          await loadCount();

                                          if (n.orderId != null) {
                                              window.location.href =
                                                      contextPath + '/my-orders/detail?id='
                                                      + encodeURIComponent(n.orderId);
                                          } else {
                                              await loadList();
                                          }
                                      } catch (error) {
                                          console.error(error);
                                      }
                                  });

                                  list.appendChild(item);
                              });
                          } catch (error) {
                              list.replaceChildren();

                              const failed = document.createElement('p');
                              failed.className = 'notification-empty';
                              failed.textContent = 'Không tải được thông báo. Vui lòng thử lại.';
                              list.appendChild(failed);

                              console.error(error);
                          }
                      }

                      bell.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                          const isOpening = panel.hidden;
                          panel.hidden = !isOpening;
                          bell.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(isOpening));

                          if (isOpening) {
                              await loadList();
                              await loadCount();
                          }
                      });

                      document.addEventListener('click', event => {
                          if (!event.target.closest('.notification-wrapper')) {
                              panel.hidden = true;
                              bell.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                          }
                      });

                      loadCount();
                  })();
              </script>
        </c:if>

                    Gồm thay đổi thủ công, số dư khi bắt đầu theo dõi và thay đổi từ nghiệp vụ khác.
                </p>
            </div>
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table class="table table-striped inventory-history mb-0">
                    <thead>
                        <tr>
                            <th scope="col" class="ps-3">Thời gian</th>
                            <th scope="col">SKU</th>
                            <th scope="col">Loại</th>
                            <th scope="col">Thay đổi</th>
                            <th scope="col">Trước → sau</th>
                            <th scope="col">Người thực hiện</th>
                            <th scope="col">Ghi chú</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                    <c:choose>
                        <c:when test="${not empty movements}">
                            <c:forEach items="${movements}" var="m">
                                <tr>
                                    <td class="ps-3 text-nowrap">
                                <fmt:formatDate value="${m.createdAt}" pattern="dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss"/>
                                </td>
                                <td>
                                    <strong><c:out value="${m.skuCode}"/></strong>
                                    <div class="text-muted small"><c:out value="${m.productName}"/></div>
                                </td>
                                <td>
                                <c:choose>
                                    <c:when test="${m.movementType eq 'IN'}">Nhập kho</c:when>
                                    <c:when test="${m.movementType eq 'OUT'}">Xuất kho</c:when>
                                    <c:when test="${m.movementType eq 'SET'}">Kiểm kê</c:when>
                                    <c:when test="${m.movementType eq 'OPENING'}">Số dư đầu</c:when>
                                    <c:otherwise>Hệ thống</c:otherwise>
                                </c:choose>
                                </td>
                                <td>
                                    <span class="${m.quantityDelta ge 0 ? 'inventory-positive' : 'inventory-negative'}">
                                        <c:if test="${m.quantityDelta gt 0}">+</c:if><c:out value="${m.quantityDelta}"/>
                                    </span>
                                </td>
                                <td><c:out value="${m.quantityBefore}"/> → <c:out value="${m.quantityAfter}"/></td>
                                <td>
                                <c:choose>
                                    <c:when test="${not empty m.actorName}"><c:out value="${m.actorName}"/></c:when>
                                    <c:otherwise><span class="text-muted">—</span></c:otherwise>
                                </c:choose>
                                </td>
                                <td style="max-width:280px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;">
                                <c:out value="${m.note}"/>
                                </td>
                                </tr>
                            </c:forEach>
                        </c:when>
                        <c:otherwise>
                            <tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center text-muted py-4">
                                    Chưa có lịch sử biến động tồn kho.
                                </td></tr>
                        </c:otherwise>
                    </c:choose>
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </section>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

        const categorySelect =
                document.getElementById("categoryId");

        const productForm =
                document.getElementById("createProductForm");

        const imageInput =
                document.getElementById("imageFile");

        const galleryInput =
                document.getElementById("galleryFiles");

        const imagePreview =
                document.getElementById("imagePreview");

        const previewImage =
                document.getElementById("previewImage");

        const galleryPreview =
                document.getElementById("galleryPreview");

        // ========================================
        // 1. ĐỔI CATEGORY -> TẢI LẠI FORM
        // ========================================

        let lastCategoryId = categorySelect.value;

        categorySelect.addEventListener("change", function () {

            const categoryId = this.value;

            const nameInput = document.getElementById("productName");
            const descriptionInput = document.getElementById("description");
            const modelInput = document.getElementById("modelCode");
            const brandInput = document.getElementById("brandId");

            const hasEnteredData =
                    nameInput.value.trim() !== ""
                    || descriptionInput.value.trim() !== ""
                    || modelInput.value.trim() !== ""
                    || brandInput.value !== ""
                    || imageInput.files.length > 0
                    || galleryInput.files.length > 0;

            if (hasEnteredData) {

                const confirmed = confirm(
                        "Thay đổi danh mục sẽ tải lại trang " +
                        "và làm mất dữ liệu chưa lưu. Tiếp tục?"
                        );

                if (!confirmed) {
                    categorySelect.value = lastCategoryId;
                    return;
                }
            }

            const baseUrl =
                    "${pageContext.request.contextPath}/product?view=create";

            if (categoryId) {
                window.location.href =
                        baseUrl + "&categoryId=" +
                        encodeURIComponent(categoryId);
            } else {
                window.location.href = baseUrl;
            }
        });

        // ========================================
        // 2. XEM TRƯỚC ẢNH ĐẠI DIỆN
        // ========================================

        let imagePreviewUrl = null;

        imageInput.addEventListener("change", function () {

            if (imagePreviewUrl) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(imagePreviewUrl);
                imagePreviewUrl = null;
            }

            const file = this.files[0];

            if (!file) {
                imagePreview.classList.add("d-none");
                previewImage.removeAttribute("src");
                return;
            }

            imagePreviewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);

            previewImage.src = imagePreviewUrl;
            imagePreview.classList.remove("d-none");
        });

        // ========================================
        // 3. XEM TRƯỚC ẢNH GALLERY
        // ========================================

        let galleryPreviewUrls = [];

        galleryInput.addEventListener("change", function () {

            galleryPreviewUrls.forEach(function (url) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            });

            galleryPreviewUrls = [];
            galleryPreview.replaceChildren();

            Array.from(this.files).forEach(function (file) {

                const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
                galleryPreviewUrls.push(url);

                const img = document.createElement("img");

                img.src = url;
                img.alt = "Ảnh gallery";
                img.className = "img-thumbnail";

                img.style.width = "90px";
                img.style.height = "90px";
                img.style.objectFit = "cover";

                galleryPreview.appendChild(img);
            });
        });

        // ========================================
        // 4. KIỂM TRA TRƯỚC KHI SUBMIT
        // ========================================

        productForm.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {

            const categoryId = categorySelect.value;

            const selectedCategoryId =
                    "${selectedCategoryId}";

            if (!categoryId
                    || categoryId !== selectedCategoryId) {

                event.preventDefault();

                alert(
                        "Vui lòng chọn danh mục và tải " +
                        "thông số kỹ thuật trước khi lưu."
                        );

                return;
            }

            const saveButton =
                    document.getElementById("saveProductBtn");

            if (productForm.checkValidity()) {

                saveButton.disabled = true;
                saveButton.innerHTML =
                        "Đang lưu sản phẩm...";
            }
        });

        window.addEventListener("pagehide", function () {

            if (imagePreviewUrl) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(imagePreviewUrl);
            }

            galleryPreviewUrls.forEach(function (url) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            });
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

        const form =
                document.getElementById("editProductForm");

        const imageInput =
                document.getElementById("imageFile");

        const galleryInput =
                document.getElementById("galleryFiles");

        const imagePreview =
                document.getElementById("imagePreview");

        const previewImage =
                document.getElementById("previewImage");

        const galleryPreview =
                document.getElementById("galleryPreview");

        // ========================================
        // 1. PREVIEW ẢNH ĐẠI DIỆN MỚI
        // ========================================

        let previewUrl = null;

        imageInput.addEventListener("change", function () {

            if (previewUrl) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
                previewUrl = null;
            }

            const file = this.files[0];

            if (!file) {

                imagePreview.classList.add("d-none");
                previewImage.removeAttribute("src");
                return;
            }

            previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);

            previewImage.src = previewUrl;
            imagePreview.classList.remove("d-none");
        });

        // ========================================
        // 2. PREVIEW ẢNH GALLERY MỚI
        // ========================================

        let galleryUrls = [];

        galleryInput.addEventListener("change", function () {

            galleryUrls.forEach(function (url) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            });

            galleryUrls = [];
            galleryPreview.replaceChildren();

            Array.from(this.files).forEach(function (file) {

                const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);

                galleryUrls.push(url);

                const img = document.createElement("img");

                img.src = url;
                img.alt = "Ảnh gallery mới";
                img.className = "img-thumbnail";

                img.style.width = "90px";
                img.style.height = "90px";
                img.style.objectFit = "cover";

                galleryPreview.appendChild(img);
            });
        });

        // ========================================
        // 3. XÁC NHẬN GỠ ẢNH GALLERY
        // ========================================

        form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {

            const selectedImages =
                    form.querySelectorAll(
                            'input[name="deleteImageIds"]:checked'
                            );

            if (selectedImages.length > 0) {

                const confirmed = confirm(
                        "Bạn đã chọn gỡ "
                        + selectedImages.length
                        + " ảnh gallery. Tiếp tục lưu thay đổi?"
                        );

                if (!confirmed) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    return;
                }
            }

            if (form.checkValidity()) {

                const saveButton =
                        document.getElementById("saveProductBtn");

                saveButton.disabled = true;
                saveButton.textContent = "Đang lưu thay đổi...";
            }
        });

        // ========================================
        // 4. GIẢI PHÓNG PREVIEW URL
        // ========================================

        window.addEventListener("pagehide", function () {

            if (previewUrl) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
            }

            galleryUrls.forEach(function (url) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            });
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

        const ratings = document.querySelectorAll(
            'input[name="rating"]'
        );

        const ratingText =
            document.getElementById("oeRatingText");

        const ratingMessages = {
            1: "1 sao · Rất không hài lòng",
            2: "2 sao · Không hài lòng",
            3: "3 sao · Bình thường",
            4: "4 sao · Hài lòng",
            5: "5 sao · Rất hài lòng"
        };

        ratings.forEach(function (radio) {
            radio.addEventListener("change", function () {
                ratingText.textContent =
                    ratingMessages[this.value];
            });
        });

        const comment =
            document.getElementById("oeReviewComment");

        const commentCount =
            document.getElementById("oeCommentCount");

        function updateCommentCount() {
            commentCount.textContent = comment.value.length;
        }

        comment.addEventListener("input", updateCommentCount);

        document.querySelectorAll(
            ".oe-review-suggestion"
        ).forEach(function (button) {

            button.addEventListener("click", function () {
                const suggestion = this.dataset.suggestion;
                const current = comment.value.trim();

                if (current.includes(suggestion)) {
                    return;
                }

                const separator = current ? ". " : "";
                const next = current + separator + suggestion;

                comment.value = next.slice(0, 2000);

                updateCommentCount();
                comment.focus();
            });
        });

        const imageInput =
            document.getElementById("oeReviewImages");

        const imagePreview =
            document.getElementById("oeImagePreview");

        const imageCount =
            document.getElementById("oeImageCount");

        const maxImages = 3;
        const maxSize = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

        let previewUrls = [];

        function clearPreview() {
            previewUrls.forEach(function (url) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            });

            previewUrls = [];
            imagePreview.innerHTML = "";
            imageCount.textContent = "0/3 ảnh đã chọn";
        }

        imageInput.addEventListener("change", function () {

            clearPreview();

            const files = Array.from(this.files);

            if (files.length > maxImages) {
                alert("Chỉ được chọn tối đa 3 ảnh.");
                this.value = "";
                return;
            }

            const allowedTypes = [
                "image/jpeg",
                "image/png",
                "image/webp"
            ];

            for (const file of files) {

                if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
                    alert(
                        "Chỉ hỗ trợ ảnh JPG, PNG và WEBP."
                    );

                    this.value = "";
                    clearPreview();
                    return;
                }

                if (file.size > maxSize) {
                    alert(
                        "Mỗi ảnh không được vượt quá 5MB."
                    );

                    this.value = "";
                    clearPreview();
                    return;
                }
            }

            files.forEach(function (file, index) {
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
                previewUrls.push(url);

                const img = document.createElement("img");
                img.src = url;
                img.alt = "Ảnh đánh giá " + (index + 1);

                imagePreview.appendChild(img);
            });

            imageCount.textContent =
                files.length + "/3 ảnh đã chọn";
        });

        const form =
            document.getElementById("oeReviewForm");

        const submitButton =
            document.getElementById("oeReviewSubmit");

        form.addEventListener("submit", function () {

            if (!form.checkValidity()) {
                return;
            }

            submitButton.disabled = true;
            submitButton.textContent = "Đang gửi...";
        });

        window.addEventListener("pagehide", function () {
            previewUrls.forEach(function (url) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            });
        });
    });
</script>
