package controller;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

@WebServlet(
        name = "BannerImageServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/uploads/banners/*"}
)
public class BannerImageServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private Path getUploadDirectory() {
        return Paths.get(
                System.getProperty("user.home"),
                "OECS-uploads",
                "banners"
        ).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String pathInfo = request.getPathInfo();

        if (pathInfo == null || pathInfo.length() < 2) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND);
            return;
        }

        String fileName = pathInfo.substring(1);

        if (fileName.contains("/")
                || fileName.contains("\\")
                || fileName.contains("..")) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
            return;
        }

        Path uploadDirectory = getUploadDirectory();
        Path imagePath = uploadDirectory.resolve(fileName)
                .normalize();

        if (!imagePath.startsWith(uploadDirectory)
                || !Files.isRegularFile(imagePath)) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND);
            return;
        }

        String extension = fileName.substring(
                fileName.lastIndexOf('.') + 1
        ).toLowerCase();

        String contentType;

        if (extension.equals("jpg") || extension.equals("jpeg")) {
            contentType = "image/jpeg";
        } else if (extension.equals("png")) {
            contentType = "image/png";
        } else if (extension.equals("gif")) {
            contentType = "image/gif";
        } else if (extension.equals("webp")) {
            contentType = "image/webp";
        } else {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND);
            return;
        }

        response.setContentType(contentType);
        response.setContentLengthLong(Files.size(imagePath));
        response.setHeader("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-cache");

        try (OutputStream output = response.getOutputStream()) {
            Files.copy(imagePath, output);
        }
    }
}

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.MultipartConfig;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.Part;
import model.Banner;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.URI;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

@WebServlet(name = "BannerServlet", urlPatterns = {"/staff/banner"})
@MultipartConfig(
        fileSizeThreshold = 1024 * 1024,
        maxFileSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024,
        maxRequestSize = 20 * 1024 * 1024
)
public class BannerServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private final BannerDAO bannerDAO = new BannerDAO();

    private static final Pattern ALT_TEXT_PATTERN = Pattern.compile(
            "^[\\p{L}\\p{M}\\p{N}\\s.,!?()'’:;-]*$"
    );

    private Path getUploadDirectory() throws IOException {
        Path uploadDirectory = Paths.get(
                System.getProperty("user.home"),
                "OECS-uploads",
                "banners"
        ).toAbsolutePath().normalize();

        Files.createDirectories(uploadDirectory);

        return uploadDirectory;
    }

    private void deleteOldImage(String imageUrl) {
        if (imageUrl == null || !imageUrl.startsWith("uploads/banners/")) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            Path uploadDirectory = getUploadDirectory();

            String fileName = Paths.get(imageUrl)
                    .getFileName()
                    .toString();

            Path oldImage = uploadDirectory.resolve(fileName).normalize();

            if (oldImage.startsWith(uploadDirectory)) {
                Files.deleteIfExists(oldImage);
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            log("Cannot delete old banner image", e);
        }
    }

    private boolean isValidAltText(String altText) {
        if (altText == null) {
            return true;
        }

        altText = altText.trim();

        return altText.length() <= 255
                && ALT_TEXT_PATTERN.matcher(altText).matches();
    }

    private boolean isValidTargetUrl(String targetUrl) {
        if (targetUrl == null || targetUrl.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return true;
        }

        targetUrl = targetUrl.trim();

        if (targetUrl.length() > 2048
                || targetUrl.startsWith("//")
                || targetUrl.contains("\\")
                || targetUrl.matches("(?i).*%(0[0-9a-f]|1[0-9a-f]|7f).*")) {
            return false;
        }

        if (targetUrl.chars().anyMatch(
                c -> Character.isWhitespace(c)
                || Character.isISOControl(c))) {
            return false;
        }

        try {
            URI uri = URI.create(targetUrl);

            if (targetUrl.startsWith("/")) {
                return !uri.isAbsolute()
                        && uri.getRawAuthority() == null
                        && uri.getRawPath() != null
                        && uri.getRawPath().startsWith("/");
            }

            return "https".equalsIgnoreCase(uri.getScheme())
                    && uri.getHost() != null
                    && !uri.getHost().isEmpty()
                    && uri.getUserInfo() == null;

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void redirectError(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            String error
    ) throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/staff/banner?error="
                + error
        );
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        if ("edit".equals(action)) {
            try {
                int bannerId = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                if (bannerId <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }

                Banner banner = bannerDAO.getById(bannerId);

                if (banner == null) {
                    response.sendError(
                            HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND,
                            "Không tìm thấy banner."
                    );
                    return;
                }

                request.setAttribute("banner", banner);

                request.getRequestDispatcher(
                        "/WEB-INF/banner/edit.jsp"
                ).forward(request, response);

                return;

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                        "ID banner không hợp lệ."
                );
                return;
            }
        }

        if ("delete".equals(action)) {
            String idValue = request.getParameter("id");

            try {
                int bannerId = Integer.parseInt(idValue);

                if (bannerId <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }

                bannerDAO.delete(bannerId);

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                        "ID banner không hợp lệ."
                );
                return;
            }

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/staff/banner"
            );
            return;
        }

        if ("toggle".equals(action)) {
            String idValue = request.getParameter("id");

            try {
                int bannerId = Integer.parseInt(idValue);

                if (bannerId <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }

                boolean active = "1".equals(
                        request.getParameter("active")
                );

                bannerDAO.updateActive(bannerId, active);

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                        "ID banner không hợp lệ."
                );
                return;
            }

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/staff/banner"
            );
            return;
        }

        List<Banner> banners = bannerDAO.getAll();
        request.setAttribute("banners", banners);

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/banner/list.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        if ("update".equals(action)) {
            updateBanner(request, response);
            return;
        }

        String altText = request.getParameter("altText");
        String targetUrl = request.getParameter("targetUrl");
        String orderValue = request.getParameter("displayOrder");

        if (!isValidAltText(altText)) {
            redirectError(request, response, "invalidAlt");
            return;
        }

        if (!isValidTargetUrl(targetUrl)) {
            redirectError(request, response, "invalidUrl");
            return;
        }

        int displayOrder = 0;

        try {
            if (orderValue == null
                    || orderValue.trim().isEmpty()) {
                redirectError(request, response, "invalidOrder");
                return;
            }

            displayOrder = Integer.parseInt(orderValue.trim());

            if (displayOrder < 0) {
                redirectError(request, response, "invalidOrder");
                return;
            }

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            redirectError(request, response, "invalidOrder");
            return;
        }

        Part imagePart = request.getPart("imageFile");

        if (imagePart == null || imagePart.getSize() == 0) {
            redirectError(request, response, "upload");
            return;
        }

        String contentType = imagePart.getContentType();

        if (contentType == null
                || !(contentType.equals("image/jpeg")
                || contentType.equals("image/png")
                || contentType.equals("image/gif")
                || contentType.equals("image/webp"))) {

            redirectError(request, response, "upload");
            return;
        }

        String originalName = imagePart.getSubmittedFileName();

        if (originalName == null || originalName.trim().isEmpty()) {
            redirectError(request, response, "upload");
            return;
        }

        originalName = Paths.get(originalName)
                .getFileName()
                .toString();

        int dotIndex = originalName.lastIndexOf('.');

        if (dotIndex < 0) {
            redirectError(request, response, "upload");
            return;
        }

        String extension = originalName.substring(dotIndex)
                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        if (!(extension.equals(".jpg")
                || extension.equals(".jpeg")
                || extension.equals(".png")
                || extension.equals(".gif")
                || extension.equals(".webp"))) {

            redirectError(request, response, "upload");
            return;
        }

        String fileName = UUID.randomUUID() + extension;

        Path uploadDirectory = getUploadDirectory();

        Path destination = uploadDirectory.resolve(fileName)
                .normalize();

        if (!destination.startsWith(uploadDirectory)) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Đường dẫn file không hợp lệ."
            );
            return;
        }

        try (InputStream input = imagePart.getInputStream()) {
            Files.copy(
                    input,
                    destination,
                    StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING
            );
        }

        Banner banner = new Banner();

        banner.setImageUrl("uploads/banners/" + fileName);
        banner.setAltText(
                altText == null || altText.trim().isEmpty()
                ? null : altText.trim()
        );
        banner.setTargetUrl(
                targetUrl == null || targetUrl.trim().isEmpty()
                ? null : targetUrl.trim()
        );
        banner.setActive(true);
        banner.setDisplayOrder(displayOrder);

        if (!bannerDAO.insert(banner)) {
            Files.deleteIfExists(destination);

            redirectError(request, response, "database");
            return;
        }

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath() + "/staff/banner?success=create"
        );
    }

    private void updateBanner(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        int bannerId;

        try {
            bannerId = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("bannerId"));

            if (bannerId <= 0) {
                throw new NumberFormatException();
            }
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                    "ID banner không hợp lệ."
            );
            return;
        }

        Banner oldBanner = bannerDAO.getById(bannerId);

        if (oldBanner == null) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND,
                    "Không tìm thấy banner."
            );
            return;
        }

        String altText = request.getParameter("altText");
        String targetUrl = request.getParameter("targetUrl");
        String orderValue = request.getParameter("displayOrder");

        if (!isValidAltText(altText)) {
            redirectError(request, response, "invalidAlt");
            return;
        }

        if (!isValidTargetUrl(targetUrl)) {
            redirectError(request, response, "invalidUrl");
            return;
        }

        int displayOrder;

        try {
            if (orderValue == null || orderValue.trim().isEmpty()) {
                redirectError(request, response, "invalidOrder");
                return;
            }

            displayOrder = Integer.parseInt(orderValue.trim());

            if (displayOrder < 0) {
                redirectError(request, response, "invalidOrder");
                return;
            }
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            redirectError(request, response, "invalidOrder");
            return;
        }

        Part imagePart = request.getPart("imageFile");

        String imageUrl = oldBanner.getImageUrl();
        Path newImagePath = null;

        if (imagePart != null && imagePart.getSize() > 0) {

            String contentType = imagePart.getContentType();

            if (contentType == null
                    || !(contentType.equals("image/jpeg")
                    || contentType.equals("image/png")
                    || contentType.equals("image/gif")
                    || contentType.equals("image/webp"))) {

                redirectError(request, response, "upload");
                return;
            }

            String originalName = imagePart.getSubmittedFileName();

            if (originalName == null || originalName.trim().isEmpty()) {
                redirectError(request, response, "upload");
                return;
            }

            originalName = Paths.get(originalName)
                    .getFileName()
                    .toString();

            int dotIndex = originalName.lastIndexOf('.');

            if (dotIndex < 0) {
                redirectError(request, response, "upload");
                return;
            }

            String extension = originalName.substring(dotIndex)
                    .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

            if (!(extension.equals(".jpg")
                    || extension.equals(".jpeg")
                    || extension.equals(".png")
                    || extension.equals(".gif")
                    || extension.equals(".webp"))) {

                redirectError(request, response, "upload");
                return;
            }

            String fileName = UUID.randomUUID() + extension;

            Path uploadDirectory = getUploadDirectory();

            newImagePath = uploadDirectory.resolve(fileName).normalize();

            if (!newImagePath.startsWith(uploadDirectory)) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                        "Đường dẫn file không hợp lệ."
                );
                return;
            }

            try (InputStream input = imagePart.getInputStream()) {
                Files.copy(
                        input,
                        newImagePath,
                        StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING
                );
            }

            imageUrl = "uploads/banners/" + fileName;
        }

        Banner banner = new Banner();

        banner.setBannerId(bannerId);
        banner.setImageUrl(imageUrl);
        banner.setAltText(
                altText == null || altText.trim().isEmpty()
                ? null : altText.trim()
        );
        banner.setTargetUrl(
                targetUrl == null || targetUrl.trim().isEmpty()
                ? null : targetUrl.trim()
        );

        banner.setActive(oldBanner.isActive());

        banner.setDisplayOrder(displayOrder);

        if (!bannerDAO.update(banner)) {
            if (newImagePath != null) {
                Files.deleteIfExists(newImagePath);
            }

            redirectError(request, response, "database");
            return;
        }

        if (newImagePath != null) {
            deleteOldImage(oldBanner.getImageUrl());
        }

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath() + "/staff/banner?success=update"
        );
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.BrandDAO;
import model.Brand;
import service.AuditLogService;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(name = "BrandServlet", urlPatterns = {"/brand"})
public class BrandServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(BrandServlet.class.getName());

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService
            = new AuditLogService();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String view = request.getParameter("view");
        BrandDAO dao = new BrandDAO();
        String contextPath = request.getContextPath();

        if (view == null || view.equals("list")) {

            final int pageSize = 10;

            String keyword = request.getParameter("keyword");
            keyword = keyword == null ? "" : keyword.trim();

            int page = 1;

            try {
                String pageText = request.getParameter("page");

                if (pageText != null) {
                    page = Integer.parseInt(pageText);
                }

                if (page < 1) {
                    page = 1;
                }
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                page = 1;
            }

            int totalBrands;

            if (keyword.isEmpty()) {
                totalBrands = dao.countBrands();
            } else {
                totalBrands = dao.countSearchResults(keyword);
            }

            int totalPages = Math.max(
                    1,
                    (int) Math.ceil((double) totalBrands / pageSize)
            );

            if (page > totalPages) {
                page = totalPages;
            }

            List<Brand> brandList;

            if (keyword.isEmpty()) {
                brandList = dao.getListByPage(page, pageSize);
            } else {
                brandList = dao.searchByNameAndPage(
                        keyword, page, pageSize
                );
            }

            Map<Integer, Integer> productCounts
                    = dao.getProductCounts(brandList);

            int startItem = totalBrands == 0
                    ? 0
                    : (page - 1) * pageSize + 1;

            int endItem = Math.min(page * pageSize, totalBrands);

            request.setAttribute("brandList", brandList);
            request.setAttribute("keyword", keyword);
            request.setAttribute("productCounts", productCounts);
            request.setAttribute("currentPage", page);
            request.setAttribute("totalPages", totalPages);
            request.setAttribute("totalBrands", totalBrands);
            request.setAttribute("startItem", startItem);
            request.setAttribute("endItem", endItem);

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/brand/list.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

        } else if ("create".equals(view)) {

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/brand/create.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

        } else if ("edit".equals(view)) {

            try {
                int id = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                if (id <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }

                Brand selectedBrand = dao.getById(id);

                if (selectedBrand == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=list&error=notFound");
                    return;
                }

                request.setAttribute("brand", selectedBrand);

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/brand/edit.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.WARNING,
                        "Invalid ID when opening Edit Brand",
                        e
                );

                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=list&error=invalidId");
            }

        } else if ("delete".equals(view)) {

            try {
                int id = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                if (id <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }

                Brand selectedBrand = dao.getById(id);

                if (selectedBrand == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=list&error=notFound");
                    return;
                }

                int productCount = dao.countProductsByBrandId(id);

                request.setAttribute("brand", selectedBrand);
                request.setAttribute("productCount", productCount);

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/brand/delete.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.WARNING,
                        "Invalid ID when opening Delete Brand",
                        e
                );

                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=list&error=invalidId");

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Cannot open Delete Brand page",
                        e
                );

                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=list&error=server");
            }

        } else {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath + "/brand?view=list");
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String action = request.getParameter("action");
        BrandDAO dao = new BrandDAO();
        String contextPath = request.getContextPath();

        if ("create".equals(action)) {

            String name = request.getParameter("name");
            String logoUrl = request.getParameter("logoUrl");

            name = name == null ? "" : name.trim();
            logoUrl = logoUrl == null ? "" : logoUrl.trim();

            if (name.isEmpty()) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=create&error=empty");
                return;
            }

            if (name.length() > 100) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=create&error=length");
                return;
            }

            if (!isValidBrandName(name)) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=create&error=special");
                return;
            }

            if (logoUrl.isEmpty()) {
                logoUrl = null;
            } else if (logoUrl.length() > 2048
                    || !logoUrl.matches("(?i)^https?://.+")) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=create&error=logo");
                return;
            }

            try {
                if (dao.isNameExists(name, 0)) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=create&error=duplicate");
                    return;
                }

                Brand brand = new Brand(0, name, logoUrl);
                int result = dao.insert(brand);

                if (result == 1) {
                    User loggedInUser
                            = (User) request.getSession()
                                    .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                    auditLogService.log(
                            loggedInUser,
                            "CREATE_BRAND",
                            "BRAND",
                            null,
                            "Created brand: " + name,
                            request
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=list&success=create");
                } else {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=create&error=save");
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot create brand", e);

                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=create&error=server");
            }

        } else if ("edit".equals(action)) {

            String idText = request.getParameter("id");
            String name = request.getParameter("name");
            String logoUrl = request.getParameter("logoUrl");

            name = name == null ? "" : name.trim();
            logoUrl = logoUrl == null ? "" : logoUrl.trim();

            int id;

            try {
                id = Integer.parseInt(idText);

                if (id <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=list&error=invalidId");
                return;
            }

            if (name.isEmpty()) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=edit&id=" + id + "&error=empty");
                return;
            }

            if (name.length() > 100) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=edit&id=" + id + "&error=length");
                return;
            }

            if (!isValidBrandName(name)) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=edit&id=" + id + "&error=special");
                return;
            }

            if (logoUrl.isEmpty()) {
                logoUrl = null;
            } else if (logoUrl.length() > 2048
                    || !logoUrl.matches("(?i)^https?://.+")) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=edit&id=" + id + "&error=logo");
                return;
            }

            try {
                Brand existing = dao.getById(id);

                if (existing == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=list&error=notFound");
                    return;
                }

                if (dao.isNameExists(name, id)) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=edit&id=" + id
                            + "&error=duplicate");
                    return;
                }

                Brand brand = new Brand(id, name, logoUrl);
                int result = dao.edit(brand);

                if (result == 1) {
                    User loggedInUser
                            = (User) request.getSession()
                                    .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                    auditLogService.log(
                            loggedInUser,
                            "UPDATE_BRAND",
                            "BRAND",
                            null,
                            "Updated brand: " + name,
                            request
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=list&success=edit");
                } else {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=edit&id=" + id
                            + "&error=save");
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot edit brand", e);

                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=edit&id=" + id
                        + "&error=server");
            }

        } else if ("delete".equals(action)) {

            String idText = request.getParameter("id");
            int id;

            try {
                id = Integer.parseInt(idText);

                if (id <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=list&error=invalidId");
                return;
            }

            try {
                Brand existing = dao.getById(id);

                if (existing == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=list&error=notFound");
                    return;
                }

                int productCount = dao.countProductsByBrandId(id);

                if (productCount > 0) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=delete&id=" + id
                            + "&error=hasProducts");
                    return;
                }

                int result = dao.delete(existing);

                if (result == 1) {

                    User loggedInUser
                            = (User) request.getSession()
                                    .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                    auditLogService.log(
                            loggedInUser,
                            "DELETE_BRAND",
                            "BRAND",
                            null,
                            "Deleted brand: " + existing.getBrandName(),
                            request
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=list&success=delete");
                } else {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=delete&id=" + id
                            + "&error=delete");
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot delete brand", e);

                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=delete&id=" + id
                        + "&error=server");
            }

        } else {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath + "/brand?view=list");
        }
    }

    private boolean isValidBrandName(String name) {
        return name != null
                && name.matches("^[\\p{L}\\p{M}\\p{N} ]+$");
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.CategoryDAO;
import model.Category;
import model.User;
import service.AuditLogService;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(name = "CategoryServlet", urlPatterns = {"/category"})
public class CategoryServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(CategoryServlet.class.getName());

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService
            = new AuditLogService();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String view = request.getParameter("view");
        CategoryDAO dao = new CategoryDAO();

        if (view == null || view.equals("list")) {

            String keyword = request.getParameter("keyword");
            keyword = keyword == null ? "" : keyword.trim();

            List<Category> allCategories = dao.getList();

// Tra cuu danh muc bang ID, khong can query DB lan nua.
            Map<Integer, Category> categoriesById = new HashMap<>();
            Map<Integer, String> categoryNames = new HashMap<>();

            for (Category category : allCategories) {

                int categoryId = category.getCategoryId();

                categoriesById.put(categoryId, category);

                // Ten chi dung de hien thi tren JSP.
                categoryNames.put(
                        categoryId,
                        category.getCategoryName()
                );
            }

            Map<Integer, Integer> categoryDepths = new HashMap<>();

            List<Category> treeList = buildCategoryTree(
                    allCategories, categoryDepths
            );

            Set<Integer> matchedIds = new HashSet<>();

            if (keyword.isEmpty()) {
                for (Category category : treeList) {
                    matchedIds.add(category.getCategoryId());
                }
            } else {
                String searchKeyword = keyword.toLowerCase();

                for (Category category : treeList) {
                    String name = category.getCategoryName();

                    if (name != null
                            && name.toLowerCase().contains(searchKeyword)) {

                        matchedIds.add(category.getCategoryId());

                        Integer parentId = category.getParentId();
                        Set<Integer> visitedParents = new HashSet<>();

                        while (parentId != null
                                && visitedParents.add(parentId)) {

                            matchedIds.add(parentId);

                            Category parent = categoriesById.get(parentId);

                            if (parent == null) {
                                break;
                            }

                            parentId = parent.getParentId();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            List<Category> categoryList = new ArrayList<>();

            for (Category category : treeList) {
                if (matchedIds.contains(category.getCategoryId())) {
                    categoryList.add(category);
                }
            }

            int totalCategories = categoryList.size();

            Map<Integer, Integer> productCounts
                    = dao.getProductCounts(categoryList);

            Map<Integer, Integer> childCounts
                    = dao.getChildCounts(categoryList);

            request.setAttribute("categoryList", categoryList);
            request.setAttribute("categoryDepths", categoryDepths);
            request.setAttribute("keyword", keyword);
            request.setAttribute("productCounts", productCounts);
            request.setAttribute("childCounts", childCounts);
            request.setAttribute("categoryNames", categoryNames);
            request.setAttribute("totalCategories", totalCategories);

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/category/list.jsp"
            ).forward(request, response);

        } else if ("create".equals(view)) {

            request.setAttribute("categoryList", dao.getList());

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/category/create.jsp"
            ).forward(request, response);

        } else if ("edit".equals(view)) {

            try {
                int id = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                Category category = dao.getById(id);

                if (category == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(
                            request.getContextPath()
                            + "/category?view=list"
                    );
                    return;
                }

                request.setAttribute("category", category);
                request.setAttribute("categoryList", dao.getList());

                request.getRequestDispatcher(
                        "/WEB-INF/category/edit.jsp"
                ).forward(request, response);

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath()
                        + "/category?view=list"
                );
            }

        } else if ("delete".equals(view)) {

            try {
                int id = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                if (id <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }

                Category category = dao.getById(id);

                if (category == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(
                            request.getContextPath()
                            + "/category?view=list&error=notFound"
                    );
                    return;
                }

                int productCount
                        = dao.countProductsByCategoryId(id);

                int childCount
                        = dao.countChildCategories(id);

                request.setAttribute("category", category);
                request.setAttribute("productCount", productCount);
                request.setAttribute("childCount", childCount);

                request.getRequestDispatcher(
                        "/WEB-INF/category/delete.jsp"
                ).forward(request, response);

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.WARNING,
                        "Invalid ID when opening Delete Category",
                        e
                );

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath()
                        + "/category?view=list&error=invalidId"
                );
            }

        } else {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/category?view=list"
            );
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String action = request.getParameter("action");
        CategoryDAO dao = new CategoryDAO();
        String contextPath = request.getContextPath();

        if ("create".equals(action)) {

            try {
                String name = request.getParameter("name");
                String parentIdText
                        = request.getParameter("parentId");

                if (name == null || name.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    forwardCreateWithError(
                            request, response, dao,
                            "Vui lòng nhập tên danh mục.",
                            name
                    );
                    return;
                }

                name = name.trim();

                if (!isValidCategoryName(name)) {
                    forwardCreateWithError(
                            request, response, dao,
                            "Tên danh mục chỉ được chứa chữ cái, chữ số và khoảng trắng.",
                            name
                    );
                    return;
                }

                if (dao.isCategoryNameExists(name)) {
                    forwardCreateWithError(
                            request, response, dao,
                            "Tên danh mục đã tồn tại. Vui lòng nhập tên khác.",
                            name
                    );
                    return;
                }

                Integer parentId = null;

                if (parentIdText != null
                        && !parentIdText.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    parentId = Integer.parseInt(parentIdText);
                }

                if (parentId != null
                        && dao.getById(parentId) == null) {

                    forwardCreateWithError(
                            request, response, dao,
                            "Danh mục cha không tồn tại.",
                            name
                    );
                    return;
                }

                Category category = new Category(
                        0, name, parentId
                );

                int result = dao.insert(category);

                if (result > 0) {

                    User loggedInUser
                            = (User) request.getSession()
                                    .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                    auditLogService.log(
                            loggedInUser,
                            "CREATE_CATEGORY",
                            "CATEGORY",
                            null,
                            "Created category: " + name,
                            request
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(
                            contextPath + "/category?view=list"
                    );
                } else {
                    forwardCreateWithError(
                            request, response, dao,
                            "Không thể thêm danh mục. Vui lòng thử lại.",
                            name
                    );
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Cannot create category",
                        e
                );

                forwardCreateWithError(
                        request, response, dao,
                        "Đã xảy ra lỗi khi thêm danh mục.",
                        request.getParameter("name")
                );
            }

        } else if ("edit".equals(action)) {

            int id = 0;

            try {
                id = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                String name = request.getParameter("name");
                String parentIdText
                        = request.getParameter("parentId");

                Category currentCategory = dao.getById(id);

                if (currentCategory == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(
                            contextPath + "/category?view=list"
                    );
                    return;
                }

                if (name == null || name.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    forwardEditWithError(
                            request, response, dao, currentCategory,
                            "Vui lòng nhập tên danh mục.",
                            name
                    );
                    return;
                }

                name = name.trim();

                if (!isValidCategoryName(name)) {
                    forwardEditWithError(
                            request, response, dao, currentCategory,
                            "Tên danh mục chỉ được chứa chữ cái, chữ số và khoảng trắng.",
                            name
                    );
                    return;
                }

                if (dao.isCategoryNameExists(name, id)) {
                    forwardEditWithError(
                            request, response, dao, currentCategory,
                            "Tên danh mục đã tồn tại. Vui lòng nhập tên khác.",
                            name
                    );
                    return;
                }

                Integer parentId = null;

                if (parentIdText != null
                        && !parentIdText.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    parentId = Integer.parseInt(parentIdText);
                }

                if (parentId != null) {
                    if (parentId == id
                            || dao.getById(parentId) == null) {

                        forwardEditWithError(
                                request, response, dao, currentCategory,
                                "Danh mục cha không hợp lệ.",
                                name
                        );
                        return;
                    }

                    if (isDescendant(dao, parentId, id)) {
                        forwardEditWithError(
                                request, response, dao, currentCategory,
                                "Không thể chọn danh mục con làm danh mục cha.",
                                name
                        );
                        return;
                    }
                }

                Category category = new Category(
                        id, name, parentId
                );

                int result = dao.edit(category);

                if (result > 0) {

                    User loggedInUser
                            = (User) request.getSession()
                                    .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                    auditLogService.log(
                            loggedInUser,
                            "UPDATE_CATEGORY",
                            "CATEGORY",
                            null,
                            "Updated category: " + name,
                            request
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(
                            contextPath + "/category?view=list"
                    );
                } else {
                    forwardEditWithError(
                            request, response, dao, currentCategory,
                            "Không thể cập nhật danh mục. Vui lòng thử lại.",
                            name
                    );
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Cannot edit category",
                        e
                );

                if (id > 0) {
                    Category currentCategory = dao.getById(id);

                    if (currentCategory == null) {
                        response.sendRedirect(
                                contextPath + "/category?view=list"
                        );
                        return;
                    }

                    forwardEditWithError(
                            request, response, dao, currentCategory,
                            "Đã xảy ra lỗi khi cập nhật danh mục.",
                            request.getParameter("name")
                    );
                } else {
                    response.sendRedirect(
                            contextPath + "/category?view=list"
                    );
                }
            }

        } else if ("delete".equals(action)) {

            String idText = request.getParameter("id");
            int id;

            try {
                id = Integer.parseInt(idText);

                if (id <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendRedirect(
                        contextPath
                        + "/category?view=list&error=invalidId"
                );
                return;
            }

            try {
                Category existing = dao.getById(id);

                if (existing == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(
                            contextPath
                            + "/category?view=list&error=notFound"
                    );
                    return;
                }

                int productCount
                        = dao.countProductsByCategoryId(id);

                int childCount
                        = dao.countChildCategories(id);

                if (productCount > 0 || childCount > 0) {
                    response.sendRedirect(
                            contextPath
                            + "/category?view=delete&id=" + id
                            + "&error=hasProducts"
                    );
                    return;
                }

                int result = dao.delete(existing);

                if (result == 1) {

                    User loggedInUser
                            = (User) request.getSession()
                                    .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                    auditLogService.log(
                            loggedInUser,
                            "DELETE_CATEGORY",
                            "CATEGORY",
                            null,
                            "Deleted category: " + existing.getCategoryName(),
                            request
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(
                            contextPath
                            + "/category?view=list&success=delete"
                    );
                } else {
                    response.sendRedirect(
                            contextPath
                            + "/category?view=delete&id=" + id
                            + "&error=delete"
                    );
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Cannot delete category",
                        e
                );

                response.sendRedirect(
                        contextPath
                        + "/category?view=delete&id=" + id
                        + "&error=server"
                );
            }

        } else {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    contextPath + "/category?view=list"
            );
        }
    }

    private boolean isValidCategoryName(String name) {
        return name != null
                && name.matches("^[\\p{L}\\p{M}\\p{N} ]+$");
    }

    private void forwardCreateWithError(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            CategoryDAO dao,
            String errorMessage,
            String name)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setAttribute("errorMessage", errorMessage);
        request.setAttribute("submittedName", name);
        request.setAttribute("categoryList", dao.getList());

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/category/create.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    private void forwardEditWithError(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            CategoryDAO dao,
            Category category,
            String errorMessage,
            String name)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        category.setCategoryName(name);

        request.setAttribute("errorMessage", errorMessage);
        request.setAttribute("category", category);
        request.setAttribute("categoryList", dao.getList());

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/category/edit.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    private boolean isDescendant(
            CategoryDAO dao, int parentId, int categoryId) {

        Category current = dao.getById(parentId);
        Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();

        while (current != null
                && visited.add(current.getCategoryId())
                && current.getParentId() != null) {

            int currentParentId = current.getParentId();

            if (currentParentId == categoryId) {
                return true;
            }

            current = dao.getById(currentParentId);
        }

        return false;
    }

    private List<Category> buildCategoryTree(
            List<Category> categories,
            Map<Integer, Integer> categoryDepths) {

        Map<Integer, List<Category>> children = new HashMap<>();
        List<Category> roots = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<Integer> categoryIds = new HashSet<>();
        Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();

        for (Category category : categories) {
            categoryIds.add(category.getCategoryId());

            children.put(
                    category.getCategoryId(),
                    new ArrayList<>()
            );
        }

        for (Category category : categories) {
            Integer parentId = category.getParentId();

            if (parentId == null
                    || !categoryIds.contains(parentId)
                    || parentId == category.getCategoryId()) {
                roots.add(category);
            } else {
                children.get(parentId).add(category);
            }
        }

        Comparator<Category> byName = Comparator.comparing(
                Category::getCategoryName,
                Comparator.nullsLast(
                        String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER
                )
        );

        roots.sort(byName);

        for (List<Category> childList : children.values()) {
            childList.sort(byName);
        }

        List<Category> result = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Category root : roots) {
            appendCategoryTree(
                    root,
                    0,
                    children,
                    result,
                    categoryDepths,
                    visited
            );
        }

        for (Category category : categories) {
            if (!visited.contains(category.getCategoryId())) {
                appendCategoryTree(
                        category,
                        0,
                        children,
                        result,
                        categoryDepths,
                        visited
                );
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    private void appendCategoryTree(
            Category category,
            int depth,
            Map<Integer, List<Category>> children,
            List<Category> result,
            Map<Integer, Integer> categoryDepths,
            Set<Integer> visited) {

        int categoryId = category.getCategoryId();

        if (!visited.add(categoryId)) {
            return;
        }

        result.add(category);
        categoryDepths.put(categoryId, depth);

        List<Category> childList = children.get(categoryId);

        if (childList != null) {
            for (Category child : childList) {
                appendCategoryTree(
                        child,
                        depth + 1,
                        children,
                        result,
                        categoryDepths,
                        visited
                );
            }
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.AddressDAO;
import dao.CartDAO;
import dao.OrderDAO;
import dao.VoucherDAO;

import model.Address;
import model.CartItem;
import model.Order;
import model.User;
import model.Voucher;

import payment.PaymentGateway;
import service.OrderService;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "CheckoutServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/checkout"}
)
public class CheckoutServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(CheckoutServlet.class.getName());

    private final CartDAO cartDAO = new CartDAO();
    private final AddressDAO addressDAO = new AddressDAO();
    private final OrderDAO orderDAO = new OrderDAO();
    private final VoucherDAO voucherDAO = new VoucherDAO();
    private final OrderService orderService = new OrderService();

    // Hien thi checkout voi cac san pham da chon
    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        User user = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (user == null) {
            redirectToLogin(request, response);
            return;
        }

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        String[] values = request.getParameterValues("selectedItems");

        if (values != null) {
            List<Integer> ids = parseSelectedIds(values);

            if (ids.isEmpty()) {
                session.setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        "Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một sản phẩm."
                );

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath() + "/cart"
                );
                return;
            }

            session.setAttribute("checkoutSelectedItemIds", ids);
        }

        showCheckout(request, response, user);
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String action = request.getParameter("action");
        User user = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (user == null) {
            if ("selectAddress".equals(action)
                    || "editAddress".equals(action)
                    || "deleteAddress".equals(action)) {

                sendJsonError(
                        response,
                        401,
                        "Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn. "
                        + "Vui lòng đăng nhập lại."
                );
            } else {
                redirectToLogin(request, response);
            }
            return;
        }

        if ("addAddress".equals(action)) {
            addAddress(request, response, user);

        } else if ("selectAddress".equals(action)) {
            selectAddress(request, response, user);

        } else if ("editAddress".equals(action)) {
            editAddress(request, response, user);

        } else if ("deleteAddress".equals(action)) {
            deleteAddress(request, response, user);

        } else if ("applyVoucher".equals(action)) {
            applyVoucher(request, response, user);

        } else if ("removeVoucher".equals(action)) {
            removeVoucher(request, response);

        } else if ("placeOrder".equals(action)) {
            placeOrder(request, response, user);

        } else {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Action không hợp lệ."
            );
        }
    }

    private void showCheckout(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        int userId = user.getUserId();
        int cartId = cartDAO.getCartIdByUserId(userId);

        if (cartId <= 0) {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/cart"
            );
            return;
        }

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        List<Integer> selectedIds = getSelectedIds(session);

        if (selectedIds.isEmpty()) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Vui lòng chọn sản phẩm cần đặt hàng."
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/cart"
            );
            return;
        }

        List<CartItem> cartItems = cartDAO.getCartItemsByIds(
                cartId,
                selectedIds
        );

        if (cartItems == null
                || cartItems.isEmpty()
                || cartItems.size() != selectedIds.size()) {

            session.removeAttribute("checkoutSelectedItemIds");
            session.removeAttribute("appliedVoucher");

            session.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Một số sản phẩm đã không còn trong giỏ hàng."
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/cart"
            );
            return;
        }

        for (CartItem item : cartItems) {
            if (item.getStockQuantity() <= 0
                    || item.getQuantity() > item.getStockQuantity()) {

                session.setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        "Sản phẩm " + item.getProductName()
                        + " không đủ số lượng tồn kho."
                );

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath() + "/cart"
                );
                return;
            }
        }

        synchronized (session) {
            if (session.getAttribute("addressAddToken") == null) {
                session.setAttribute(
                        "addressAddToken",
                        UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                );
            }

            if (session.getAttribute("addressActionToken") == null) {
                session.setAttribute(
                        "addressActionToken",
                        UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                );
            }

            if (session.getAttribute("checkoutToken") == null) {
                session.setAttribute(
                        "checkoutToken",
                        UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                );
            }
        }

        List<Address> addresses =
                addressDAO.getAddressesByUser(userId);

        Address selectedAddress = null;
        Object savedId = session.getAttribute("selectedAddressId");

        if (savedId instanceof Integer) {
            selectedAddress = addressDAO.getAddressById(
                    (Integer) savedId,
                    userId
            );
        }

        if (selectedAddress == null
                && addresses != null
                && !addresses.isEmpty()) {

            selectedAddress = addresses.get(0);
        }

        if (selectedAddress != null) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "selectedAddressId",
                    selectedAddress.getAddressId()
            );
        } else {
            session.removeAttribute("selectedAddressId");
        }

        double subtotal = calculateSubtotal(cartItems);
        double shippingFee = OrderService.calculateShippingFee(BigDecimal.valueOf(subtotal)).doubleValue();
        double discount = 0;

        Voucher appliedVoucher =
                (Voucher) session.getAttribute("appliedVoucher");

        if (appliedVoucher != null) {
            Voucher valid = voucherDAO.getValidVoucher(
                    appliedVoucher.getCode(),
                    subtotal,
                    userId
            );

            if (valid != null) {
                appliedVoucher = valid;

                discount = voucherDAO.calculateDiscount(
                        valid,
                        subtotal
                );

                session.setAttribute("appliedVoucher", valid);
            } else {
                appliedVoucher = null;
                session.removeAttribute("appliedVoucher");

                session.setAttribute(
                        "checkoutError",
                        "Voucher đã chọn không còn phù hợp "
                        + "với đơn hàng này."
                );
            }
        }

        List<Voucher> availableVouchers =
                voucherDAO.getAvailableVouchers(subtotal, userId);

        request.setAttribute("cartItems", cartItems);
        request.setAttribute("addresses", addresses);
        request.setAttribute("selectedAddress", selectedAddress);
        request.setAttribute("availableVouchers", availableVouchers);
        request.setAttribute("appliedVoucher", appliedVoucher);
        request.setAttribute("subtotal", subtotal);
        request.setAttribute("shippingFee", shippingFee);
        request.setAttribute("discount", discount);

        request.setAttribute(
                "totalAmount",
                Math.max(0, subtotal + shippingFee - discount)
        );

        try {
            request.setAttribute("orderingRestriction", orderService.orderingRestriction(userId));
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new ServletException("Không kiểm tra được quyền đặt hàng.", e);
        }

        request.setAttribute(
                "vnpayAvailable",
                PaymentGateway.available("VNPAY")
        );

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/checkout/checkout.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    private void addAddress(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        String submittedToken = request.getParameter("addressAddToken");

        synchronized (session) {
            String expectedToken =
                    (String) session.getAttribute("addressAddToken");

            if (expectedToken == null
                    || submittedToken == null
                    || !expectedToken.equals(submittedToken)) {

                session.setAttribute(
                        "checkoutError",
                        "Yêu cầu thêm địa chỉ đã được xử lý "
                        + "hoặc hết hạn."
                );

                redirectToCheckout(request, response);
                return;
            }

            session.removeAttribute("addressAddToken");
        }

        String name = request.getParameter("recipientName");
        String phone = request.getParameter("phoneNumber");
        String line = request.getParameter("addressLine");

        if (!validAddressInput(name, phone, line)) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutError",
                    "Thông tin địa chỉ không hợp lệ."
            );

            redirectToCheckout(request, response);
            return;
        }

        int newId = addressDAO.insertAddress(
                user.getUserId(),
                name.trim(),
                phone.trim(),
                line.trim()
        );

        if (newId > 0) {
            session.setAttribute("selectedAddressId", newId);

            try {
                if (!addressDAO.setDefaultAddress(
                        newId,
                        user.getUserId()
                )) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Không lưu được địa chỉ mặc định."
                    );
                }

            } catch (SQLException e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Không lưu được địa chỉ mặc định mới.",
                        e
                );

                session.setAttribute(
                        "checkoutError",
                        "Đã thêm địa chỉ nhưng chưa lưu được "
                        + "địa chỉ mặc định. Vui lòng chọn lại địa chỉ."
                );

                redirectToCheckout(request, response);
                return;
            }

            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutMessage",
                    "Đã thêm địa chỉ thành công."
            );

        } else {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutError",
                    "Không thể thêm địa chỉ."
            );
        }

        redirectToCheckout(request, response);
    }

    private void selectAddress(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        if (!validAddressActionToken(request, session)) {
            sendJsonError(
                    response,
                    403,
                    "Yêu cầu chọn địa chỉ không hợp lệ."
            );
            return;
        }

        int addressId = parsePositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("addressId")
        );

        if (addressId <= 0) {
            sendJsonError(response, 400, "ID địa chỉ không hợp lệ.");
            return;
        }

        synchronized (session) {
            Address address = addressDAO.getAddressById(
                    addressId,
                    user.getUserId()
            );

            if (address == null) {
                sendJsonError(
                        response,
                        404,
                        "Địa chỉ không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa."
                );
                return;
            }

            try {
                if (!addressDAO.setDefaultAddress(
                        addressId,
                        user.getUserId()
                )) {
                    sendJsonError(
                            response,
                            404,
                            "Địa chỉ không còn khả dụng."
                    );
                    return;
                }

                session.setAttribute("selectedAddressId", addressId);
                address.setDefaultAddress(true);

                sendSelectedAddressJson(
                        response,
                        addressId,
                        address
                );

            } catch (SQLException e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Không lưu được địa chỉ checkout.",
                        e
                );

                sendJsonError(
                        response,
                        500,
                        "Chưa lưu được địa chỉ đã chọn. "
                        + "Vui lòng thử lại."
                );
            }
        }
    }

    private void editAddress(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        if (!validAddressActionToken(request, session)) {
            sendJsonError(
                    response,
                    403,
                    "Yêu cầu sửa địa chỉ không hợp lệ. "
                    + "Vui lòng tải lại trang."
            );
            return;
        }

        int addressId = parsePositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("addressId")
        );

        String name = request.getParameter("recipientName");
        String phone = request.getParameter("phoneNumber");
        String line = request.getParameter("addressLine");

        if (addressId <= 0 || !validAddressInput(name, phone, line)) {
            sendJsonError(
                    response,
                    400,
                    "Nhập đủ tên (tối đa 100 ký tự), "
                    + "số điện thoại 9–11 chữ số và địa chỉ."
            );
            return;
        }

        synchronized (session) {
            try {
                boolean updated = addressDAO.updateAddress(
                        addressId,
                        user.getUserId(),
                        name.trim(),
                        phone.trim(),
                        line.trim()
                );

                if (!updated) {
                    sendJsonError(
                            response,
                            404,
                            "Địa chỉ không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa."
                    );
                    return;
                }

                response.setContentType(
                        "application/json;charset=UTF-8"
                );

                String json =
                        "{\"success\":true,"
                        + "\"address\":{"
                        + "\"addressId\":" + addressId + ","
                        + "\"recipientName\":\""
                        + jsonEscape(name.trim()) + "\","
                        + "\"phoneNumber\":\""
                        + jsonEscape(phone.trim()) + "\","
                        + "\"addressLine\":\""
                        + jsonEscape(line.trim()) + "\"}}";

                response.getWriter().write(json);

            } catch (SQLException e) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi sửa địa chỉ.", e);

                sendJsonError(
                        response,
                        500,
                        "Không thể lưu địa chỉ. Vui lòng thử lại."
                );
            }
        }
    }

    private void deleteAddress(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        if (!validAddressActionToken(request, session)) {
            sendJsonError(
                    response,
                    403,
                    "Yêu cầu xóa địa chỉ không hợp lệ."
            );
            return;
        }

        int addressId = parsePositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("addressId")
        );

        if (addressId <= 0) {
            sendJsonError(response, 400, "ID địa chỉ không hợp lệ.");
            return;
        }

        synchronized (session) {
            Object selected = session.getAttribute("selectedAddressId");

            if (selected instanceof Integer
                    && ((Integer) selected) == addressId) {

                sendJsonError(
                        response,
                        409,
                        "Không thể xóa địa chỉ đang chọn. "
                        + "Vui lòng chọn và xác nhận địa chỉ khác trước."
                );
                return;
            }

            boolean deleted = addressDAO.deleteAddress(
                    addressId,
                    user.getUserId()
            );

            if (!deleted) {
                sendJsonError(
                        response,
                        400,
                        "Không thể xóa địa chỉ này."
                );
                return;
            }

            response.setContentType(
                    "application/json;charset=UTF-8"
            );

            response.getWriter().write(
                    "{\"success\":true,\"deletedId\":"
                    + addressId + "}"
            );
        }
    }

    // Ap dung voucher cho cac san pham duoc chon
    private void applyVoucher(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        String code = request.getParameter("voucherCode");

        if (code == null || code.trim().isEmpty()) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutError",
                    "Vui lòng chọn Voucher."
            );

            redirectToCheckout(request, response);
            return;
        }

        int cartId = cartDAO.getCartIdByUserId(user.getUserId());

        if (cartId <= 0) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutError",
                    "Giỏ hàng đang trống."
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/cart"
            );
            return;
        }

        List<CartItem> items = getSelectedCartItems(session, cartId);
        List<Integer> selectedIds = getSelectedIds(session);

        if (items.isEmpty() || items.size() != selectedIds.size()) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutError",
                    "Không tìm thấy đầy đủ các sản phẩm đang Checkout."
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/cart"
            );
            return;
        }

        double subtotal = calculateSubtotal(items);

        Voucher voucher = voucherDAO.getValidVoucher(
                code.trim(),
                subtotal,
                user.getUserId()
        );

        if (voucher == null) {
