            session.removeAttribute("appliedVoucher");
            
            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutError",
                    "Voucher không hợp lệ, chưa đủ điều kiện "
                    + "hoặc đã hết lượt."
            );

        } else {
            session.setAttribute("appliedVoucher", voucher);

            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutMessage",
                    "Áp dụng Voucher " + voucher.getCode()
                    + " thành công."
            );
        }

        redirectToCheckout(request, response);
    }

    private void removeVoucher(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        session.removeAttribute("appliedVoucher");
        session.setAttribute("checkoutMessage", "Đã bỏ Voucher.");

        redirectToCheckout(request, response);
    }

    private void placeOrder(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        String checkoutToken = request.getParameter("checkoutToken");

        try {
            if (checkoutToken == null
                    || !checkoutToken.matches("[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}")) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Phiên đặt hàng không hợp lệ. "
                        + "Vui lòng tải lại Checkout."
                );
            }

            int orderId;

            synchronized (session) {
                Integer existingOrderId = orderDAO.findIdByToken(
                        user.getUserId(),
                        checkoutToken
                );

                if (existingOrderId != null) {
                    orderId = existingOrderId;

                } else {
                    Object expectedToken =
                            session.getAttribute("checkoutToken");

                    if (!(expectedToken instanceof String)
                            || !checkoutToken.equals(expectedToken)) {

                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Phiên đặt hàng đã hết hạn. "
                                + "Vui lòng tải lại Checkout."
                        );
                    }

                    String method = request.getParameter("paymentMethod");
                    PaymentGateway.requireConfigured(method);

                    int addressId = parsePositiveInt(
                            request.getParameter("addressId")
                    );

                    Object selectedAddressId =
                            session.getAttribute("selectedAddressId");

                    if (addressId <= 0
                            || !(selectedAddressId instanceof Integer)
                            || ((Integer) selectedAddressId) != addressId) {

                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Vui lòng chọn và xác nhận "
                                + "địa chỉ giao hàng."
                        );
                    }

                    List<Integer> selectedIds = getSelectedIds(session);

                    if (selectedIds.isEmpty()) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Không tìm thấy sản phẩm đã chọn."
                        );
                    }

                    Voucher voucher =
                            (Voucher) session.getAttribute("appliedVoucher");

                    String voucherCode = voucher == null
                            ? null
                            : voucher.getCode();

                    orderId = orderService.placeOrder(
                            user.getUserId(),
                            addressId,
                            checkoutToken,
                            voucherCode,
                            selectedIds,
                            method
                    );
                }

                if (checkoutToken.equals(
                        session.getAttribute("checkoutToken")
                )) {
                    session.removeAttribute("checkoutToken");
                    session.removeAttribute("appliedVoucher");
                    session.removeAttribute("checkoutSelectedItemIds");
                }
            }

            Order savedOrder = orderDAO.findByIdAndUser(
                    orderId,
                    user.getUserId()
            );

            String nextPage =
                    savedOrder != null
                    && "PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(savedOrder.getOrderStatus())
                            ? "/payment?id="
                            : "/order-success?id=";

            response.setStatus(HttpServletResponse.SC_SEE_OTHER);

            response.setHeader(
                    "Location",
                    response.encodeRedirectURL(
                            request.getContextPath() + nextPage + orderId
                    )
            );

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            session.setAttribute("checkoutError", e.getMessage());
            redirectToCheckout(request, response);

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi đặt hàng.", e);

            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutError",
                    "Chưa xác nhận được kết quả đặt hàng. "
                    + "Vui lòng thử lại."
            );

            redirectToCheckout(request, response);
        }
    }

    private List<Integer> getSelectedIds(HttpSession session) {
        Object value = session.getAttribute("checkoutSelectedItemIds");

        if (!(value instanceof List<?>)) {
            return new ArrayList<>();
        }

        List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Object item : (List<?>) value) {
            if (item instanceof Integer) {
                Integer id = (Integer) item;

                if (id > 0 && !result.contains(id)) {
                    result.add(id);
                }
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    private List<CartItem> getSelectedCartItems(
            HttpSession session,
            int cartId
    ) {
        if (cartId <= 0) {
            return new ArrayList<>();
        }

        List<Integer> ids = getSelectedIds(session);

        if (ids.isEmpty()) {
            return new ArrayList<>();
        }

        List<CartItem> items = cartDAO.getCartItemsByIds(cartId, ids);

        return items == null ? new ArrayList<>() : items;
    }

    private List<Integer> parseSelectedIds(String[] values) {
        List<Integer> list = new ArrayList<>();

        if (values == null) {
            return list;
        }

        for (String value : values) {
            int id = parsePositiveInt(value);

            if (id > 0 && !list.contains(id)) {
                list.add(id);
            }
        }

        return list;
    }

    private double calculateSubtotal(List<CartItem> items) {
        double total = 0;

        if (items == null) {
            return total;
        }

        for (CartItem item : items) {
            total += item.getPrice() * item.getQuantity();
        }

        return total;
    }

    private boolean validAddressInput(
            String name,
            String phone,
            String line
    ) {
        return name != null
                && !name.trim().isEmpty()
                && name.trim().length() <= 100
                && phone != null
                && phone.trim().matches("[0-9]{9,11}")
                && line != null
                && !line.trim().isEmpty();
    }

    private boolean validAddressActionToken(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpSession session
    ) {
        String submitted = request.getParameter("addressActionToken");
        Object expected = session.getAttribute("addressActionToken");

        return submitted != null
                && expected instanceof String
                && submitted.equals(expected);
    }

    private void sendSelectedAddressJson(
            HttpServletResponse response,
            int addressId,
            Address address
    ) throws IOException {

        response.setContentType("application/json;charset=UTF-8");

        String json =
                "{\"success\":true,"
                + "\"selectedAddress\":{"
                + "\"addressId\":" + addressId + ","
                + "\"recipientName\":\""
                + jsonEscape(address.getRecipientName()) + "\","
                + "\"phoneNumber\":\""
                + jsonEscape(address.getPhoneNumber()) + "\","
                + "\"addressLine\":\""
                + jsonEscape(address.getAddressLine()) + "\","
                + "\"defaultAddress\":"
                + address.isDefaultAddress() + "}}";

        response.getWriter().write(json);
    }

    private void sendJsonError(
            HttpServletResponse response,
            int status,
            String message
    ) throws IOException {

        response.setStatus(status);
        response.setContentType("application/json;charset=UTF-8");

        response.getWriter().write(
                "{\"success\":false,\"message\":\""
                + jsonEscape(message) + "\"}"
        );
    }

    private String jsonEscape(String value) {
        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }

        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();

        for (char c : value.toCharArray()) {
            switch (c) {
                case '"':
                    result.append("\\\"");
                    break;

                case '\\':
                    result.append("\\\\");
                    break;

                case '\n':
                    result.append("\\n");
                    break;

                case '\r':
                    result.append("\\r");
                    break;

                case '\t':
                    result.append("\\t");
                    break;

                default:
                    if (c < 0x20) {
                        result.append(
                                String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c)
                        );
                    } else {
                        result.append(c);
                    }
                    break;
            }
        }

        return result.toString();
    }

    private int parsePositiveInt(String value) {
        try {
            int id = Integer.parseInt(value);
            return id > 0 ? id : -1;

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    private User getLoggedInUser(HttpServletRequest request) {
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            return null;
        }

        Object value = session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        return value instanceof User ? (User) value : null;
    }

    private void redirectToLogin(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws IOException {

        request.getSession().setAttribute(
                "redirectUrl",
                request.getContextPath() + "/checkout"
        );

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath() + "/login"
        );
    }

    private void redirectToCheckout(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath() + "/checkout"
        );
    }
}package controller;

import dao.OrderDAO;
import dao.ReturnExchangeDAO;
import dao.PaymentRefundDAO;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import model.Order;
import model.User;
import service.OrderService;
import service.OrderCancellationService;

@WebServlet(
        name = "CustomerOrderServlet",
        urlPatterns = {
            "/my-orders",
            "/my-orders/detail",
            "/my-orders/cancel"
        }
)
public class CustomerOrderServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(CustomerOrderServlet.class.getName());

    private final OrderDAO orders = new OrderDAO();
    private final OrderService service = new OrderService();

    private final ReturnExchangeDAO returnExchangeDAO
            = new ReturnExchangeDAO();

    private final PaymentRefundDAO paymentRefundDAO
            = new PaymentRefundDAO();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        User user = customer(request, response);

        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        if ("/my-orders/cancel".equals(request.getServletPath())) {
            response.setHeader("Allow", "POST");
            response.sendError(405);
            return;
        }

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        synchronized (session) {
            if (session.getAttribute("customerOrderToken") == null) {
                session.setAttribute(
                        "customerOrderToken",
                        UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                );
            }
        }

        request.setAttribute(
                "statusLabels",
                OrderService.statusLabels()
        );

        try {

            if ("/my-orders".equals(request.getServletPath())) {

                Map<String, String> tabs
                        = OrderService.purchaseTabs();

                String tab = request.getParameter("status");

                tab = tab == null
                        ? "ALL"
                        : tab.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

                if (!tabs.containsKey(tab)) {
                    tab = "ALL";
                }

                String query = request.getParameter("q");

                query = query == null ? "" : query.trim();

                if (query.length() > 100) {
                    query = query.substring(0, 100);
                }

                Map<String, Long> counts
                        = OrderService.purchaseTabCounts(
                                orders.countPurchasesByStatus(
                                        user.getUserId(),
                                        query
                                )
                        );

                long total = counts.getOrDefault(tab, 0L);

                long pageCount = Math.max(
                        1L,
                        (total + 9) / 10
                );

                long page = Math.min(
                        pageCount,
                        Math.max(
                                1L,
                                positiveId(request.getParameter("page"))
                        )
                );

                List<Order> list = orders.findPurchasePage(
                        user.getUserId(),
                        query,
                        OrderService.statusesForTab(tab),
                        (page - 1) * 10,
                        10
                );

                for (Order order : list) {
                    order.setOrderStatus(
                            OrderService.normalizeStatus(
                                    order.getOrderStatus()
                            )
                    );
                }

                List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();

                for (Order order : list) {
                    ids.add(order.getOrderId());
                }

                request.setAttribute(
                        "orderItems",
                        orders.findItemsForOrders(
                                user.getUserId(),
                                ids
                        )
                );

                request.setAttribute("tabs", tabs);
                request.setAttribute("tabCounts", counts);
                request.setAttribute("activeTab", tab);
                request.setAttribute("query", query);
                request.setAttribute("currentPage", page);
                request.setAttribute("pageCount", pageCount);
                request.setAttribute("resultCount", total);
                request.setAttribute("orders", list);

                request.getRequestDispatcher(
                        "/WEB-INF/customer-orders/list.jsp"
                ).forward(request, response);

                return;
            }

            int id = positiveId(request.getParameter("id"));

            if (id < 1) {
                response.sendError(
                        400,
                        "Mã đơn hàng không hợp lệ."
                );
                return;
            }

            Order order = orders.findByIdAndUser(
                    id,
                    user.getUserId()
            );

            if (order == null) {
                response.sendError(
                        404,
                        "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                );
                return;
            }

            order.setOrderStatus(
                    OrderService.normalizeStatus(
                            order.getOrderStatus()
                    )
            );

            request.setAttribute("order", order);
            request.setAttribute("canCancelOrder",
                    OrderCancellationService.canCancel(order.getOrderStatus()));

            request.setAttribute(
                    "refunds",
                    paymentRefundDAO.findForCustomer(
                            id,
                            user.getUserId()
                    )
            );

            String orderStatus = order.getOrderStatus();

            boolean canRequestReturnExchange
                    = returnExchangeDAO.canRequest(id, user.getUserId());

            request.setAttribute(
                    "canRequestReturnExchange",
                    canRequestReturnExchange
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "latestReturnExchangeRequest",
                    returnExchangeDAO.getLatestRequestByOrder(
                            id,
                            user.getUserId()
                    )
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "items",
                    orders.findItems(
                            id,
                            user.getUserId()
                    )
            );

            List<Map<String, Object>> history
                    = service.findHistory(
                            id,
                            user.getUserId()
                    );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "trackingSteps",
                    OrderService.trackingSteps(
                            order,
                            history
                    )
            );

            Collections.reverse(history);

            request.setAttribute("history", history);

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/customer-orders/detail.jsp"
            ).forward(request, response);

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot load customer orders",
                    ex
            );

            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                    "Chưa tải được đơn hàng. Vui lòng thử lại."
            );
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        User user = customer(request, response);

        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        if (!"/my-orders/cancel"
                .equals(request.getServletPath())) {

            response.setHeader("Allow", "GET");
            response.sendError(405);
            return;
        }

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        String token = request.getParameter("csrfToken");

        if (token == null
                || !token.equals(
                        session.getAttribute("customerOrderToken")
                )) {

            response.sendError(
                    403,
                    "Yêu cầu không hợp lệ. Vui lòng tải lại trang."
            );
            return;
        }

        int id = positiveId(request.getParameter("id"));

        if (id < 1) {
            response.sendError(
                    400,
                    "Mã đơn hàng không hợp lệ."
            );
            return;
        }

        try {

            if (orders.findByIdAndUser(
                    id,
                    user.getUserId()
            ) == null) {

                response.sendError(
                        404,
                        "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                );
                return;
            }

            boolean changed
                    = service.cancelOrderByCustomer(
                            user.getUserId(),
                            id
                    );

            session.setAttribute(
                    "customerOrderMessage",
                    changed
                            ? "Đã hủy đơn hàng thành công."
                            : "Đơn hàng đã được hủy trước đó."
            );

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "customerOrderError",
                    ex.getMessage()
            );

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot cancel customer order",
                    ex
            );

            session.setAttribute(
                    "customerOrderError",
                    "Chưa xác nhận được kết quả hủy. "
                    + "Vui lòng tải lại đơn hàng và thử lại."
            );
        }

        response.setStatus(
                HttpServletResponse.SC_SEE_OTHER
        );

        response.setHeader(
                "Location",
                response.encodeRedirectURL(
                        request.getContextPath()
                        + "/my-orders/detail?id="
                        + id
                )
        );
    }

    private User customer(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession(false);

        Object value = session == null
                ? null
                : session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (!(value instanceof User)) {

            request.getSession().setAttribute(
                    "redirectUrl",
                    request.getContextPath() + "/my-orders"
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/login"
            );

            return null;
        }

        User user = (User) value;

        if (!user.isCustomer()) {
            response.sendError(403);
            return null;
        }

        return user;
    }

    private int positiveId(String value) {

        try {
            return Math.max(
                    -1,
                    Integer.parseInt(value)
            );
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import service.EmailService;
import service.PasswordResetService;

@WebServlet(name = "ForgotPasswordServlet", urlPatterns = {"/forgot-password"})
public class ForgotPasswordServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(ForgotPasswordServlet.class.getName());

    private final PasswordResetService passwordResetService
            = new PasswordResetService();

    private final EmailService emailService
            = new EmailService();

    
    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/forgot-password.jsp")
                .forward(request, response);
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String email = request.getParameter("email");

        if (email == null || email.trim().isEmpty()) {

            request.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Vui lòng nhập email!"
            );

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/forgot-password.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

            return;
        }

        email = email.trim();

        try {
            if (!emailService.emailExists(email)) {
                request.setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        "Email chưa được đăng ký trong hệ thống"
                );

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/forgot-password.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);
                return;

            }

            try {

                
                String token
                        = passwordResetService.createResetToken(email, 15);

                if (token != null) {

                    String resetLink = buildResetLink(
                            request,
                            token
                    );

               
                    boolean sent
                            = emailService.sendResetPasswordEmail(
                                    email,
                                    resetLink
                            );

                    if (!sent) {
                        LOGGER.log(
                                Level.WARNING,
                                "Không thể gửi email reset password tới: {0}",
                                email);
                        request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/forgot-password.jsp")
                                .forward(request, response);

                        return;
                    }

                }
              
                request.setAttribute(
                        "successMessage",
                        "Nếu email tồn tại trong hệ thống, "
                        + "Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu đã được gửi đến email của bạn."
                );

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/forgot-password.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);

            } catch (Exception ex) {

                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Lỗi xử lý quên mật khẩu!",
                        ex
                );

                request.setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        "Đã xảy ra lỗi. Vui lòng thử lại sau!"
                );

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/forgot-password.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);
            }
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ForgotPasswordServlet.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, null, ex);
        }
    }

  
    private String buildResetLink(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String token) {

        StringBuilder url = new StringBuilder();

        url.append(request.getScheme())
                .append("://")
                .append(request.getServerName());

        int port = request.getServerPort();

        boolean defaultHttpPort
                = request.getScheme().equals("http")
                && port == 80;

        boolean defaultHttpsPort
                = request.getScheme().equals("https")
                && port == 443;

        if (!defaultHttpPort && !defaultHttpsPort) {
            url.append(":").append(port);
        }

        url.append(request.getContextPath())
                .append("/reset-password?token=")
                .append(
                        URLEncoder.encode(
                                token,
                                StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                        )
                );

        return url.toString();
    }
}

package controller;

import dao.InventoryDAO;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(name = "InventoryServlet", urlPatterns = {"/inventory"})
public class InventoryServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(InventoryServlet.class.getName());
    private static final int PAGE_SIZE = 25;
    private static final String JSP = "/WEB-INF/inventory/list.jsp";

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
        User user = authorize(request, response);
        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        String keyword = trim(request.getParameter("keyword"));
        if (keyword.length() > 100) {
            keyword = keyword.substring(0, 100);
        }
        String status = normalizeStatus(request.getParameter("status"));
        int page = positiveInt(request.getParameter("page"), 1);
        page = Math.min(page, 100000);
        InventoryDAO dao = new InventoryDAO();
        try {
            int total = dao.countItems(keyword, status);
            int pages = Math.max(1, (total + PAGE_SIZE - 1) / PAGE_SIZE);
            page = Math.min(page, pages);

            request.setAttribute("items",
                    dao.findItems(keyword, status, page, PAGE_SIZE));
            request.setAttribute("movements", dao.getRecentMovements(40));
            request.setAttribute("keyword", keyword);
            request.setAttribute("status", status);
            request.setAttribute("pageNumber", page);
            request.setAttribute("totalPages", pages);
            request.setAttribute("totalItems", total);
            request.setAttribute("csrfToken", csrfToken(request.getSession()));
            request.getRequestDispatcher(JSP).forward(request, response);
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot load inventory", ex);
            throw new ServletException("Không thể tải dữ liệu tồn kho.", ex);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
        User user = authorize(request, response);
        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
        String actual = request.getParameter("csrfToken");
        String expected = (String) session.getAttribute("inventoryCsrfToken");
        if (!constantTimeEquals(expected, actual)) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN, "CSRF token không hợp lệ.");
            return;
        }

        String action = trim(request.getParameter("action"));
        String note = trim(request.getParameter("note"));
        int skuId = positiveInt(request.getParameter("skuId"), -1);
        int quantity = nonnegativeInt(request.getParameter("quantity"));
        try {
            if (skuId <= 0 || quantity < 0) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("SKU hoặc số lượng không hợp lệ.");
            }
            int newStock = new InventoryDAO().changeStock(
                    skuId, action, quantity, note, user.getUserId());
            session.setAttribute("inventorySuccess",
                    "Cập nhật tồn kho thành công. Số tồn mới: " + newStock + ".");
            session.removeAttribute("inventoryError");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException | IllegalStateException ex) {
            session.setAttribute("inventoryError", ex.getMessage());
            session.removeAttribute("inventorySuccess");
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Stock update failed", ex);
            session.setAttribute("inventoryError",
                    "Không thể cập nhật tồn kho. Vui lòng kiểm tra log và thử lại.");
            session.removeAttribute("inventorySuccess");
        }
        response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/inventory");
    }

    /**
     * Checks both login and actual database role; do not rely on a URL filter
     * alone.
     */
    private User authorize(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException, ServletException {
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
        Object logged = session == null ? null : session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");
        if (!(logged instanceof User)) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return null;
        }
        User user = (User) logged;
        try {
            if (!new InventoryDAO().isAuthorizedStaff(user.getUserId())) {
                response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN,
                        "Chỉ Staff/Admin có thể quản lý tồn kho.");
                return null;
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot check inventory access", ex);
            throw new ServletException("Không thể kiểm tra quyền truy cập kho.", ex);
        }
        return user;
    }

    private static String csrfToken(HttpSession session) {
        String token = (String) session.getAttribute("inventoryCsrfToken");
        if (token == null) {
            token = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
            session.setAttribute("inventoryCsrfToken", token);
        }
        return token;
    }

    private static boolean constantTimeEquals(String first, String second) {
        if (first == null || second == null) {
            return false;
        }
        return MessageDigest.isEqual(
                first.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
                second.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }

    private static String normalizeStatus(String status) {
        return "LOW".equals(status) || "OUT".equals(status) ? status : "ALL";
    }

    private static String trim(String value) {
        return value == null ? "" : value.trim();
    }

    private static int positiveInt(String value, int fallback) {
        try {
            int number = Integer.parseInt(trim(value));
            return number > 0 ? number : fallback;
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private static int nonnegativeInt(String value) {
        try {
            return Integer.parseInt(trim(value));
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.UserDAO;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import service.AuditLogService;

@WebServlet(name = "LoginServlet", urlPatterns = {"/login"})
public class LoginServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(LoginServlet.class.getName());
    private final AuditLogService auditLogService = new AuditLogService();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        try {
            
            HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
            if (session != null
                    && session.getAttribute("loggedInUser") != null) {

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath() + "/home"
                );

                return;
            }

           
            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp").forward(request, response);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi tải trang đăng nhập!", e);
            request.setAttribute("errorMessage", "Có lỗi hệ thống xảy ra. Vui lòng thử lại sau!");
            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp").forward(request, response);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
        String username = request.getParameter("username");
        String password = request.getParameter("password");

        try {
            
            UserDAO dao = new UserDAO();
            User user = dao.login(username, password);

            if (user == null) {

                auditLogService.log(
                        username,
                        "LOGIN_FAILED",
                        "USER",
                        null,
                        "Invalid username/email or password",
                        request
                );

                request.setAttribute("errorMessage", "Sai tài khoản hoặc mật khẩu.");
                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);
                return;
            }

            if (!user.isActive()) {

                auditLogService.log(
                        user,
                        "LOGIN_FAILED",
                        "USER",
                        (long) user.getUserId(),
                        "Login attempt on locked account",
                        request
                );

                request.setAttribute("errorMessage", "Tài khoản đã bị khóa.");
                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);
                return;
            }

          
            HttpSession session = request.getSession();
            session.setAttribute("loggedInUser", user);
            auditLogService.log(
                    user,
                    "LOGIN_SUCCESS",
                    "USER",
                    (long) user.getUserId(),
                    "User logged in successfully",
                    request
            );

            String redirectUrl = (String) session.getAttribute("redirectUrl");
            if (redirectUrl != null) {
                session.removeAttribute("redirectUrl"); // Xóa sau khi dùng xong
                response.sendRedirect(redirectUrl);
            } else {
                response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/home");
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi trong quá trình xử lý đăng nhập!", e);
            request.setAttribute("errorMessage", "Hệ thống gặp sự cố trong quá trình đăng nhập!");
            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp").forward(request, response);
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(name = "LogoutServlet", urlPatterns = {"/logout"})
public class LogoutServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(LogoutServlet.class.getName());

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        processLogout(request, response);
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        processLogout(request, response);
    }

  
    private void processLogout(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {
        try {
            
            HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
            if (session != null) {
                session.invalidate();
            }

           
            HttpSession newSession = request.getSession(true);
            newSession.setAttribute("logoutMessage", "Bạn đã đăng xuất thành công!");

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi xử lý đăng xuất người dùng!", e);
        } finally {
          
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
        }
    }
}package controller;

import dao.NotificationDAO;
import model.Notification;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;

@WebServlet(name = "NotificationServlet", urlPatterns = "/notification")
public class NotificationServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private final NotificationDAO notificationDAO =
            new NotificationDAO();

    private User getLoggedInUser(HttpServletRequest request) {
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            return null;
        }

        Object user = session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (user instanceof User) {
            return (User) user;
        }

        return null;
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
                         HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        User user = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (user == null) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED);
            return;
        }

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");
        int userId = user.getUserId();
        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        response.setContentType("application/json");
        response.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        try {
            if ("count".equals(action)) {
                int count = notificationDAO.countUnread(userId);
                response.getWriter().write(
                        "{\"count\":" + count + "}");
            } else if ("list".equals(action)) {
                List<Notification> list =
                        notificationDAO.findLatest(userId);

                StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder("[");
                boolean first = true;

                for (Notification n : list) {
                    if (!first) {
                        json.append(",");
                    }
                    first = false;

                    json.append("{")
                        .append("\"id\":").append(n.getNotificationId())
                        .append(",\"orderId\":")
                        .append(n.getOrderId() == null
                                ? "null" : n.getOrderId())
                        .append(",\"title\":\"")
                        .append(escapeJson(n.getTitle()))
                        .append("\",\"message\":\"")
                        .append(escapeJson(n.getMessage()))
                        .append("\",\"read\":")
                        .append(n.isRead())
                        .append(",\"createdAt\":\"")
                        .append(escapeJson(
                                n.getCreatedAt() == null
                                ? "" : n.getFormattedCreatedAt()))
                        .append("\"}");
                }

                json.append("]");
                response.getWriter().write(json.toString());
            } else {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
            }
                } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Cannot load notifications.", e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
                          HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        User user = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (user == null) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED);
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        if (!"read".equals(action)) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
            return;
        }

        try {
            int id = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("id"));

            boolean updated = notificationDAO.markAsRead(
                    id, user.getUserId());

            response.setContentType("application/json");
            response.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
            response.getWriter().write(
                    "{\"success\":" + updated + "}");

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
                } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Cannot update notification.", e);
        }
    }

    private String escapeJson(String value) {
        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }

        return value.replace("\\", "\\\\")
                    .replace("\"", "\\\"")
                    .replace("\n", "\\n")
                    .replace("\r", "\\r")
                    .replace("\t", "\\t");
    }
}package controller;

import dao.OrderDAO;
import model.Order;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "OrderSuccessServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/order-success"}
)
public class OrderSuccessServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(OrderSuccessServlet.class.getName());

    private final OrderDAO orderDAO = new OrderDAO();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        Object loggedInUser = session == null
                ? null
                : session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (!(loggedInUser instanceof User)) {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/login"
            );
            return;
        }

        User user = (User) loggedInUser;

        int orderId;

        try {
            orderId = Integer.parseInt(
                    request.getParameter("id")
            );

            if (orderId <= 0) {
                throw new NumberFormatException();
            }

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Mã đơn hàng không hợp lệ."
            );
            return;
        }

        try {
            Order order = orderDAO.findByIdAndUser(
                    orderId,
                    user.getUserId()
            );

            if (order == null) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND,
                        "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                );
                return;
            }

            request.setAttribute("order", order);

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/checkout/order-success.jsp"
            ).forward(request, response);

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Loi tai thong tin don hang!",
                    e
            );

            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                    "Chưa tải được thông tin đơn hàng. Vui lòng thử lại."
            );
        }
    }
}package controller;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;

import dao.PaymentDAO;
import payment.PaymentGateway;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "PaymentCallbackServlet",
        urlPatterns = {
            "/payment/vnpay/ipn",
            "/payment/momo/ipn",
            "/payment/vnpay/return",
            "/payment/momo/return"
        }
)
public class PaymentCallbackServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(
                    PaymentCallbackServlet.class.getName()
            );

    private final PaymentDAO payments = new PaymentDAO();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        String path = request.getServletPath();

        if (path.endsWith("/return")) {
            showReturnResult(request, response);
            return;
        }

        if (!"/payment/vnpay/ipn".equals(path)) {
            response.setHeader("Allow", "POST");
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED
            );
            return;
        }

        response.setContentType(
                "application/json;charset=UTF-8"
        );

        try {
            Map<String, String> params = new HashMap<>();

            for (Map.Entry<String, String[]> entry
                    : request.getParameterMap().entrySet()) {

                if (entry.getValue().length != 1) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Tham số callback bị trùng."
                    );
                }

                params.put(
                        entry.getKey(),
                        entry.getValue()[0]
                );
            }

            if (!PaymentGateway.verifyVnp(params)) {
                sendVnpResponse(response, "97");
                return;
            }

            String providerCode =
                    params.get("vnp_ResponseCode");

            boolean success =
                    "00".equals(providerCode)
                    && "00".equals(
                            params.get("vnp_TransactionStatus")
                    );

            BigDecimal amount = new BigDecimal(
                    params.get("vnp_Amount")
            ).movePointLeft(2);

            String result = payments.settle(
                    "VNPAY",
                    params.get("vnp_TxnRef"),
                    amount,
                    params.get("vnp_TransactionNo"),
                    providerCode,
                    success
            );

            sendVnpResponse(response, result);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.WARNING,
                    "Không xử lý được VNPay IPN.",
                    e
            );

            sendVnpResponse(response, "99");
        }
    }

    private void showReturnResult(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {
        boolean success = false;
        String message = "Chưa xác minh được kết quả thanh toán. "
                + "Vui lòng kiểm tra trạng thái trong Đơn mua trước khi thử lại.";

        try {
            Map<String, String> params = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<String, String[]> entry
                    : request.getParameterMap().entrySet()) {
                if (entry.getValue().length != 1) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Tham số callback bị trùng.");
                }
                params.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue()[0]);
            }

            boolean vnpay = "/payment/vnpay/return".equals(request.getServletPath());
            boolean verified = vnpay
                    ? PaymentGateway.verifyVnp(params)
                    : PaymentGateway.verifyMomo(params);

            if (verified) {
                success = vnpay
                        ? "00".equals(params.get("vnp_ResponseCode"))
                            && "00".equals(params.get("vnp_TransactionStatus"))
                        : "0".equals(params.get("resultCode"));
                message = success
                        ? "Cổng thanh toán đã xác nhận giao dịch thành công. "
                            + "Cảm ơn bạn đã mua sắm tại OECS!"
                        : "Thanh toán chưa hoàn tất hoặc đã bị hủy. "
                            + "Bạn có thể kiểm tra đơn hàng và thanh toán lại trong Đơn mua.";
            }
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            LOGGER.warning("Không xác minh được kết quả thanh toán trả về.");
        }

        response.setHeader("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer");
        request.setAttribute("paymentSuccess", success);
        request.setAttribute("paymentResultMessage", message);
        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/checkout/payment-result.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    private void sendVnpResponse(
            HttpServletResponse response,
            String code
    ) throws IOException {

        String message;

        switch (code) {
            case "00":
                message = "Confirm Success";
                break;

            case "02":
                message = "Already confirmed";
                break;

            case "01":
                message = "Order not found";
                break;

            case "04":
                message = "Invalid amount";
                break;

            case "97":
                message = "Invalid signature";
                break;

            default:
                message = "Unknown error";
                break;
        }

        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.addProperty("RspCode", code);
        body.addProperty("Message", message);

        response.getWriter().write(body.toString());
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws IOException {

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        if (!"/payment/momo/ipn".equals(
                request.getServletPath()
        )) {
            response.setHeader("Allow", "GET");
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED
            );
            return;
        }

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        try {
            char[] buffer = new char[16385];

            int total = 0;
            int count;

            Reader reader = request.getReader();

            while (total < buffer.length
                    && (count = reader.read(
                            buffer,
                            total,
                            buffer.length - total
                    )) != -1) {

                total += count;
            }

            if (total > 16384) {
                response.sendError(413);
                return;
            }

            String json = new String(
                    buffer,
                    0,
                    total
            );

            JsonObject body = JsonParser.parseString(
                    json
            ).getAsJsonObject();

            Map<String, String> params = new HashMap<>();

            for (Map.Entry<String, JsonElement> entry
                    : body.entrySet()) {

                if (entry.getValue().isJsonPrimitive()) {
                    params.put(
                            entry.getKey(),
                            entry.getValue().getAsString()
                    );
                }
            }

            if (!PaymentGateway.verifyMomo(params)) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST
                );
                return;
            }

            String providerCode = params.get("resultCode");

            BigDecimal amount = new BigDecimal(
                    params.get("amount")
            );

            String result = payments.settle(
                    "MOMO",
                    params.get("orderId"),
                    amount,
                    params.get("transId"),
                    providerCode,
                    "0".equals(providerCode)
            );

            if ("00".equals(result)
                    || "02".equals(result)) {

                response.setStatus(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_NO_CONTENT
                );

            } else {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST
                );
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi database khi nhận MoMo IPN.",
                    e
            );

            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
            );

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.WARNING,
                    "MoMo IPN không hợp lệ.",
                    e
            );

            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST
            );
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.PaymentRefundDAO;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import model.User;

@WebServlet(name = "PaymentRefundServlet", urlPatterns = "/staff/payment-refunds")
public class PaymentRefundServlet extends HttpServlet {
    private final PaymentRefundDAO refunds = new PaymentRefundDAO();
    private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger(PaymentRefundServlet.class.getName());

    private User staff(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
        User user = session == null ? null : (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");
        if (user == null || !user.isStaff()) {
            response.sendError(403);
            return null;
        }
        return user;
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        if (staff(request, response) == null) return;
        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");
        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        synchronized (session) {
            if (session.getAttribute("refundToken") == null) {
                session.setAttribute("refundToken", UUID.randomUUID().toString());
            }
        }
        try {
            int page = 1;
            if (request.getParameter("page") != null) {
                page = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("page"));
            }
            if (page < 1 || page > 1000000) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
            request.setAttribute("refunds", refunds.findPage(page));
            request.setAttribute("currentPage", page);
            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/staff/payment-refunds.jsp").forward(request, response);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            response.sendError(400);
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOG.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot load payment refunds", e);
            response.sendError(500, "Không tải được yêu cầu hoàn tiền.");
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
        User user = staff(request, response);
        if (user == null) return;
        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        String token = request.getParameter("csrfToken");
        if (token == null || !token.equals(session.getAttribute("refundToken"))) {
            response.sendError(403);
            return;
        }
        try {
            refunds.updateStatus(Long.parseLong(request.getParameter("id")),
                    request.getParameter("expectedStatus"), request.getParameter("status"),
                    request.getParameter("reference"), user.getUserId());
            session.setAttribute("refundMessage", "Đã cập nhật yêu cầu hoàn tiền.");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            session.setAttribute("refundMessage", "Không cập nhật được. " + e.getMessage());
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOG.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot update payment refund", e);
            session.setAttribute("refundMessage", "Không cập nhật được. Vui lòng thử lại.");
        }
        response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/staff/payment-refunds");
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.OrderDAO;
import dao.PaymentDAO;

import model.Order;
import model.User;

import payment.PaymentGateway;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "PaymentServlet",
        urlPatterns = {
            "/payment",
            "/payment/action"
        }
)
public class PaymentServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(PaymentServlet.class.getName());

    private final PaymentDAO payments = new PaymentDAO();
    private final OrderDAO orders = new OrderDAO();

    // Kiem tra dang nhap va quyen Customer
    private User customer(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        Object value = session == null
                ? null
                : session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (!(value instanceof User)) {
            request.getSession().setAttribute(
                    "redirectUrl",
                    request.getContextPath() + "/my-orders"
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/login"
            );

            return null;
        }

        User user = (User) value;

        if (!user.isCustomer()) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN
            );

            return null;
        }

        return user;
    }

    private int getOrderId(HttpServletRequest request) {
        try {
            return Integer.parseInt(
                    request.getParameter("id")
            );
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        User user = customer(request, response);

        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        if (!"/payment".equals(request.getServletPath())) {
            response.setHeader("Allow", "POST");
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED
            );
            return;
        }

        try {
            int orderId = getOrderId(request);

            Order order = orders.findByIdAndUser(
                    orderId,
                    user.getUserId()
            );

            if (order == null) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND,
                        "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                );
                return;
            }

            payments.expireOrder(
                    user.getUserId(),
                    orderId
            );

            order = orders.findByIdAndUser(
                    orderId,
                    user.getUserId()
            );

            if (order == null) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND
                );
                return;
            }

            if (!"PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(
                    order.getOrderStatus()
            )) {
                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath()
                        + "/my-orders/detail?id="
                        + orderId
                );
                return;
            }

            HttpSession session = request.getSession();

            synchronized (session) {
                if (session.getAttribute("paymentCsrf") == null) {
                    session.setAttribute(
                            "paymentCsrf",
                            UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                    );
                }
            }

            request.setAttribute("order", order);

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/checkout/payment.jsp"
            ).forward(request, response);

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND,
                    "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
            );

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Không tải được trang thanh toán.",
                    e
            );

            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                    "Chưa tải được thanh toán. Vui lòng thử lại."
            );
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        User user = customer(request, response);

        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        if (!"/payment/action".equals(
                request.getServletPath()
        )) {
            response.setHeader("Allow", "GET");
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED
            );
            return;
        }

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        String token = request.getParameter("csrfToken");

        if (token == null
                || !token.equals(
                        session.getAttribute("paymentCsrf")
                )) {

            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN,
                    "Yêu cầu không hợp lệ. Vui lòng tải lại trang."
            );
            return;
        }

        int orderId = getOrderId(request);

        if (orderId <= 0) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Mã đơn hàng không hợp lệ."
            );
            return;
        }

        try {
            String action = request.getParameter("action");

            if ("pay".equals(action)) {

                PaymentDAO.Attempt attempt = payments.begin(
                        user.getUserId(),
                        orderId
                );

                String paymentUrl = attempt.url;

                if (paymentUrl == null) {
                    paymentUrl = PaymentGateway.create(
                            attempt.method,
                            attempt.ref,
                            attempt.amount,
                            attempt.seconds,
                            request.getRemoteAddr()
                    );

                    payments.saveUrl(
                            attempt.ref,
                            paymentUrl
                    );
                }

                response.setStatus(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_SEE_OTHER
                );

                response.setHeader(
                        "Location",
                        paymentUrl
                );

                return;

            } else if ("cod".equals(action)
                    || "cancel".equals(action)) {

                payments.changeOrCancel(
                        user.getUserId(),
                        orderId,
                        "cod".equals(action)
                );

                response.setStatus(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_SEE_OTHER
                );

                response.setHeader(
                        "Location",
                        request.getContextPath()
                        + "/my-orders/detail?id="
                        + orderId
                );

                return;

            } else {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                        "Thao tác không hợp lệ."
                );
                return;
            }

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "paymentError",
                    e.getMessage()
            );

        } catch (Exception e) {
            if (e instanceof InterruptedException) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            }

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.WARNING,
                    "Không khởi tạo được thanh toán.",
                    e
            );

            session.setAttribute(
                    "paymentError",
                    "Chưa mở được cổng thanh toán. "
                    + "Đơn vẫn chờ thanh toán đến hạn; "
                    + "thử lại sau 30 giây hoặc đổi COD."
            );
        }

        response.setStatus(
                HttpServletResponse.SC_SEE_OTHER
        );

        response.setHeader(
                "Location",
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/payment?id="
                + orderId
        );
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.BrandDAO;
import dao.CategoryAttributeDAO;
import dao.CategoryDAO;
import dao.ProductDAO;

import model.CategoryAttribute;
import model.Product;
import model.ProductImage;
import model.ProductSpec;

import service.ProductCatalogService;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.MultipartConfig;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.Part;

import java.io.BufferedInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "ProductServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/product"}
)
@MultipartConfig(
        fileSizeThreshold = 1024 * 1024 * 2,
        maxFileSize = 1024 * 1024 * 10,
        maxRequestSize = 1024 * 1024 * 50
)
public class ProductServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(ProductServlet.class.getName());

    private static final String LIST_URL
            = "/product?view=list";

    private static final String UPLOAD_FOLDER
            = "uploads/products";

    private static final long MAX_IMAGE_SIZE
            = 10L * 1024 * 1024;

    // ========================================
    // 1. DO GET
    // ========================================
    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String view = request.getParameter("view");

        if (view == null || "list".equals(view)) {
            showList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        switch (view) {

            case "create":
                showCreate(request, response);
                break;

            case "edit":
                showEdit(request, response);
                break;

            case "delete":
                showDelete(request, response);
                break;

            default:
                redirectToList(request, response);
                break;
        }
    }

    // ========================================
    // 2. HIỂN THỊ DANH SÁCH SẢN PHẨM
    // ========================================
    private void showList(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        ProductDAO productDAO = new ProductDAO();

        String keyword = request.getParameter("search");

        List<Product> productList;

        if (keyword != null && !keyword.trim().isEmpty()) {

            productList = productDAO.searchProducts(
                    keyword.trim()
            );

        } else {

            productList = productDAO.getList();
        }

        request.setAttribute(
                "productList",
                productList
        );

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/product/list.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    // ========================================
    // 3. HIỂN THỊ FORM THÊM
    // ========================================
    private void showCreate(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        Integer categoryId = parseOptionalPositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("categoryId")
        );

        loadFormCommonAttributes(request, true);

        if (categoryId != null) {

            loadCategoryAttributes(
                    request,
                    categoryId
            );

        } else {

            setEmptyCategoryAttributes(request);
        }

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/product/create.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    // ========================================
    // 4. HIỂN THỊ FORM CHỈNH SỬA
    // ========================================
    private void showEdit(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        Integer productId = parseOptionalPositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("id")
        );

        if (productId == null) {
            redirectToList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        ProductDAO productDAO = new ProductDAO();

        Product product = productDAO.getById(productId);

        if (product == null) {
            redirectToList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        product.setGalleryImages(
                productDAO.getProductImages(productId)
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "product",
                product
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "productSpecs",
                productDAO.getProductSpecsForAdmin(productId)
        );

        loadFormCommonAttributes(request, false);

        loadCategoryAttributes(
                request,
                product.getCategoryId()
        );

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/product/edit.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    // ========================================
    // 5. HIỂN THỊ FORM NGỪNG BÁN
    // ========================================
    private void showDelete(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        Integer productId = parseOptionalPositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("id")
        );

        if (productId == null) {
            redirectToList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        Product product
                = new ProductDAO().getById(productId);

        if (product == null) {
            redirectToList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        request.setAttribute(
                "product",
                product
        );

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/product/delete.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    // ========================================
    // 6. DO POST
    // ========================================
    @Override
    protected void doPost(
