                    fieldName
                    + " phải là số VNĐ nguyên không âm."
            );
        }

        BigDecimal amount;

        try {

            amount = new BigDecimal(value);

        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    fieldName + " không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        /*
         * DECIMAL(18,2):
         * Tối đa 16 chữ số phần nguyên.
         */
        if (amount.signum() < 0
                || amount.precision() > 16) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    fieldName
                    + " vượt giới hạn cho phép."
            );
        }

        return amount.doubleValue();
    }

    // ========================================
    // 13. PARSE GIÁ TÙY CHỌN
    // ========================================
    private Double parseOptionalMoney(
            String input,
            String fieldName) {

        if (input == null
                || input.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return null;
        }

        return parseMoney(
                input,
                fieldName
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 14. PARSE TỒN KHO
    // ========================================
    private int parseNonNegativeInt(
            String input,
            String fieldName) {

        if (input == null
                || input.trim().isEmpty()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    fieldName + " không được để trống."
            );
        }

        try {

            int stock
                    = Integer.parseInt(input.trim());

            if (stock < 0) {
                throw new NumberFormatException();
            }

            return stock;

        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    fieldName
                    + " phải là số nguyên không âm."
            );
        }
    }

    // ========================================
    // 15. PARSE BOOLEAN
    // ========================================
    private boolean parseBoolean(
            String input,
            String fieldName) {

        String value = input == null
                ? ""
                : input.trim();

        if ("true".equalsIgnoreCase(value)
                || "1".equals(value)) {

            return true;
        }

        if ("false".equalsIgnoreCase(value)
                || "0".equals(value)) {

            return false;
        }

        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                fieldName + " không hợp lệ."
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 16. PARSE ID DƯƠNG
    // ========================================
    private Integer parsePositiveInt(
            String input) {

        if (input == null
                || input.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return null;
        }

        try {

            int value
                    = Integer.parseInt(input.trim());

            return value > 0 ? value : null;

        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {

            return null;
        }
    }

    // ========================================
    // 17. CHUẨN HÓA STRING
    // ========================================
    private String trimToNull(
            String input) {

        if (input == null
                || input.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return null;
        }

        return input.trim();
    }

    // ========================================
    // 18. GHI AUDIT LOG
    // ========================================
    private void writeAuditLog(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            int productId,
            int createdCount) {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            return;
        }

        User user
                = (User) session.getAttribute(
                        "loggedInUser"
                );

        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        try {

            auditLogService.log(
                    user,
                    "CREATE_SKU_BULK",
                    "PRODUCT_SKU",
                    null,
                    "Bulk created "
                    + createdCount
                    + " SKUs for product ID "
                    + productId,
                    request
            );

        } catch (Exception ex) {

            /*
             * Transaction SQL đã commit.
             * Không báo lưu thất bại chỉ vì
             * audit log gặp lỗi.
             */
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Không thể ghi audit log SKU bulk",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    // ========================================
    // 19. THÔNG BÁO
    // ========================================
    private void setSuccess(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String message) {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession();

        session.removeAttribute(
                "errorMsg"
        );

        session.setAttribute(
                "successMsg",
                message
        );
    }

    private void setError(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String message) {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession();

        session.removeAttribute(
                "successMsg"
        );

        session.setAttribute(
                "errorMsg",
                message
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 20. REDIRECT VỀ DANH SÁCH PRODUCT
    // ========================================
    private void redirectToProductList(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/product?view=list"
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 21. CLASS LƯU BẢN PREVIEW TRONG SESSION
    // ========================================
    private static class BulkDraft
            implements java.io.Serializable {

        private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;

        private final int productId;
        private final String token;
        private final List<ProductSku> skuList;

        private BulkDraft(
                int productId,
                String token,
                List<ProductSku> skuList) {

            this.productId = productId;
            this.token = token;
            this.skuList = skuList;
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.ProductSkuDAO;
import model.ProductSku;
import model.User;
import service.SkuImageService;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.MultipartConfig;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import jakarta.servlet.http.Part;

import java.io.BufferedInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

import java.sql.SQLException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "SkuImageServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/sku-images"}
)
@MultipartConfig(
        fileSizeThreshold = 1024 * 1024 * 2,
        maxFileSize = 1024 * 1024 * 10,
        maxRequestSize = 1024 * 1024 * 50
)
public class SkuImageServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(SkuImageServlet.class.getName());

    private static final long MAX_IMAGE_SIZE
            = 10L * 1024 * 1024;

    private static final int MAX_FILES_PER_REQUEST = 10;

    private static final String UPLOAD_FOLDER
            = "uploads/products";

    // ========================================
    // 1. CHỈ CHO PHÉP POST
    // ========================================
    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendError(
                HttpServletResponse.SC_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED,
                "Chức năng này chỉ hỗ trợ POST."
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 2. XỬ LÝ POST
    // ========================================
    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        /*
         * Kiểm tra đăng nhập.
         *
         * Việc kiểm tra quyền ADMIN/STAFF phải
         * được thực hiện bằng filter phân quyền
         * của OECS trước khi đến Servlet này.
         */
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null
                || !(session.getAttribute("loggedInUser") instanceof User)) {

            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED,
                    "Bạn cần đăng nhập."
            );

            return;
        }

        Integer productId = parsePositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("productId")
        );

        Integer skuId = parsePositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("skuId")
        );

        if (productId == null || skuId == null) {

            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Product ID hoặc SKU ID không hợp lệ."
            );

            return;
        }

        /*
         * Kiểm tra SKU thuộc Product.
         *
         * Service vẫn kiểm tra lại bằng
         * Connection và transaction của nó.
         */
        ProductSku sku
                = new ProductSkuDAO().getBySkuId(skuId);

        if (sku == null
                || sku.getProductId() != productId) {

            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND,
                    "Không tìm thấy SKU thuộc sản phẩm."
            );

            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        try {

            if ("upload".equals(action)) {

                uploadSkuImages(
                        request,
                        productId,
                        skuId
                );

            } else if ("setPrimary".equals(action)) {

                setPrimaryImage(
                        request,
                        productId,
                        skuId
                );

            } else if ("reorder".equals(action)) {

                reorderImages(
                        request,
                        productId,
                        skuId
                );

            } else if ("delete".equals(action)) {

                deleteSkuImage(
                        request,
                        productId,
                        skuId
                );

            } else {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Thao tác quản lý ảnh không hợp lệ."
                );
            }

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.WARNING,
                    "Dữ liệu ảnh SKU không hợp lệ",
                    ex
            );

            setError(
                    request,
                    ex.getMessage()
            );

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi SQL khi quản lý ảnh SKU",
                    ex
            );

            setError(
                    request,
                    "Không thể lưu ảnh SKU vào database."
            );

        } catch (IOException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi upload ảnh SKU",
                    ex
            );

            setError(
                    request,
                    "Không thể xử lý file ảnh."
            );

        } catch (Exception ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi không xác định khi quản lý ảnh SKU",
                    ex
            );

            setError(
                    request,
                    "Có lỗi xảy ra khi quản lý ảnh SKU."
            );
        }

        redirectToSkuList(
                request,
                response,
                productId
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 3. UPLOAD NHIỀU ẢNH SKU
    // ========================================
    private void uploadSkuImages(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            int productId,
            int skuId)
            throws IOException, ServletException, SQLException {

        List<Path> uploadedFiles = new ArrayList<>();

        boolean saved = false;

        try {

            List<String> imageUrls
                    = saveUploadedImages(
                            request,
                            uploadedFiles
                    );

            if (imageUrls.isEmpty()) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một ảnh."
                );
            }

            SkuImageService service
                    = new SkuImageService();

            int inserted = service.addImages(
                    productId,
                    skuId,
                    imageUrls
            );

            if (inserted != imageUrls.size()) {

                throw new SQLException(
                        "Số lượng ảnh được lưu không khớp."
                );
            }

            saved = true;

            setSuccess(
                    request,
                    "Đã thêm " + inserted
                    + " ảnh cho SKU."
            );

        } finally {

            /*
             * Nếu không lưu thành công,
             * dọn các file mới upload.
             *
             * Lưu ý: đây là best effort.
             * File system không thuộc
             * transaction SQL Server.
             */
            if (!saved) {
                deleteUploadedFiles(uploadedFiles);
            }
        }
    }

    // ========================================
    // 4. ĐẶT ẢNH CHÍNH
    // ========================================
    private void setPrimaryImage(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            int productId,
            int skuId)
            throws SQLException {

        Integer imageId = parsePositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("imageId")
        );

        if (imageId == null) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Image ID không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        SkuImageService service
                = new SkuImageService();

        boolean result = service.setPrimaryImage(
                productId,
                skuId,
                imageId
        );

        if (!result) {

            setError(
                    request,
                    "Ảnh không tồn tại hoặc không thuộc SKU."
            );

            return;
        }

        setSuccess(
                request,
                "Đã cập nhật ảnh đại diện SKU."
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 5. SẮP XẾP ẢNH
    // ========================================
    private void reorderImages(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            int productId,
            int skuId)
            throws SQLException {

        /*
         * Form gửi:
         *
         * <input name="imageIds" value="25">
         * <input name="imageIds" value="22">
         * <input name="imageIds" value="24">
         *
         * Thứ tự parameter chính là thứ tự ảnh.
         */
        String[] submitted
                = request.getParameterValues("imageIds");

        if (submitted == null) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Chưa có danh sách ảnh cần sắp xếp."
            );
        }

        List<Integer> imageIds = new ArrayList<>();

        Set<Integer> uniqueIds = new HashSet<>();

        for (String value : submitted) {

            Integer imageId = parsePositiveInt(value);

            if (imageId == null
                    || !uniqueIds.add(imageId)) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Danh sách ảnh có ID không hợp lệ "
                        + "hoặc bị trùng."
                );
            }

            imageIds.add(imageId);
        }

        SkuImageService service
                = new SkuImageService();

        boolean result = service.reorderImages(
                productId,
                skuId,
                imageIds
        );

        if (!result) {

            setError(
                    request,
                    "Danh sách ảnh không khớp với SKU hiện tại."
            );

            return;
        }

        setSuccess(
                request,
                "Đã cập nhật thứ tự ảnh SKU."
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 6. XÓA ẢNH SKU
    // ========================================
    private void deleteSkuImage(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            int productId,
            int skuId)
            throws SQLException {

        Integer imageId = parsePositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("imageId")
        );

        if (imageId == null) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Image ID không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        SkuImageService service
                = new SkuImageService();

        boolean result = service.deleteImage(
                productId,
                skuId,
                imageId
        );

        if (!result) {

            setError(
                    request,
                    "Không thể gỡ ảnh khỏi SKU."
            );

            return;
        }

        /*
         * Chỉ xóa bản ghi trong database.
         * Không xóa file vật lý tại đây.
         */
        setSuccess(
                request,
                "Đã gỡ ảnh khỏi SKU."
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 7. ĐỌC CÁC FILE ĐƯỢC UPLOAD
    // ========================================
    private List<String> saveUploadedImages(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            List<Path> uploadedFiles)
            throws IOException, ServletException {

        List<String> imageUrls
                = new ArrayList<>();

        int count = 0;

        for (Part part : request.getParts()) {

            if (!"skuImages".equals(part.getName())
                    || part.getSize() == 0) {
                continue;
            }

            count++;

            if (count > MAX_FILES_PER_REQUEST) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Mỗi lần chỉ được tải tối đa "
                        + MAX_FILES_PER_REQUEST + " ảnh."
                );
            }

            String url = saveUploadedPart(
                    part,
                    request,
                    uploadedFiles
            );

            imageUrls.add(url);
        }

        return imageUrls;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 8. LƯU MỘT FILE ẢNH
    // ========================================
    private String saveUploadedPart(
            Part part,
            HttpServletRequest request,
            List<Path> uploadedFiles)
            throws IOException {

        if (part.getSize() <= 0
                || part.getSize() > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Ảnh phải có dung lượng từ 1 byte "
                    + "đến tối đa 10MB."
            );
        }

        String extension = getImageExtension(
                part.getContentType()
        );

        String root = request.getServletContext()
                .getRealPath("/");

        if (root == null) {

            throw new IOException(
                    "Không xác định được thư mục upload."
            );
        }

        Path directory = Paths.get(
                root,
                "uploads",
                "products"
        );

        Files.createDirectories(directory);

        String fileName
                = UUID.randomUUID().toString() + extension;

        Path destination
                = directory.resolve(fileName);

        /*
         * Ghi nhận trước khi copy để có thể
         * dọn file nếu quá trình ghi bị lỗi.
         */
        uploadedFiles.add(destination);

        try (BufferedInputStream input
                = new BufferedInputStream(
                        part.getInputStream()
                )) {

            validateImageSignature(input, extension);

            Files.copy(
                    input,
                    destination
            );
        }

        return UPLOAD_FOLDER + "/" + fileName;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 9. KIỂM TRA LOẠI ẢNH
    // ========================================
    private String getImageExtension(
            String contentType) {

        if ("image/jpeg".equalsIgnoreCase(contentType)) {
            return ".jpg";
        }

        if ("image/png".equalsIgnoreCase(contentType)) {
            return ".png";
        }

        if ("image/webp".equalsIgnoreCase(contentType)) {
            return ".webp";
        }

        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Chỉ hỗ trợ ảnh JPG, PNG và WEBP."
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 10. KIỂM TRA CHỮ KÝ FILE
    // ========================================
    private void validateImageSignature(
            BufferedInputStream input,
            String extension)
            throws IOException {

        input.mark(16);

        byte[] header = new byte[12];

        int length = 0;

        while (length < header.length) {

            int read = input.read(
                    header,
                    length,
                    header.length - length
            );

            if (read == -1) {
                break;
            }

            length += read;
        }

        input.reset();

        boolean valid = false;

        if (".jpg".equals(extension)
                && length >= 3) {

            valid
                    = (header[0] & 0xFF) == 0xFF
                    && (header[1] & 0xFF) == 0xD8
                    && (header[2] & 0xFF) == 0xFF;

        } else if (".png".equals(extension)
                && length >= 8) {

            int[] pngSignature = {
                137, 80, 78, 71,
                13, 10, 26, 10
            };

            valid = true;

            for (int i = 0; i < pngSignature.length; i++) {

                if ((header[i] & 0xFF)
                        != pngSignature[i]) {

                    valid = false;
                    break;
                }
            }

        } else if (".webp".equals(extension)
                && length >= 12) {

            valid
                    = header[0] == 'R'
                    && header[1] == 'I'
                    && header[2] == 'F'
                    && header[3] == 'F'
                    && header[8] == 'W'
                    && header[9] == 'E'
                    && header[10] == 'B'
                    && header[11] == 'P';
        }

        if (!valid) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Nội dung file ảnh không hợp lệ."
            );
        }
    }

    // ========================================
    // 11. DỌN FILE UPLOAD KHI THẤT BẠI
    // ========================================
    private void deleteUploadedFiles(
            List<Path> uploadedFiles) {

        for (Path path : uploadedFiles) {

            try {

                Files.deleteIfExists(path);

            } catch (IOException ex) {

                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.WARNING,
                        "Không xóa được file upload: " + path,
                        ex
                );
            }
        }
    }

    // ========================================
    // 12. PARSE ID DƯƠNG
    // ========================================
    private Integer parsePositiveInt(String input) {

        if (input == null || input.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        try {

            int value = Integer.parseInt(input.trim());

            return value > 0 ? value : null;

        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    // ========================================
    // 13. THÔNG BÁO
    // ========================================
    private void setSuccess(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String message) {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        session.removeAttribute("errorMsg");
        session.setAttribute("successMsg", message);
    }

    private void setError(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String message) {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        session.removeAttribute("successMsg");
        session.setAttribute("errorMsg", message);
    }

    // ========================================
    // 14. REDIRECT VỀ DANH SÁCH SKU
    // ========================================
    private void redirectToSkuList(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            int productId)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/product-sku?productId="
                + productId
        );
    }
}
package controller;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import model.User;
import service.ReturnExchangeService;

@WebServlet(
        name = "StaffReturnExchangeServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/staff/return-exchange"}
)
public class StaffReturnExchangeServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(StaffReturnExchangeServlet.class.getName());

    private final ReturnExchangeService returnExchangeService =
            new ReturnExchangeService();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String contextPath = request.getContextPath();
        String view = request.getParameter("view");

        try {
            if ("detail".equals(view)) {
                int requestId = parseRequestId(
                        request.getParameter("id"));

                List<Map<String, Object>> requests =
                        returnExchangeService.getAllRequests();

                Map<String, Object> selectedRequest = null;

                for (Map<String, Object> item : requests) {
                    if (((Number) item.get("requestId")).intValue()
                            == requestId) {
                        selectedRequest = item;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (selectedRequest == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/staff/return-exchange?error=notFound");
                    return;
                }

                request.setAttribute("selectedRequest", selectedRequest);
                request.setAttribute(
                        "requestItems",
                        returnExchangeService.getRequestItems(requestId));

                request.getRequestDispatcher(
                        "/WEB-INF/staff/return-exchange/detail.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);
                return;
            }

            request.setAttribute(
                    "requestList",
                    returnExchangeService.getAllRequests());

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/staff/return-exchange/list.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?error=invalidId");
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot load return/exchange requests", ex);
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Không thể tải danh sách yêu cầu đổi/trả hàng.", ex);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String contextPath = request.getContextPath();
        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
        User staff = session == null
                ? null
                : (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (staff == null || !staff.isStaff()) {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath + "/login");
            return;
        }

        int requestId;

        try {
            requestId = parseRequestId(request.getParameter("id"));
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?error=invalidId");
            return;
        }

        String newStatus;

        if ("approve".equals(action)) {
            newStatus = "APPROVED";
        } else if ("reject".equals(action)) {
            newStatus = "REJECTED";
        } else {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?error=invalidAction");
            return;
        }

        String staffNote = request.getParameter("staffNote");
        staffNote = staffNote == null ? "" : staffNote.trim();

        if ("REJECTED".equals(newStatus) && staffNote.isEmpty()) {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?view=detail&id="
                    + requestId + "&error=noteRequired");
            return;
        }

        try {
            boolean updated = returnExchangeService.reviewRequest(
                    requestId,
                    staff.getUserId(),
                    newStatus,
                    staffNote);

            if (!updated) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/staff/return-exchange?view=detail&id="
                        + requestId + "&error=alreadyReviewed");
                return;
            }

            String message = "APPROVED".equals(newStatus)
                    ? "approved"
                    : "rejected";

            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?view=detail&id="
                    + requestId + "&message="
                    + URLEncoder.encode(
                            message, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?view=detail&id="
                    + requestId + "&error=invalid");
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot review return/exchange request", ex);

            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?view=detail&id="
                    + requestId + "&error=system");
        }
    }

    private int parseRequestId(String value) {
        int requestId = Integer.parseInt(value);

        if (requestId <= 0) {
            throw new NumberFormatException();
        }

        return requestId;
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.ReviewReportDAO;
import dao.StaffReviewDAO;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@WebServlet(name = "StaffReviewServlet", urlPatterns = {"/staff/reviews"})
public class StaffReviewServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private User getStaff(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null
                || !(session.getAttribute("loggedInUser") instanceof User)) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return null;
        }

        User user = (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (!user.isStaff()) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN);
            return null;
        }

        return user;
    }

    private String ensureToken(HttpSession session) {
        String token = (String) session.getAttribute("reviewCsrfToken");

        if (token == null) {
            token = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
            session.setAttribute("reviewCsrfToken", token);
        }

        return token;
    }

    private boolean validToken(HttpServletRequest request) {
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            return false;
        }

        String expected = (String) session.getAttribute("reviewCsrfToken");
        String actual = request.getParameter("csrfToken");

        return expected != null && expected.equals(actual);
    }

    private String reviewFilter(String raw) {
        if (raw == null) {
            return "all";
        }

        String value = raw.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        return "visible".equals(value) || "hidden".equals(value)
                ? value : "all";
    }

    private String reportFilter(String raw) {
        if (raw == null) {
            return "all";
        }

        String value = raw.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        return "pending".equals(value)
                || "resolved".equals(value)
                || "rejected".equals(value)
                ? value : "all";
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        if (getStaff(request, response) == null) {
            return;
        }

        ensureToken(request.getSession());

        String reviewStatus =
                reviewFilter(request.getParameter("reviewStatus"));

        String reportStatus =
                reportFilter(request.getParameter("reportStatus"));

        try {
            List<Map<String, Object>> allReviews =
                    new StaffReviewDAO().getAllReviewsForStaff();

            List<Map<String, Object>> allReports =
                    new ReviewReportDAO().getAllReports();

            List<Map<String, Object>> filteredReviews = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Map<String, Object>> filteredReports = new ArrayList<>();

            int visibleCount = 0;
            int hiddenCount = 0;

            for (Map<String, Object> review : allReviews) {
                boolean hidden =
                        Boolean.TRUE.equals(review.get("isHidden"));

                if (hidden) {
                    hiddenCount++;
                } else {
                    visibleCount++;
                }

                if ("all".equals(reviewStatus)
                        || (hidden && "hidden".equals(reviewStatus))
                        || (!hidden && "visible".equals(reviewStatus))) {
                    filteredReviews.add(review);
                }
            }

            int pendingCount = 0;
            int resolvedCount = 0;
            int rejectedCount = 0;

            for (Map<String, Object> report : allReports) {
                String status = String.valueOf(report.get("status"));

                if ("PENDING".equals(status)) {
                    pendingCount++;
                } else if ("RESOLVED".equals(status)) {
                    resolvedCount++;
                } else if ("REJECTED".equals(status)) {
                    rejectedCount++;
                }

                if ("all".equals(reportStatus)
                        || reportStatus.equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
                    filteredReports.add(report);
                }
            }

            request.setAttribute("reviews", filteredReviews);
            request.setAttribute("reports", filteredReports);

            request.setAttribute("allReviewCount", allReviews.size());
            request.setAttribute("visibleReviewCount", visibleCount);
            request.setAttribute("hiddenReviewCount", hiddenCount);

            request.setAttribute("allReportCount", allReports.size());
            request.setAttribute("pendingReportCount", pendingCount);
            request.setAttribute("resolvedReportCount", resolvedCount);
            request.setAttribute("rejectedReportCount", rejectedCount);

            request.setAttribute("reviewStatusFilter", reviewStatus);
            request.setAttribute("reportStatusFilter", reportStatus);

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/review/staff-list.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new ServletException("Không thể tải dữ liệu đánh giá.", e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        User user = getStaff(request, response);

        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        if (!validToken(request)) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN,
                    "Phiên làm việc không hợp lệ. Vui lòng tải lại trang.");
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");
        boolean success;

        try {
            if ("visibility".equals(action)) {
                int reviewId =
                        Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("reviewId"));

                String hiddenParam = request.getParameter("hidden");

                if (!"true".equals(hiddenParam)
                        && !"false".equals(hiddenParam)) {
                    response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
                    return;
                }

                success = new StaffReviewDAO().setReviewHidden(
                        reviewId,
                        Boolean.parseBoolean(hiddenParam));

            } else if ("resolveReport".equals(action)) {
                int reportId =
                        Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("reportId"));

                String decision = request.getParameter("decision");

                if (!"HIDE".equals(decision)
                        && !"DISMISS".equals(decision)) {
                    response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
                    return;
                }

                success = new ReviewReportDAO().resolveReport(
                        reportId,
                        user.getUserId(),
                        decision);

            } else {
                response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
                return;
            }

            request.getSession().setAttribute(
                    success ? "successMessage" : "errorMessage",
                    success
                            ? "Thao tác kiểm duyệt thành công."
                            : "Không thể thực hiện thao tác; dữ liệu có thể đã thay đổi.");

            String url = request.getContextPath()
                    + "/staff/reviews?reviewStatus="
                    + reviewFilter(request.getParameter("reviewStatus"))
                    + "&reportStatus="
                    + reportFilter(request.getParameter("reportStatus"));

            response.sendRedirect(url);

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                    "ID không hợp lệ.");

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Không thể cập nhật đánh giá hoặc báo cáo.", e);
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.VoucherDAO;
import service.AuditLogService;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import model.User;
import model.Voucher;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;

@WebServlet(
        name = "VoucherServlet", urlPatterns = {"/staff/voucher"}
)
public class VoucherServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService
            = new AuditLogService();

    private VoucherDAO voucherDAO;

    private final DateTimeFormatter formatter
            = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(
                    "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm"
            );

    @Override
    public void init()
            throws ServletException {

        voucherDAO
                = new VoucherDAO();
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding(
                "UTF-8"
        );

        if (!checkStaff(
                request,
                response
        )) {

            return;
        }

        String view
                = request.getParameter(
                        "view"
                );

        if (view == null
                || view.trim().isEmpty()) {

            view = "list";
        }

        switch (view) {

            case "create":

                showCreate(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "edit":

                showEdit(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "delete":

                showDelete(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;
            case "usage":

                showUsage(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "list":

            default:

                showList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding(
                "UTF-8"
        );

        if (!checkStaff(
                request,
                response
        )) {

            return;
        }

        String action
                = request.getParameter(
                        "action"
                );

        if (action == null
                || action.trim().isEmpty()) {

            redirectList(
                    request,
                    response
            );

            return;
        }

        switch (action) {

            case "create":

                createVoucher(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "update":

                updateVoucher(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "delete":

                deleteVoucher(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            default:

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;
        }
    }

    private boolean checkStaff(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/login"
            );

            return false;
        }

        Object value
                = session.getAttribute(
                        "loggedInUser"
                );

        if (!(value instanceof User)) {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/login"
            );

            return false;
        }

        User loggedInUser
                = (User) value;

        if (!loggedInUser.isStaff()) {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "toastMessage",
                    "Chỉ Staff mới có quyền quản lý Voucher!"
            );

            session.setAttribute(
                    "toastType",
                    "error"
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/home"
            );

            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private void showList(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String status = request.getParameter("status");

        if (status == null) {
            status = "all";
        }

        status = status.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        if (!"available".equals(status)
                && !"exhausted".equals(status)
                && !"upcoming".equals(status)
                && !"expired".equals(status)) {

            status = "all";
        }

        // Lấy danh sách voucher và trạng thái từ DAO
        List<Voucher> allVouchers = voucherDAO.getAllVouchers();
        List<Voucher> filteredVouchers = new ArrayList<>();

        int availableCount = 0;
        int exhaustedCount = 0;
        int upcomingCount = 0;
        int expiredCount = 0;

        for (Voucher voucher : allVouchers) {

            String voucherStatus
                    = voucher.getAvailabilityStatus();

            if ("AVAILABLE".equals(voucherStatus)) {
                availableCount++;
            }

            if ("EXHAUSTED".equals(voucherStatus)) {
                exhaustedCount++;
            }

            if ("UPCOMING".equals(voucherStatus)) {
                upcomingCount++;
            }

            if ("EXPIRED".equals(voucherStatus)) {
                expiredCount++;
            }

            // Chỉ đưa voucher đúng trạng thái vào danh sách
            if ("all".equals(status)
                    || status.equalsIgnoreCase(voucherStatus)) {

                filteredVouchers.add(voucher);
            }
        }

        request.setAttribute(
                "vouchers",
                filteredVouchers
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "totalVoucherCount",
                allVouchers.size()
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "voucherStatusFilter",
                status
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "availableVoucherCount",
                availableCount
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "exhaustedVoucherCount",
                exhaustedCount
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "upcomingVoucherCount",
                upcomingCount
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "expiredVoucherCount",
                expiredCount
        );

        // Giữ nguyên thống kê và lịch sử voucher
        request.setAttribute(
                "usedVoucherCount",
                voucherDAO.countUsedVouchers()
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "recentVoucherUsages",
                voucherDAO.getRecentVoucherUsages()
        );

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/voucher/list.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    private void createVoucher(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        try {

            Voucher voucher
                    = getVoucherFromRequest(
                            request
                    );

            String error
                    = validateVoucher(
                            voucher,
                            false
                    );

            if (error != null) {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        error
                );

                redirectCreate(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                return;
            }

            boolean success
                    = voucherDAO
                            .insertVoucher(
                                    voucher
                            );

            if (success) {

                setSuccessMessage(
                        request,
                        "Tạo Voucher thành công."
                );

                User loggedInUser
                        = (User) request.getSession()
                                .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                auditLogService.log(
                        loggedInUser,
                        "CREATE_VOUCHER",
                        "VOUCHER",
                        null,
                        "Created voucher: " + voucher.getCode(),
                        request
                );

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

            } else {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        "Không thể tạo Voucher."
                );

                redirectCreate(
                        request,
                        response
                );
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {

            e.printStackTrace();

            setErrorMessage(
                    request,
                    "Dữ liệu Voucher không hợp lệ."
            );

            redirectCreate(
                    request,
                    response
            );
        }
    }

    private void showEdit(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        try {

            int voucherId
                    = Integer.parseInt(
                            request.getParameter(
                                    "id"
                            )
                    );

            Voucher voucher
                    = voucherDAO
                            .getVoucherById(
                                    voucherId
                            );

            if (voucher == null) {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        "Không tìm thấy Voucher."
                );

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                return;
            }

            request.setAttribute(
                    "voucher",
                    voucher
            );

            if (voucher.getValidFrom()
                    != null) {

                request.setAttribute(
                        "validFromValue",
                        voucher
                                .getValidFrom()
                                .toLocalDateTime()
                                .format(
                                        formatter
                                )
                );
            }

            if (voucher.getValidTo()
                    != null) {

                request.setAttribute(
                        "validToValue",
                        voucher
                                .getValidTo()
                                .toLocalDateTime()
                                .format(
                                        formatter
                                )
                );
            }

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/voucher/edit.jsp"
            ).forward(
                    request,
                    response
            );

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {

            setErrorMessage(
                    request,
                    "ID Voucher không hợp lệ."
            );

            redirectList(
                    request,
                    response
            );
        }
    }

    private void updateVoucher(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        int voucherId = -1;

        try {

            voucherId
                    = Integer.parseInt(
                            request.getParameter(
                                    "voucherId"
                            )
                    );

            Voucher oldVoucher
                    = voucherDAO
                            .getVoucherById(
                                    voucherId
                            );

            if (oldVoucher == null) {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        "Voucher không tồn tại."
                );

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                return;
            }

            Voucher voucher
                    = getVoucherFromRequest(
                            request
                    );

            voucher.setVoucherId(
                    voucherId
            );

            String error
                    = validateVoucher(
                            voucher,
                            true
                    );

            if (error != null) {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        error
                );

                redirectEdit(
                        request,
                        response,
                        voucherId
                );

                return;
            }

            boolean success
                    = voucherDAO
                            .updateVoucher(
                                    voucher
                            );

            if (success) {

                setSuccessMessage(
                        request,
                        "Cập nhật Voucher thành công."
                );

                User loggedInUser
                        = (User) request.getSession()
                                .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                auditLogService.log(
                        loggedInUser,
                        "UPDATE_VOUCHER",
                        "VOUCHER",
                        null,
                        "Updated voucher: " + voucher.getCode(),
                        request
                );

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

            } else {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        "Cập nhật Voucher thất bại."
                );

                redirectEdit(
                        request,
                        response,
                        voucherId
                );
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {

            e.printStackTrace();

            setErrorMessage(
                    request,
                    "Dữ liệu Voucher không hợp lệ."
            );

            if (voucherId > 0) {

                redirectEdit(
                        request,
                        response,
                        voucherId
                );

            } else {

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );
            }
        }
    }

    private void deleteVoucher(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        try {

            int voucherId
                    = Integer.parseInt(
                            request.getParameter(
                                    "voucherId"
                            )
                    );

            Voucher voucher
                    = voucherDAO
                            .getVoucherById(
                                    voucherId
                            );

            if (voucher == null) {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        "Voucher không tồn tại."
                );

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                return;
            }

            boolean success
                    = voucherDAO
                            .deleteVoucher(
                                    voucherId
                            );

            if (success) {

                setSuccessMessage(
                        request,
                        "Xóa Voucher thành công."
                );

                User loggedInUser
                        = (User) request.getSession()
                                .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                auditLogService.log(
                        loggedInUser,
                        "DELETE_VOUCHER",
                        "VOUCHER",
                        null,
                        "Deleted voucher: " + voucher.getCode(),
                        request
                );

            } else {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        "Không thể xóa Voucher."
                );
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {

            e.printStackTrace();

            setErrorMessage(
                    request,
                    "Không thể xóa Voucher. "
                    + "Voucher có thể đã được sử dụng trong đơn hàng."
            );
        }

        redirectList(
                request,
                response
        );
    }

    private Voucher getVoucherFromRequest(
            HttpServletRequest request) {

        Voucher voucher
                = new Voucher();

        String code
                = request.getParameter(
                        "code"
                );

        if (code != null) {

            code
                    = code.trim()
                            .toUpperCase();
        }

        voucher.setCode(
                code
        );

        String discountType
                = request.getParameter(
                        "discountType"
                );

        if (discountType != null) {

            discountType
                    = discountType
                            .trim()
                            .toUpperCase();
        }

        voucher.setDiscountType(
                discountType
        );

        double discountValue
                = Double.parseDouble(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "discountValue"
                        )
                );

        voucher.setDiscountValue(
                discountValue
        );

        double minOrderValue
                = Double.parseDouble(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "minOrderValue"
                        )
                );

        voucher.setMinOrderValue(
                minOrderValue
        );

        Timestamp validFrom
                = parseTimestamp(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "validFrom"
                        )
                );

        voucher.setValidFrom(
                validFrom
        );

        Timestamp validTo
                = parseTimestamp(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "validTo"
                        )
                );

        voucher.setValidTo(
                validTo
        );
        ;

        Double maxDiscount
                = parseNullableDouble(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "maxDiscount"
                        )
                );

        if ("AMOUNT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                discountType
        )) {

            voucher.setMaxDiscount(
                    null
            );

        } else {

            voucher.setMaxDiscount(
                    maxDiscount
            );
        }

        Integer usageLimit
                = parseNullableInteger(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "usageLimit"
                        )
                );

        voucher.setUsageLimit(
                usageLimit
        );

        Integer perUserLimit
                = parseNullableInteger(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "perUserLimit"
                        )
                );

        voucher.setPerUserLimit(
                perUserLimit
        );

        return voucher;
    }

    private String validateVoucher(
            Voucher voucher,
            boolean isUpdate) {

        if (voucher.getCode() == null
                || voucher.getCode()
                        .trim()
                        .isEmpty()) {

            return "Mã Voucher không được để trống.";
        }

        boolean duplicate;

        if (isUpdate) {

            duplicate
                    = voucherDAO
                            .existsCodeExceptId(
                                    voucher.getCode(),
                                    voucher.getVoucherId()
                            );

        } else {

            duplicate
                    = voucherDAO
                            .existsCode(
                                    voucher.getCode()
                            );
        }

        if (duplicate) {

            return "Mã Voucher đã tồn tại.";
        }

        if (!"AMOUNT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                voucher.getDiscountType()
        )
                && !"PERCENT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                        voucher.getDiscountType()
                )) {

            return "Loại giảm giá không hợp lệ.";
        }

        if (voucher.getDiscountValue()
                <= 0) {

            return "Giá trị giảm phải lớn hơn 0.";
        }

        if ("PERCENT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                voucher.getDiscountType()
        )
                && voucher.getDiscountValue()
                > 100) {

            return "Phần trăm giảm không được vượt quá 100%.";
        }

        if ("PERCENT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                voucher.getDiscountType()
        )
                && voucher.getMaxDiscount()
                != null
                && voucher.getMaxDiscount()
                <= 0) {

            return "Giảm tối đa phải lớn hơn 0.";
        }

        if (voucher.getMinOrderValue()
                < 0) {

            return "Giá trị đơn tối thiểu không hợp lệ.";
        }

        if (voucher.getValidFrom()
                == null
                || voucher.getValidTo()
                == null) {

            return "Thời gian Voucher không hợp lệ.";
        }

        if (!voucher
                .getValidTo()
                .after(
                        voucher.getValidFrom()
                )) {

            return "Thời gian kết thúc phải sau thời gian bắt đầu.";
        }

        if (voucher.getUsageLimit()
                != null
                && voucher.getUsageLimit()
                <= 0) {

            return "Tổng lượt sử dụng phải lớn hơn 0.";
        }

        if (voucher.getPerUserLimit()
                != null
                && voucher.getPerUserLimit()
                <= 0) {

            return "Giới hạn mỗi User phải lớn hơn 0.";
        }

        if (voucher.getUsageLimit()
                != null
                && voucher.getPerUserLimit()
                != null
                && voucher.getPerUserLimit()
                > voucher.getUsageLimit()) {

            return "Giới hạn mỗi User không được lớn hơn tổng lượt sử dụng.";
        }

        return null;
    }

    private Timestamp parseTimestamp(
            String value) {

        if (value == null
                || value.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return null;
        }

        LocalDateTime dateTime
                = LocalDateTime.parse(
                        value,
                        formatter
                );

        return Timestamp.valueOf(
                dateTime
        );
    }

    private Double parseNullableDouble(
            String value) {

        if (value == null
                || value.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return null;
        }

        return Double.parseDouble(
                value.trim()
        );
    }

    private Integer parseNullableInteger(
            String value) {

        if (value == null
                || value.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return null;
        }

        return Integer.parseInt(
                value.trim()
        );
    }

    private void setSuccessMessage(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String message) {

        request.getSession()
                .setAttribute(
                        "successMessage",
                        message
                );
    }

    private void setErrorMessage(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String message) {

        request.getSession()
                .setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        message
                );
    }

    private void redirectList(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/staff/voucher"
        );
    }

    private void redirectCreate(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/staff/voucher?view=create"
        );
    }

    private void redirectEdit(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            int voucherId)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/staff/voucher?view=edit&id="
                + voucherId
        );
    }
}
package controller.admin;

import dao.DashboardDAO;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;

@WebServlet(
        name = "DashboardServlet",
        urlPatterns = "/admin/dashboard"
)
public class AdminDashboardServlet extends HttpServlet {
    private static final int DEFAULT_RANGE_DAYS = 30;

    private DashboardDAO dashboardDAO;

    @Override
    public void init() {
        dashboardDAO = new DashboardDAO();
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        LocalDate endDate = LocalDate.now();
        LocalDate startDate = endDate.minusDays(DEFAULT_RANGE_DAYS - 1);

        String startParam = request.getParameter("startDate");
        String endParam = request.getParameter("endDate");

        String dateError = null;

        boolean hasStart = startParam != null && !startParam.isBlank();

        boolean hasEnd = endParam != null && !endParam.isBlank();

        if (hasStart || hasEnd) {
            if (!hasStart || !hasEnd) {
                dateError
                        = "Vui lòng chọn đầy đủ ngày bắt đầu "
                        + "và ngày kết thúc.";
            } else {
                try {
                    LocalDate selectedStart = LocalDate.parse(startParam);

                    LocalDate selectedEnd = LocalDate.parse(endParam);

                    if (selectedStart.isAfter(selectedEnd)) {
                        dateError
                                = "Ngày bắt đầu không được lớn hơn "
                                + "ngày kết thúc.";
                    } else {
                        startDate = selectedStart;
                        endDate = selectedEnd;
                    }
                } catch (DateTimeParseException ex) {
                    dateError
                            = "Ngày được chọn không hợp lệ.";
                }
            }
        }

        try {
            request.setAttribute(
                    "totalRevenue",
                    dashboardDAO.getTotalRevenueByRange(startDate, endDate)
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "totalOrders",
                    dashboardDAO.getTotalOrdersByRange(startDate, endDate)
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "completedOrders",
                    dashboardDAO.getCompletedOrdersByRange(startDate, endDate)
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "cancelledOrders",
                    dashboardDAO.getCancelledOrdersByRange(startDate, endDate)
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "revenueByDate",
                    dashboardDAO.getRevenueByDateRange(startDate, endDate)
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "orderStatusStatistics",
                    dashboardDAO.getOrderStatusByRange(startDate, endDate)
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "topSellingProducts",
                    dashboardDAO.getTopSellingProductsByRange(startDate, endDate)
            );

            int[] stock = dashboardDAO.getCurrentStockStatistics();

            request.setAttribute("stockAvailable", stock[0]);
            request.setAttribute("stockLow", stock[1]);
            request.setAttribute("stockOut", stock[2]);

            request.setAttribute(
                    "lowStockProducts",
                    dashboardDAO.getLowStockProducts()
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "totalSku",
                    stock[0] + stock[1] + stock[2]
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "startDate", startDate.toString()
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "endDate", endDate.toString()
            );

            request.setAttribute("dateError", dateError);

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/admin/dashboard.jsp").forward(request, response);
        } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Không thể tải thống kê Dashboard "
                    + "từ SQL Server.",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }
}
package controller.admin;

import dao.AdminOrderDAO;
import model.Order;
import model.OrderItem;
import dao.NotificationDAO;
import model.User;
import service.AuditLogService;
import service.OrderCancellationService;
import service.OrderStatusPolicy;
import java.util.UUID;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(name = "AdminOrderServlet", urlPatterns = "/admin/orders/*")
public class AdminOrderServlet extends HttpServlet {
    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(AdminOrderServlet.class.getName());

    private AdminOrderDAO orderDAO;
    private NotificationDAO notificationDAO;

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService = new AuditLogService();

    @Override
    public void init() {
        orderDAO = new AdminOrderDAO();
        notificationDAO = new NotificationDAO();
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        String path = request.getPathInfo();
        if (request.getSession().getAttribute("staffOrderToken") == null) {
            request.getSession().setAttribute("staffOrderToken", UUID.randomUUID().toString());
        }

        if ("/detail".equals(path)) {
            try {
                int orderId = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                Order order = orderDAO.getById(orderId);
                List<OrderItem> items = orderDAO.getItemsByOrderId(orderId);
                String status = orderDAO.getCurrentStatus(orderId);

                if (status == null && order != null) {
                    status = order.getOrderStatus();
                }

                request.setAttribute("order", order);
                request.setAttribute("items", items);
                request.setAttribute("status", status);

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/admin/order-detail.jsp").forward(request, response);
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "Order ID không hợp lệ khi xem chi tiết!", e);

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath() + "/admin/orders"
                );
            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi tải thông tin chi tiết đơn hàng!", e);

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath() + "/admin/orders"
                );
            }
        } else {
            try {
                List<Order> orders = orderDAO.getList();

                request.setAttribute("orders", orders);

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/admin/orders.jsp").forward(request, response);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi lấy danh sách đơn hàng!", e);

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath() + "/admin/dashboard"
                );
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        int orderId;

        try {
            orderId = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("orderId"));
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/admin/orders");
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");
        Object expected = request.getSession().getAttribute("staffOrderToken");
        if (!(expected instanceof String) || !expected.equals(request.getParameter("csrfToken"))) {
            response.sendError(403, "Yêu cầu không hợp lệ. Vui lòng tải lại trang.");
            return;
        }
        if ("cancel".equals(action)) {
            cancelOrder(request, orderId);
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/admin/orders/detail?id=" + orderId);
            return;
        }

        try {
            String current = OrderStatusPolicy.normalize(orderDAO.getCurrentStatus(orderId));
            String nextStatus = OrderStatusPolicy.requestedStatus(current, action);

            if (nextStatus == null) {
                request.getSession().setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        "Không thể cập nhật! Vui lòng thực hiện đúng trình tự: "
                        + "Confirmed → Packing → Shipping → Completed."
                );
            } else if (orderDAO.transitionStatus(orderId, nextStatus)) {
                request.getSession().setAttribute("successMessage", statusSuccessMessage(nextStatus));

                User loggedInUser = (User) request.getSession()
                                .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                auditLogService.log(
                        loggedInUser,
                        "UPDATE_ORDER_STATUS",
                        "ORDER",
                        (long) orderId,
                        "Changed order #" + orderId
                        + " status from "
                        + current
                        + " to "
                        + nextStatus,
                        request
                );

                notifyOrderStatus(orderId, nextStatus);
            } else {
                request.getSession().setAttribute("errorMessage", "Không thể chuyển trạng thái. Vui lòng tải lại đơn hàng!");
            }
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            request.getSession().setAttribute("errorMessage", e.getMessage());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi cập nhật trạng thái đơn hàng #" + orderId,
                    e
            );

            request.getSession().setAttribute("errorMessage", "Thao tác thất bại! Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.");
        }

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/admin/orders/detail?id=" + orderId
        );
    }

    private String statusSuccessMessage(String status) {
        switch (status) {
            case "CONFIRMED":
                return "Xác nhận đơn hàng thành công!";
            case "PACKING":
                return "Đơn hàng đã chuyển sang đóng gói!";
            case "SHIPPING":
                return "Đơn hàng đã chuyển sang giao hàng!";
            case "COMPLETED":
                return "Đơn hàng đã hoàn thành!";
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported order status: " + status);
        }
    }

    private void cancelOrder(HttpServletRequest request, int orderId) {
        try {
