            User staff = (User) request.getSession().getAttribute("loggedInUser");
            OrderCancellationService cancellation = new OrderCancellationService();
            String result = cancellation.staffCancel(staff.getUserId(), orderId);
            auditLogService.log(staff, "CANCEL_ORDER", "ORDER", (long) orderId, "Staff cancellation: " + result, request);
            request.getSession().setAttribute("successMessage", "UNCHANGED".equals(result)
                    ? "Đơn hàng đã được hủy trước đó."
                    : "Đã hủy đơn hàng thành công");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            request.getSession().setAttribute("errorMessage", e.getMessage());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot process cancellation", e);
            request.getSession().setAttribute("errorMessage", "Chưa xử lý được yêu cầu. Vui lòng tải lại đơn và thử lại.");
        }
    }

    private void notifyOrderStatus(int orderId, String nextStatus) {
        try {
            boolean notified = notificationDAO
                    .createOrderStatusNotification(orderId, nextStatus);

            if (!notified) {
                LOGGER.warning(
                        "Không tạo được thông báo cho đơn hàng #" + orderId
                );
            }
        } catch (Exception notificationError) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.WARNING,
                    "Lỗi tạo thông báo cho đơn hàng #" + orderId,
                    notificationError
            );
        }
    }
}
package controller.admin;

import dao.AuditLogDAO;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import model.AuditLog;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;

@WebServlet(name = "AuditLogServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/admin/audit-log"})
public class AuditLogServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private final AuditLogDAO auditLogDAO
            = new AuditLogDAO();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String keyword
                = request.getParameter("keyword");

        String action
                = request.getParameter("action");

        String entityType
                = request.getParameter("entityType");

        List<AuditLog> logs
                = auditLogDAO.search(
                        keyword,
                        action,
                        entityType
                );

        request.setAttribute("auditLogs", logs);
        request.setAttribute("keyword", keyword);
        request.setAttribute("selectedAction", action);
        request.setAttribute("selectedEntityType", entityType);

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/admin/audit-log.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }
}
package controller.admin;

import dao.ReportDAO;
import model.User;
import service.AuditLogService;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.*;
import org.apache.poi.xssf.usermodel.XSSFWorkbook;

import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPage;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPageContentStream;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.common.PDRectangle;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.font.PDType0Font;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Date;
import java.text.DecimalFormat;
import java.text.DecimalFormatSymbols;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "ReportExportServlet",
        urlPatterns = "/admin/report/export"
)
public class ReportExportServlet extends HttpServlet {
    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(ReportExportServlet.class.getName());

    private static final DateTimeFormatter DATE_FORMAT = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd/MM/yyyy");

    private static final String FONT_REGULAR = "/WEB-INF/fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf";

    private static final String FONT_BOLD = "/WEB-INF/fonts/NotoSans-Bold.ttf";

    private ReportDAO reportDAO;

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService = new AuditLogService();

    @Override
    public void init() {
        reportDAO = new ReportDAO();
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        String startParam = request.getParameter("startDate");

        String endParam = request.getParameter("endDate");

        String format = request.getParameter("format");

        if (format == null || format.trim().isEmpty()) {
            format = "excel";
        }

        if (!format.equalsIgnoreCase("excel")
                && !format.equalsIgnoreCase("pdf")) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST, "Định dạng báo cáo không hợp lệ.");
            return;
        }

        String today = LocalDate.now().toString();

        if (startParam == null
                || startParam.trim().isEmpty()) {
            startParam = today;
        }

        if (endParam == null
                || endParam.trim().isEmpty()) {
            endParam = today;
        }

        LocalDate startDate;
        LocalDate endDate;

        try {
            startDate = LocalDate.parse(startParam);
            endDate = LocalDate.parse(endParam);
        } catch (DateTimeParseException e) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST, "Ngày không hợp lệ.");
            return;
        }

        if (startDate.isAfter(endDate)) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST, "Ngày bắt đầu không được lớn hơn ngày kết thúc.");
            return;
        }

        try {
            String exportFormat;
            if (format.equalsIgnoreCase("pdf")) {
                exportPdf(response, startDate, endDate);
                exportFormat = "PDF";
            } else {
                exportExcel(response, startDate, endDate);
                exportFormat = "EXCEL";
            }
            User loggedInUser = (User) request.getSession()
                            .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

            auditLogService.log(
                    loggedInUser,
                    "EXPORT_REPORT",
                    "REPORT",
                    null,
                    "Exported revenue report as "
                    + exportFormat
                    + " from "
                    + startDate
                    + " to "
                    + endDate,
                    request
            );
        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi xuất báo cáo OECS", e);

            if (!response.isCommitted()) {
                response.reset();
                throw new ServletException("Không thể xuất báo cáo.", e);
            }

            throw new IOException("Lỗi khi xuất báo cáo.", e);
        }
    }

    private void exportExcel(
            HttpServletResponse response,
            LocalDate startDate,
            LocalDate endDate) throws IOException {
        BigDecimal totalRevenue = reportDAO.getTotalRevenueByRange(startDate, endDate);
        int completedOrders = reportDAO.getCompletedOrdersByRange(startDate, endDate);
        int totalProductsSold = reportDAO.getTotalProductsSoldByRange(startDate, endDate);
        List<Object[]> revenueByDate = reportDAO.getRevenueByDateRange(startDate, endDate);
        List<Object[]> orderStatusStats = reportDAO.getOrderStatusByRange(startDate, endDate);
        List<Object[]> topSellingProducts = reportDAO.getTopSellingProductsByRange(startDate, endDate);
        BigDecimal averageOrderValue = ReportDAO.calculateAverageOrderValue(totalRevenue, completedOrders);

        try (Workbook workbook = new XSSFWorkbook()) {
            Sheet sheet = workbook.createSheet("Bao cao kinh doanh");

            org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.Font titleFont = workbook.createFont();

            titleFont.setBold(true);
            titleFont.setFontName("Arial");
            titleFont.setFontHeightInPoints((short) 17);
            titleFont.setColor(
                    IndexedColors.DARK_BLUE.getIndex()
            );

            CellStyle titleStyle = workbook.createCellStyle();

            titleStyle.setFont(titleFont);

            org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.Font headerFont = workbook.createFont();

            headerFont.setBold(true);
            headerFont.setFontName("Arial");
            headerFont.setColor(
                    IndexedColors.WHITE.getIndex()
            );

            CellStyle headerStyle = workbook.createCellStyle();

            headerStyle.setFont(headerFont);

            headerStyle.setFillForegroundColor(
                    IndexedColors.DARK_BLUE.getIndex()
            );

            headerStyle.setFillPattern(FillPatternType.SOLID_FOREGROUND);

            headerStyle.setVerticalAlignment(VerticalAlignment.CENTER);

            CellStyle moneyStyle = workbook.createCellStyle();

            moneyStyle.setDataFormat(
                    workbook.createDataFormat()
                            .getFormat("#,##0.##")
            );

            CellStyle percentStyle = workbook.createCellStyle();

            percentStyle.setDataFormat(
                    workbook.createDataFormat()
                            .getFormat("0.0%")
            );

            int row = 0;

            Row titleRow = sheet.createRow(row++);
            titleRow.setHeightInPoints(32);

            Cell titleCell = titleRow.createCell(0);

            titleCell.setCellValue("OECS - BÁO CÁO KINH DOANH");

            titleCell.setCellStyle(titleStyle);

            row++;

            addTextRow(
                    sheet, row++,
                    "Ngày bắt đầu",
                    startDate.format(DATE_FORMAT)
            );

            addTextRow(
                    sheet, row++,
                    "Ngày kết thúc",
                    endDate.format(DATE_FORMAT)
            );

            row++;

            row = addSection(sheet, row, headerStyle, "TỔNG QUAN KINH DOANH");

            addMoneyRow(
                    sheet, row++,
                    "Tổng doanh thu (VNĐ)",
                    totalRevenue,
                    moneyStyle
            );

            addNumberRow(
                    sheet, row++,
                    "Đơn hàng hoàn thành",
                    completedOrders
            );

            addNumberRow(
                    sheet, row++,
                    "Sản phẩm đã bán",
                    totalProductsSold
            );

            addMoneyRow(
                    sheet, row++,
                    "Giá trị đơn trung bình (VNĐ)",
                    averageOrderValue,
                    moneyStyle
            );

            row++;

            row = addSection(sheet, row, headerStyle, "THỐNG KÊ TRẠNG THÁI ĐƠN HÀNG");

            row = addTableHeader(sheet, row, headerStyle, "Trạng thái", "Số đơn hàng", "Tỷ lệ");

            int totalOrders = 0;

            for (Object[] item : orderStatusStats) {
                totalOrders += toInt(item[1]);
            }

            if (orderStatusStats.isEmpty()) {
                addTextRow(
                        sheet, row++,
                        "Không có đơn hàng",
                        ""
                );
            } else {
                for (Object[] item : orderStatusStats) {
                    String status = statusName(String.valueOf(item[0]));

                    int count = toInt(item[1]);

                    double ratio = totalOrders > 0
                            ? (double) count / totalOrders
                            : 0;

                    Row excelRow = sheet.createRow(row++);

                    excelRow.createCell(0)
                            .setCellValue(status);

                    excelRow.createCell(1)
                            .setCellValue(count);

                    Cell cell = excelRow.createCell(2);

                    cell.setCellValue(ratio);
                    cell.setCellStyle(percentStyle);
                }
            }

            row++;

            row = addSection(sheet, row, headerStyle, "TOP 5 SẢN PHẨM BÁN CHẠY");

            row = addTableHeader(sheet, row, headerStyle, "Hạng", "Tên sản phẩm", "Số lượng đã bán");

            if (topSellingProducts.isEmpty()) {
                addTextRow(
                        sheet, row++,
                        "Không có sản phẩm bán ra",
                        ""
                );
            } else {
                int rank = 1;

                for (Object[] item : topSellingProducts) {
                    Row excelRow = sheet.createRow(row++);

                    excelRow.createCell(0)
                            .setCellValue(rank++);

                    excelRow.createCell(1)
                            .setCellValue(
                                    String.valueOf(item[0])
                            );

                    excelRow.createCell(2)
                            .setCellValue(toInt(item[1]));
                }
            }

            row++;

            row = addSection(sheet, row, headerStyle, "DOANH THU THEO NGÀY");

            row = addTableHeader(sheet, row, headerStyle, "Ngày", "Doanh thu (VNĐ)", "Số đơn hoàn thành");

            if (revenueByDate.isEmpty()) {
                addTextRow(
                        sheet, row++,
                        "Không có doanh thu",
                        ""
                );
            } else {
                for (Object[] item : revenueByDate) {
                    Row excelRow = sheet.createRow(row++);

                    excelRow.createCell(0)
                            .setCellValue(formatDate(item[0]));

                    Cell revenueCell = excelRow.createCell(1);

                    revenueCell.setCellValue(
                            toMoney(item[1]).doubleValue()
                    );

                    revenueCell.setCellStyle(moneyStyle);

                    excelRow.createCell(2)
                            .setCellValue(toInt(item[2]));
                }
            }

            row++;

            addMoneyRow(
                    sheet, row++,
                    "TỔNG DOANH THU (VNĐ)",
                    totalRevenue,
                    moneyStyle
            );

            row++;

            addTextRow(
                    sheet, row++,
                    "Ghi chú",
                    "Doanh thu chỉ tính đơn COMPLETED"
            );

            addTextRow(
                    sheet, row++,
                    "Thời gian",
                    "Thống kê theo ngày tạo đơn"
            );

            sheet.setColumnWidth(0, 34 * 256);
            sheet.setColumnWidth(1, 46 * 256);
            sheet.setColumnWidth(2, 25 * 256);

            sheet.setDisplayGridlines(false);

            response.setContentType(
                    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument."
                    + "spreadsheetml.sheet"
            );

            response.setHeader(
                    "Content-Disposition",
                    "attachment; filename=\"OECS_BaoCaoKinhDoanh.xlsx\""
            );

            workbook.write(response.getOutputStream());
        }
    }

    private int addSection(
            Sheet sheet,
            int rowIndex,
            CellStyle style,
            String title) {
        Row row = sheet.createRow(rowIndex++);
        row.setHeightInPoints(24);

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            Cell cell = row.createCell(i);
            cell.setCellStyle(style);

            if (i == 0) {
                cell.setCellValue(title);
            }
        }

        return rowIndex;
    }

    private int addTableHeader(
            Sheet sheet,
            int rowIndex,
            CellStyle style,
            String... headers) {
        Row row = sheet.createRow(rowIndex++);
        row.setHeightInPoints(23);

        for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
            Cell cell = row.createCell(i);

            cell.setCellValue(headers[i]);
            cell.setCellStyle(style);
        }

        return rowIndex;
    }

    private void addTextRow(
            Sheet sheet,
            int rowIndex,
            String label,
            String value) {
        Row row = sheet.createRow(rowIndex);

        row.createCell(0).setCellValue(label);
        row.createCell(1).setCellValue(value);
    }

    private void addNumberRow(
            Sheet sheet,
            int rowIndex,
            String label,
            int value) {
        Row row = sheet.createRow(rowIndex);

        row.createCell(0).setCellValue(label);
        row.createCell(1).setCellValue(value);
    }

    private void addMoneyRow(
            Sheet sheet,
            int rowIndex,
            String label,
            BigDecimal value,
            CellStyle style) {
        Row row = sheet.createRow(rowIndex);

        row.createCell(0).setCellValue(label);

        Cell cell = row.createCell(1);

        cell.setCellValue(
                value == null ? 0 : value.doubleValue()
        );

        cell.setCellStyle(style);
    }

    private void exportPdf(
            HttpServletResponse response,
            LocalDate startDate,
            LocalDate endDate) throws IOException {
        BigDecimal totalRevenue = reportDAO.getTotalRevenueByRange(startDate, endDate);
        int completedOrders = reportDAO.getCompletedOrdersByRange(startDate, endDate);
        int totalProductsSold = reportDAO.getTotalProductsSoldByRange(startDate, endDate);
        List<Object[]> revenueByDate = reportDAO.getRevenueByDateRange(startDate, endDate);
        List<Object[]> orderStatusStats = reportDAO.getOrderStatusByRange(startDate, endDate);
        List<Object[]> topSellingProducts = reportDAO.getTopSellingProductsByRange(startDate, endDate);
        BigDecimal averageOrderValue = ReportDAO.calculateAverageOrderValue(totalRevenue, completedOrders);

        try (
                InputStream regularStream = getServletContext().getResourceAsStream(FONT_REGULAR); InputStream boldStream = getServletContext().getResourceAsStream(FONT_BOLD)) {
                    if (regularStream == null || boldStream == null) {
                        throw new IOException(
                                "Không tìm thấy NotoSans-Regular.ttf hoặc "
                                + "NotoSans-Bold.ttf trong WEB-INF/fonts."
                        );
                    }

                    try (PDDocument document = new PDDocument()) {
                        PDType0Font regular = PDType0Font.load(document, regularStream, true);

                        PDType0Font bold = PDType0Font.load(document, boldStream, true);

                        try (PdfWriter pdf = new PdfWriter(document, regular, bold)) {
                            pdf.heading("OECS - BÁO CÁO KINH DOANH");

                            pdf.paragraph(
                                    "Thời gian: "
                                    + startDate.format(DATE_FORMAT)
                                    + " - "
                                    + endDate.format(DATE_FORMAT)
                            );

                            pdf.space(14);

                            pdf.section("1. TỔNG QUAN KINH DOANH");

                            pdf.paragraph(
                                    "Tổng doanh thu: "
                                    + formatMoney(totalRevenue)
                                    + " VNĐ"
                            );

                            pdf.paragraph(
                                    "Đơn hàng hoàn thành: "
                                    + completedOrders
                            );

                            pdf.paragraph(
                                    "Sản phẩm đã bán: "
                                    + totalProductsSold
                            );

                            pdf.paragraph(
                                    "Giá trị đơn trung bình: "
                                    + formatMoney(averageOrderValue)
                                    + " VNĐ"
                            );

                            pdf.space(14);

                            pdf.section("2. THỐNG KÊ TRẠNG THÁI ĐƠN HÀNG");

                            int totalOrders = 0;

                            for (Object[] item : orderStatusStats) {
                                totalOrders += toInt(item[1]);
                            }

                            if (orderStatusStats.isEmpty()) {
                                pdf.paragraph("Không có đơn hàng trong khoảng thời gian này.");
                            } else {
                                pdf.beginTable(
                                        new String[]{
                                            "Trạng thái",
                                            "Số đơn",
                                            "Tỷ lệ"
                                        },
                                        new float[]{220, 140, 140}
                                );

                                for (Object[] item : orderStatusStats) {
                                    int count = toInt(item[1]);

                                    double percent = totalOrders > 0
                                            ? count * 100.0 / totalOrders
                                            : 0;

                                    pdf.tableRow(
                                            statusName(
                                                    String.valueOf(item[0])
                                            ),
                                            String.valueOf(count),
                                            String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f%%", percent)
                                    );
                                }
                            }

                            pdf.space(14);

                            pdf.section("3. TOP 5 SẢN PHẨM BÁN CHẠY");

                            if (topSellingProducts.isEmpty()) {
                                pdf.paragraph("Không có sản phẩm bán ra trong kỳ.");
                            } else {
                                pdf.beginTable(
                                        new String[]{
                                            "Hạng",
                                            "Tên sản phẩm",
                                            "Số lượng"
                                        },
                                        new float[]{60, 340, 100}
                                );

                                int rank = 1;

                                for (Object[] item : topSellingProducts) {
                                    pdf.tableRow(
                                            String.valueOf(rank++),
                                            String.valueOf(item[0]),
                                            String.valueOf(toInt(item[1]))
                                    );
                                }
                            }

                            pdf.space(14);

                            pdf.section("4. DOANH THU THEO NGÀY");

                            if (revenueByDate.isEmpty()) {
                                pdf.paragraph("Không có doanh thu trong khoảng thời gian này.");
                            } else {
                                pdf.beginTable(
                                        new String[]{
                                            "Ngày",
                                            "Doanh thu (VNĐ)",
                                            "Số đơn"
                                        },
                                        new float[]{125, 245, 130}
                                );

                                for (Object[] item : revenueByDate) {
                                    pdf.tableRow(
                                            formatDate(item[0]),
                                            formatMoney(toMoney(item[1])),
                                            String.valueOf(toInt(item[2]))
                                    );
                                }
                            }

                            pdf.space(14);

                            pdf.section(
                                    "TỔNG DOANH THU: "
                                    + formatMoney(totalRevenue)
                                    + " VNĐ"
                            );

                            pdf.space(10);

                            pdf.paragraph(
                                    "Ghi chú: Doanh thu và sản phẩm bán ra "
                                    + "chỉ tính đơn hàng COMPLETED."
                            );

                            pdf.paragraph(
                                    "Thời gian được xác định theo ngày tạo "
                                    + "đơn hàng (created_at)."
                            );
                        }

                        response.setContentType("application/pdf");

                        response.setHeader(
                                "Content-Disposition",
                                "attachment; filename=\"OECS_BaoCaoKinhDoanh.pdf\""
                        );

                        document.save(
                                response.getOutputStream()
                        );
                    }
                }
    }

    private static class PdfWriter implements AutoCloseable {
        private static final float PAGE_TOP = 780;
        private static final float PAGE_BOTTOM = 48;
        private static final float LEFT = 47;

        private final PDDocument document;
        private final PDType0Font regularFont;
        private final PDType0Font boldFont;

        private PDPageContentStream content;
        private float y;

        private String[] tableHeaders;
        private float[] tableWidths;
        private boolean tableActive = false;
        private int pageNumber = 0;

        PdfWriter(
                PDDocument document,
                PDType0Font regularFont,
                PDType0Font boldFont) throws IOException {
            this.document = document;
            this.regularFont = regularFont;
            this.boldFont = boldFont;

            newPage();
        }

        private void newPage() throws IOException {
            if (content != null) {
                content.close();
            }

            PDPage page = new PDPage(PDRectangle.A4);

            document.addPage(page);

            content = new PDPageContentStream(document, page);

            y = PAGE_TOP;
            pageNumber++;

            if (pageNumber > 1) {
                drawText("OECS - Báo cáo kinh doanh (tiếp)", LEFT, y, 10, true);

                y -= 29;
            }
        }

        private void ensureSpace(float height)
                throws IOException {
            if (y - height < PAGE_BOTTOM) {
                newPage();

                // Lặp lại tiêu đề bảng ở trang mới
                if (tableActive && tableHeaders != null) {
                    drawTableHeader();
                }
            }
        }

        void heading(String text) throws IOException {
            tableActive = false;
            ensureSpace(38);

            drawText(text, LEFT, y, 16, true);

            y -= 36;
        }

        void section(String text) throws IOException {
            tableActive = false;
            ensureSpace(35);

            drawText(text, LEFT, y, 11, true);

            y -= 26;
        }

        void paragraph(String text) throws IOException {
            tableActive = false;

            List<String> lines = wrapText(text, regularFont, 10, 500);

            for (String line : lines) {
                ensureSpace(18);

                drawText(line, LEFT, y, 10, false);

                y -= 18;
            }
        }

        void space(float height) throws IOException {
            tableActive = false;
            ensureSpace(height);

            y -= height;
        }

        void beginTable(
                String[] headers,
                float[] widths) throws IOException {
            tableActive = false;

            ensureSpace(25);

            tableHeaders = headers;
            tableWidths = widths;
            tableActive = true;

            drawTableHeader();
        }

        private void drawTableHeader() throws IOException {
            float x = LEFT;

            for (int i = 0; i < tableHeaders.length; i++) {
                drawText(
                        tableHeaders[i],
                        x, y, 9, true
                );

                x += tableWidths[i];
            }

            y -= 22;
        }

        void tableRow(String... cells) throws IOException {
            if (!tableActive) {
                throw new IOException("Chưa khởi tạo bảng PDF.");
            }

            List<List<String>> wrapped = new ArrayList<>();

            int maxLines = 1;

            for (int i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {
                List<String> lines = wrapText(
                        cells[i],
                        regularFont,
                        9,
                        tableWidths[i] - 12
                );

                wrapped.add(lines);

                maxLines = Math.max(
                        maxLines,
                        lines.size()
                );
            }

            float rowHeight = maxLines * 15 + 6;

            ensureSpace(rowHeight);

            float x = LEFT;

            for (int i = 0; i < wrapped.size(); i++) {
                List<String> lines = wrapped.get(i);

                for (int j = 0; j < lines.size(); j++) {
                    drawText(
                            lines.get(j),
                            x,
                            y - (j * 15),
                            9,
                            false
                    );
                }

                x += tableWidths[i];
            }

            y -= rowHeight;
        }

        private void drawText(
                String text,
                float x,
                float positionY,
                int fontSize,
                boolean bold) throws IOException {
            PDType0Font font = bold ? boldFont : regularFont;

            String safeText = text == null ? "" : text;

            if (safeText.isEmpty()) {
                return;
            }

            content.beginText();

            content.setFont(font, fontSize);

            content.newLineAtOffset(x, positionY);

            content.showText(safeText);

            content.endText();
        }

        private List<String> wrapText(
                String text,
                PDType0Font font,
                int fontSize,
                float maxWidth) throws IOException {
            List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();

            if (text == null || text.trim().isEmpty()) {
                result.add("");
                return result;
            }

            StringBuilder current = new StringBuilder();

            for (String word : text.trim().split("\\s+")) {
                String candidate = current.length() == 0
                        ? word
                        : current + " " + word;

                if (textWidth(candidate, font, fontSize) <= maxWidth) {
                    current.setLength(0);
                    current.append(candidate);
                } else {
                    if (current.length() > 0) {
                        result.add(current.toString());
                        current.setLength(0);
                    }

                    StringBuilder part = new StringBuilder();

                    for (int offset = 0;
                            offset < word.length();) {
                        int cp = word.codePointAt(offset);

                        String ch = new String(
                                Character.toChars(cp)
                        );

                        String test = part.toString() + ch;

                        if (part.length() > 0
                                && textWidth(test, font, fontSize) > maxWidth) {
                            result.add(part.toString());
                            part.setLength(0);
                        }

                        part.append(ch);

                        offset += Character.charCount(cp);
                    }

                    current.append(part);
                }
            }

            if (current.length() > 0) {
                result.add(current.toString());
            }

            return result;
        }

        private float textWidth(
                String text,
                PDType0Font font,
                int fontSize) throws IOException {
            return font.getStringWidth(text)
                    / 1000f * fontSize;
        }

        @Override
        public void close() throws IOException {
            if (content != null) {
                content.close();
                content = null;
            }
        }
    }

    private static int toInt(Object value) {
        if (value instanceof Number) {
            return ((Number) value).intValue();
        }

        return 0;
    }

    private static BigDecimal toMoney(Object value) {
        if (value instanceof BigDecimal) {
            return (BigDecimal) value;
        }

        if (value instanceof Number) {
            return BigDecimal.valueOf(
                    ((Number) value).doubleValue()
            );
        }

        return BigDecimal.ZERO;
    }

    private static String formatMoney(BigDecimal value) {
        DecimalFormatSymbols symbols = new DecimalFormatSymbols(
                        new Locale("vi", "VN")
                );

        symbols.setGroupingSeparator('.');

        DecimalFormat formatter = new DecimalFormat("#,##0.##", symbols);

        return formatter.format(
                value == null
                        ? BigDecimal.ZERO
                        : value
        );
    }

    private static String formatDate(Object value) {
        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }

        if (value instanceof LocalDate) {
            return ((LocalDate) value)
                    .format(DATE_FORMAT);
        }

        if (value instanceof Date) {
            return ((Date) value)
                    .toLocalDate()
                    .format(DATE_FORMAT);
        }

        String text = value.toString();

        try {
            return LocalDate.parse(
                    text.substring(0, 10)
            ).format(DATE_FORMAT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return text;
        }
    }

    private static String statusName(String status) {
        if (status == null) {
            return "Không xác định";
        }

        switch (status) {
            case "PENDING_CONFIRMATION":
                return "Chờ xác nhận";

            case "CONFIRMED":
                return "Đã xác nhận";

            case "PACKING":
                return "Đang đóng gói";

            case "SHIPPING":
                return "Đang giao hàng";

            case "COMPLETED":
                return "Hoàn thành";

            case "CANCELLED":
                return "Đã hủy";

            default:
                return status;
        }
    }
}
package controller.admin;

import dao.ReportDAO;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "ReportServlet",
        urlPatterns = "/admin/report"
)
public class ReportServlet extends HttpServlet {
    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(ReportServlet.class.getName());

    private static final int DEFAULT_RANGE_DAYS = 30;

    private ReportDAO reportDAO;

    @Override
    public void init() {
        reportDAO = new ReportDAO();
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        try {

            String startDateParam =
                    request.getParameter("startDate");

            String endDateParam
                    = request.getParameter("endDate");

            LocalDate defaultEnd = LocalDate.now();

            if (startDateParam == null
                    || startDateParam.trim().isEmpty()) {
                startDateParam = defaultEnd.minusDays(DEFAULT_RANGE_DAYS - 1).toString();
            }

            if (endDateParam == null
                    || endDateParam.trim().isEmpty()) {
                endDateParam = defaultEnd.toString();
            }

            LocalDate startDate = null;
            LocalDate endDate = null;
            String filterError = null;

            try {
                startDate = LocalDate.parse(startDateParam);
                endDate = LocalDate.parse(endDateParam);

                if (startDate.isAfter(endDate)) {
                    filterError
                            = "Start date cannot be after end date.";
                }
            } catch (DateTimeParseException e) {
                filterError
                        = "Invalid date format. Please select valid dates.";
            }

            BigDecimal totalRevenue = BigDecimal.ZERO;
            int completedOrders = 0;
            int totalProductsSold = 0;
            List<Object[]> revenueByDate = Collections.emptyList();
            List<Object[]> orderStatusStats = Collections.emptyList();
            List<Object[]> topSellingProducts = Collections.emptyList();

            if (filterError == null) {
                totalRevenue = reportDAO.getTotalRevenueByRange(startDate, endDate);
                completedOrders = reportDAO.getCompletedOrdersByRange(startDate, endDate);
                totalProductsSold = reportDAO.getTotalProductsSoldByRange(startDate, endDate);
                revenueByDate = reportDAO.getRevenueByDateRange(startDate, endDate);
                orderStatusStats = reportDAO.getOrderStatusByRange(startDate, endDate);
                topSellingProducts = reportDAO.getTopSellingProductsByRange(startDate, endDate);
            }
            BigDecimal averageOrderValue = ReportDAO.calculateAverageOrderValue(totalRevenue, completedOrders);

            request.setAttribute("totalRevenue", totalRevenue);
            request.setAttribute("completedOrders", completedOrders);
            request.setAttribute("totalProductsSold", totalProductsSold);
            request.setAttribute("averageOrderValue", averageOrderValue);
            request.setAttribute("revenueByDate", revenueByDate);
            request.setAttribute("orderStatusStats", orderStatusStats);
            request.setAttribute("topSellingProducts", topSellingProducts);

            request.setAttribute("startDate", startDateParam);

            request.setAttribute("endDate", endDateParam);

            request.setAttribute("filterError", filterError);

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/admin/report.jsp").forward(request, response);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Error loading Report page", e);

            throw new ServletException("Cannot load Report page.", e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
        doGet(request, response);
    }
}
package controller.admin;

import dao.UserDAO;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import model.User;
import service.AuditLogService;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.UUID;

import service.EmailService;
import service.PasswordResetService;

@WebServlet(name = "UserServlet", urlPatterns = {"/user"})
public class UserServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(UserServlet.class.getName());

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService = new AuditLogService();
    private final PasswordResetService passwordResetService = new PasswordResetService();
    private final EmailService emailService = new EmailService();

    private boolean checkPermission(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return false;
        }

        User loggedInUser = (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (loggedInUser == null) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return false;
        }

        if (!loggedInUser.isAdmin()) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/home");
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        if (!checkPermission(request, response)) {
            return;
        }

        String view = request.getParameter("view");

        UserDAO dao = new UserDAO();
        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        if (view == null || "list".equals(view)) {

            String keyword = request.getParameter("keyword");
            String roleIdParam = request.getParameter("roleId");
            String status = request.getParameter("status");
            String sort = request.getParameter("sort");

            keyword = keyword != null ? keyword.trim() : "";
            status = status != null ? status.trim() : "";
            sort = sort != null ? sort.trim() : "newest";

// Chuyen roleId tu String sang Integer.
            Integer roleId = null;

            if (roleIdParam != null
                    && !roleIdParam.trim().isEmpty()) {

                try {

                    roleId = Integer.valueOf(roleIdParam.trim());

                    if (roleId <= 0) {
                        response.sendError(
                                HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                                "Role ID khong hop le."
                        );
                        return;
                    }

                } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {

                    response.sendError(
                            HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                            "Role ID khong hop le."
                    );
                    return;
                }
            }

// Loc nguoi dung theo role_id.
            List<User> userList = dao.getAllUsers(
                    keyword,
                    roleId,
                    status,
                    sort
            );

// Lay danh sach Role cho dropdown tren JSP.
            request.setAttribute(
                    "roleList",
                    dao.getAllRoles()
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "userList",
                    userList
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "keyword",
                    keyword
            );

            request.setAttribute("roleId", roleId);

            request.setAttribute(
                    "status",
                    status
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "sort",
                    sort
            );
            request.setAttribute("keyword", keyword);
            request.setAttribute("message", session.getAttribute("message"));
            request.setAttribute("error", session.getAttribute("error"));

            session.removeAttribute("message");
            session.removeAttribute("error");

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/user/list.jsp").forward(request, response);

        } else if ("create".equals(view)) {

            request.setAttribute("roleList", dao.getAllRoles());

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/user/create.jsp").forward(request, response);

        } else {

            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=list");
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        if (!checkPermission(request, response)) {
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        UserDAO dao = new UserDAO();
        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        if ("create".equals(action)) {

            String username = request.getParameter("username");
            String email = request.getParameter("email");
            String phone = request.getParameter("phone");
            String roleIdParam = request.getParameter("roleId");

            username = username != null ? username.trim() : "";
            email = email != null ? email.trim() : "";
            phone = phone != null ? phone.trim() : "";

            try {

                if (username.isEmpty()
                        || email.isEmpty()
                        || roleIdParam == null
                        || roleIdParam.isEmpty()) {

                    session.setAttribute("error", "Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ thông tin!");

                    response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=create");
                    return;
                }

                int roleId = Integer.parseInt(roleIdParam);

                if (dao.checkUserExist(username, email)) {

                    session.setAttribute("error", "Username hoặc Email đã tồn tại!");

                    response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=create");
                    return;
                }

                User newUser = new User();

                newUser.setUsername(username);
                newUser.setEmail(email);
                newUser.setPhone(phone);
                newUser.setRoleId(roleId);

                String temporaryPassword = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                        + UUID.randomUUID().toString();

                boolean success = dao.createUser(newUser, temporaryPassword);

                if (!success) {

                    session.setAttribute("error", "Tạo tài khoản thất bại!");

                    response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=create");
                    return;
                }

                User createdUser = dao.findByEmail(email);

                String token = passwordResetService.createResetToken(email, 24 * 60);

                boolean emailSent = false;

                if (token != null) {

                    String setupLink = buildResetLink(request, token);

                    emailSent = emailService.sendAccountSetupEmail(email, setupLink);
                }

                if (emailSent) {

                    session.setAttribute(
                            "message",
                            "Tạo tài khoản thành công! "
                            + "Liên kết thiết lập mật khẩu "
                            + "đã được gửi đến email người dùng."
                    );

                } else {

                    session.setAttribute(
                            "message",
                            "Tài khoản đã được tạo, "
                            + "nhưng không thể gửi email "
                            + "thiết lập mật khẩu."
                    );
                }

                User loggedInUser = (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                Long createdUserId = createdUser != null
                        ? (long) createdUser.getUserId()
                        : null;

                auditLogService.log(
                        loggedInUser,
                        "CREATE_USER",
                        "USER",
                        createdUserId,
                        "Created new user account: " + username,
                        request
                );

                response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=list");
                return;

            } catch (Exception e) {

                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi tạo User!", e);

                session.setAttribute("error", "Lỗi khi tạo tài khoản!");

                response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=create");
                return;
            }

        } else if ("toggleStatus".equals(action)) {

            try {

                int id = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("id"));

                boolean active = Boolean.parseBoolean(request.getParameter("active"));

                User loggedInUser = (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                if (loggedInUser != null && loggedInUser.getUserId() == id) {

                    session.setAttribute("error", "Không thể khóa tài khoản "
                            + "đang đăng nhập!");

                    response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=list");
                    return;
                }

                User selectedUser = dao.getUserById(id);

                if (selectedUser == null) {

                    session.setAttribute("error", "Không tìm thấy tài khoản!");

                    response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=list");
                    return;
                }

                boolean success = dao.updateUserStatus(id, active);

                if (success) {

                    if (active) {

                        session.setAttribute("message", "Mở khóa tài khoản thành công!");

                        auditLogService.log(
                                loggedInUser,
                                "UNLOCK_USER",
                                "USER",
                                (long) id,
                                "Unlocked user account: " + selectedUser.getUsername(),
                                request
                        );

                    } else {

                        session.setAttribute("message", "Khóa tài khoản thành công!");

                        auditLogService.log(
                                loggedInUser,
                                "LOCK_USER",
                                "USER",
                                (long) id,
                                "Locked user account: " + selectedUser.getUsername(),
                                request
                        );
                    }

                } else {

                    session.setAttribute("error", "Cập nhật trạng thái tài khoản thất bại!");
                }

                response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=list");

            } catch (Exception e) {

                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi cập nhật trạng thái User!", e);

                session.setAttribute("error", "Lỗi khi cập nhật trạng thái tài khoản!");

                response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=list");
            }

        } else {

            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=list");
        }
    }

    private String buildResetLink(HttpServletRequest request, String token) {

        StringBuilder url = new StringBuilder();

        url.append(request.getScheme())
                .append("://")
                .append(request.getServerName());

        int port = request.getServerPort();

        boolean defaultHttpPort = request.getScheme().equals("http")
                && port == 80;

        boolean defaultHttpsPort = request.getScheme().equals("https")
                && port == 443;

        if (!defaultHttpPort && !defaultHttpsPort) {
            url.append(":").append(port);
        }

        url.append(request.getContextPath())
                .append("/reset-password?token=")
                .append(
                        URLEncoder.encode(
                                token,
                                StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                        )
                );

        return url.toString();
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import model.Address;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class AddressDAO {
    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public AddressDAO() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public AddressDAO(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    private Connection getConnection() throws SQLException {
        Connection conn = connections.open();
        if (conn == null) throw new SQLException("Khong ket noi duoc database.");
        return conn;
    }

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(AddressDAO.class.getName());

    public List<Address> getAddressesByUser(int userId) {
        List<Address> addresses = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT address_id, user_id, recipient_name, "
                + "phone_number, address_line, is_default "
                + "FROM dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 "
                + "ORDER BY is_default DESC, address_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    addresses.add(mapAddress(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Loi lay danh sach dia chi!", e);
        }

        return addresses;
    }

    public Address getAddressById(int addressId, int userId) {
        String sql = "SELECT address_id, user_id, recipient_name, "
                + "phone_number, address_line, is_default "
                + "FROM dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "WHERE address_id = ? AND user_id = ? "
                + "AND is_deleted = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, addressId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return mapAddress(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Loi lay dia chi theo ID!", e);
        }

        return null;
    }

    public int insertAddress(
            int userId,
            String recipientName,
            String phoneNumber,
            String addressLine
    ) {
        if (userId <= 0
                || recipientName == null
                || phoneNumber == null
                || addressLine == null
                || recipientName.trim().isEmpty()
                || recipientName.trim().length() > 100
                || !phoneNumber.trim().matches("[0-9]{9,11}")
                || addressLine.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return -1;
        }

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "(user_id, recipient_name, phone_number, "
                + "address_line, is_default, is_deleted) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0, 0)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                sql, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.setString(2, recipientName.trim());
            ps.setString(3, phoneNumber.trim());
            ps.setString(4, addressLine.trim());

            int rows = ps.executeUpdate();

            if (rows == 1) {
                try (ResultSet rs = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                    if (rs.next()) {
                        return rs.getInt(1);
                    }
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Loi them dia chi!", e);
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public boolean updateAddress(
            int addressId,
            int userId,
            String recipientName,
            String phoneNumber,
            String addressLine
    ) throws SQLException {

        if (addressId <= 0
                || userId <= 0
                || recipientName == null
                || recipientName.trim().isEmpty()
                || recipientName.trim().length() > 100
                || phoneNumber == null
                || !phoneNumber.trim().matches("[0-9]{9,11}")
                || addressLine == null
                || addressLine.trim().isEmpty()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Thông tin địa chỉ không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        String sql = "UPDATE dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "SET recipient_name = ?, phone_number = ?, address_line = ? "
                + "WHERE address_id = ? AND user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException("Khong the ket noi database.");
            }

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                ps.setString(1, recipientName.trim());
                ps.setString(2, phoneNumber.trim());
                ps.setString(3, addressLine.trim());
                ps.setInt(4, addressId);
                ps.setInt(5, userId);

                return ps.executeUpdate() == 1;
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean deleteAddress(int addressId, int userId) {
        if (addressId <= 0 || userId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql = "UPDATE dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "SET is_deleted = 1, is_default = 0 "
                + "WHERE address_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ? "
                + "AND is_deleted = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, addressId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() == 1;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Loi xoa dia chi!", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    public boolean setDefaultAddress(int addressId, int userId)
            throws SQLException {
        String checkSql = "SELECT address_id FROM dbo.ADDRESSBOOK WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE address_id = ? AND user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0";
        String updateSql = "UPDATE dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "SET is_default = CASE WHEN address_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException("Khong the ket noi database.");
            }
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);
            try (PreparedStatement check = conn.prepareStatement(checkSql);
                    PreparedStatement update = conn.prepareStatement(updateSql)) {
                try (PreparedStatement owner = conn.prepareStatement(
                        "SELECT user_id FROM dbo.[USER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE user_id = ?")) {
                    owner.setInt(1, userId);
                    try (ResultSet rs = owner.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) { conn.rollback(); return false; }
                    }
                }
                check.setInt(1, addressId);
                check.setInt(2, userId);
                try (ResultSet rs = check.executeQuery()) {
                    if (!rs.next()) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                update.setInt(1, addressId);
                update.setInt(2, userId);
                update.executeUpdate();
                conn.commit();
                return true;
            } catch (SQLException e) {
                conn.rollback();
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    private Address mapAddress(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {
        Address address = new Address();

        address.setAddressId(rs.getInt("address_id"));
        address.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
        address.setRecipientName(rs.getString("recipient_name"));
        address.setPhoneNumber(rs.getString("phone_number"));
        address.setAddressLine(rs.getString("address_line"));
        address.setDefaultAddress(rs.getBoolean("is_default"));

        return address;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Order;
import model.OrderItem;
import service.OrderStatusPolicy;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class AdminOrderDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(AdminOrderDAO.class.getName());

    public List<Order> getList() {
        List<Order> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT o.order_id, "
                + "o.user_id, "
                + "o.address_id, "
                + "o.total_amount, "
                + "o.shipping_fee, "
                + "o.created_at, "
                + "o.recipient_name, "
                + "o.recipient_phone, "
                + "o.shipping_address, "
                + "o.order_status, "
                + "o.payment_status "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.order_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
            while (rs.next()) {
                Order order = mapOrder(rs);
                order.setPaymentStatus(rs.getString("payment_status"));
                list.add(order);
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy danh sách Order!", ex);
        }

        return list;
    }

    public Order getById(int id) {
        String sql = "SELECT o.order_id, "
                + "o.user_id, "
                + "o.address_id, "
                + "o.total_amount, "
                + "o.shipping_fee, "
                + "o.created_at, "
                + "o.recipient_name, "
                + "o.recipient_phone, "
                + "o.shipping_address, "
                + "o.order_status, "
                + "o.payment_method, "
                + "o.payment_status "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, id);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    Order order = mapOrder(rs);
                    order.setPaymentMethod(rs.getString("payment_method"));
                    order.setPaymentStatus(rs.getString("payment_status"));

                    return order;
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy Order theo ID!", ex);
        }

        return null;
    }

    public List<OrderItem> getItemsByOrderId(int orderId) {
        List<OrderItem> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT oi.*, "
                + "p.product_name, "
                + "s.sku_code, "
                + "s.stock_quantity "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON oi.sku_id = s.sku_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON s.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "WHERE oi.order_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, orderId);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    OrderItem item = new OrderItem();

                    item.setOrderItemId(
                            rs.getInt("order_item_id")
                    );

                    item.setOrderId(
                            rs.getInt("order_id")
                    );

                    item.setSkuId(
                            rs.getInt("sku_id")
                    );

                    item.setPrice(
                            rs.getBigDecimal("price")
                    );

                    item.setQuantity(
                            rs.getInt("quantity")
                    );
                    item.setProductName(rs.getString("product_name"));
                    item.setSkuCode(rs.getString("sku_code"));
                    item.setStockQuantity(rs.getInt("stock_quantity"));

                    list.add(item);
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi lấy Order Item!", ex);
        }

        return list;
    }

    public String getCurrentStatus(int orderId) {
        String sql = "SELECT order_status "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE order_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, orderId);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getString("order_status");
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi lấy trạng thái Order!", ex);
        }

        return null;
    }

    private Order mapOrder(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {
        Order order = new Order();
        order.setOrderId(rs.getInt("order_id"));
        order.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
        order.setAddressId(rs.getInt("address_id"));
        order.setTotalAmount(rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount"));
        order.setShippingFee(rs.getBigDecimal("shipping_fee"));
        order.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
        order.setOrderStatus(rs.getString("order_status"));
        order.setRecipientName(rs.getString("recipient_name"));
        order.setRecipientPhone(rs.getString("recipient_phone"));
        order.setShippingAddress(rs.getString("shipping_address"));
        return order;
    }

    public boolean transitionStatus(int orderId, String requestedStatus)
            throws SQLException {
        String next = OrderStatusPolicy.normalize(requestedStatus);

        if (next == null || "PENDING_CONFIRMATION".equals(next) || "CANCELLED".equals(next)) {
            return false;
        }

        String selectSql = "SELECT order_status, payment_method, payment_status, stock_restored_at "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE order_id = ?";

        String updateSql = "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "SET order_status = ?, "
                + "delivered_at = CASE "
                + "WHEN ? = 'COMPLETED' "
                + "THEN COALESCE(delivered_at, SYSDATETIME()) "
                + "ELSE delivered_at END "
                + "WHERE order_id = ?";

        String historySql = "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY "
                + "(order_id, status) VALUES (?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                String current;
                String method;
                String payment;
                boolean restored;

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(selectSql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return false;
                        }

                        current = OrderStatusPolicy.normalize(
                                rs.getString("order_status")
                        );
                        method = rs.getString("payment_method");
                        payment = rs.getString("payment_status");
                        restored = rs.getTimestamp("stock_restored_at") != null;

                    }
                }

                if (!next.equals(OrderStatusPolicy.nextStatus(current))) {
                    conn.rollback();
                    return false;
                }

                if ("CONFIRMED".equals(next)) {
                    if (restored) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Đơn đã hoàn kho, cần kiểm tra lại trước khi xác nhận.");
                    }
                    if (!"COD".equalsIgnoreCase(method) && !"PAID".equalsIgnoreCase(payment)) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Đơn thanh toán online cần thanh toán thành công trước khi xác nhận.");
                    }
                    new OrderInventoryDAO().deduct(conn, orderId);
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(updateSql)) {
                    ps.setString(1, next);
                    ps.setString(2, next);
                    ps.setInt(3, orderId);

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        throw new SQLException("Không thể cập nhật đơn hàng.");
                    }
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(historySql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setString(2, next);

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        throw new SQLException("Không thể ghi lịch sử đơn hàng.");
                    }
                }

                conn.commit();
                return true;
            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
                    e.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
                }

                throw e;
            } finally {
                conn.setAutoCommit(true);
            }
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Attribute;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class AttributeDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(AttributeDAO.class.getName());

    private static final String ATTRIBUTE_COLUMNS
            = "attribute_id, attribute_name, "
            + "data_type, unit, is_active ";

    private Attribute mapAttribute(ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        return new Attribute(
                rs.getInt("attribute_id"),
                rs.getString("attribute_name"),
                rs.getString("data_type"),
                rs.getString("unit"),
                rs.getBoolean("is_active")
        );
    }

    public List<Attribute> getList() {

        List<Attribute> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + ATTRIBUTE_COLUMNS
                + "FROM ATTRIBUTE "
                + "ORDER BY attribute_name, attribute_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapAttribute(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get attribute list",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get attribute list", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<Attribute> getActiveAttributes() {

        List<Attribute> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + ATTRIBUTE_COLUMNS
                + "FROM ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WHERE is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY attribute_name, attribute_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapAttribute(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get active attributes",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get active attributes", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public Attribute getById(int attributeId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + ATTRIBUTE_COLUMNS
                + "FROM ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WHERE attribute_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, attributeId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return mapAttribute(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get attribute by ID",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get attribute by ID", ex
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    public List<Attribute> searchByName(String keyword) {

        List<Attribute> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + ATTRIBUTE_COLUMNS
                + "FROM ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WHERE attribute_name LIKE ? "
                + "ORDER BY attribute_name, attribute_id";

        String pattern = "%"
                + (keyword == null ? "" : keyword.trim())
                + "%";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, pattern);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapAttribute(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot search attributes",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot search attributes", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public boolean isNameExists(String attributeName) {

        return isNameExists(attributeName, 0);
    }

    public boolean isNameExists(
            String attributeName,
            int excludeAttributeId) {

        if (attributeName == null
                || attributeName.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(attribute_name))) "
                + "= LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(?))) "
                + "AND attribute_id <> ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, attributeName.trim());
            ps.setInt(2, excludeAttributeId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot check duplicate attribute name",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot check attribute name", ex
            );
        }
    }

    public int insert(Attribute attribute) {

        if (!isValidAttribute(attribute)) {
            return 0;
        }

        if (isNameExists(attribute.getAttributeName())) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO ATTRIBUTE "
                + "(attribute_name, data_type, unit, is_active) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(
                    1,
                    attribute.getAttributeName().trim()
            );

            ps.setString(
                    2,
                    attribute.getDataType()
            );

            ps.setNString(
                    3,
                    normalizeUnit(attribute.getUnit())
            );

            ps.setBoolean(
                    4,
                    attribute.isActive()
            );

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot insert attribute",
                    ex
            );
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public int update(Attribute attribute) {

        if (!isValidAttribute(attribute)
                || attribute.getAttributeId() <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        if (isNameExists(
                attribute.getAttributeName(),
                attribute.getAttributeId())) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE ATTRIBUTE "
                + "SET attribute_name = ?, "
                + "data_type = ?, "
                + "unit = ? "
                + "WHERE attribute_id = ? "
                + "AND ("
                + "data_type = ? "
