                + "OR NOT EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE ca "
                + "WHERE ca.attribute_id = ATTRIBUTE.attribute_id"
                + ") "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION ps "
                + "WHERE ps.attribute_id = ATTRIBUTE.attribute_id"
                + ") "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE sav "
                + "WHERE sav.attribute_id = ATTRIBUTE.attribute_id"
                + ")"
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(
                    1,
                    attribute.getAttributeName().trim()
            );

            ps.setString(
                    2,
                    attribute.getDataType()
            );

            ps.setNString(
                    3,
                    normalizeUnit(attribute.getUnit())
            );

            ps.setInt(
                    4,
                    attribute.getAttributeId()
            );

            ps.setString(
                    5,
                    attribute.getDataType()
            );

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot update attribute",
                    ex
            );
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public boolean isAttributeInUse(int attributeId) {

        if (attributeId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT CASE WHEN "
                + "EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WHERE attribute_id = ?"
                + ") "
                + "OR EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION "
                + "WHERE attribute_id = ?"
                + ") "
                + "OR EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 FROM SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE "
                + "WHERE attribute_id = ?"
                + ") "
                + "THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_used";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, attributeId);
            ps.setInt(2, attributeId);
            ps.setInt(3, attributeId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                return rs.next()
                        && rs.getBoolean("is_used");
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot check attribute usage",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot check attribute usage", ex
            );
        }
    }

    public int delete(int attributeId) {

        return setAttributeActive(attributeId, false);
    }

    public int setAttributeActive(
            int attributeId,
            boolean active) {

        if (attributeId <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE ATTRIBUTE "
                + "SET is_active = ? "
                + "WHERE attribute_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, active);
            ps.setInt(2, attributeId);

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot change attribute status",
                    ex
            );
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public int countAttributes() {

        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTRIBUTE";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            return rs.next()
                    ? rs.getInt(1)
                    : 0;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count attributes",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count attributes", ex
            );
        }
    }

    private boolean isValidAttribute(Attribute attribute) {

        if (attribute == null
                || attribute.getAttributeName() == null
                || attribute.getDataType() == null) {
            return false;
        }

        String name = attribute.getAttributeName().trim();

        if (name.isEmpty() || name.length() > 100) {
            return false;
        }

        String dataType = attribute.getDataType();

        if (!"TEXT".equals(dataType)
                && !"NUMBER".equals(dataType)
                && !"BOOLEAN".equals(dataType)) {
            return false;
        }

        String unit = normalizeUnit(attribute.getUnit());

        return unit == null || unit.length() <= 30;
    }

    private String normalizeUnit(String unit) {

        if (unit == null || unit.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        return unit.trim();
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.AuditLog;

import java.sql.*;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class AuditLogDAO extends DBContext {

    public boolean insert(AuditLog log) {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG"
                + "(actor_user_id, "
                + "actor_identifier,"
                + "action,"
                + "entity_type, "
                + "entity_id,"
                + "description,"
                + "ip_address)"
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            if (log.getActorUserId() != null) {
                ps.setInt(1, log.getActorUserId());
            } else {
                ps.setNull(1, Types.INTEGER);
            }

            ps.setString(2, log.getActorIdentifier());
            ps.setString(3, log.getAction());
            ps.setString(4, log.getEntityType());

            if (log.getEntityId() != null) {
                ps.setLong(5, log.getEntityId());
            } else {
                ps.setNull(5, Types.BIGINT);
            }

            ps.setString(6, log.getDescription());
            ps.setString(7, log.getIpAddress());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    public List<AuditLog> getAll() {

        List<AuditLog> logs = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT "
                + "log_id, "
                + "actor_user_id, "
                + "actor_identifier, "
                + "action, "
                + "entity_type, "
                + "entity_id, "
                + "description, "
                + "ip_address, "
                + "created_at "
                + "FROM AUDIT_LOG "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                AuditLog log = new AuditLog();

                log.setLogId(rs.getLong("log_id"));

                int actorUserId = rs.getInt("actor_user_id");
                if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                    log.setActorUserId(actorUserId);
                }

                log.setActorIdentifier(
                        rs.getString("actor_identifier"));

                log.setAction(
                        rs.getString("action"));

                log.setEntityType(
                        rs.getString("entity_type"));

                long entityId = rs.getLong("entity_id");
                if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                    log.setEntityId(entityId);
                }

                log.setDescription(
                        rs.getString("description"));

                log.setIpAddress(
                        rs.getString("ip_address"));

                log.setCreatedAt(
                        rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                logs.add(log);
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return logs;
    }

    public List<AuditLog> search(
            String keyword,
            String action,
            String entityType) {

        List<AuditLog> logs = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT log_id, actor_user_id, actor_identifier, action, "
                + "entity_type, entity_id, description, ip_address, created_at "
                + "FROM AUDIT_LOG "
                + "WHERE (? IS NULL OR actor_identifier LIKE ? "
                + "OR description LIKE ?) "
                + "AND (? IS NULL OR action = ?) "
                + "AND (? IS NULL OR entity_type = ?) "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            String searchKeyword = null;

            if (keyword != null && !keyword.trim().isEmpty()) {
                searchKeyword = "%" + keyword.trim() + "%";
            }

            String actionValue
                    = action == null || action.trim().isEmpty()
                    ? null
                    : action.trim();

            String entityValue
                    = entityType == null || entityType.trim().isEmpty()
                    ? null
                    : entityType.trim();

            ps.setString(1, searchKeyword);
            ps.setString(2, searchKeyword);
            ps.setString(3, searchKeyword);

            ps.setString(4, actionValue);
            ps.setString(5, actionValue);

            ps.setString(6, entityValue);
            ps.setString(7, entityValue);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    AuditLog log = new AuditLog();

                    log.setLogId(rs.getLong("log_id"));

                    int actorUserId
                            = rs.getInt("actor_user_id");

                    if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                        log.setActorUserId(actorUserId);
                    }

                    log.setActorIdentifier(
                            rs.getString("actor_identifier"));

                    log.setAction(
                            rs.getString("action"));

                    log.setEntityType(
                            rs.getString("entity_type"));

                    long entityId
                            = rs.getLong("entity_id");

                    if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                        log.setEntityId(entityId);
                    }

                    log.setDescription(
                            rs.getString("description"));

                    log.setIpAddress(
                            rs.getString("ip_address"));

                    log.setCreatedAt(
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                    logs.add(log);
                }

            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return logs;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Banner;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class BannerDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(BannerDAO.class.getName());

    public List<Banner> getAll() {
        List<Banner> banners = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT banner_id, image_url, alt_text, target_url, "
                + "is_active, display_order, created_at "
                + "FROM BANNER "
                + "ORDER BY display_order, banner_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
             ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                Banner banner = new Banner();
                banner.setBannerId(rs.getInt("banner_id"));
                banner.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url"));
                banner.setAltText(rs.getString("alt_text"));
                banner.setTargetUrl(rs.getString("target_url"));
                banner.setActive(rs.getBoolean("is_active"));
                banner.setDisplayOrder(rs.getInt("display_order"));
                banner.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                banners.add(banner);
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot get banners", e);
        }

        return banners;
    }

    public Banner getById(int bannerId) {
        String sql = "SELECT banner_id, image_url, alt_text, target_url, "
                + "is_active, display_order, created_at "
                + "FROM BANNER WHERE banner_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, bannerId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    Banner banner = new Banner();
                    banner.setBannerId(rs.getInt("banner_id"));
                    banner.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url"));
                    banner.setAltText(rs.getString("alt_text"));
                    banner.setTargetUrl(rs.getString("target_url"));
                    banner.setActive(rs.getBoolean("is_active"));
                    banner.setDisplayOrder(rs.getInt("display_order"));
                    banner.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                    return banner;
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot get banner by ID", e);
        }

        return null;
    }

    public List<Banner> getActive() {
        List<Banner> banners = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT banner_id, image_url, alt_text, target_url, "
                + "is_active, display_order, created_at "
                + "FROM BANNER "
                + "WHERE is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY display_order, banner_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
             ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                Banner banner = new Banner();
                banner.setBannerId(rs.getInt("banner_id"));
                banner.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url"));
                banner.setAltText(rs.getString("alt_text"));
                banner.setTargetUrl(rs.getString("target_url"));
                banner.setActive(rs.getBoolean("is_active"));
                banner.setDisplayOrder(rs.getInt("display_order"));
                banner.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                banners.add(banner);
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot get active banners", e);
        }

        return banners;
    }

    public boolean insert(Banner banner) {
        String sql = "INSERT INTO BANNER "
                + "(image_url, alt_text, target_url, is_active, display_order) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, banner.getImageUrl());
            ps.setString(2, banner.getAltText());
            ps.setString(3, banner.getTargetUrl());
            ps.setBoolean(4, banner.isActive());
            ps.setInt(5, banner.getDisplayOrder());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot insert banner", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    public boolean update(Banner banner) {
        String sql = "UPDATE BANNER "
                + "SET image_url = ?, alt_text = ?, target_url = ?, "
                + "is_active = ?, display_order = ? "
                + "WHERE banner_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, banner.getImageUrl());
            ps.setString(2, banner.getAltText());
            ps.setString(3, banner.getTargetUrl());
            ps.setBoolean(4, banner.isActive());
            ps.setInt(5, banner.getDisplayOrder());
            ps.setInt(6, banner.getBannerId());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot update banner", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    public boolean updateActive(int bannerId, boolean active) {
        String sql = "UPDATE BANNER SET is_active = ? WHERE banner_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, active);
            ps.setInt(2, bannerId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot change banner status", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    public boolean delete(int bannerId) {
        String sql = "DELETE FROM BANNER WHERE banner_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, bannerId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot delete banner", e);
            return false;
        }
    }
}package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Brand;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class BrandDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(BrandDAO.class.getName());

    private static final String BRAND_COLUMNS
            = "brand_id, brand_name, logo_url, is_active ";

    private Brand mapBrand(ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        return new Brand(
                rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                rs.getString("brand_name"),
                rs.getString("logo_url"),
                rs.getBoolean("is_active")
        );
    }

    public List<Brand> getList() {

        List<Brand> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + BRAND_COLUMNS
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "ORDER BY brand_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapBrand(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot load brand list",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<Brand> getActiveBrands() {

        List<Brand> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + BRAND_COLUMNS
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY brand_name, brand_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapBrand(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot load active brands",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public Brand getById(int id) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + BRAND_COLUMNS
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE brand_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, id);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return mapBrand(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot find brand by ID",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    public boolean isNameExists(
            String name,
            int excludeId) {

        if (name == null || name.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(brand_name))) "
                + "= LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(?))) "
                + "AND brand_id <> ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, name.trim());
            ps.setInt(2, excludeId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot check duplicate brand name",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot check brand name",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    public int countProductsByBrandId(int brandId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM PRODUCT "
                + "WHERE brand_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, brandId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next() ? rs.getInt(1) : 0;
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count products by brand",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count products",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    public Map<Integer, Integer> getProductCounts(
            List<Brand> brandList) {

        Map<Integer, Integer> productCounts
                = new HashMap<>();

        if (brandList == null || brandList.isEmpty()) {
            return productCounts;
        }

        for (Brand brand : brandList) {
            productCounts.put(brand.getBrandId(), 0);
        }

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "SELECT brand_id, COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM PRODUCT "
                + "WHERE brand_id IN ("
        );

        appendPlaceholders(sql, brandList.size());

        sql.append(") GROUP BY brand_id");

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {

            for (int i = 0; i < brandList.size(); i++) {

                ps.setInt(
                        i + 1,
                        brandList.get(i).getBrandId()
                );
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    productCounts.put(
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getInt("total")
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count products by brands",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count products by brands",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return productCounts;
    }

    public int insert(Brand brand) {

        if (!isValidBrand(brand)) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO BRAND "
                + "(brand_name, logo_url, is_active) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(
                    1,
                    brand.getBrandName().trim()
            );

            ps.setString(
                    2,
                    brand.getLogoUrl()
            );

            ps.setBoolean(
                    3,
                    brand.isActive()
            );

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot insert brand",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot insert brand",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    public int edit(Brand brand) {

        if (!isValidBrand(brand)
                || brand.getBrandId() <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE BRAND "
                + "SET brand_name = ?, "
                + "logo_url = ? "
                + "WHERE brand_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(
                    1,
                    brand.getBrandName().trim()
            );

            ps.setString(
                    2,
                    brand.getLogoUrl()
            );

            ps.setInt(
                    3,
                    brand.getBrandId()
            );

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot update brand",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot update brand",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    public int delete(Brand brand) {

        if (brand == null || brand.getBrandId() <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        return setBrandActive(
                brand.getBrandId(),
                false
        );
    }

    public int setBrandActive(
            int brandId,
            boolean active) {

        if (brandId <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE BRAND "
                + "SET is_active = ? "
                + "WHERE brand_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, active);
            ps.setInt(2, brandId);

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot change brand status",
                    ex
            );

            return 0;
        }
    }

    public List<Brand> searchByName(String keyword) {

        List<Brand> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + BRAND_COLUMNS
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE LOWER(brand_name) LIKE LOWER(?) "
                + "ORDER BY brand_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, searchPattern(keyword));

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapBrand(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot search brands",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot search brands",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<Brand> getListByPage(
            int page,
            int pageSize) {

        List<Brand> list = new ArrayList<>();

        validatePage(page, pageSize);

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + BRAND_COLUMNS
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "ORDER BY brand_id "
                + "OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, calculateOffset(page, pageSize));
            ps.setInt(2, pageSize);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapBrand(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot load brands by page",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot load brands by page",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<Brand> searchByNameAndPage(
            String keyword,
            int page,
            int pageSize) {

        List<Brand> list = new ArrayList<>();

        validatePage(page, pageSize);

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + BRAND_COLUMNS
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE LOWER(brand_name) LIKE LOWER(?) "
                + "ORDER BY brand_id "
                + "OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, searchPattern(keyword));
            ps.setInt(2, calculateOffset(page, pageSize));
            ps.setInt(3, pageSize);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapBrand(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot search brands by page",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot search brands by page",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public int countSearchResults(String keyword) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE LOWER(brand_name) LIKE LOWER(?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, searchPattern(keyword));

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                return rs.next()
                        ? rs.getInt(1)
                        : 0;
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count searched brands",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count searched brands",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    public int countBrands() {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BRAND";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            return rs.next()
                    ? rs.getInt(1)
                    : 0;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count brands",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count brands",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    private boolean isValidBrand(Brand brand) {

        if (brand == null
                || brand.getBrandName() == null) {
            return false;
        }

        String name = brand.getBrandName().trim();

        if (name.isEmpty() || name.length() > 100) {
            return false;
        }

        return brand.getLogoUrl() == null
                || brand.getLogoUrl().length() <= 2048;
    }

    private void appendPlaceholders(
            StringBuilder sql,
            int count) {

        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {

            if (i > 0) {
                sql.append(", ");
            }

            sql.append("?");
        }
    }

    private String searchPattern(String keyword) {

        String value
                = keyword == null
                        ? ""
                        : keyword.trim();

        return "%" + value + "%";
    }

    private void validatePage(
            int page,
            int pageSize) {

        if (page <= 0 || pageSize <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Page và pageSize phải lớn hơn 0."
            );
        }
    }

    private int calculateOffset(
            int page,
            int pageSize) {

        long offset
                = ((long) page - 1) * pageSize;

        if (offset > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Giá trị phân trang quá lớn."
            );
        }

        return (int) offset;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.CartItem;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class CartDAO extends DBContext {

    public int getCartIdByUserId(int userId) {

        if (userId <= 0) {
            return -1;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT cart_id "
                + "FROM CART "
                + "WHERE user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("cart_id");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return -1;
    }


   
    public int createCart(int userId) {

        if (userId <= 0) {
            return -1;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO CART "
                + "(user_id, created_at) "
                + "VALUES (?, GETDATE())";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(
                             sql,
                             Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            int affected = ps.executeUpdate();

            if (affected <= 0) {
                return -1;
            }

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            e.printStackTrace();

            int existing
                    = getCartIdByUserId(userId);

            if (existing > 0) {
                return existing;
            }
        }

        return -1;
    }


    public int getOrCreateCart(int userId) {

        int cartId
                = getCartIdByUserId(userId);

        if (cartId > 0) {
            return cartId;
        }

        return createCart(userId);
    }


    public List<CartItem> getCartItems(int cartId) {

        List<CartItem> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        if (cartId <= 0) {
            return list;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "ci.cart_item_id, "
                + "ci.cart_id, "
                + "ci.sku_id, "
                + "ci.quantity, "
                + "ps.sku_code, "
                + "ps.price, "
                + "ps.stock_quantity, "
                + "p.product_name "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS ci "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON ps.sku_id = ci.sku_id "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.product_id = ps.product_id "
                + "WHERE ci.cart_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY ci.cart_item_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    list.add(
                            mapCartItem(rs)
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return list;
    }


   
    public List<CartItem> getCartItemsByIds(
            int cartId,
            List<Integer> cartItemIds) {

        List<CartItem> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        if (cartId <= 0
                || cartItemIds == null
                || cartItemIds.isEmpty()) {

            return list;
        }

        List<Integer> validIds
                = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Integer id : cartItemIds) {

            if (id != null
                    && id > 0
                    && !validIds.contains(id)) {

                validIds.add(id);
            }
        }

        if (validIds.isEmpty()) {
            return list;
        }

        StringBuilder placeholders
                = new StringBuilder();

        for (int i = 0;
             i < validIds.size();
             i++) {

            if (i > 0) {
                placeholders.append(",");
            }

            placeholders.append("?");
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "ci.cart_item_id, "
                + "ci.cart_id, "
                + "ci.sku_id, "
                + "ci.quantity, "
                + "ps.sku_code, "
                + "ps.price, "
                + "ps.stock_quantity, "
                + "p.product_name "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS ci "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON ps.sku_id = ci.sku_id "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.product_id = ps.product_id "
                + "WHERE ci.cart_id = ? "
                + "AND ci.cart_item_id IN ("
                + placeholders
                + ") "
                + "ORDER BY ci.cart_item_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            int index = 1;

            ps.setInt(
                    index++,
                    cartId
            );

            for (Integer id : validIds) {

                ps.setInt(
                        index++,
                        id
                );
            }

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    list.add(
                            mapCartItem(rs)
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return list;
    }


    public boolean exists(
            int cartId,
            int skuId) {

        if (cartId <= 0 || skuId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS "
                + "WHERE cart_id = ? "
                + "AND sku_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }


    public int getStockQuantity(int skuId) {

        if (skuId <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT stock_quantity "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return rs.getInt(
                            "stock_quantity"
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }


    public int getCurrentQuantity(
            int cartId,
            int skuId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT quantity "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS "
                + "WHERE cart_id = ? "
                + "AND sku_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return rs.getInt(
                            "quantity"
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }


    public boolean addToCart(
            int cartId,
            int skuId,
            int quantity) {

        if (cartId <= 0
                || skuId <= 0
                || quantity <= 0) {

            return false;
        }

        int stock
                = getStockQuantity(skuId);

        if (stock <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        int current
                = getCurrentQuantity(
                        cartId,
                        skuId
                );

        if (current + quantity > stock) {

            return false;
        }

        if (current > 0) {

            String sql
                    = "UPDATE CART_ITEMS "
                    + "SET quantity = quantity + ? "
                    + "WHERE cart_id = ? "
                    + "AND sku_id = ?";

            try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                 PreparedStatement ps
                         = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                ps.setInt(1, quantity);
                ps.setInt(2, cartId);
                ps.setInt(3, skuId);

                return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

            } catch (SQLException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }

            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO CART_ITEMS "
                + "(cart_id, sku_id, quantity) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);
            ps.setInt(3, quantity);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }


    public int getSkuIdByCartItemId(
            int cartItemId,
            int cartId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT sku_id "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS "
                + "WHERE cart_item_id = ? "

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(2, cartId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return rs.getInt(
                            "sku_id"
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return -1;
    }


    public boolean updateQuantity(
            int cartItemId,
            int cartId,
            int quantity) {

        if (quantity <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        int skuId
                = getSkuIdByCartItemId(
                        cartItemId,
                        cartId
                );

        if (skuId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        int stock
                = getStockQuantity(skuId);

        if (quantity > stock) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE CART_ITEMS "
                + "SET quantity = ? "
                + "WHERE cart_item_id = ? "
                + "AND cart_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, quantity);
            ps.setInt(2, cartItemId);
            ps.setInt(3, cartId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }


    public boolean updateQuantity(
            int cartItemId,
            int quantity) {

        if (quantity <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT ci.cart_id "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS ci "
                + "WHERE ci.cart_item_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartItemId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return updateQuantity(
                            cartItemId,
                            rs.getInt("cart_id"),
                            quantity
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean clearCart(int cartId) {

        if (cartId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "DELETE FROM CART_ITEMS "
                + "WHERE cart_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);

            ps.executeUpdate();

            return true;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }


    public double getCartTotal(int cartId) {

        if (cartId <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT COALESCE("
                + "SUM(ps.price * ci.quantity), 0"
                + ") AS total "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS ci "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON ps.sku_id = ci.sku_id "
                + "WHERE ci.cart_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return rs.getDouble(
                            "total"
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }


    public double getCartTotalByIds(
            int cartId,
            List<Integer> cartItemIds) {

        List<CartItem> items
                = getCartItemsByIds(
                        cartId,
                        cartItemIds
                );

        double total = 0;

        for (CartItem item : items) {

            total += item.getPrice()
                    * item.getQuantity();
        }

        return total;
    }


    public boolean deleteCartItemsByIds(
            int cartId,
            List<Integer> cartItemIds) {

        if (cartId <= 0
                || cartItemIds == null
                || cartItemIds.isEmpty()) {

            return false;
        }

        StringBuilder placeholders
                = new StringBuilder();

        for (int i = 0;
             i < cartItemIds.size();
             i++) {

            if (i > 0) {
                placeholders.append(",");
            }

            placeholders.append("?");
        }

        String sql
                = "DELETE FROM CART_ITEMS "
                + "WHERE cart_id = ? "
                + "AND cart_item_id IN ("
                + placeholders
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            int index = 1;

            ps.setInt(
                    index++,
                    cartId
            );

            for (Integer id : cartItemIds) {

                ps.setInt(
                        index++,
                        id
                );
            }

            int deleted
                    = ps.executeUpdate();

            return deleted
                    == cartItemIds.size();

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }


    private CartItem mapCartItem(
            ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        CartItem item
                = new CartItem();

        item.setCartItemId(
                rs.getInt(
                        "cart_item_id"
                )
        );

        item.setCartId(
                rs.getInt(
                        "cart_id"
                )
        );

        item.setSkuId(
                rs.getInt(
                        "sku_id"
                )
        );

        item.setQuantity(
                rs.getInt(
                        "quantity"
                )
        );

        item.setSkuCode(
                rs.getString(
                        "sku_code"
                )
        );

        item.setPrice(
                rs.getDouble(
                        "price"
                )
        );

        item.setStockQuantity(
                rs.getInt(
                        "stock_quantity"
                )
        );

        item.setProductName(
                rs.getString(
                        "product_name"
                )
        );

        return item;
    }
}package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.CategoryAttribute;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class CategoryAttributeDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(CategoryAttributeDAO.class.getName());

    private static final String BASE_SELECT
            = "SELECT "
            + "ca.category_id, "
            + "ca.attribute_id, "
            + "ca.group_name, "
            + "ca.attribute_type, "
            + "ca.is_required, "
            + "ca.is_filterable, "
            + "ca.display_order, "
            + "a.attribute_name, "
            + "a.data_type, "
            + "a.unit "
            + "FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE ca "
            + "INNER JOIN ATTRIBUTE a "
            + "ON ca.attribute_id = a.attribute_id ";

    private CategoryAttribute mapCategoryAttribute(
            ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {

        return new CategoryAttribute(
                rs.getInt("category_id"),
                rs.getInt("attribute_id"),
                rs.getString("group_name"),
                rs.getString("attribute_type"),
                rs.getBoolean("is_required"),
                rs.getBoolean("is_filterable"),
                rs.getInt("display_order"),
                rs.getString("attribute_name"),
                rs.getString("data_type"),
                rs.getString("unit")
        );
    }

    public List<CategoryAttribute> getByCategoryId(
            int categoryId) {

        List<CategoryAttribute> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = BASE_SELECT
                + "WHERE ca.category_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY ca.display_order, "
                + "ca.attribute_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapCategoryAttribute(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Loi lay thuoc tinh theo danh muc!",
                    ex
            );

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Khong the tai cau hinh thuoc tinh danh muc.",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<CategoryAttribute> getSpecificationAttributes(
            int categoryId) {

        List<CategoryAttribute> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = BASE_SELECT
                + "WHERE ca.category_id = ? "
                + "AND ca.attribute_type IN "
                + "('SPECIFICATION', 'BOTH') "
                + "AND a.is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY ca.display_order, "
                + "ca.attribute_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapCategoryAttribute(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Loi lay thuoc tinh thong so ky thuat!",
                    ex
            );

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Khong the tai thuoc tinh thong so ky thuat.",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<CategoryAttribute> getVariantAttributes(
            int categoryId) {

        List<CategoryAttribute> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = BASE_SELECT
                + "WHERE ca.category_id = ? "
                + "AND ca.attribute_type IN "
                + "('VARIANT', 'BOTH') "
                + "AND a.is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY ca.display_order, "
                + "ca.attribute_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapCategoryAttribute(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Loi lay thuoc tinh bien the SKU!",
                    ex
            );

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Khong the tai thuoc tinh bien the SKU.",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public CategoryAttribute getByCategoryAndAttribute(
            int categoryId,
            int attributeId) {

        String sql = BASE_SELECT
                + "WHERE ca.category_id = ? "
                + "AND ca.attribute_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(2, attributeId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return mapCategoryAttribute(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy cấu hình CategoryAttribute!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    public boolean save(CategoryAttribute config) {

        if (config == null
                || config.getCategoryId() <= 0
                || config.getAttributeId() <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String attributeType
                = config.getAttributeType();

        if (!isValidAttributeType(attributeType)) {
            return false;
        }

        if (config.getDisplayOrder() < 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String groupName = config.getGroupName();

        if (groupName == null
                || groupName.trim().isEmpty()
                || groupName.trim().length() > 100) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WITH (UPDLOCK, SERIALIZABLE) "
                + "SET group_name = ?, "
                + "attribute_type = ?, "
                + "is_required = ?, "
                + "is_filterable = ?, "
                + "display_order = ? "
                + "WHERE category_id = ? "
                + "AND attribute_id = ?; "
                + "IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 "
                + "BEGIN "
                + "INSERT INTO CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE "
                + "(category_id, attribute_id, "
                + "group_name, attribute_type, "
                + "is_required, is_filterable, "
                + "display_order) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?); "
                + "END";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection()) {

            boolean oldAutoCommit
                    = conn.getAutoCommit();

            try {
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setNString(1, groupName.trim());
                    ps.setString(2, attributeType);
                    ps.setBoolean(3, config.isRequired());
                    ps.setBoolean(4, config.isFilterable());
                    ps.setInt(5, config.getDisplayOrder());
                    ps.setInt(6, config.getCategoryId());
                    ps.setInt(7, config.getAttributeId());

                    ps.setInt(8, config.getCategoryId());
                    ps.setInt(9, config.getAttributeId());
                    ps.setNString(10, groupName.trim());
                    ps.setString(11, attributeType);
                    ps.setBoolean(12, config.isRequired());
                    ps.setBoolean(13, config.isFilterable());
                    ps.setInt(14, config.getDisplayOrder());

                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException ex) {

                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackEx) {
                    ex.addSuppressed(rollbackEx);
                }

                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Lỗi lưu CategoryAttribute!",
                        ex
                );

                return false;

            } finally {
                try {
                    conn.setAutoCommit(oldAutoCommit);
                } catch (SQLException ex) {
                    LOGGER.log(
                            Level.WARNING,
                            "Lỗi khôi phục autoCommit!",
                            ex
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi kết nối CategoryAttribute!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean delete(
            int categoryId,
            int attributeId) {

        if (categoryId <= 0 || attributeId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "DELETE FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WHERE category_id = ? "
                + "AND attribute_id = ? "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION ps "
                + "ON ps.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "WHERE p.category_id = ? "
                + "AND ps.attribute_id = ?"
                + ") "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "ON s.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "JOIN SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE sav "
                + "ON sav.sku_id = s.sku_id "
                + "WHERE p.category_id = ? "
                + "AND sav.attribute_id = ?"
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(2, attributeId);

            ps.setInt(3, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(4, attributeId);

            ps.setInt(5, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(6, attributeId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi xóa cấu hình CategoryAttribute!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return false;
    }

    private boolean isValidAttributeType(String type) {

        return "SPECIFICATION".equals(type)
                || "VARIANT".equals(type)
                || "BOTH".equals(type);
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Category;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Types;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class CategoryDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(CategoryDAO.class.getName());

    private static final String CATEGORY_COLUMNS
            = "category_id, category_name, parent_id, "
            + "description, is_active ";

    private Category mapCategory(ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        Object parentValue = rs.getObject("parent_id");

        Integer parentId = parentValue == null
                ? null
                : ((Number) parentValue).intValue();

        return new Category(
                rs.getInt("category_id"),
                rs.getString("category_name"),
                parentId,
                rs.getString("description"),
                rs.getBoolean("is_active")
        );
    }

    public List<Category> getList() {

        List<Category> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + CATEGORY_COLUMNS
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "ORDER BY parent_id ASC, "
                + "category_name ASC, category_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapCategory(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get category list",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get category list", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<Category> getActiveCategories() {

        List<Category> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + CATEGORY_COLUMNS
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY parent_id ASC, "
                + "category_name ASC, category_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapCategory(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get active categories",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get active categories", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public Category getById(int id) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + CATEGORY_COLUMNS
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE category_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, id);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return mapCategory(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get category by ID",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get category by ID", ex
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    public boolean isCategoryNameExists(String categoryName)
            throws SQLException {

        return isCategoryNameExists(categoryName, 0);
    }

    public boolean isCategoryNameExists(
            String categoryName,
            int excludeCategoryId) throws SQLException {

        if (categoryName == null
                || categoryName.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(category_name))) "
                + "= LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(?))) "
                + "AND category_id <> ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, categoryName.trim());
            ps.setInt(2, excludeCategoryId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }
        }
    }

    public int insert(Category category) {

        if (!isValidCategory(category)) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO CATEGORY "
                + "(category_name, parent_id, "
                + "description, is_active) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            if (!isValidParent(
                    conn, category.getParentId(), null)) {
                return 0;
            }

            try (PreparedStatement ps
                    = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                ps.setNString(
                        1, category.getCategoryName().trim()
                );

                setParentId(ps, 2, category.getParentId());

                ps.setNString(
                        3, category.getDescription()
                );

                ps.setBoolean(4, category.isActive());

                return ps.executeUpdate();
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot insert category",
                    ex
            );
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public int edit(Category category) {

        if (!isValidCategory(category)
                || category.getCategoryId() <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE CATEGORY "
                + "SET category_name = ?, "
                + "parent_id = ?, "
                + "description = ?, "
                + "is_active = ? "
                + "WHERE category_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            boolean oldAutoCommit = conn.getAutoCommit();

            try {
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);

                if (!isValidParent(
                        conn,
                        category.getParentId(),
                        category.getCategoryId())) {

                    conn.rollback();
                    return 0;
                }

                int result;

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setNString(
                            1, category.getCategoryName().trim()
                    );

                    setParentId(
                            ps, 2, category.getParentId()
                    );

                    ps.setNString(
                            3, category.getDescription()
                    );

                    ps.setBoolean(4, category.isActive());

                    ps.setInt(
                            5, category.getCategoryId()
                    );

                    result = ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                conn.commit();
                return result;

            } catch (SQLException ex) {

                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackEx) {
                    ex.addSuppressed(rollbackEx);
                }

                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Cannot update category",
                        ex
                );
                return 0;

            } finally {
                try {
                    conn.setAutoCommit(oldAutoCommit);
                } catch (SQLException ex) {
                    LOGGER.log(
                            Level.WARNING,
                            "Cannot restore autoCommit",
                            ex
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot connect to update category",
                    ex
            );
            return 0;
        }
    }

    private boolean isValidCategory(Category category) {

        if (category == null
                || category.getCategoryName() == null) {
            return false;
        }

        String name = category.getCategoryName().trim();

        if (name.isEmpty() || name.length() > 100) {
            return false;
        }

        return category.getDescription() == null
                || category.getDescription().length() <= 500;
    }

    private boolean isValidParent(
            Connection conn,
            Integer parentId,
            Integer categoryId) throws SQLException {

        if (parentId == null) {
            return true;
        }

        if (parentId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        if (categoryId != null
                && parentId.equals(categoryId)) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT parent_id "
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE category_id = ?";

        Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();

        Integer currentId = parentId;

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            while (currentId != null) {

                if (!visited.add(currentId)) {
                    return false;
                }

                if (categoryId != null
                        && currentId.equals(categoryId)) {
                    return false;
                }

                ps.setInt(1, currentId);

                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                    if (!rs.next()) {
                        return false;
                    }

                    Object value = rs.getObject("parent_id");

                    currentId = value == null
                            ? null
                            : ((Number) value).intValue();
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private void setParentId(
            PreparedStatement ps,
            int index,
            Integer parentId) throws SQLException {

        if (parentId == null) {
            ps.setNull(index, Types.INTEGER);
        } else {
            ps.setInt(index, parentId);
        }
    }

    public int countCategories() {

        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CATEGORY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            return rs.next() ? rs.getInt(1) : 0;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count categories",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count categories", ex
            );
        }
    }

    public List<Category> searchByName(String keyword) {

        List<Category> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + CATEGORY_COLUMNS
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE category_name LIKE ? "
                + "ORDER BY parent_id ASC, "
                + "category_name ASC, category_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, searchPattern(keyword));

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapCategory(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot search categories",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot search categories", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public int countSearchResults(String keyword) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE category_name LIKE ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, searchPattern(keyword));

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next() ? rs.getInt(1) : 0;
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count category search results",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count category search results", ex
            );
        }
    }

    public List<Category> getListByPage(
            int page,
            int pageSize) {

        List<Category> list = new ArrayList<>();

        validatePage(page, pageSize);

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + CATEGORY_COLUMNS
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "ORDER BY parent_id ASC, "
                + "category_name ASC, category_id ASC "
                + "OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, offset(page, pageSize));
            ps.setInt(2, pageSize);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapCategory(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get categories by page",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get categories by page", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<Category> searchByNameAndPage(
            String keyword,
            int page,
            int pageSize) {

        List<Category> list = new ArrayList<>();

        validatePage(page, pageSize);

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + CATEGORY_COLUMNS
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE category_name LIKE ? "
                + "ORDER BY parent_id ASC, "
                + "category_name ASC, category_id ASC "
                + "OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, searchPattern(keyword));
            ps.setInt(2, offset(page, pageSize));
            ps.setInt(3, pageSize);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapCategory(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot search categories by page",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot search categories by page", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }


    public Map<Integer, Integer> getProductCounts(
            List<Category> categories) {

        Map<Integer, Integer> counts = new HashMap<>();

        if (categories == null || categories.isEmpty()) {
            return counts;
        }

        for (Category category : categories) {
            counts.put(category.getCategoryId(), 0);
        }

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "WITH CategoryTree AS ( "
                + "SELECT c.category_id AS root_id, "
                + "c.category_id AS descendant_id, "
                + "CAST('/' + CAST(c.category_id AS VARCHAR(20)) "
                + "+ '/' AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS category_path "
                + "FROM CATEGORY c "
                + "WHERE c.category_id IN ("
        );

        appendPlaceholders(sql, categories.size());

        sql.append(
                ") "
                + "UNION ALL "
                + "SELECT ct.root_id, child.category_id, "
                + "CAST(ct.category_path "
                + "+ CAST(child.category_id AS VARCHAR(20)) "
                + "+ '/' AS VARCHAR(MAX)) "
                + "FROM CATEGORY child "
                + "JOIN CategoryTree ct "
                + "ON child.parent_id = ct.descendant_id "
                + "WHERE CHARINDEX( "
                + "'/' + CAST(child.category_id AS VARCHAR(20)) "
                + "+ '/', ct.category_path) = 0 "
                + ") "
                + "SELECT ct.root_id, "
                + "COUNT(p.product_id) AS total "
                + "FROM CategoryTree ct "
                + "LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.category_id = ct.descendant_id "
