                + "GROUP BY ct.root_id "
                + "OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767)"
        );

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {

            for (int i = 0; i < categories.size(); i++) {
                ps.setInt(
                        i + 1,
                        categories.get(i).getCategoryId()
                );
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    counts.put(
                            rs.getInt("root_id"),
                            rs.getInt("total")
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get product counts",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get product counts", ex
            );
        }

        return counts;
    }

    public Map<Integer, Integer> getChildCounts(
            List<Category> categories) {

        Map<Integer, Integer> counts = new HashMap<>();

        if (categories == null || categories.isEmpty()) {
            return counts;
        }

        for (Category category : categories) {
            counts.put(category.getCategoryId(), 0);
        }

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "SELECT parent_id, COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE parent_id IN ("
        );

        appendPlaceholders(sql, categories.size());

        sql.append(") GROUP BY parent_id");

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {

            for (int i = 0; i < categories.size(); i++) {
                ps.setInt(
                        i + 1,
                        categories.get(i).getCategoryId()
                );
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    counts.put(
                            rs.getInt("parent_id"),
                            rs.getInt("total")
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get child counts",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get child counts", ex
            );
        }

        return counts;
    }

    public int countProductsByCategoryId(int categoryId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT "
                + "WHERE category_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next() ? rs.getInt(1) : 0;
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count category products",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count category products", ex
            );
        }
    }

    public int countChildCategories(int categoryId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE parent_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next() ? rs.getInt(1) : 0;
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count child categories",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count child categories", ex
            );
        }
    }

    public int delete(Category category) {

        if (category == null
                || category.getCategoryId() <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        return setCategoryActive(
                category.getCategoryId(),
                false
        );
    }

    public int setCategoryActive(
            int categoryId,
            boolean active) {

        if (categoryId <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE CATEGORY "
                + "SET is_active = ? "
                + "WHERE category_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, active);
            ps.setInt(2, categoryId);

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot change category status",
                    ex
            );
            return 0;
        }
    }

    private void appendPlaceholders(
            StringBuilder sql,
            int count) {

        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {

            if (i > 0) {
                sql.append(", ");
            }

            sql.append("?");
        }
    }

    private String searchPattern(String keyword) {

        return "%" + (keyword == null
                ? ""
                : keyword.trim()) + "%";
    }

    private void validatePage(int page, int pageSize) {

        if (page <= 0 || pageSize <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Page và pageSize phải lớn hơn 0."
            );
        }
    }

    private int offset(int page, int pageSize) {

        long value = ((long) page - 1) * pageSize;

        if (value > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Giá trị phân trang quá lớn."
            );
        }

        return (int) value;
    }
}

package dao;

import db.DBContext;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.Date;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class DashboardDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(DashboardDAO.class.getName());

    // 1. Tổng doanh thu trong khoảng thời gian.
    // Không tính các đơn đã được duyệt yêu cầu RETURN.
    public BigDecimal getTotalRevenueByRange(
            LocalDate start, LocalDate end) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' "
                + "AND o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ( "
                + "    SELECT 1 "
                + "    FROM RETURN_REQUEST rr "
                + "    WHERE rr.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "      AND rr.request_type = 'RETURN' "
                + "      AND rr.request_status = 'APPROVED' "
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setRange(ps, start, end);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getBigDecimal(1);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            throw databaseError("Lỗi lấy doanh thu", ex);
        }

        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Truy vấn không trả về kết quả.");
    }

    // 2. Tổng số đơn hàng trong khoảng thời gian.
    // Không tính các đơn đã được duyệt yêu cầu RETURN.
    public int getTotalOrdersByRange(
            LocalDate start, LocalDate end) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ( "
                + "    SELECT 1 "
                + "    FROM RETURN_REQUEST rr "
                + "    WHERE rr.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "      AND rr.request_type = 'RETURN' "
                + "      AND rr.request_status = 'APPROVED' "
                + ")";

        return countByRange(sql, start, end);
    }

    // 3. Tổng số đơn hoàn thành.
    // Không tính các đơn đã được duyệt yêu cầu RETURN.
    public int getCompletedOrdersByRange(
            LocalDate start, LocalDate end) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' "
                + "AND o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ( "
                + "    SELECT 1 "
                + "    FROM RETURN_REQUEST rr "
                + "    WHERE rr.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "      AND rr.request_type = 'RETURN' "
                + "      AND rr.request_status = 'APPROVED' "
                + ")";

        return countByRange(sql, start, end);
    }

    // 4. Tổng số đơn đã hủy.
    // Không tính các đơn đã được duyệt yêu cầu RETURN.
    public int getCancelledOrdersByRange(
            LocalDate start, LocalDate end) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_status = 'CANCELLED' "
                + "AND o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ( "
                + "    SELECT 1 "
                + "    FROM RETURN_REQUEST rr "
                + "    WHERE rr.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "      AND rr.request_type = 'RETURN' "
                + "      AND rr.request_status = 'APPROVED' "
                + ")";

        return countByRange(sql, start, end);
    }

    // 5. Doanh thu theo ngày tạo đơn.
    // Không tính các đơn đã được duyệt yêu cầu RETURN.
    public List<Object[]> getRevenueByDateRange(
            LocalDate start, LocalDate end) {

        List<Object[]> result = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "    CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) AS order_date, "
                + "    SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_value "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' "
                + "AND o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ( "
                + "    SELECT 1 "
                + "    FROM RETURN_REQUEST rr "
                + "    WHERE rr.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "      AND rr.request_type = 'RETURN' "
                + "      AND rr.request_status = 'APPROVED' "
                + ") "
                + "GROUP BY CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) "
                + "ORDER BY order_date ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setRange(ps, start, end);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    result.add(new Object[]{
                        rs.getDate("order_date"),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("total_value")
                    });
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            throw databaseError(
                    "Lỗi lấy biểu đồ doanh thu", ex);
        }

        return result;
    }

    // 6. Thống kê trạng thái đơn hàng.
    // Không tính các đơn đã được duyệt yêu cầu RETURN.
    public List<Object[]> getOrderStatusByRange(
            LocalDate start, LocalDate end) {

        List<Object[]> result = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT o.order_status, COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ( "
                + "    SELECT 1 "
                + "    FROM RETURN_REQUEST rr "
                + "    WHERE rr.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "      AND rr.request_type = 'RETURN' "
                + "      AND rr.request_status = 'APPROVED' "
                + ") "
                + "GROUP BY o.order_status "
                + "ORDER BY total DESC, o.order_status ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setRange(ps, start, end);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    result.add(new Object[]{
                        rs.getString("order_status"),
                        rs.getInt("total")
                    });
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            throw databaseError(
                    "Lỗi thống kê trạng thái đơn", ex);
        }

        return result;
    }

    // 7. Top 5 sản phẩm theo số lượng bán.
    // Không tính sản phẩm thuộc các đơn đã được duyệt yêu cầu RETURN.
    public List<Object[]> getTopSellingProductsByRange(
            LocalDate start, LocalDate end) {

        List<Object[]> result = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT TOP 5 "
                + "    p.product_id, "
                + "    p.product_name, "
                + "    p.image_url, "
                + "    price_info.min_price, "
                + "    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU sku "
                + "    ON oi.sku_id = sku.sku_id "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p "
                + "    ON sku.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN ( "
                + "    SELECT product_id, MIN(price) AS min_price "
                + "    FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "    GROUP BY product_id "
                + ") price_info "
                + "    ON price_info.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "WHERE o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' "
                + "AND o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ( "
                + "    SELECT 1 "
                + "    FROM RETURN_REQUEST rr "
                + "    WHERE rr.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "      AND rr.request_type = 'RETURN' "
                + "      AND rr.request_status = 'APPROVED' "
                + ") "
                + "GROUP BY "
                + "    p.product_id, "
                + "    p.product_name, "
                + "    p.image_url, "
                + "    price_info.min_price "
                + "ORDER BY "
                + "    total_sold DESC, "
                + "    p.product_name ASC, "
                + "    p.product_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setRange(ps, start, end);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    result.add(new Object[]{
                        rs.getInt("product_id"),
                        rs.getString("product_name"),
                        rs.getString("image_url"),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("min_price"),
                        rs.getInt("total_sold")
                    });
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            throw databaseError(
                    "Lỗi lấy Top 5 sản phẩm", ex);
        }

        return result;
    }

    // ==================== INVENTORY ====================

    public int[] getCurrentStockStatistics() {

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "COALESCE(SUM(CASE "
                + "WHEN COALESCE(stock_quantity, 0) > 5 "
                + "THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_stock, "
                + "COALESCE(SUM(CASE "
                + "WHEN stock_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 5 "
                + "THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS low_stock, "
                + "COALESCE(SUM(CASE "
                + "WHEN COALESCE(stock_quantity, 0) <= 0 "
                + "THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS out_stock "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
                ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            if (rs.next()) {
                return new int[]{
                    rs.getInt("in_stock"),
                    rs.getInt("low_stock"),
                    rs.getInt("out_stock")
                };
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            throw databaseError(
                    "Lỗi lấy tình trạng tồn kho", ex);
        }

        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Không đọc được dữ liệu tồn kho.");
    }

    // ==================== HELPER METHODS ====================

    private int countByRange(
            String sql, LocalDate start, LocalDate end) {

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setRange(ps, start, end);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            throw databaseError(
                    "Lỗi đếm dữ liệu Dashboard", ex);
        }

        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Truy vấn đếm không trả về kết quả.");
    }

    private void setRange(
            PreparedStatement ps,
            LocalDate start,
            LocalDate end) throws SQLException {

        ps.setDate(1, Date.valueOf(start));
        ps.setDate(2, Date.valueOf(end.plusDays(1)));
    }

    private IllegalStateException databaseError(
            String message, SQLException ex) {

        LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, message, ex);

        return new IllegalStateException(
                message + ". Không thể tải dữ liệu.", ex);
    }

    // ==================== LOW STOCK PRODUCTS ====================

    public List<Object[]> getLowStockProducts() {

        List<Object[]> result = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "s.sku_id, "
                + "s.sku_code, "
                + "p.product_name, "
                + "p.image_url, "
                + "COALESCE(s.stock_quantity, 0) AS stock_quantity, "
                + "s.price "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p "
                + "    ON s.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "WHERE COALESCE(s.stock_quantity, 0) <= 5 "
                + "ORDER BY "
                + "CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.stock_quantity, 0) <= 0 "
                + "THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, "
                + "COALESCE(s.stock_quantity, 0) ASC, "
                + "p.product_name ASC, "
                + "s.sku_code ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
                ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                result.add(new Object[]{
                    rs.getInt("sku_id"),
                    rs.getString("sku_code"),
                    rs.getString("product_name"),
                    rs.getString("image_url"),
                    rs.getInt("stock_quantity"),
                    rs.getBigDecimal("price")
                });
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting low stock products",
                    ex
            );

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Không thể lấy danh sách SKU cần nhập hàng.",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return result;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.InventoryItem;
import model.InventoryMovement;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Types;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class InventoryDAO extends DBContext {

    public boolean isAuthorizedStaff(int userId) throws SQLException {

        String sql
                = "SELECT TOP (1) 1 "
                + "FROM dbo.[USER] u "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.ROLES r "
                + "ON u.role_id = r.role_id "
                + "WHERE u.user_id = ? "
                + "AND u.is_active = 1 "
                + "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.role_name))) "
                + "IN ('STAFF', 'ADMIN')";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }
        }
    }

    public int countItems(String keyword, String status) throws SQLException {
        Filter filter = makeFilter(keyword, status);
        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) " + filter.sql;
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            bindFilter(ps, filter);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next() ? rs.getInt(1) : 0;
            }
        }
    }

    public List<InventoryItem> findItems(String keyword, String status,
            int page, int pageSize) throws SQLException {
        Filter filter = makeFilter(keyword, status);
        String sql = "SELECT s.sku_id, s.product_id, s.sku_code, "
                + "p.product_name, s.stock_quantity, s.is_active AS sku_active, "
                + "p.is_active AS product_active " + filter.sql
                + " ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.is_active=1 AND p.is_active=1 "
                + "THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, s.stock_quantity ASC, s.sku_id DESC "
                + "OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";
        List<InventoryItem> result = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            int index = bindFilter(ps, filter);
            ps.setInt(index++, (page - 1) * pageSize);
            ps.setInt(index, pageSize);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    result.add(new InventoryItem(
                            rs.getInt("sku_id"), rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getString("sku_code"), rs.getString("product_name"),
                            rs.getInt("stock_quantity"), rs.getBoolean("sku_active"),
                            rs.getBoolean("product_active")));
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public List<InventoryMovement> getRecentMovements(int limit)
            throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT TOP (?) m.movement_id, s.sku_code, "
                + "p.product_name, m.movement_type, m.quantity_delta, "
                + "m.quantity_before, m.quantity_after, m.note, "
                + "u.username AS actor_name, m.created_at "
                + "FROM dbo.INVENTORY_MOVEMENT m "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON s.sku_id=m.sku_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id=s.product_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.[USER] u ON u.user_id=m.actor_user_id "
                + "ORDER BY m.movement_id DESC";
        List<InventoryMovement> result = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, Math.max(1, Math.min(100, limit)));
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    result.add(new InventoryMovement(
                            rs.getLong("movement_id"), rs.getString("sku_code"),
                            rs.getString("product_name"), rs.getString("movement_type"),
                            rs.getInt("quantity_delta"), rs.getInt("quantity_before"),
                            rs.getInt("quantity_after"), rs.getString("note"),
                            rs.getString("actor_name"), rs.getTimestamp("created_at")));
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    /**
     * Executes a row-locked, transactional stock change. The DB trigger writes
     * the movement in the SAME transaction, tagged by SESSION_CONTEXT. action:
     * IN adds; OUT subtracts; SET makes an absolute correction.
     */
    public int changeStock(int skuId, String action, int quantity,
            String note, int actorUserId) throws SQLException {
        if (skuId <= 0 || actorUserId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("SKU hoặc nhân viên không hợp lệ.");
        }
        if (!"IN".equals(action) && !"OUT".equals(action)
                && !"SET".equals(action)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Loại điều chỉnh không hợp lệ.");
        }
        if (quantity < 0 || (!"SET".equals(action) && quantity == 0)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Số lượng không hợp lệ.");
        }
        if (note == null || note.trim().isEmpty() || note.trim().length() > 500) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cần nhập lý do (tối đa 500 ký tự).");
        }

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);
            try {
                int oldQty;
                String readSql = "SELECT s.stock_quantity FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id=s.product_id "
                        + "WHERE s.sku_id=? AND s.is_active=1 AND p.is_active=1";
                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(readSql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, skuId);
                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "SKU không tồn tại hoặc đã ngừng kinh doanh.");
                        }
                        oldQty = rs.getInt(1);
                        if (rs.wasNull()) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException("SKU có tồn kho NULL.");
                        }
                    }
                }

                long newQtyLong;
                if ("IN".equals(action)) {
                    newQtyLong = (long) oldQty + quantity;
                } else if ("OUT".equals(action)) {
                    newQtyLong = (long) oldQty - quantity;
                } else {
                    newQtyLong = quantity;
                }
                if (newQtyLong < 0 || newQtyLong > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Không đủ hàng hoặc vượt giới hạn tồn kho.");
                }
                int newQty = (int) newQtyLong;
                if (newQty == oldQty) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Số tồn mới không thay đổi.");
                }

                setContext(conn, "oecs_inventory_action", action);
                setContext(conn, "oecs_inventory_note", note.trim());
                setContext(conn, "oecs_inventory_user_id", actorUserId);

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                        "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU SET stock_quantity=? "
                        + "WHERE sku_id=? AND stock_quantity=?")) {
                    ps.setInt(1, newQty);
                    ps.setInt(2, skuId);
                    ps.setInt(3, oldQty);
                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        throw new SQLException("Dữ liệu tồn kho đã thay đổi. Vui lòng tải lại.");
                    }
                }

                // Ghi lịch sử nhập/xuất kho bằng Java
                // Sử dụng cùng transaction với cập nhật tồn kho
                InventoryMovementHelper.record(
                        conn,
                        skuId,
                        action,
                        oldQty,
                        newQty,
                        note.trim(),
                        actorUserId
                );

                // Chỉ commit khi cập nhật kho và lịch sử đều thành công
                conn.commit();
                return newQty;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
                    ex.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
                }
                throw ex;
            } finally {
                // SESSION_CONTEXT is per SQL connection, NOT per transaction.
                // Clear it even after rollback to prevent metadata leaking into
                // a subsequent request when JDBC connections are pooled.
                SQLException clearError = null;
                for (String key : new String[]{
                    "oecs_inventory_action", "oecs_inventory_note",
                    "oecs_inventory_user_id"}) {
                    try {
                        setContext(conn, key, null);
                    } catch (SQLException ex) {
                        if (clearError == null) {
                            clearError = ex;
                        } else {
                            clearError.addSuppressed(ex);
                        }
                    }
                }
                try {
                    conn.setAutoCommit(true);
                } catch (SQLException ex) {
                    if (clearError == null) {
                        clearError = ex;
                    } else {
                        clearError.addSuppressed(ex);
                    }
                }
                if (clearError != null) {
                    throw clearError;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void setContext(Connection conn, String key, Object value)
            throws SQLException {
        // Only internally fixed keys, never user-controlled SQL identifiers.
        String sql = "EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'" + key
                + "', @value=?";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            if (value == null) {
                ps.setNull(1, Types.NVARCHAR);
            } else if (value instanceof Integer) {
                ps.setInt(1, (Integer) value);
            } else {
                ps.setString(1, (String) value);
            }
            ps.execute();
        }
    }

    private Filter makeFilter(String keyword, String status) {
        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id=s.product_id "
                + "WHERE 1=1");
        String normalized = keyword == null ? "" : keyword.trim();
        if (normalized.length() > 100) {
            normalized = normalized.substring(0, 100);
        }
        if (!normalized.isEmpty()) {
            sql.append(" AND (s.sku_code LIKE ? ESCAPE '~' "
                    + "OR p.product_name LIKE ? ESCAPE '~')");
        }
        if ("LOW".equals(status)) {
            sql.append(" AND s.stock_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 5");
        } else if ("OUT".equals(status)) {
            sql.append(" AND s.stock_quantity=0");
        }
        return new Filter(sql.toString(), normalized);
    }

    private int bindFilter(PreparedStatement ps, Filter filter)
            throws SQLException {
        int i = 1;
        if (!filter.keyword.isEmpty()) {
            String pattern = "%" + filter.keyword
                    .replace("~", "~~").replace("%", "~%")
                    .replace("_", "~_").replace("[", "~[") + "%";
            ps.setString(i++, pattern);
            ps.setString(i++, pattern);
        }
        return i;
    }

    private static class Filter {

        final String sql;
        final String keyword;

        Filter(String sql, String keyword) {
            this.sql = sql;
            this.keyword = keyword;
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Types;

/**
 * Records stock movements from Java instead of relying on a database trigger.
 * IMPORTANT: call within the same open transaction as the stock UPDATE.
 */
public final class InventoryMovementHelper {
    private InventoryMovementHelper() { }

    public static void record(Connection conn, int skuId, String movementType,
                              int before, int after, String note, Integer actorUserId)
            throws SQLException {
        if (conn == null || skuId <= 0 || before < 0 || after < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid stock-movement arguments.");
        }
        if (movementType == null ||
                !(movementType.equals("OPENING") || movementType.equals("IN") ||
                  movementType.equals("OUT") || movementType.equals("SET") ||
                  movementType.equals("SYSTEM"))) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid movement type.");
        }
        if (note != null && note.length() > 500) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Movement note exceeds 500 characters.");
        }

        long delta = (long) after - before;
        if (delta > Integer.MAX_VALUE || delta < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Movement delta out of SQL INT range.");
        }
        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.INVENTORY_MOVEMENT "
                + "(sku_id,movement_type,quantity_delta,quantity_before,"
                + "quantity_after,note,actor_user_id) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, skuId);
            ps.setString(2, movementType);
            ps.setInt(3, (int) delta);
            ps.setInt(4, before);
            ps.setInt(5, after);
            if (note == null) ps.setNull(6, Types.NVARCHAR);
            else ps.setNString(6, note);
            if (actorUserId == null) ps.setNull(7, Types.INTEGER);
            else ps.setInt(7, actorUserId);
            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                throw new SQLException("Could not write inventory movement.");
            }
        }
    }

    /** Call immediately after a successful +/- stock UPDATE in the same transaction. */
    public static void recordAfterDelta(Connection conn, int skuId, int delta,
                                        String movementType, String note,
                                        Integer actorUserId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT stock_quantity FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) "
                   + "WHERE sku_id=?";
        int after;
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, skuId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) throw new SQLException("SKU not found: " + skuId);
                after = rs.getInt(1);
                if (rs.wasNull()) throw new SQLException("SKU stock is NULL.");
            }
        }
        long before = (long) after - delta;
        if (before < 0 || before > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
            throw new SQLException("Invalid prior stock value for SKU " + skuId);
        }
        record(conn, skuId, movementType, (int) before, after, note, actorUserId);
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Notification;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class NotificationDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(NotificationDAO.class.getName());

    public boolean createOrderStatusNotification(int orderId, String status) {
        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            return createOrderStatusNotification(conn, orderId, status);
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Error creating order status notification", ex);
            return false;
        }
    }

    public static boolean createOrderStatusNotification(Connection conn, int orderId, String status) throws SQLException {
        if (conn == null || conn.isClosed()) throw new SQLException("Kết nối không hợp lệ.");
        if (orderId <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mã đơn hàng không hợp lệ.");
        String title;
        String message;

        String normalizedStatus = status == null
                ? ""
                : status.trim().toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);

        if (normalizedStatus.equals("CONFIRMED")) {

            title = "Đơn hàng đã được xác nhận";
            message = "Đơn hàng #" + orderId
                    + " của bạn đã được xác nhận và đang được chuẩn bị.";

        } else if (normalizedStatus.equals("PACKING")) {

            title = "Đơn hàng đang được đóng gói";
            message = "Đơn hàng #" + orderId
                    + " đã được xác nhận và đang trong quá trình đóng gói.";

        } else if (normalizedStatus.equals("SHIPPING")
                || normalizedStatus.equals("SHIPPED")) {

            title = "Đơn hàng đang được vận chuyển";
            message = "Đơn hàng #" + orderId
                    + " đã được bàn giao cho đơn vị vận chuyển. "
                    + "Vui lòng chú ý điện thoại để nhận hàng.";

        } else if (normalizedStatus.equals("DELIVERED")) {

            title = "Đơn hàng đã giao thành công";
            message = "Đơn hàng #" + orderId
                    + " đã được giao thành công. "
                    + "Cảm ơn bạn đã mua sắm tại OECS!";

        } else if (normalizedStatus.equals("COMPLETED")) {

            title = "Đơn hàng đã hoàn tất";
            message = "Đơn hàng #" + orderId
                    + " đã hoàn tất. Hy vọng bạn hài lòng với sản phẩm!";

        } else if (normalizedStatus.equals("CANCELLED")
                || normalizedStatus.equals("CANCELED")) {

            title = "Đơn hàng đã bị hủy";
            message = "Đơn hàng #" + orderId
                    + " của bạn đã bị hủy. "
                    + "Nếu cần hỗ trợ, vui lòng liên hệ nhân viên OECS.";

        } else {
            LOGGER.warning("Unsupported order status: " + status);
            return false;
        }

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.NOTIFICATION "
                + "(user_id, order_id, title, message) "
                + "SELECT o.user_id, o.order_id, ?, ? "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, title);
            ps.setString(2, message);
            ps.setInt(3, orderId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        }
    }

    public void createReturnExchangeNotification(
            Connection conn,
            int userId,
            int orderId,
            String requestType,
            String status) throws SQLException {

        String type = "RETURN".equals(requestType)
                ? "trả hàng"
                : "đổi hàng";

        String result = "APPROVED".equals(status)
                ? "đã được chấp nhận"
                : "đã bị từ chối";

        String title = "Cập nhật yêu cầu đổi/trả hàng";
        String message = "Yêu cầu " + type
                + " cho đơn hàng #" + orderId
                + " " + result + ".";

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.NOTIFICATION "
                + "(user_id, order_id, title, message) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.setInt(2, orderId);
            ps.setString(3, title);
            ps.setString(4, message);

            ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }

    public int countUnread(int userId) {

        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM dbo.NOTIFICATION "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? AND is_read = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error counting unread notifications", ex);
        }

        return 0;
    }

    public List<Notification> findLatest(int userId) {

        List<Notification> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT TOP 20 "
                + "notification_id, user_id, order_id, "
                + "title, message, is_read, created_at "
                + "FROM dbo.NOTIFICATION "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {

                    Notification n = new Notification();

                    n.setNotificationId(
                            rs.getInt("notification_id"));

                    n.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));

                    int orderId = rs.getInt("order_id");

                    if (rs.wasNull()) {
                        n.setOrderId(null);
                    } else {
                        n.setOrderId(orderId);
                    }

                    n.setTitle(rs.getString("title"));
                    n.setMessage(rs.getString("message"));
                    n.setRead(rs.getBoolean("is_read"));
                    n.setCreatedAt(
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                    list.add(n);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting latest notifications", ex);
        }

        return list;
    }

    public boolean markAsRead(int notificationId, int userId) {

        String sql = "UPDATE dbo.NOTIFICATION "
                + "SET is_read = 1 "
                + "WHERE notification_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, notificationId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error marking notification as read", ex);
        }

        return false;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import model.Order;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Collections;

public class OrderDAO {

    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public OrderDAO() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public OrderDAO(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    private Connection getConnection() throws SQLException {
        Connection conn = connections.open();
        if (conn == null) {
            throw new SQLException("Khong ket noi duoc database.");
        }
        return conn;
    }

    public List<Order> findByUser(int userId) throws SQLException {
        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            return findByUser(conn, userId);
        }
    }

    private static final String PURCHASE_SEARCH = " FROM dbo.[ORDER] o WHERE o.user_id = ? "
            + "AND (? = N'' OR CONVERT(varchar(20), o.order_id) = ? OR EXISTS ("
            + "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM si JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU ss ON ss.sku_id = si.sku_id "
            + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT sp ON sp.product_id = ss.product_id WHERE si.order_id = o.order_id "
            + "AND (sp.product_name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' OR ss.sku_code LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'))) ";

    private int bindPurchaseSearch(PreparedStatement ps, int userId, String query) throws SQLException {
        String text = query == null ? "" : query.trim();
        String pattern = "%" + text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%")
                .replace("_", "\\_").replace("[", "\\[") + "%";
        ps.setInt(1, userId);
        ps.setNString(2, text);
        ps.setString(3, text.startsWith("#") ? text.substring(1) : text);
        ps.setNString(4, pattern);
        ps.setNString(5, pattern);
        return 6;
    }

    public Map<String, Long> countPurchasesByStatus(int userId, String query) throws SQLException {
        Map<String, Long> counts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        String sql = "SELECT o.order_status, COUNT_BIG(*) AS total" + PURCHASE_SEARCH + "GROUP BY o.order_status";
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            bindPurchaseSearch(ps, userId, query);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    counts.put(rs.getString("order_status"), rs.getLong("total"));
                }
            }
        }
        return counts;
    }

    public List<Order> findPurchasePage(int userId, String query, List<String> statuses,
            long offset, int pageSize) throws SQLException {
        if (offset < 0 || pageSize < 1 || pageSize > 50) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid page");
        }
        String statusFilter = statuses.isEmpty() ? "" : "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.order_status))) IN ("
                + String.join(",", Collections.nCopies(statuses.size(), "?")) + ") ";
        String sql = "SELECT o.*" + PURCHASE_SEARCH + statusFilter
                + "ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.order_id DESC OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";
        List<Order> result = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            int index = bindPurchaseSearch(ps, userId, query);
            for (String status : statuses) {
                ps.setString(index++, status);
            }
            ps.setLong(index++, offset);
            ps.setInt(index, pageSize);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    result.add(mapOrder(rs));
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public Map<Integer, List<Map<String, Object>>> findItemsForOrders(int userId, List<Integer> ids) throws SQLException {
        Map<Integer, List<Map<String, Object>>> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (ids.isEmpty()) {
            return result;
        }
        if (ids.size() > 50) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Too many orders");
        }
        String sql = "SELECT i.order_id, i.sku_id, i.price, i.quantity, s.sku_code, p.product_name, p.image_url "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM i JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = i.order_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON s.sku_id = i.sku_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = s.product_id WHERE o.user_id = ? "
                + "AND o.order_id IN (" + String.join(",", Collections.nCopies(ids.size(), "?"))
                + ") ORDER BY i.order_id, i.order_item_id";
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            for (int i = 0; i < ids.size(); i++) {
                ps.setInt(i + 2, ids.get(i));
            }
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    item.put("skuId", rs.getInt("sku_id"));
                    item.put("imageUrl", rs.getString("image_url"));
                    item.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));
                    item.put("productName", rs.getString("product_name"));
                    item.put("price", rs.getBigDecimal("price"));
                    item.put("quantity", rs.getInt("quantity"));
                    result.computeIfAbsent(rs.getInt("order_id"), key -> new ArrayList<>()).add(item);
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public int insert(Connection conn, Order order) throws SQLException {
        return insert(conn, order, null);
    }

    public int insert(
            Connection conn,
            Order order,
            String checkoutToken
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "(user_id, address_id, total_amount, shipping_fee, "
                + "order_status, payment_method, payment_status, "
                + "recipient_name, recipient_phone, shipping_address, "
                + "discount_amount, checkout_token) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                sql, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

            ps.setInt(1, order.getUserId());
            ps.setInt(2, order.getAddressId());
            ps.setBigDecimal(3, order.getTotalAmount());
            ps.setBigDecimal(4, order.getShippingFee());
            ps.setString(5, order.getOrderStatus());
            ps.setString(6, order.getPaymentMethod());
            ps.setString(7, order.getPaymentStatus());
            ps.setString(8, order.getRecipientName());
            ps.setString(9, order.getRecipientPhone());
            ps.setString(10, order.getShippingAddress());
            ps.setBigDecimal(11, order.getDiscountAmount());
            ps.setString(12, checkoutToken);

            ps.executeUpdate();

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Khong lay duoc ma don hang."
                    );
                }

                return rs.getInt(1);
            }
        }
    }

    public void insertItem(
            Connection conn,
            int orderId,
            int skuId,
            BigDecimal price,
            int quantity
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_ITEM "
                + "(order_id, sku_id, price, quantity) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);
            ps.setBigDecimal(3, price);
            ps.setInt(4, quantity);

            ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }

    public void addHistory(
            Connection conn,
            int orderId,
            String status
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY "
                + "(order_id, status) VALUES (?, ?)";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setString(2, status);

            ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }

    public Integer findIdByToken(
            Connection conn,
            int userId,
            String checkoutToken
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "SELECT order_id "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? AND checkout_token = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.setString(2, checkoutToken);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("order_id");
                }

                return null;
            }
        }
    }

    public Integer findIdByToken(
            int userId,
            String checkoutToken
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Khong ket noi duoc database."
                );
            }

            return findIdByToken(conn, userId, checkoutToken);
        }
    }

    public Order findByIdAndUser(
            int orderId,
            int userId
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "SELECT * FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? AND user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Khong ket noi duoc database."
                );
            }

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                ps.setInt(2, userId);

                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                    if (rs.next()) {
                        return mapOrder(rs);
                    }

                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public List<Order> findByUser(
            Connection conn,
            int userId
    ) throws SQLException {

        List<Order> orders = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT * FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC, order_id DESC";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    orders.add(mapOrder(rs));
                }
            }
        }

        return orders;
    }

    private Order mapOrder(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {
        Order order = new Order();

        order.setOrderId(rs.getInt("order_id"));
        order.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
        order.setAddressId(rs.getInt("address_id"));


        order.setTotalAmount(rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount"));
        order.setShippingFee(rs.getBigDecimal("shipping_fee"));
        order.setDiscountAmount(rs.getBigDecimal("discount_amount"));

        order.setOrderStatus(rs.getString("order_status"));
        order.setPaymentMethod(rs.getString("payment_method"));
        order.setPaymentStatus(rs.getString("payment_status"));

        order.setRecipientName(rs.getString("recipient_name"));
        order.setRecipientPhone(rs.getString("recipient_phone"));
        order.setShippingAddress(rs.getString("shipping_address"));

        order.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
        order.setPaymentExpiresAt(
                rs.getTimestamp(
                        "payment_expires_at",
                        java.util.Calendar.getInstance(
                                java.util.TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC")
                        )
                )
        );

        return order;
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> findItems(int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT i.order_item_id, i.sku_id, i.price, i.quantity, s.sku_code, p.product_name, p.image_url "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM i JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = i.order_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON s.sku_id = i.sku_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = s.product_id "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ? AND o.user_id = ? ORDER BY i.order_item_id";
        List<Map<String, Object>> items = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    item.put("orderItemId", rs.getInt("order_item_id"));
                    item.put("skuId", rs.getInt("sku_id"));
                    item.put("imageUrl", rs.getString("image_url"));
                    item.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));
                    item.put("productName", rs.getString("product_name"));
                    item.put("price", rs.getBigDecimal("price"));
                    item.put("quantity", rs.getInt("quantity"));
                    items.add(item);
                }
            }
        }
        return items;
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> findHistory(int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT h.status, h.updated_at FROM dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY h "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = h.order_id "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ? AND o.user_id = ? ORDER BY h.updated_at, h.status_id";
        List<Map<String, Object>> history = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> entry = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    entry.put("status", rs.getString("status"));
                    entry.put("updatedAt", rs.getTimestamp("updated_at"));
                    history.add(entry);
                }
            }
        }
        return history;
    }
