package dao;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The caller must hold the order lock and commit inventory with the order
 * status.
 */
public final class OrderInventoryDAO {

    public void deduct(Connection connection, int orderId) throws SQLException {
        adjust(connection, orderId, true);
    }

    public void restore(Connection connection, int orderId) throws SQLException {
        adjust(connection, orderId, false);
    }

    private void adjust(Connection connection, int orderId, boolean deduct) throws SQLException {
        List<long[]> items = new ArrayList<>();
        String itemsSql = "SELECT sku_id, SUM(CAST(quantity AS bigint)) AS quantity "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM WHERE order_id = ? GROUP BY sku_id ORDER BY sku_id";
        try (PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(itemsSql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, orderId);
            try (ResultSet result = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (result.next()) {
                    long quantity = result.getLong("quantity");
                    if (quantity <= 0) {
                        throw new SQLException("Số lượng sản phẩm trong đơn không hợp lệ.");
                    }
                    items.add(new long[]{result.getInt("sku_id"), quantity});
                }
            }
        }
        if (items.isEmpty()) {
            throw new SQLException("Đơn hàng không có sản phẩm.");
        }
        String updateSql = deduct
                ? "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - ? "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ? AND stock_quantity >= ?"
                : "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + ? WHERE sku_id = ?";
        try (PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(updateSql)) {
            for (long[] item : items) {
                statement.setLong(1, item[1]);
                statement.setInt(2, (int) item[0]);
                if (deduct) {
                    statement.setLong(3, item[1]);
                }
                if (statement.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                    if (deduct) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("SKU " + item[0]
                                + " không đủ tồn kho để xác nhận đơn hàng. Vui lòng kiểm tra hoặc hủy đơn.");
                    }
                    throw new SQLException("Không hoàn được tồn kho SKU " + item[0] + ".");
                }

                int skuId = Math.toIntExact(item[0]);
                int qty = Math.toIntExact(item[1]);

                InventoryMovementHelper.recordAfterDelta(
                        connection,
                        skuId,
                        deduct ? -qty : qty,
                        deduct ? "OUT" : "IN",
                        (deduct
                                ? "Xac nhan don hang #"
                                : "Hoan kho don hang #") + orderId,
                        null
                );

                
            }
        }
    }
}

package dao;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;

public class OrderPolicyDAO {

    public void lockCustomer(Connection connection, int userId)
            throws SQLException {

        try (PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(
                "SELECT user_id FROM dbo.[USER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE user_id = ?")) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy khách hàng."
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public void requireAllowed(Connection connection, int userId)
            throws SQLException {

        String message = restriction(connection, userId);

        if (message != null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(message);
        }
    }

    public String restriction(Connection connection, int userId)
            throws SQLException {

        String sql =
                "SELECT violation_count, blocked_until "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_POLICY "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "AND (violation_count >= 3 "
                + "OR blocked_until > SYSUTCDATETIME())";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (!rs.next()) {
                    return null;
                }

                if (rs.getInt("violation_count") >= 3) {
                    return "Bạn đã bị khóa đặt hàng vĩnh viễn "
                            + "do vi phạm chính sách hủy đơn lần thứ 3.";
                }

                Timestamp until = rs.getTimestamp("blocked_until");

                String local = until.toLocalDateTime()
                        .atOffset(ZoneOffset.UTC)
                        .atZoneSameInstant(
                                ZoneId.of("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh")
                        )
                        .format(
                                DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(
                                        "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm"
                                )
                        );

                return "Bạn đang bị khóa đặt hàng đến " + local
                        + " (giờ Việt Nam) do hủy hơn 5 sản phẩm trong 7 ngày.";
            }
        }
    }

    public void recordCancellation(
            Connection connection,
            int userId,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        // 1. Mark this order as cancelled by the customer.
        // Only the first call is allowed to register the cancellation.
        String markCancellationSql =
                "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "SET cancellation_source = 'CUSTOMER', "
                + "cancelled_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ? "
                + "AND order_status = 'CANCELLED' "
                + "AND cancellation_source IS NULL "
                + "AND cancelled_at IS NULL";

        int affectedRows;

        try (PreparedStatement ps =
                connection.prepareStatement(markCancellationSql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            affectedRows = ps.executeUpdate();
        }

        // Already recorded or invalid order.
        if (affectedRows == 0) {
            return;
        }

        // 2. Create customer policy record if it does not exist.
        String createPolicySql =
                "IF NOT EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_POLICY "
                + "WHERE user_id = ?"
                + ") "
                + "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_POLICY (user_id) "
                + "VALUES (?)";

        try (PreparedStatement ps =
                connection.prepareStatement(createPolicySql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            ps.executeUpdate();
        }

        // 3. Calculate cancelled product quantity directly
        // from ORDER and ORDER_ITEM within the last 7 days.
        String updatePolicySql =
                "UPDATE p "
                + "SET violation_count = violation_count + 1, "
                + "blocked_until = CASE violation_count "
                + "WHEN 0 THEN DATEADD(DAY, 3, SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                + "WHEN 1 THEN DATEADD(DAY, 7, SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                + "ELSE NULL END "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_POLICY p "
                + "WHERE p.user_id = ? "
                + "AND p.violation_count < 3 "
                + "AND (p.blocked_until IS NULL "
                + "OR p.blocked_until <= SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                + "AND ("
                + "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(i.quantity AS BIGINT)), 0) "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "JOIN dbo.ORDER_ITEM i "
                + "ON i.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "WHERE o.user_id = p.user_id "
                + "AND o.cancellation_source = 'CUSTOMER' "
                + "AND o.cancelled_at > DATEADD(DAY, -7, SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                + "AND (p.blocked_until IS NULL "
                + "OR o.cancelled_at >= p.blocked_until)"
                + ") > 5";

        try (PreparedStatement ps =
                connection.prepareStatement(updatePolicySql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import model.PasswordResetToken;

public class PasswordResetDAO {

    public boolean createToken(PasswordResetToken token) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN "
                + "(user_id, token_hash, expires_at) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection connection = new DBContext().getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, token.getUserId());
            ps.setString(2, token.getTokenHash());
            ps.setTimestamp(3, token.getExpiresAt());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        }
    }

   
    public PasswordResetToken findValidToken(String tokenHash)
            throws SQLException {

        String sql = "SELECT reset_id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, used_at, created_at "
                + "FROM PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN "
                + "WHERE token_hash = ? "
                + "AND used_at IS NULL "
                + "AND expires_at > GETDATE()";

        try (Connection connection = new DBContext().getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, tokenHash);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    PasswordResetToken token = new PasswordResetToken();

                    token.setResetId(rs.getInt("reset_id"));
                    token.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
                    token.setTokenHash(rs.getString("token_hash"));
                    token.setExpiresAt(rs.getTimestamp("expires_at"));
                    token.setUsedAt(rs.getTimestamp("used_at"));
                    token.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                    return token;
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    
    public boolean markAsUsed(int resetId) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "UPDATE PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN "
                + "SET used_at = GETDATE() "
                + "WHERE reset_id = ? "
                + "AND used_at IS NULL";

        try (Connection connection = new DBContext().getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, resetId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        }
    }

   
    public void invalidateOldTokens(int userId) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "UPDATE PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN "
                + "SET used_at = GETDATE() "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "AND used_at IS NULL";

        try (Connection connection = new DBContext().getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }
}package dao;

import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import db.DBContext;
import payment.PaymentGateway;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

public class PaymentDAO {

    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public PaymentDAO() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public PaymentDAO(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    private Connection open() throws SQLException {
        Connection connection = connections.open();

        if (connection == null) {
            throw new SQLException(
                    "Không kết nối được database."
            );
        }

        return connection;
    }

    public static final class Attempt {

        public final String ref;
        public final String method;
        public final String url;
        public final BigDecimal amount;
        public final long seconds;

        public Attempt(
                String ref,
                String method,
                String url,
                BigDecimal amount,
                long seconds
        ) {
            this.ref = ref;
            this.method = method;
            this.url = url;
            this.amount = amount;
            this.seconds = seconds;
        }
    }

    private static final class LockedOrder {

        int id;
        int owner;
        String status;
        String method;
        String payment;
        BigDecimal amount;
        long seconds;
        boolean restored;
    }

    private LockedOrder lock(
            Connection connection,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql
                = "SELECT *, "
                + "DATEDIFF_BIG(SECOND, SYSUTCDATETIME(), "
                + "payment_expires_at) AS seconds_left "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE order_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                LockedOrder order = new LockedOrder();

                order.id = orderId;
                order.owner = rs.getInt("user_id");
                order.status = rs.getString("order_status");
                order.method = rs.getString("payment_method");
                order.payment = rs.getString("payment_status");
                order.amount = rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount");
                order.seconds = rs.getLong("seconds_left");
                order.restored
                        = rs.getTimestamp("stock_restored_at") != null;

                return order;
            }
        }
    }

    private static int update(
            Connection connection,
            String sql,
            Object... values
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
                ps.setObject(i + 1, values[i]);
            }

            return ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }

    private void history(
            Connection connection,
            int orderId,
            String status
    ) throws SQLException {

        update(
                connection,
                "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY "
                + "(order_id, status) VALUES (?, ?)",
                orderId,
                status
        );
    }

    private static void rollback(
            Connection connection,
            Exception original
    ) {
        try {
            connection.rollback();
        } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
            original.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
        }
    }

    private boolean expire(
            Connection connection,
            LockedOrder order
    ) throws SQLException {

        if (!"PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                || order.seconds > 0
                || "PAID".equals(order.payment)) {
            return false;
        }

        cancel(connection, order, false);
        return true;
    }

    private void cancel(
            Connection connection,
            LockedOrder order,
            boolean customerInitiated
    ) throws SQLException {

        // Customer cancellation is recorded by OrderPolicyDAO afterward.
        // System expiration is marked immediately.
        update(
                connection,
                "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] SET "
                + "order_status = 'CANCELLED', "
                + "cancellation_source = CASE "
                + "WHEN ? = 1 THEN NULL ELSE 'SYSTEM' END, "
                + "cancelled_at = CASE "
                + "WHEN ? = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SYSUTCDATETIME() END, "
                + "payment_status = 'UNPAID', "
                + "payment_expires_at = NULL "
                + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                customerInitiated ? 1 : 0,
                customerInitiated ? 1 : 0,
                order.id
        );

        update(
                connection,
                "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                + "SET status = ? "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING'",
                customerInitiated ? "CANCELLED" : "EXPIRED",
                order.id
        );

        history(connection, order.id, "CANCELLED");

        order.status = "CANCELLED";
    }

    public Attempt begin(
            int userId,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                if (order.owner != userId) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                if (expire(connection, order)) {
                    connection.commit();

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Đơn đã hết 15 phút thanh toán "
                            + "và được hủy."
                    );
                }

                if (!"PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                        || "PAID".equals(order.payment)
                        || order.restored) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Đơn không còn chờ thanh toán."
                    );
                }

                PaymentGateway.requireConfigured(order.method);

                String sql
                        = "SELECT TOP 1 transaction_code, pay_url, "
                        + "DATEDIFF(SECOND, created_at, "
                        + "SYSUTCDATETIME()) AS age "
                        + "FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                        + "AND payment_method = ? "
                        + "AND status = 'PENDING' "
                        + "ORDER BY transaction_id DESC";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setString(2, order.method);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (rs.next()) {
                            String url = rs.getString("pay_url");

                            if (url != null) {
                                Attempt attempt = new Attempt(
                                        rs.getString("transaction_code"),
                                        order.method,
                                        url,
                                        order.amount,
                                        order.seconds
                                );

                                connection.commit();
                                return attempt;
                            }

                            if (rs.getInt("age") < 30) {
                                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Đang tạo thanh toán. "
                                        + "Chờ vài giây rồi thử lại."
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                update(
                        connection,
                        "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "SET status = 'EXPIRED' "
                        + "WHERE order_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING'",
                        orderId
                );

                String ref = "OECS"
                        + orderId
                        + UUID.randomUUID()
                                .toString()
                                .replace("-", "");

                update(
                        connection,
                        "INSERT INTO dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "(order_id, payment_method, amount, "
                        + "transaction_code) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        orderId,
                        order.method,
                        order.amount,
                        ref
                );

                connection.commit();

                return new Attempt(
                        ref,
                        order.method,
                        null,
                        order.amount,
                        order.seconds
                );

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public void saveUrl(
            String ref,
            String url
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            update(
                    connection,
                    "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                    + "SET pay_url = ? "
                    + "WHERE transaction_code = ? "
                    + "AND status = 'PENDING'",
                    url,
                    ref
            );
        }
    }

    public void changeOrCancel(
            int userId,
            int orderId,
            boolean toCod
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                OrderPolicyDAO policy = new OrderPolicyDAO();
                policy.lockCustomer(connection, userId);
                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                if (order.owner != userId) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                if (expire(connection, order)) {
                    connection.commit();
                    return;
                }

                if (toCod
                        && "COD".equals(order.method)
                        && "PENDING_CONFIRMATION".equals(order.status)) {

                    connection.commit();
                    return;
                }

                if (!toCod && "CANCELLED".equals(order.status)) {
                    connection.commit();
                    return;
                }

                if (!"PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                        || "PAID".equals(order.payment)
                        || order.restored) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Đơn không còn chờ thanh toán. "
                            + "Hãy tải lại trang."
                    );
                }

                if (toCod) {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                            + "SET payment_method = 'COD', "
                            + "payment_expires_at = NULL, "
                            + "order_status = 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION', "
                            + "payment_status = 'UNPAID' "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                            orderId
                    );

                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                            + "SET status = 'CANCELLED' "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                            + "AND status = 'PENDING'",
                            orderId
                    );

                    history(
                            connection,
                            orderId,
                            "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                    );

                } else {
                    cancel(connection, order, true);
                    policy.recordCancellation(connection, userId, orderId);
                }

                connection.commit();

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public String settle(
            String method,
            String ref,
            BigDecimal amount,
            String providerId,
            String code,
            boolean success
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                int orderId;

                String sql
                        = "SELECT order_id "
                        + "FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "WHERE transaction_code = ? "
                        + "AND payment_method = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setString(1, ref);
                    ps.setString(2, method);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            connection.rollback();
                            return "01";
                        }

                        orderId = rs.getInt("order_id");
                    }
                }

                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                long transactionId;
                String transactionStatus;
                BigDecimal expectedAmount;

                sql
                        = "SELECT transaction_id, status, amount "
                        + "FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE transaction_code = ? "
                        + "AND payment_method = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setString(1, ref);
                    ps.setString(2, method);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không tìm thấy giao dịch."
                            );
                        }

                        transactionId = rs.getLong("transaction_id");
                        transactionStatus = rs.getString("status");
                        expectedAmount = rs.getBigDecimal("amount");
                    }
                }

                if (expectedAmount.compareTo(amount) != 0
                        || order.amount.compareTo(amount) != 0) {

                    connection.rollback();
                    return "04";
                }

                if ("SUCCESS".equals(transactionStatus)) {
                    connection.commit();
                    return "02";
                }

                if (success
                        && (providerId == null
                        || providerId.isEmpty()
                        || "0".equals(providerId))) {

                    connection.rollback();
                    return "99";
                }

                expire(connection, order);

                if (!success) {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                            + "SET status = 'FAILED', "
                            + "provider_response_code = ?, "
                            + "completed_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                            + "WHERE transaction_id = ? "
                            + "AND status <> 'SUCCESS'",
                            code,
                            transactionId
                    );

                    connection.commit();
                    return "00";
                }

                update(
                        connection,
                        "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "SET status = 'SUCCESS', "
                        + "provider_transaction_id = ?, "
                        + "provider_response_code = ?, "
                        + "completed_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                        + "WHERE transaction_id = ?",
                        providerId,
                        code,
                        transactionId
                );

                boolean canConfirm
                        = "PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                        && !"PAID".equals(order.payment)
                        && !order.restored
                        && method.equals(order.method)
                        && order.seconds > 0;

                if (canConfirm) {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                            + "SET payment_status = 'PAID', "
                            + "order_status = 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION', "
                            + "payment_expires_at = NULL "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                            orderId
                    );

                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                            + "SET status = 'CANCELLED' "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                            + "AND transaction_id <> ? "
                            + "AND status = 'PENDING'",
                            orderId,
                            transactionId
                    );

                    history(
                            connection,
                            orderId,
                            "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                    );

                } else {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "INSERT INTO dbo.PAYMENT_REFUND "
                            + "(transaction_id, refund_amount, reason) "
                            + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                            transactionId,
                            amount,
                            "Thanh toán về trễ, đổi COD hoặc "
                            + "thanh toán trùng; cần đối soát "
                            + "và hoàn tiền."
                    );

                    if ("CANCELLED".equals(order.status)) {
                        update(
                                connection,
                                "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                                + "SET payment_status = 'REFUND_PENDING' "
                                + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                                orderId
                        );
                    }
                }

                connection.commit();
                return "00";

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public void expireOrder(
            int userId,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                if (order.owner != userId) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                expire(connection, order);
                connection.commit();

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public void expireBatch() throws SQLException {
        List<int[]> orders = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT TOP 200 order_id, user_id "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE order_status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' "
                + "AND payment_expires_at <= SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                + "ORDER BY order_id";

        try (
                Connection connection = open(); PreparedStatement ps
                = connection.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
            while (rs.next()) {
                orders.add(new int[]{
                    rs.getInt("order_id"),
                    rs.getInt("user_id")
                });
            }
        }

        for (int[] order : orders) {
            expireOrder(order[1], order[0]);
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import db.DBContext;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class PaymentRefundDAO {
    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public PaymentRefundDAO() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public PaymentRefundDAO(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> findForCustomer(int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {
        return find("WHERE t.order_id = ? AND o.user_id = ? ORDER BY r.refund_id DESC", orderId, userId);
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> findPage(int page) throws SQLException {
        return find("ORDER BY r.requested_at DESC, r.refund_id DESC OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT 50 ROWS ONLY",
                (page - 1) * 50);
    }

    private List<Map<String, Object>> find(String suffix, int... parameters) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT r.*, t.order_id, t.transaction_code, t.payment_method, "
                + "t.provider_transaction_id FROM dbo.PAYMENT_REFUND r "
                + "JOIN dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION t ON t.transaction_id = r.transaction_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = t.order_id " + suffix;
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection c = connections.open(); PreparedStatement ps = c.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            for (int i = 0; i < parameters.length; i++) {
                ps.setInt(i + 1, parameters[i]);
            }
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    row.put("id", rs.getLong("refund_id"));
                    row.put("orderId", rs.getInt("order_id"));
                    row.put("transactionCode", rs.getString("transaction_code"));
                    row.put("providerTransactionId", rs.getString("provider_transaction_id"));
                    row.put("method", rs.getString("payment_method"));
                    row.put("amount", rs.getBigDecimal("refund_amount"));
                    row.put("status", rs.getString("refund_status"));
                    row.put("statusLabel", statusLabel(rs.getString("refund_status")));
                    row.put("reference", rs.getString("provider_refund_id"));
                    row.put("reason", rs.getString("reason"));
                    row.put("requestedAt", rs.getTimestamp("requested_at"));
                    row.put("completedAt", rs.getTimestamp("completed_at"));
                    rows.add(row);
                }
            }
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private static String statusLabel(String status) {
        switch (status) {
            case "PENDING": return "Chờ đối soát";
            case "PROCESSING": return "Đang xử lý";
            case "SUCCESS": return "Đã hoàn tiền";
            case "FAILED": return "Hoàn tiền chưa thành công";
            default: return status;
        }
    }

    public void updateStatus(long refundId, String expectedStatus, String nextStatus,
            String reference, int staffId) throws SQLException {
        boolean start = ("PENDING".equals(expectedStatus) || "FAILED".equals(expectedStatus))
                && "PROCESSING".equals(nextStatus);
        boolean finish = "PROCESSING".equals(expectedStatus)
                && ("SUCCESS".equals(nextStatus) || "FAILED".equals(nextStatus));
        if (refundId <= 0 || staffId <= 0 || (!start && !finish)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Chuyển trạng thái hoàn tiền không hợp lệ.");
        }
        String trimmed = reference == null ? "" : reference.trim();
        if (trimmed.length() > 150 || ("SUCCESS".equals(nextStatus) && trimmed.isEmpty())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cần mã tham chiếu hoàn tiền thực tế, tối đa 150 ký tự.");
        }
        String sql = "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_REFUND SET refund_status = ?, "
                + "provider_refund_id = CASE WHEN ? = 'SUCCESS' THEN ? ELSE provider_refund_id END, "
                + "completed_at = CASE WHEN ? = 'SUCCESS' THEN SYSUTCDATETIME() ELSE NULL END, "
                + "processed_by = ?, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                + "WHERE refund_id = ? AND refund_status = ?";
        try (Connection c = connections.open()) {
            c.setAutoCommit(false);
            try {
                int orderId;
                try (PreparedStatement lookup = c.prepareStatement("SELECT t.order_id FROM dbo.PAYMENT_REFUND r "
                        + "JOIN dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION t ON t.transaction_id=r.transaction_id WHERE r.refund_id=?")) {
                    lookup.setLong(1, refundId);
                    try (ResultSet rs = lookup.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Không tìm thấy yêu cầu hoàn tiền.");
                        orderId = rs.getInt(1);
                    }
                }
                // Match payment and cancellation lock ordering: order before refund.
                try (PreparedStatement lock = c.prepareStatement("SELECT order_id FROM dbo.[ORDER] WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE order_id=?")) {
                    lock.setInt(1, orderId);
                    try (ResultSet rs = lock.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Không tìm thấy đơn hàng.");
                    }
                }
                try (PreparedStatement ps = c.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                ps.setString(1, nextStatus);
                ps.setString(2, nextStatus);
                ps.setString(3, trimmed);
                ps.setString(4, nextStatus);
                ps.setInt(5, staffId);
                ps.setLong(6, refundId);
                ps.setString(7, expectedStatus);
                if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Yêu cầu đã được cập nhật. Hãy tải lại trang.");
                }
                }
                if ("SUCCESS".equals(nextStatus)) {
                    try (PreparedStatement done = c.prepareStatement("UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] SET payment_status='REFUNDED' "
                            + "WHERE order_id=? AND order_status='CANCELLED' AND payment_status='REFUND_PENDING' "
                            + "AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PAYMENT_REFUND r JOIN dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION t "
                            + "ON t.transaction_id=r.transaction_id WHERE t.order_id=? AND r.refund_status<>'SUCCESS')")) {
                        done.setInt(1, orderId);
                        done.setInt(2, orderId);
                        done.executeUpdate();
                    }
                }
                c.commit();
                } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                try { c.rollback(); } catch (SQLException rollback) { e.addSuppressed(rollback); }
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Attribute;
import model.Brand;
import model.Category;
import model.Product;
import model.ProductImage;
import model.ProductSpec;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.sql.Types;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class ProductDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(ProductDAO.class.getName());

    // ========================================
    // SQL DÙNG CHUNG KHI ĐỌC PRODUCT
    // ========================================
    private static final String PRODUCT_SELECT
            = "SELECT "
            + "p.product_id, "
            + "p.category_id, "
            + "p.brand_id, "
            + "p.product_name, "
            + "p.description, "
            + "p.image_url, "
            + "p.created_at, "
            + "p.model_code, "
            + "p.is_active AS product_active, "
            + "p.updated_at, "
            + "c.category_name, "
            + "c.parent_id, "
            + "c.description AS category_description, "
            + "c.is_active AS category_active, "
            + "b.brand_name, "
            + "b.logo_url, "
            + "b.is_active AS brand_active, "
            + "(SELECT MIN(s.price) "
            + " FROM PRODUCT_SKU s "
            + " WHERE s.product_id = p.product_id "
            + " AND s.is_active = 1) AS min_price "
            + "FROM PRODUCT p "
            + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c "
            + "ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
            + "INNER JOIN BRAND b "
            + "ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id ";

    // ========================================
    // MAP PRODUCT
    // ========================================
    private Product mapProduct(ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        Integer parentId = (Integer) rs.getObject("parent_id");

        Category category = new Category(
                rs.getInt("category_id"),
                rs.getString("category_name"),
                parentId,
                rs.getString("category_description"),
                rs.getBoolean("category_active")
        );

        Brand brand = new Brand(
                rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                rs.getString("brand_name"),
                rs.getString("logo_url"),
                rs.getBoolean("brand_active")
        );

        Product product = new Product(
                rs.getInt("product_id"),
                rs.getInt("category_id"),
                rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                rs.getString("product_name"),
                rs.getString("description"),
                rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                rs.getString("image_url"),
                category,
                brand
        );

        product.setModelCode(rs.getString("model_code"));
        product.setActive(rs.getBoolean("product_active"));
        product.setUpdatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("updated_at"));

        double minPrice = rs.getDouble("min_price");

        if (!rs.wasNull()) {
            product.setMinPrice(minPrice);
        }

        return product;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 1. LẤY DANH SÁCH SẢN PHẨM
    // ========================================
    public List<Product> getList() {

        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();

        // Giữ tất cả trạng thái để trang admin
        // vẫn quản lý được sản phẩm đã ngừng bán.
        String sql = PRODUCT_SELECT
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapProduct(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Loi truy van danh sach san pham!",
                    ex
            );

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Khong the tai danh sach san pham tu database.",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 2. LẤY SẢN PHẨM ĐANG HOẠT ĐỘNG
    // ========================================
    public List<Product> getActiveProducts() {

        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = PRODUCT_SELECT
                + "WHERE p.is_active = 1 "
                + "AND c.is_active = 1 "
                + "AND b.is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapProduct(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Loi truy van danh sach san pham dang ban!",
                    ex
            );

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Khong the tai san pham dang ban tu database.",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 3. LẤY PRODUCT THEO ID
    // ========================================
    public Product getById(int id) {

        String sql = PRODUCT_SELECT
                + "WHERE p.product_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, id);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return mapProduct(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy Product theo ID!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 4. THÊM PRODUCT, TRẢ VỀ ID
    // ========================================
    public int insertReturnId(Product product) {

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT "
                + "(product_name, description, "
                + "category_id, brand_id, image_url, "
                + "model_code, is_active) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                sql,
                Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS
        )) {

            ps.setNString(1, product.getProductName());
            ps.setNString(2, product.getDescription());
            ps.setInt(3, product.getCategoryId());
            ps.setInt(4, product.getBrandId());
            ps.setString(5, product.getImageUrl());
            ps.setString(6, product.getModelCode());
            ps.setBoolean(7, product.isActive());

            if (ps.executeUpdate() > 0) {

                try (ResultSet rs = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {

                    if (rs.next()) {
                        return rs.getInt(1);
                    }
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi thêm Product!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 5. CẬP NHẬT PRODUCT
    // ========================================
    public int update(Product product) {

        String sql
                = "UPDATE PRODUCT SET "
                + "product_name = ?, "
                + "description = ?, "
                + "category_id = ?, "
                + "brand_id = ?, "
                + "image_url = COALESCE(?, image_url), "
                + "model_code = COALESCE(?, model_code), "
                + "updated_at = GETDATE() "
                + "WHERE product_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, product.getProductName());
            ps.setNString(2, product.getDescription());
            ps.setInt(3, product.getCategoryId());
            ps.setInt(4, product.getBrandId());
            ps.setString(5, product.getImageUrl());
            ps.setString(6, product.getModelCode());
            ps.setInt(7, product.getProductId());

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi cập nhật Product!",
                    ex
            );
            return 0;
        }
    }

    // ========================================
    // 6. XÓA MỀM PRODUCT
    // ========================================
    public int delete(int productId) {

        // Không xóa vật lý vì sản phẩm có thể
        // đã xuất hiện trong CART hoặc ORDER.
        return setProductActive(productId, false);
    }

    // ========================================
    // 7. BẬT / TẮT TRẠNG THÁI PRODUCT
    // ========================================
    public int setProductActive(int productId, boolean active) {

        String sql
                = "UPDATE PRODUCT "
                + "SET is_active = ?, "
                + "updated_at = GETDATE() "
                + "WHERE product_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, active);
            ps.setInt(2, productId);

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi cập nhật trạng thái Product!",
                    ex
            );

            return 0;
        }
    }

    // ========================================
    // 8. TÌM KIẾM PRODUCT
    // ========================================
    public List<Product> searchProducts(String keyword) {

        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = PRODUCT_SELECT
                + "WHERE ("
                + "p.product_name LIKE ? "
                + "OR p.model_code LIKE ? "
                + "OR c.category_name LIKE ? "
                + "OR b.brand_name LIKE ?"
                + ") "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        String searchPattern
                = "%" + (keyword == null ? "" : keyword.trim()) + "%";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, searchPattern);
            ps.setNString(2, searchPattern);
            ps.setNString(3, searchPattern);
            ps.setNString(4, searchPattern);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapProduct(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi tìm kiếm Product!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 11. THÊM ẢNH GALLERY CHUNG
    // ========================================
    public void insertGalleryImages(
            int productId,
            List<String> imageUrls) {

        if (imageUrls == null || imageUrls.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                + "(product_id, sku_id, image_url, "
                + "is_primary, display_order) "
                + "SELECT ?, NULL, ?, 0, ? "
                + "WHERE NOT EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                + "WHERE product_id = ? "
                + "AND sku_id IS NULL "
                + "AND image_url = ?"
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            int order = 0;

            for (String url : imageUrls) {

                if (url == null || url.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    continue;
                }

                String cleanUrl = url.trim();

                ps.setInt(1, productId);
                ps.setString(2, cleanUrl);
                ps.setInt(3, order++);
                ps.setInt(4, productId);
                ps.setString(5, cleanUrl);

                ps.addBatch();
            }

            ps.executeBatch();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lưu ảnh Gallery!",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    // ========================================
    // 12. LẤY TOÀN BỘ ẢNH CỦA PRODUCT
    // ========================================
    public List<ProductImage> getProductImages(int productId) {

        List<ProductImage> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT image_id, product_id, sku_id, "
                + "image_url, is_primary, display_order, "
                + "alt_text, created_at "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                + "WHERE product_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY "
                + "CASE WHEN sku_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, "
                + "sku_id, display_order, image_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    Integer skuId
                            = (Integer) rs.getObject("sku_id");

                    ProductImage image = new ProductImage(
                            rs.getInt("image_id"),
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            skuId,
                            rs.getString("image_url"),
                            rs.getBoolean("is_primary"),
                            rs.getInt("display_order"),
                            rs.getString("alt_text"),
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at")
                    );

                    list.add(image);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy ảnh Product!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 14. LẤY TOÀN BỘ ATTRIBUTE
    // ========================================
    public List<Attribute> getAllAttributes() {

        List<Attribute> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT attribute_id, attribute_name, "
                + "data_type, unit, is_active "
                + "FROM ATTRIBUTE "
                + "ORDER BY attribute_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                Attribute attribute = new Attribute(
                        rs.getInt("attribute_id"),
                        rs.getString("attribute_name"),
                        rs.getString("data_type"),
                        rs.getString("unit"),
                        rs.getBoolean("is_active")
                );

                list.add(attribute);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy danh sách Attribute!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 15. LƯU THÔNG SỐ KỸ THUẬT PRODUCT
    // ========================================
    public void saveProductSpecs(
            int productId,
            String[] attributeIds,
            String[] specValues) {

        /*
         * Giữ chữ ký phương thức cũ.
         *
         * Tạo danh sách duy nhất theo attributeId.
         * Sau đó xóa dữ liệu cũ và lưu dữ liệu mới
         * trong cùng một transaction.
         */
        Map<Integer, String> uniqueSpecs
                = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        if (attributeIds != null && specValues != null) {

            int len = Math.min(
                    attributeIds.length,
                    specValues.length
            );

            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {

                String attributeId = attributeIds[i];
                String value = specValues[i];

                if (attributeId == null
                        || attributeId.trim().isEmpty()
                        || value == null
                        || value.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    continue;
                }

                try {
                    int id = Integer.parseInt(
                            attributeId.trim()
                    );

                    if (id > 0) {
                        uniqueSpecs.put(id, value.trim());
                    }

                } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
                    LOGGER.log(
                            Level.WARNING,
                            "Attribute ID không hợp lệ: "
                            + attributeId,
                            ex
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        String sqlDelete
                = "DELETE FROM PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION "
                + "WHERE product_id = ?";

        String sqlInsert
                = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION "
                + "(product_id, attribute_id, value) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection()) {

            boolean originalAutoCommit
                    = conn.getAutoCommit();

            try {
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);

                try (PreparedStatement psDel
                        = conn.prepareStatement(sqlDelete)) {

                    psDel.setInt(1, productId);
                    psDel.executeUpdate();
                }

                if (!uniqueSpecs.isEmpty()) {

                    try (PreparedStatement psIns
                            = conn.prepareStatement(sqlInsert)) {

                        for (Map.Entry<Integer, String> entry
                                : uniqueSpecs.entrySet()) {

                            psIns.setInt(1, productId);
                            psIns.setInt(2, entry.getKey());
                            psIns.setNString(3, entry.getValue());

                            psIns.addBatch();
                        }

                        psIns.executeBatch();
                    }
                }

                conn.commit();

            } catch (SQLException ex) {

                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackEx) {
                    ex.addSuppressed(rollbackEx);
                }

                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Lỗi lưu thông số kỹ thuật!",
                        ex
                );

            } finally {
                try {
                    conn.setAutoCommit(originalAutoCommit);
                } catch (SQLException ex) {
                    LOGGER.log(
                            Level.WARNING,
                            "Không khôi phục được autoCommit!",
                            ex
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi kết nối khi lưu thông số!",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    // ========================================
    // 16. LẤY THÔNG SỐ CHO ADMIN
    // ========================================
    public List<ProductSpec> getProductSpecsForAdmin(
            int productId) {

        List<ProductSpec> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "ps.product_id, "
                + "ps.attribute_id, "
                + "ps.value, "
                + "ps.numeric_value, "
                + "ps.boolean_value, "
                + "a.attribute_name, "
                + "a.unit, "
                + "ca.group_name, "
                + "ca.display_order "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION ps "
                + "INNER JOIN PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.product_id = ps.product_id "
                + "INNER JOIN ATTRIBUTE a "
                + "ON a.attribute_id = ps.attribute_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE ca "
                + "ON ca.category_id = p.category_id "
                + "AND ca.attribute_id = ps.attribute_id "
                + "WHERE ps.product_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY ca.display_order, "
                + "ps.attribute_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    ProductSpec spec = new ProductSpec();

                    spec.setProductId(
                            rs.getInt("product_id")
                    );

                    spec.setAttributeId(
                            rs.getInt("attribute_id")
                    );

                    spec.setAttributeName(
                            rs.getString("attribute_name")
                    );

                    spec.setValue(
                            rs.getString("value")
                    );

                    spec.setNumericValue(
                            rs.getBigDecimal("numeric_value")
                    );

                    Object booleanObject
                            = rs.getObject("boolean_value");

                    spec.setBooleanValue(
                            booleanObject == null
                                    ? null
                                    : rs.getBoolean("boolean_value")
                    );

                    spec.setGroupName(
                            rs.getString("group_name")
                    );

                    spec.setUnit(
                            rs.getString("unit")
                    );

                    spec.setDisplayOrder(
                            rs.getInt("display_order")
                    );

                    list.add(spec);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy thông số Product!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }
}

package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.ProductReview;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

public class ProductReviewDAO {

    public static final int SAVE_FAILED = -1;
    public static final int ALREADY_REVIEWED = -2;
    public static final int RATE_LIMIT_REACHED = -3;
    public static final int NOT_ELIGIBLE = -4;

    // Mỗi thao tác mở một kết nối riêng.
    private Connection getConnection() throws SQLException {
        Connection conn = new DBContext().getConnection();

        if (conn == null) {
            throw new SQLException("Cannot connect to OECS database");
        }

        return conn;
    }

    public int getSkuIdByOrderItemId(int orderItemId) {
        String sql = "SELECT sku_id FROM ORDER_ITEM "
                + "WHERE order_item_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("sku_id");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public boolean canReview(int userId, int orderItemId, int skuId) {
        String sql =
                "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "WHERE oi.order_item_id = ? "
                + "AND oi.sku_id = ? "
                + "AND o.user_id = ? "
                + "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.order_status))) "
                + "IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELIVERED') "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ( "
                + "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "WHERE pr.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id "
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);
            ps.setInt(3, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            java.util.logging.Logger
                    .getLogger(ProductReviewDAO.class.getName())
                    .log(
                            java.util.logging.Level.SEVERE,
                            "Lỗi kiểm tra quyền đánh giá", e);
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean alreadyReviewed(int orderItemId) {
        String sql = "SELECT review_id FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE order_item_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    // Kiểm tra điều kiện, chống trùng và giới hạn 10 review trong 10 phút.
    // Tất cả được xử lý cùng một transaction.
    public int insertReview(ProductReview review) {

        if (review == null
                || review.getUserId() <= 0
                || review.getOrderItemId() <= 0
                || review.getSkuId() <= 0
                || review.getRating() < 1
                || review.getRating() > 5
                || (review.getComment() != null
                    && review.getComment().length() > 2000)) {
            return NOT_ELIGIBLE;
        }

        String lockUserSql =
                "SELECT user_id FROM dbo.[USER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE user_id = ?";

        String eligibleSql =
                "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id "
                + "WHERE oi.order_item_id = ? "
                + "AND oi.sku_id = ? "
                + "AND o.user_id = ? "
                + "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.order_status))) "
                + "IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELIVERED')";

        String existingSql =
                "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE order_item_id = ?";

        String countSql =
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "AND created_at >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -10, GETDATE())";

        String insertSql =
                "INSERT INTO dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "(user_id, order_item_id, sku_id, rating, comment, created_at) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, GETDATE())";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                // Khóa user đến khi commit.
                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(lockUserSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, review.getUserId());

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return NOT_ELIGIBLE;
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Đơn hàng phải thuộc khách và đã hoàn tất.
                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(eligibleSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, review.getOrderItemId());
                    ps.setInt(2, review.getSkuId());
                    ps.setInt(3, review.getUserId());

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return NOT_ELIGIBLE;
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Review ẩn vẫn được tính là đã đánh giá.
                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(existingSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, review.getOrderItemId());

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return ALREADY_REVIEWED;
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Đếm lại số review gần đây ngay trước INSERT.
                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(countSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, review.getUserId());

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        rs.next();

                        if (rs.getInt(1) >= 10) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return RATE_LIMIT_REACHED;
                        }
                    }
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(
                                insertSql,
                                Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, review.getUserId());
                    ps.setInt(2, review.getOrderItemId());
                    ps.setInt(3, review.getSkuId());
                    ps.setInt(4, review.getRating());
                    ps.setString(5, review.getComment());

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        return SAVE_FAILED;
                    }

                    try (ResultSet keys = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                        if (!keys.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return SAVE_FAILED;
                        }

                        int reviewId = keys.getInt(1);
                        conn.commit();
                        return reviewId;
                    }
                }

            } catch (SQLException e) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
                    e.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
                }

                throw e;
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            java.util.logging.Logger
                    .getLogger(ProductReviewDAO.class.getName())
                    .log(
                            java.util.logging.Level.SEVERE,
                            "Atomic review insert failed", e);

            return SAVE_FAILED;
        }
    }

        } catch (SQLException e) {

        }
