    public Product getProductDetail(int productId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "p.product_id, "
                + "p.product_name, "
                + "p.description, "
                + "p.created_at, "
                + "p.image_url, "
                + "p.model_code, "
                + "c.category_id, "
                + "c.category_name, "
                + "b.brand_id, "
                + "b.brand_name "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c "
                + "ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b "
                + "ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "WHERE p.product_id = ? "
                + "AND p.is_active = 1";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    Product product = mapProduct(rs);

                    product.setModelCode(
                            rs.getString("model_code")
                    );

                    return product;
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy chi tiết sản phẩm",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 3. LẤY SKU ĐANG KINH DOANH
    // ========================================
    public List<ProductSku> getProductSkus(
            int productId) {

        List<ProductSku> skus = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "sku_id, "
                + "product_id, "
                + "sku_code, "
                + "price, "
                + "original_price, "
                + "stock_quantity, "
                + "is_active "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "WHERE product_id = ? "
                + "AND is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY price ASC, sku_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            Map<Integer, ProductSku> skuMap
                    = new LinkedHashMap<>();

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    ProductSku sku = new ProductSku(
                            rs.getInt("sku_id"),
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getString("sku_code"),
                            rs.getDouble("price"),
                            rs.getInt("stock_quantity")
                    );

                    BigDecimal originalPrice
                            = rs.getBigDecimal("original_price");

                    if (originalPrice != null) {

                        sku.setOriginalPrice(
                                originalPrice.doubleValue()
                        );
                    }

                    sku.setActive(
                            rs.getBoolean("is_active")
                    );

                    skus.add(sku);

                    skuMap.put(
                            sku.getSkuId(),
                            sku
                    );
                }
            }

            if (!skuMap.isEmpty()) {

                loadSkuAttributeValues(
                        conn,
                        productId,
                        skuMap
                );
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy danh sách SKU",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return skus;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 4. LẤY BIẾN THỂ CỦA SKU
    // ========================================
    private void loadSkuAttributeValues(
            Connection conn,
            int productId,
            Map<Integer, ProductSku> skuMap)
            throws SQLException {

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "v.sku_id, "
                + "v.attribute_id, "
                + "a.attribute_name, "
                + "v.text_value, "
                + "v.numeric_value, "
                + "v.boolean_value "
                + "FROM SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE v "
                + "INNER JOIN PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "ON v.sku_id = s.sku_id "
                + "INNER JOIN ATTRIBUTE a "
                + "ON v.attribute_id = a.attribute_id "
                + "WHERE s.product_id = ? "
                + "AND s.is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY v.sku_id, v.attribute_id";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    int skuId = rs.getInt("sku_id");

                    ProductSku sku = skuMap.get(skuId);

                    if (sku == null) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    SkuAttributeValue value
                            = new SkuAttributeValue();

                    value.setAttributeId(
                            rs.getInt("attribute_id")
                    );

                    value.setAttributeName(
                            rs.getString("attribute_name")
                    );

                    value.setTextValue(
                            rs.getString("text_value")
                    );

                    value.setNumericValue(
                            rs.getBigDecimal("numeric_value")
                    );

                    boolean bit
                            = rs.getBoolean("boolean_value");

                    if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                        value.setBooleanValue(bit);
                    }

                    sku.getAttributeValues().add(value);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public List<ProductSpec> getProductSpecs(int productId) {

        List<ProductSpec> specs = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "ps.attribute_id, "
                + "a.attribute_name, "
                + "ps.value, "
                + "ca.group_name, "
                + "COALESCE(ca.display_order, 2147483647) AS display_order "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION ps "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.product_id = ps.product_id "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.ATTRIBUTE a "
                + "ON a.attribute_id = ps.attribute_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE ca "
                + "ON ca.category_id = p.category_id "
                + "AND ca.attribute_id = ps.attribute_id "
                + "WHERE ps.product_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY display_order ASC, ps.attribute_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    ProductSpec spec = new ProductSpec(
                            rs.getInt("attribute_id"),
                            rs.getString("attribute_name"),
                            rs.getString("value")
                    );

                    spec.setProductId(productId);
                    spec.setGroupName(
                            rs.getString("group_name")
                    );
                    spec.setDisplayOrder(
                            rs.getInt("display_order")
                    );

                    specs.add(spec);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Loi lay thong so ky thuat san pham",
                    ex
            );

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Khong the tai thong so ky thuat.",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return specs;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 6. GALLERY CHUNG CỦA SẢN PHẨM
    // ========================================
    public List<ProductImage> getProductImages(
            int productId) {

        List<ProductImage> images = new ArrayList<>();

        /*
         * Chỉ lấy ảnh chung của Product.
         *
         * Ảnh riêng của SKU được truy vấn
         * trong getSkuImagesByProduct().
         */
        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "image_id, "
                + "product_id, "
                + "image_url, "
                + "is_primary, "
                + "display_order, "
                + "alt_text "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                + "WHERE product_id = ? "
                + "AND sku_id IS NULL "
                + "ORDER BY is_primary DESC, "
                + "display_order ASC, "
                + "image_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    ProductImage image = new ProductImage(
                            rs.getInt("image_id"),
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getString("image_url")
                    );

                    image.setPrimary(
                            rs.getBoolean("is_primary")
                    );

                    image.setDisplayOrder(
                            rs.getInt("display_order")
                    );

                    image.setAltText(
                            rs.getString("alt_text")
                    );

                    images.add(image);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy gallery sản phẩm",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return images;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 7. GALLERY RIÊNG CỦA SKU
    // ========================================
    public Map<Integer, List<ProductImage>>
            getSkuImagesByProduct(int productId) {

        Map<Integer, List<ProductImage>> result
                = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        /*
         * Truy vấn một lần cho tất cả SKU.
         *
         * Key   = sku_id
         * Value = danh sách ảnh của SKU
         */
        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "pi.image_id, "
                + "pi.product_id, "
                + "pi.sku_id, "
                + "pi.image_url, "
                + "pi.is_primary, "
                + "pi.display_order, "
                + "pi.alt_text "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES pi "
                + "INNER JOIN PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "ON pi.sku_id = s.sku_id "
                + "WHERE pi.product_id = ? "
                + "AND s.product_id = ? "
                + "AND s.is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY pi.sku_id, "
                + "pi.is_primary DESC, "
                + "pi.display_order ASC, "
                + "pi.image_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);
            ps.setInt(2, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    int skuId = rs.getInt("sku_id");

                    ProductImage image = new ProductImage(
                            rs.getInt("image_id"),
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getString("image_url")
                    );

                    image.setSkuId(skuId);

                    image.setPrimary(
                            rs.getBoolean("is_primary")
                    );

                    image.setDisplayOrder(
                            rs.getInt("display_order")
                    );

                    image.setAltText(
                            rs.getString("alt_text")
                    );

                    result.computeIfAbsent(
                            skuId,
                            key -> new ArrayList<>()
                    ).add(image);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy ảnh riêng của SKU",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return result;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 8. CHUẨN HÓA TỪ KHÓA TÌM KIẾM
    // ========================================
    private String removeAccents(String text) {

        if (text == null) {
            return "";
        }

        return Normalizer.normalize(
                text,
                Normalizer.Form.NFD
        )
                .replaceAll(
                        "\\p{InCombiningDiacriticalMarks}+",
                        ""
                )
                .replace('đ', 'd')
                .replace('Đ', 'd')
                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
                .replaceAll("[^a-z0-9\\s]", " ")
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .trim();
    }

    private String normalizeUserQuery(
            String rawKeyword) {

        String keyword = removeAccents(rawKeyword);

        if (keyword.isEmpty()) {
            return "";
        }

        return keyword
                .replace(
                        "sac dien thoai",
                        "sac"
                )
                .replace(
                        "cap dien thoai",
                        "cap"
                )
                .replace(
                        "balo laptop",
                        "balo"
                )
                .replace(
                        "tui laptop",
                        "balo"
                )
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .trim();
    }

    // ========================================
    // 9. TỪ ĐỒNG NGHĨA DANH MỤC
    // ========================================
    private String getCategorySynonyms(
            String categoryName) {

        switch (categoryName) {

            case "smartphone":
            case "dien thoai":
                return "dien thoai smartphone "
                        + "di dong phone dt";

            case "dong ho thong minh":
                return "dong ho thong minh "
                        + "smartwatch watch";

            case "tai nghe":
                return "tai nghe headphone "
                        + "earphone airpods buds";

            case "sac dien thoai":
                return "sac cu sac adapter "
                        + "charger fast charger";

            case "cap sac":
                return "cap sac day sac "
                        + "day cap cable";

            case "laptop van phong":
                return "laptop may tinh "
                        + "xach tay van phong";

            case "laptop gaming":
                return "laptop may tinh "
                        + "xach tay gaming";

            case "balo laptop":
                return "balo tui chong soc backpack";

            case "chuot":
                return "chuot mouse";

            case "ban phim":
                return "ban phim keyboard";

            case "may anh":
            case "may anh mirrorless":
            case "may anh compact":
                return categoryName
                        + " may anh camera mirrorless compact";

            default:
                return categoryName;
        }
    }

    // ========================================
    // 10. CHẤM ĐIỂM KẾT QUẢ TÌM KIẾM
    // ========================================
    private int calculateMatchScore(
            Product product,
            String normalizedQuery) {

        if (normalizedQuery == null
                || normalizedQuery.isEmpty()) {

            return 0;
        }

        String[] queryWords
                = normalizedQuery.split(" ");

        String categoryName
                = product.getCategory() != null
                ? removeAccents(
                        product.getCategory().getCategoryName()
                )
                : "";

        String brandName
                = product.getBrand() != null
                ? removeAccents(
                        product.getBrand().getBrandName()
                )
                : "";

        String productName
                = removeAccents(
                        product.getProductName()
                );

        String cleanName
                = "balo laptop".equals(categoryName)
                ? productName
                        .replace("laptop", "")
                        .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                        .trim()
                : productName;

        String searchableText
                = (cleanName + " "
                        + getCategorySynonyms(categoryName)
                        + " "
                        + brandName).trim();

        String[] searchableTokens
                = searchableText.split(" ");

        String[] nameTokens
                = cleanName.split(" ");

        int score = 0;

        for (String word : queryWords) {

            boolean matched = false;

            for (String token : searchableTokens) {

                if (token.equals(word)) {

                    score += 30;
                    matched = true;
                    break;

                } else if (token.startsWith(word)) {

                    score += 20;
                    matched = true;
                    break;

                } else if (word.length() >= 3
                        && token.contains(word)) {

                    score += 10;
                    matched = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (!matched) {
                return 0;
            }

            for (String token : nameTokens) {

                if (token.startsWith(word)
                        || (word.length() >= 3
                        && token.contains(word))) {

                    score += 25;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if (cleanName.contains(normalizedQuery)) {
            score += 50;
        }

        if (!"sac dien thoai".equals(categoryName)
                && !"cap sac".equals(categoryName)
                && !"balo laptop".equals(categoryName)) {

            score += 15;
        }

        return score;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 11. SEARCH GỢI Ý
    // ========================================
    public List<Product> searchProducts(
            String keyword) {

        if (keyword == null
                || keyword.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return new ArrayList<>();
        }

        List<Product> matched
                = getFilteredCatalog(
                        keyword,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null
                );

        if (matched.size() <= 5) {
            return matched;
        }

        return new ArrayList<>(
                matched.subList(0, 5)
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 12. LỌC CATALOG
    // ========================================
    public List<Product> getFilteredCatalog(
            String keyword,
            String[] categoryIds,
            String priceRange,
            String minRating,
            String sort) {

        List<Product> products = new ArrayList<>();

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "SELECT "
                + "p.product_id, "
                + "p.product_name, "
                + "p.description, "
                + "p.created_at, "
                + "p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, "
                + "c.category_name, "
                + "b.brand_id, "
                + "b.brand_name, "
                + "ISNULL(mp.min_price, 0) AS min_price, "
                + "ISNULL(rv.avg_rating, 0) AS avg_rating, "
                + "ISNULL(rv.review_count, 0) AS review_count "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c "
                + "ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b "
                + "ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN ( "
                + "    SELECT product_id, "
                + "           MIN(price) AS min_price "
                + "    FROM PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "    WHERE is_active = 1 "
                + "    GROUP BY product_id "
                + ") mp "
                + "ON p.product_id = mp.product_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN ( "
                + "    SELECT s.product_id, "
                + "           AVG(CAST(r.rating AS FLOAT)) "
                + "               AS avg_rating, "
                + "           COUNT(r.review_id) "
                + "               AS review_count "
                + "    FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS r "
                + "    INNER JOIN PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "    ON r.sku_id = s.sku_id "
                + "    WHERE r.is_hidden = 0 "
                + "    GROUP BY s.product_id "
                + ") rv "
                + "ON p.product_id = rv.product_id "
                + "WHERE p.is_active = 1 "
        );

        List<Integer> parameters = new ArrayList<>();

        // ====================================
        // 12.1. LỌC DANH MỤC
        // ====================================
        List<Integer> validCategoryIds
                = new ArrayList<>();

        if (categoryIds != null) {

            for (String rawId : categoryIds) {

                try {

                    int id
                            = Integer.parseInt(
                                    rawId.trim()
                            );

                    if (id > 0
                            && !validCategoryIds.contains(id)) {

                        validCategoryIds.add(id);
                    }

                } catch (NumberFormatException
                        | NullPointerException ex) {

                    // Bỏ qua ID không hợp lệ.
                }
            }
        }

        if (!validCategoryIds.isEmpty()) {

            StringBuilder placeholders
                    = new StringBuilder();

            for (int i = 0;
                    i < validCategoryIds.size(); i++) {

                if (i > 0) {
                    placeholders.append(", ");
                }

                placeholders.append("?");
            }

            /*
             * Lọc danh mục được chọn
             * và danh mục con trực tiếp.
             */
            sql.append(
                    "AND (c.category_id IN ("
            ).append(
                    placeholders
            ).append(
                    ") OR c.parent_id IN ("
            ).append(
                    placeholders
            ).append(
                    ")) "
            );

            parameters.addAll(validCategoryIds);
            parameters.addAll(validCategoryIds);
        }

        // ====================================
        // 12.2. LỌC THEO GIÁ
        // ====================================
        if ("under5".equals(priceRange)) {

            sql.append(
                    "AND mp.min_price > 0 "
                    + "AND mp.min_price < 5000000 "
            );

        } else if ("5to15".equals(priceRange)) {

            sql.append(
                    "AND mp.min_price BETWEEN "
                    + "5000000 AND 15000000 "
            );

        } else if ("over15".equals(priceRange)) {

            sql.append(
                    "AND mp.min_price > 15000000 "
            );
        }

        // ====================================
        // 12.3. LỌC THEO ĐÁNH GIÁ
        // ====================================
        if (minRating != null
                && !minRating.trim().isEmpty()) {

            try {

                int rating
                        = Integer.parseInt(
                                minRating.trim()
                        );

                if (rating >= 1 && rating <= 5) {

                    sql.append(
                            "AND rv.review_count > 0 "
                            + "AND FLOOR(rv.avg_rating) = ? "
                    );

                    parameters.add(rating);
                }

            } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {

                // Bỏ qua rating không hợp lệ.
            }
        }

        // ====================================
        // 12.4. SẮP XẾP
        // ====================================
        if ("priceAsc".equals(sort)) {

            sql.append(
                    "ORDER BY "
                    + "CASE WHEN mp.min_price IS NULL "
                    + "THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, "
                    + "mp.min_price ASC, "
                    + "p.product_id DESC"
            );

        } else if ("priceDesc".equals(sort)) {

            sql.append(
                    "ORDER BY "
                    + "CASE WHEN mp.min_price IS NULL "
                    + "THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, "
                    + "mp.min_price DESC, "
                    + "p.product_id DESC"
            );

        } else if ("ratingDesc".equals(sort)) {

            sql.append(
                    "ORDER BY "
                    + "ISNULL(rv.avg_rating, 0) DESC, "
                    + "ISNULL(rv.review_count, 0) DESC, "
                    + "p.product_id DESC"
            );

        } else {

            sql.append(
                    "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC"
            );
        }

        // ====================================
        // 12.5. TRUY VẤN DATABASE
        // ====================================
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(
                        sql.toString()
                )) {

            for (int i = 0;
                    i < parameters.size(); i++) {

                ps.setInt(
                        i + 1,
                        parameters.get(i)
                );
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    Product product = mapProduct(rs);

                    product.setMinPrice(
                            rs.getDouble("min_price")
                    );

                    product.setAverageRating(
                            rs.getDouble("avg_rating")
                    );

                    product.setReviewCount(
                            rs.getInt("review_count")
                    );

                    products.add(product);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lọc catalog",
                    ex
            );
        }

        // ====================================
        // 12.6. SEARCH THEO TỪ KHÓA
        // ====================================
        if (keyword != null
                && !keyword.trim().isEmpty()) {

            String normalizedQuery
                    = normalizeUserQuery(keyword);

            if (!normalizedQuery.isEmpty()) {

                Map<Product, Integer> scores
                        = new HashMap<>();

                products.removeIf(product -> {

                    int score
                            = calculateMatchScore(
                                    product,
                                    normalizedQuery
                            );

                    if (score <= 0) {
                        return true;
                    }

                    scores.put(product, score);

                    return false;
                });

                if (!"priceAsc".equals(sort)
                        && !"priceDesc".equals(sort)
                        && !"ratingDesc".equals(sort)) {

                    products.sort(
                            (first, second)
                            -> Integer.compare(
                                    scores.get(second),
                                    scores.get(first)
                            )
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        return products;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 13. SẢN PHẨM TƯƠNG TỰ - OECS V2
    // ========================================
    /**
     * Lấy tối đa 8 sản phẩm tương tự.
     *
     * Quy tắc:
     *
     * 1. Cùng danh mục với sản phẩm đang xem. 2. Không lấy chính sản phẩm đó.
     * 3. PRODUCT phải đang hoạt động. 4. Phải có ít nhất một SKU đang hoạt
     * động. 5. Ưu tiên sản phẩm còn hàng. 6. Giá lấy từ SKU còn hàng nếu có. 7.
     * Nếu tất cả SKU hết hàng thì dùng giá thấp nhất của SKU đang hoạt động.
     *
     * Kết quả trả về có thể dùng trực tiếp với related-products.jsp.
     */
    public List<Product> getRelatedProducts(
            int productId,
            int categoryId) {

        List<Product> relatedProducts
                = new ArrayList<>();

        if (productId <= 0 || categoryId <= 0) {
            return relatedProducts;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT TOP (8) "
                + "p.product_id, "
                + "p.product_name, "
                + "p.description, "
                + "p.created_at, "
                + "p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, "
                + "c.category_name, "
                + "b.brand_id, "
                + "b.brand_name, "
                + "s.min_price "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c "
                + "ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b "
                + "ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "INNER JOIN ( "
                + "    SELECT "
                + "        product_id, "
                + "        COALESCE( "
                + "            MIN( "
                + "                CASE "
                + "                    WHEN stock_quantity > 0 "
                + "                    THEN price "
                + "                END "
                + "            ), "
                + "            MIN(price) "
                + "        ) AS min_price, "
                + "        SUM(stock_quantity) AS total_stock "
                + "    FROM PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "    WHERE is_active = 1 "
                + "    GROUP BY product_id "
                + ") s "
                + "ON p.product_id = s.product_id "
                + "WHERE p.category_id = ? "
                + "AND p.product_id <> ? "
                + "AND p.is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY "
                + "CASE "
                + "    WHEN s.total_stock > 0 "
                + "    THEN 0 "
                + "    ELSE 1 "
                + "END, "
                + "p.created_at DESC, "
                + "p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(2, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    Product product = mapProduct(rs);

                    product.setMinPrice(
                            rs.getDouble("min_price")
                    );

                    relatedProducts.add(product);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy sản phẩm tương tự, productId="
                    + productId
                    + ", categoryId="
                    + categoryId,
                    ex
            );
        }

        return relatedProducts;
    }

    // ========================================
    // 14. MAPPING PRODUCT
    // ========================================
    private Product mapProduct(ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        Category category = new Category(
                rs.getInt("category_id"),
                rs.getString("category_name"),
                null
        );

        Brand brand = new Brand(
                rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                rs.getString("brand_name"),
                null
        );

        Product product = new Product(
                rs.getInt("product_id"),
                rs.getInt("category_id"),
                rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                rs.getString("product_name"),
                rs.getString("description"),
                rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                category,
                brand
        );

        product.setImageUrl(
                rs.getString("image_url")
        );

        return product;
    }


    public List<ProductOverviewSection> getProductOverviewSections(
            int productId) {

        List<ProductOverviewSection> sections = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT section_id, product_id, section_key, "
                + "section_title, section_content, image_url, "
                + "image_alt, display_order "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_CONTENT_SECTION "
                + "WHERE product_id = ? AND is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY display_order ASC, section_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    ProductOverviewSection section
                            = new ProductOverviewSection(
                                    rs.getInt("section_id"),
                                    rs.getInt("product_id"),
                                    rs.getString("section_key"),
                                    rs.getString("section_title"),
                                    rs.getString("section_content"),
                                    rs.getString("image_url"),
                                    rs.getString("image_alt"),
                                    rs.getInt("display_order")
                            );

                    sections.add(section);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Không thể tải nội dung Tổng quan sản phẩm "
                    + productId,
                    ex
            );
        }

        return sections;
    }

}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;

public class SkuHardDeleteDAO extends DBContext {

    /**
     * Xóa vĩnh viễn SKU chưa có giao dịch.
     *
     * Trả về mã SKU đã xóa để ghi Audit Log.
     *
     * Không xóa SKU đã có đơn hàng, đánh giá, giỏ hàng hoặc lịch sử kho thực
     * tế.
     */
    public String deletePermanently(
            int productId,
            int skuId) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            conn.setTransactionIsolation(
                    Connection.TRANSACTION_SERIALIZABLE
            );

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {

                // =====================================
                // 1. KHÓA SKU TRONG TRANSACTION
                // =====================================
                String skuCode = null;

                String sqlSku
                        = "SELECT sku_code "
                        + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ? "
                        + "AND product_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(sqlSku)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, skuId);
                    ps.setInt(2, productId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (rs.next()) {
                            skuCode = rs.getString("sku_code");
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (skuCode == null) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy SKU thuộc sản phẩm này."
                    );
                }

                // =====================================
                // 2. KIỂM TRA ĐƠN HÀNG
                // =====================================
                if (exists(
                        conn,
                        "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ?",
                        skuId)) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không thể xóa SKU đã phát sinh "
                            + "đơn hàng. Hãy dùng Ngừng bán."
                    );
                }

                // =====================================
                // 3. KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ
                // =====================================
                if (exists(
                        conn,
                        "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ?",
                        skuId)) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không thể xóa SKU đã có đánh giá."
                    );
                }

                // =====================================
                // 4. KIỂM TRA GIỎ HÀNG
                // =====================================
                if (exists(
                        conn,
                        "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.CART_ITEMS "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ?",
                        skuId)) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "SKU đang nằm trong giỏ hàng. "
                            + "Cần xử lý giỏ hàng trước khi xóa."
                    );
                }

                // =====================================
                // 5. KIỂM TRA LỊCH SỬ KHO
                // =====================================

                /*
                 * OPENING là số dư lúc tạo SKU.
                 *
                 * IN, OUT, SET, SYSTEM là lịch sử
                 * phát sinh nên không được xóa.
                 */
                if (exists(
                        conn,
                        "SELECT 1 "
                        + "FROM dbo.INVENTORY_MOVEMENT "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ? "
                        + "AND movement_type <> 'OPENING'",
                        skuId)) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "SKU đã phát sinh lịch sử "
                            + "nhập/xuất hoặc thay đổi tồn kho. "
                            + "Không thể xóa vĩnh viễn."
                    );
                }

                // =====================================
                // 6. XÓA ẢNH GẮN VỚI SKU
                // =====================================
                executeDelete(
                        conn,
                        "DELETE FROM dbo.PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                        + "WHERE product_id = ? "
                        + "AND sku_id = ?",
                        productId,
                        skuId
                );

                // =====================================
                // 7. XÓA THUỘC TÍNH BIẾN THỂ
                // =====================================
                executeDeleteBySku(
                        conn,
                        "DELETE FROM dbo.SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ?",
                        skuId
                );

                // =====================================
                // 8. XÓA OPENING STOCK
                // =====================================
                executeDeleteBySku(
                        conn,
                        "DELETE FROM dbo.INVENTORY_MOVEMENT "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ? "
                        + "AND movement_type = 'OPENING'",
                        skuId
                );

                // =====================================
                // 9. XÓA SKU CHÍNH
                // =====================================
                int deleted = executeDelete(
                        conn,
                        "DELETE FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU "
                        + "WHERE product_id = ? "
                        + "AND sku_id = ?",
                        productId,
                        skuId
                );

                if (deleted != 1) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Không thể xóa SKU khỏi PRODUCT_SKU."
                    );
                }

                // =====================================
                // 10. HOÀN TẤT
                // =====================================
                conn.commit();

                return skuCode;

            } catch (SQLException ex) {

                conn.rollback();

                // SQL Server lỗi FK
                if (ex.getErrorCode() == 547) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "SKU vẫn được dữ liệu khác tham chiếu. "
                            + "Không thể xóa vĩnh viễn.",
                            ex
                    );
                }

                throw ex;

            } catch (RuntimeException ex) {

                conn.rollback();
                throw ex;
            }
        }
    }

    // =========================================
    // KIỂM TRA CÓ DỮ LIỆU THAM CHIẾU
    // =========================================
    private boolean exists(
            Connection conn,
            String sql,
            int skuId) throws SQLException {

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }
        }
    }

    // =========================================
    // XÓA VỚI PRODUCT ID + SKU ID
    // =========================================
    private int executeDelete(
            Connection conn,
            String sql,
            int productId,
            int skuId) throws SQLException {

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);

            return ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }

    // =========================================
    // XÓA THEO SKU ID
    // =========================================
    private int executeDeleteBySku(
            Connection conn,
            String sql,
            int skuId) throws SQLException {

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            return ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.SQLException;

/**
 * Replaces the missing dbo.usp_OECS_RefreshSkuVariantKey stored procedure.
 * The caller must use the same connection and transaction that saved attributes.
 * The UNIQUE filtered index UX_SKU_ProductVariant rejects duplicate combinations.
 */
public final class SkuVariantKeyHelper {
    private SkuVariantKeyHelper() { }

    public static void refresh(Connection conn, int skuId) throws SQLException {
        if (conn == null || skuId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Connection/SKU ID khong hop le.");
        }

        String sql =
                "UPDATE s SET variant_key = "
              + "CASE WHEN av.variant_text IS NULL THEN NULL "
              + "ELSE HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', av.variant_text) END "
              + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU AS s "
              + "OUTER APPLY ( "
              + " SELECT STRING_AGG( "
              + "   CAST(CONCAT(sav.attribute_id, N'=', "
              + "     CASE WHEN sav.text_value IS NOT NULL THEN "
              + "       N'T:' + UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(sav.text_value))) "
              + "     WHEN sav.numeric_value IS NOT NULL THEN "
              + "       N'N:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(60), sav.numeric_value) "
              + "     ELSE N'B:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1),sav.boolean_value) "
              + "     END) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), N'|' "
              + " ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sav.attribute_id) AS variant_text "
              + " FROM dbo.SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE AS sav WHERE sav.sku_id=s.sku_id "
              + ") AS av "
              + "WHERE s.sku_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, skuId);
            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                throw new SQLException("Khong tim thay SKU de cap nhat variant_key: " + skuId);
            }
        }
    }
}

package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class StaffReviewDAO extends DBContext {

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getAllReviewsForStaff()
            throws SQLException {

        List<Map<String, Object>> reviews = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT pr.review_id, pr.user_id, "
                + "u.username AS reviewer_name, "
                + "pr.order_item_id, pr.sku_id, "
                + "ps.sku_code, p.product_name, "
                + "pr.rating, pr.comment, pr.created_at, "
                + "pr.is_hidden "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "LEFT JOIN [USER] u ON pr.user_id = u.user_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_SKU ps ON pr.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p ON ps.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC";

        Map<Integer, Map<String, Object>> byId = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
                 ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> review = new HashMap<>();

                    review.put("reviewId", rs.getInt("review_id"));
                    review.put("userId", rs.getInt("user_id"));
                    review.put("reviewerName", rs.getString("reviewer_name"));
                    review.put("orderItemId", rs.getInt("order_item_id"));
                    review.put("skuId", rs.getInt("sku_id"));
                    review.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));
                    review.put("productName", rs.getString("product_name"));
                    review.put("rating", rs.getInt("rating"));
                    review.put("comment", rs.getString("comment"));
                    review.put("createdAt", rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
                    review.put("isHidden", rs.getBoolean("is_hidden"));

                    review.put("images", new ArrayList<String>());
                    reviews.add(review);
                    byId.put(rs.getInt("review_id"), review);
                }
            }

            // Tải ảnh cùng lượt truy vấn để Staff kiểm duyệt.
            String imageSql =
                    "SELECT review_id, image_url "
                    + "FROM dbo.REVIEW_IMAGES "
                    + "ORDER BY review_id, image_id";

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(imageSql);
                 ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> review =
                            byId.get(rs.getInt("review_id"));

                    if (review != null) {
                        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                        List<String> images =
                                (List<String>) review.get("images");

                        images.add(rs.getString("image_url"));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return reviews;
    }

    public boolean setReviewHidden(int reviewId, boolean hidden)
            throws SQLException {

        String sql = "UPDATE PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "SET is_hidden = ? "
                + "WHERE review_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, hidden);
            ps.setInt(2, reviewId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;

            = Logger.getLogger(UserDAO.class.getName());

    public User login(String account, String rawPassword) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.email, u.password_hash, "
                + "u.phone, u.created_at, u.is_active, "
                + "u.role_id, r.role_name, "
                + "a.address_line AS default_address "
                + "FROM [USER] u "
                + "LEFT JOIN ROLES r ON u.role_id = r.role_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN ADDRESSBOOK a "
                + "ON u.user_id = a.user_id AND a.is_default = 1 "
                + "WHERE (u.username = ? OR u.email = ?) "
                + "AND u.password_hash = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            statement.setString(1, account);
            statement.setString(2, account);
            statement.setString(3, hashMd5(rawPassword));

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    int roleId = rs.getInt("role_id");
                    String roleName = rs.getString("role_name");
                    boolean active = rs.getBoolean("is_active");

                    User user = new User(
                            rs.getInt("user_id"),
                            rs.getString("username"),
                            rs.getString("email"),
                            rs.getString("password_hash"),
                            rs.getString("phone"),
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                            roleId,
                            roleName,
                            active
                    );

                    user.setAddress(
                            rs.getString("default_address")
                    );

                    return user;
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi đăng nhập!", ex);
        }

        return null;
    }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi kiểm tra sự tồn tại của người dùng!", ex);
        }

        return false;
    }

    }

    public List<User> getAllUsers(
            String keyword,
            Integer roleId,
            String status,
            String sort) {

        List<User> userList = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Object> params = new ArrayList<>();

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder();

        sql.append(
                "SELECT "
                + "u.user_id, "
                + "u.username, "
                + "u.email, "
                + "u.phone, "
                + "u.is_active, "
                + "u.created_at, "
                + "u.role_id, "
                + "r.role_name "
                + "FROM [USER] u "
                + "LEFT JOIN ROLES r ON u.role_id = r.role_id "
                + "WHERE 1 = 1 "
        );

        if (keyword != null && !keyword.trim().isEmpty()) {

            sql.append(
                    "AND ("
                    + "u.username LIKE ? "
                    + "OR u.email LIKE ? "
                    + "OR u.phone LIKE ?"
                    + ") "
            );

            String searchKeyword = "%" + keyword.trim() + "%";

            params.add(searchKeyword);
            params.add(searchKeyword);
            params.add(searchKeyword);
        }

        if (roleId != null) {

            sql.append("AND u.role_id = ? ");

            params.add(roleId);
        }

        if ("active".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {

            sql.append("AND u.is_active = 1 ");

        } else if ("locked".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {

            sql.append("AND u.is_active = 0 ");
        }

        if (sort == null || sort.trim().isEmpty()) {
            sort = "newest";
        }

        switch (sort) {

            case "oldest":
                sql.append("ORDER BY u.created_at ASC ");
                break;

            case "username_asc":
                sql.append("ORDER BY u.username ASC ");
                break;

            case "username_desc":
                sql.append("ORDER BY u.username DESC ");
                break;

            case "newest":
            default:
                sql.append("ORDER BY u.created_at DESC ");
                break;
        }

        try (Connection connection = getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {

            for (int i = 0; i < params.size(); i++) {
                statement.setObject(i + 1, params.get(i));
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    User user = new User();

                    user.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
                    user.setUsername(rs.getString("username"));
                    user.setEmail(rs.getString("email"));
                    user.setPhone(rs.getString("phone"));
                    user.setActive(rs.getBoolean("is_active"));
                    user.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
                    user.setRoleId(rs.getInt("role_id"));
                    user.setRoleName(rs.getString("role_name"));

                    userList.add(user);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi lấy danh sách User!", e);
        }

        return userList;
    }

    public User getUserById(int userId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.email, "

                + "FROM [USER] u "
                + "LEFT JOIN ROLES r ON u.role_id = r.role_id "
                + "WHERE u.user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return new User(
                            rs.getInt("user_id"),

                            rs.getString("email"),
                            rs.getString("password_hash"),
                            rs.getString("phone"),
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                            rs.getInt("role_id"),
                            rs.getString("role_name"),
                            rs.getBoolean("is_active")
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy user theo ID!", ex);
        }

        return null;
    }

    public boolean createUser(User user, String rawPassword) {

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO [USER] "
                + "(username, email, password_hash, phone, role_id) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, user.getUsername());
            ps.setString(2, user.getEmail());
            ps.setString(3, hashMd5(rawPassword));
            ps.setString(4, user.getPhone());
            ps.setInt(5, user.getRoleId());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi tạo user!", ex);
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean updateProfile(int userId, String email, String phone, String address, String fullName) {
        String updateProfileSql = "UPDATE [USER] SET email = ?, phone = ? WHERE user_id = ?";

        String updateAddrSql = "UPDATE ADDRESSBOOK SET address_line = ?, phone_number = ? WHERE user_id = ? AND is_default = 1";
        String insertAddrSql = "INSERT INTO ADDRESSBOOK (user_id, recipient_name, phone_number, address_line, is_default) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 1)";

        Connection conn = null;
        try {
            conn = getConnection();
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try (PreparedStatement psUser = conn.prepareStatement(updateProfileSql)) {
                psUser.setString(1, email);
                psUser.setString(2, phone);
                psUser.setInt(3, userId);
                psUser.executeUpdate();
            }

            if (address != null && !address.trim().isEmpty()) {

                // 1. Thu cap nhat dia chi mac dinh theo user_id.
                int updatedRows;

                try (PreparedStatement psUpdateAddr
                        = conn.prepareStatement(updateAddrSql)) {

                    psUpdateAddr.setString(1, address.trim());
                    psUpdateAddr.setString(2, phone);
                    psUpdateAddr.setInt(3, userId);

                    updatedRows = psUpdateAddr.executeUpdate();
                }

                // 2. Neu chua co dia chi mac dinh,
                //    them dia chi moi.
                if (updatedRows == 0) {

                    try (PreparedStatement psInsertAddr
                            = conn.prepareStatement(insertAddrSql)) {

                        psInsertAddr.setInt(1, userId);

                        psInsertAddr.setString(
                                2,
                                fullName != null
                                        ? fullName
                                        : "Khách hàng"
                        );

                        psInsertAddr.setString(3, phone);
                        psInsertAddr.setString(4, address.trim());

                        psInsertAddr.executeUpdate();
                    }
                }
            }

            conn.commit();
            return true;
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            if (conn != null) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi cập nhật profile!", ex);
        } finally {
            if (conn != null) {
                try {
                    conn.setAutoCommit(true);
                    conn.close();
                } catch (SQLException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public boolean changePassword(
            int userId,
            String rawOldPassword,
            String rawNewPassword) {

        String sql
                = "UPDATE dbo.[USER] "
                + "SET password_hash = ? "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "AND password_hash = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            // Mat khau moi
            ps.setString(
                    1,
                    hashMd5(rawNewPassword)
            );

            // Xac dinh tai khoan bang ID
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            // Kiem tra mat khau cu ngay trong UPDATE
            ps.setString(
                    3,
                    hashMd5(rawOldPassword)
            );

            // 1 dong duoc cap nhat = thanh cong
            return ps.executeUpdate() == 1;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Loi doi mat khau nguoi dung!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean updateUserStatus(
            int userId,
            boolean active) {

        String sql
                = "UPDATE [USER] "
                + "SET is_active = ? "
                + "WHERE user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, active);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi cập nhật trạng thái tài khoản!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return false;
    }

    private String hashMd5(String raw) {

        if (raw == null) {
            return "";
        }

        try {

            MessageDigest md
                    = MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5");

            byte[] mess = md.digest(raw.getBytes());

            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();

            for (byte b : mess) {
                sb.append(String.format("%02x", b));
            }

            return sb.toString();

        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi thuật toán MD5!", ex);

            return "";
        }
    }

    public User findByEmail(String email) throws SQLException {

        String sql
                = "SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.email, "
                + "u.password_hash, u.phone, u.created_at, "
                + "u.is_active, u.role_id, r.role_name "
                + "FROM [USER] u "
                + "LEFT JOIN ROLES r ON u.role_id = r.role_id "
                + "WHERE u.email = ?";

        try (Connection connection = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, email);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    User user = new User();

                    user.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
                    user.setUsername(rs.getString("username"));
                    user.setEmail(rs.getString("email"));
                    user.setPasswordHash(rs.getString("password_hash"));
                    user.setPhone(rs.getString("phone"));
                    user.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
                    user.setRoleId(rs.getInt("role_id"));
                    user.setRoleName(rs.getString("role_name"));
                    user.setActive(rs.getBoolean("is_active"));

                    return user;
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    public boolean resetPassword(int userId, String rawNewPassword)
            throws SQLException {

        String sql = "UPDATE [USER] "
                + "SET password_hash = ? "
                + "WHERE user_id = ?";

        try (Connection connection = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, hashMd5(rawNewPassword));
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        }
    }

package dao;

import db.DBContext;

import model.Voucher;
import model.VoucherUsageDTO;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.sql.Types;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class VoucherDAO extends DBContext {

    public List<Voucher> getAllVouchers() {

        List<Voucher> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT v.voucher_id, v.code, v.min_order_value, "
                + "v.valid_from, v.valid_to, v.discount_type, "
                + "v.discount_value, v.max_discount, v.usage_limit, "
                + "v.per_user_limit, "
                + "ISNULL(u.used_count, 0) AS used_count, "
                + "CASE "
                + "WHEN v.usage_limit IS NOT NULL "
                + "AND ISNULL(u.used_count, 0) >= v.usage_limit "
                + "THEN 'EXHAUSTED' "
                + "WHEN v.valid_from > GETDATE() "
                + "THEN 'UPCOMING' "
                + "WHEN v.valid_to < GETDATE() "
                + "THEN 'EXPIRED' "
                + "ELSE 'AVAILABLE' "
                + "END AS availability_status "
                + "FROM VOUCHER v "
                + "LEFT JOIN ("
                + "SELECT voucher_id, COUNT(*) AS used_count "
                + "FROM VOUCHER_USAGES "
                + "GROUP BY voucher_id"
                + ") u ON u.voucher_id = v.voucher_id "
                + "ORDER BY v.voucher_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); 
                ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                Voucher voucher = mapVoucher(rs);

                voucher.setUsedCount(
                        rs.getInt("used_count")
                );

                voucher.setAvailabilityStatus(
                        rs.getString("availability_status")
                );

                list.add(voucher);
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return list;
    }

    public Voucher getVoucherById(
            int voucherId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "voucher_id, "
                + "code, "
                + "min_order_value, "
                + "valid_from, "
                + "valid_to, "
                + "discount_type, "
                + "discount_value, "
                + "max_discount, "
                + "usage_limit, "
                + "per_user_limit "
                + "FROM VOUCHER "
                + "WHERE voucher_id = ?";

        try (
                Connection conn
                = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(
                    1,
                    voucherId
            );

            try (
                    ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return mapVoucher(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return null;
    }

    public List<Voucher> getAvailableVouchers(
            double orderTotal,
            int userId) {

        List<Voucher> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "v.voucher_id, "
                + "v.code, "
                + "v.min_order_value, "
                + "v.valid_from, "
                + "v.valid_to, "
                + "v.discount_type, "
                + "v.discount_value, "
                + "v.max_discount, "
                + "v.usage_limit, "
                + "v.per_user_limit "
                + "FROM VOUCHER v "
                + "WHERE v.valid_from <= GETDATE() "
                + "AND v.valid_to >= GETDATE() "
                + "AND v.min_order_value <= ? "
                + "AND ( "
                + "v.usage_limit IS NULL "
                + "OR ( "
                + "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM VOUCHER_USAGES vu "
                + "WHERE vu.voucher_id = v.voucher_id "
                + ") < v.usage_limit "
                + ") "
                + "AND ( "
                + "v.per_user_limit IS NULL "
                + "OR ( "
                + "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM VOUCHER_USAGES vu2 "
                + "WHERE vu2.voucher_id = v.voucher_id "
                + "AND vu2.user_id = ? "
                + ") < v.per_user_limit "
                + ") "
                + "ORDER BY v.discount_value DESC";

        try (
                Connection conn
                = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setDouble(
                    1,
                    orderTotal
            );

            ps.setInt(
                    2,
                    userId
            );

            try (
                    ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    list.add(
                            mapVoucher(rs)
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return list;
    }

    public Voucher getValidVoucher(
            String code,
            double orderTotal,
            int userId) {

        if (code == null
                || code.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return null;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "v.voucher_id, "
                + "v.code, "
                + "v.min_order_value, "
                + "v.valid_from, "
                + "v.valid_to, "
                + "v.discount_type, "
                + "v.discount_value, "
                + "v.max_discount, "
                + "v.usage_limit, "
                + "v.per_user_limit "
                + "FROM VOUCHER v "
                + "WHERE UPPER(v.code) = UPPER(?) "
                + "AND v.valid_from <= GETDATE() "
                + "AND v.valid_to >= GETDATE() "
                + "AND v.min_order_value <= ? "
                + "AND ( "
                + "v.usage_limit IS NULL "
                + "OR ( "
                + "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM VOUCHER_USAGES vu "
                + "WHERE vu.voucher_id = v.voucher_id "
                + ") < v.usage_limit "
                + ") "
                + "AND ( "
                + "v.per_user_limit IS NULL "
                + "OR ( "
                + "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM VOUCHER_USAGES vu2 "
                + "WHERE vu2.voucher_id = v.voucher_id "
                + "AND vu2.user_id = ? "
                + ") < v.per_user_limit "
                + ")";

        try (
                Connection conn
                = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(
                    1,
                    code.trim()
            );

            ps.setDouble(
                    2,
                    orderTotal
            );

            ps.setInt(
                    3,
                    userId
            );

            try (
                    ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return mapVoucher(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return null;
    }

    public Voucher getAvailableVoucherById(
            int voucherId,
            double orderTotal,
            int userId) {

        Voucher voucher
                = getVoucherById(
                        voucherId
                );

        if (voucher == null) {

            return null;
        }

        return getValidVoucher(
                voucher.getCode(),
                orderTotal,
                userId
        );
    }

    public boolean existsCode(
            String code) {

        if (code == null
                || code.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM VOUCHER "
                + "WHERE UPPER(code) = UPPER(?)";

        try (
                Connection conn
                = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(
                    1,
                    code.trim()
            );

            try (
                    ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean existsCodeExceptId(
            String code,
            int voucherId) {

        if (code == null
                || code.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM VOUCHER "
                + "WHERE UPPER(code) = UPPER(?) "
                + "AND voucher_id <> ?";

        try (
                Connection conn
                = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(
                    1,
                    code.trim()
            );

            ps.setInt(
                    2,
                    voucherId
            );

            try (
                    ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean insertVoucher(
            Voucher voucher) {

        if (voucher == null) {

            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO VOUCHER ("
                + "code, "
                + "min_order_value, "
                + "valid_from, "
                + "valid_to, "
                + "discount_type, "
                + "discount_value, "
                + "max_discount, "
                + "usage_limit, "
                + "per_user_limit"
                + ") "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (
                Connection conn
                = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(
                        sql,
                        Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS
                )) {

            ps.setString(
                    1,
                    voucher.getCode()
            );

            ps.setDouble(
                    2,
                    voucher.getMinOrderValue()
            );

            ps.setTimestamp(
                    3,
                    voucher.getValidFrom()
            );

            ps.setTimestamp(
                    4,
                    voucher.getValidTo()
            );

            ps.setString(
                    5,
                    voucher.getDiscountType()
            );

            ps.setDouble(
                    6,
                    voucher.getDiscountValue()
            );

            if (voucher.getMaxDiscount() == null) {

                ps.setNull(
                        7,
                        Types.DECIMAL
                );

            } else {

                ps.setDouble(
                        7,
                        voucher.getMaxDiscount()
                );
            }

            if (voucher.getUsageLimit() == null) {

                ps.setNull(
                        8,
                        Types.INTEGER
                );

            } else {

                ps.setInt(
                        8,
                        voucher.getUsageLimit()
                );
            }

            if (voucher.getPerUserLimit() == null) {

                ps.setNull(
                        9,
                        Types.INTEGER
                );

            } else {

                ps.setInt(
                        9,
                        voucher.getPerUserLimit()
                );
            }

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean updateVoucher(
            Voucher voucher) {

        if (voucher == null) {

            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE VOUCHER SET "
                + "code = ?, "
                + "min_order_value = ?, "
                + "valid_from = ?, "
                + "valid_to = ?, "
                + "discount_type = ?, "
                + "discount_value = ?, "
                + "max_discount = ?, "
                + "usage_limit = ?, "
                + "per_user_limit = ? "
                + "WHERE voucher_id = ?";

        try (
                Connection conn
                = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(
                    1,
                    voucher.getCode()
            );

            ps.setDouble(
                    2,
                    voucher.getMinOrderValue()
            );

            ps.setTimestamp(
                    3,
                    voucher.getValidFrom()
            );

            ps.setTimestamp(
                    4,
                    voucher.getValidTo()
            );

            ps.setString(
                    5,
                    voucher.getDiscountType()
            );

            ps.setDouble(
                    6,
                    voucher.getDiscountValue()
            );

            if (voucher.getMaxDiscount() == null) {

                ps.setNull(
                        7,
                        Types.DECIMAL
                );

            } else {

                ps.setDouble(
                        7,
                        voucher.getMaxDiscount()
                );
            }

            if (voucher.getUsageLimit() == null) {

                ps.setNull(
                        8,
                        Types.INTEGER
                );

            } else {

                ps.setInt(
                        8,
                        voucher.getUsageLimit()
                );
            }

            if (voucher.getPerUserLimit() == null) {

                ps.setNull(
                        9,
                        Types.INTEGER
                );

            } else {

                ps.setInt(
                        9,
                        voucher.getPerUserLimit()
                );
            }

            ps.setInt(
                    10,
                    voucher.getVoucherId()
            );

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }
