    }

    public double calculateDiscount(
            Voucher voucher,
            double orderTotal) {

        if (voucher == null
                || orderTotal <= 0) {

            return 0;
        }

        double discount = 0;

        if ("AMOUNT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                voucher.getDiscountType()
        )) {

            discount
                    = voucher.getDiscountValue();

        } else if ("PERCENT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                voucher.getDiscountType()
        )) {

            discount
                    = orderTotal
                    * voucher.getDiscountValue()
                    / 100.0;

            if (voucher.getMaxDiscount() != null
                    && discount
                    > voucher.getMaxDiscount()) {

                discount
                        = voucher.getMaxDiscount();
            }
        }

        if (discount < 0) {

            discount = 0;
        }

        if (discount > orderTotal) {

            discount
                    = orderTotal;
        }

        return discount;
    }

    public List<VoucherUsageDTO> getRecentVoucherUsages() {

        List<VoucherUsageDTO> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "vu.usage_id, "
                + "vu.voucher_id, "
                + "v.code AS voucher_code, "
                + "vu.order_id, "
                + "vu.user_id, "
                + "vu.used_at "
                + "FROM VOUCHER_USAGES vu "
                + "INNER JOIN VOUCHER v "
                + "ON vu.voucher_id = v.voucher_id "
                + "WHERE vu.used_at >= "
                + "DATEADD(DAY, -7, GETDATE()) "
                + "ORDER BY vu.used_at DESC";

        try (
                Connection conn
                = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs
                = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                list.add(
                        mapVoucherUsage(rs)
                );
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<VoucherUsageDTO> getAllVoucherUsages() {

    private Voucher mapVoucher(
            ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        Voucher voucher
                = new Voucher();

        voucher.setVoucherId(
                rs.getInt(
                        "voucher_id"
                )
        );

        voucher.setCode(
                rs.getString(
                        "code"
                )
        );

        voucher.setMinOrderValue(
                rs.getDouble(
                        "min_order_value"
                )
        );

        voucher.setValidFrom(
                rs.getTimestamp(
                        "valid_from"
                )
        );

        voucher.setValidTo(
                rs.getTimestamp(
                        "valid_to"
                )
        );

        voucher.setDiscountType(
                rs.getString(
                        "discount_type"
                )
        );

        voucher.setDiscountValue(
                rs.getDouble(
                        "discount_value"
                )
        );

        Object maxDiscount
                = rs.getObject(
                        "max_discount"
                );

        voucher.setMaxDiscount(
                maxDiscount == null
                        ? null
                        : rs.getDouble(
                                "max_discount"
                        )
        );

        Object usageLimit
                = rs.getObject(
                        "usage_limit"
                );

        voucher.setUsageLimit(
                usageLimit == null
                        ? null
                        : rs.getInt(
                                "usage_limit"
                        )
        );

        Object perUserLimit
                = rs.getObject(
                        "per_user_limit"
                );

        voucher.setPerUserLimit(
                perUserLimit == null
                        ? null
                        : rs.getInt(
                                "per_user_limit"
                        )
        );

        return voucher;
    }

    private VoucherUsageDTO mapVoucherUsage(
            ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        VoucherUsageDTO usage
                = new VoucherUsageDTO();

        usage.setUsageId(
                rs.getInt(
                        "usage_id"
                )
        );

        usage.setVoucherId(
                rs.getInt(
                        "voucher_id"
                )
        );

        usage.setVoucherCode(
                rs.getString(
                        "voucher_code"
                )
        );

        usage.setOrderId(
                rs.getInt(
                        "order_id"
                )
        );

        usage.setUserId(
                rs.getInt(
                        "user_id"
                )
        );

        usage.setUsedAt(
                rs.getTimestamp(
                        "used_at"
                )
        );

        return usage;
    }
}

package db;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class DBContext {

    private Connection conn;
    private final String DB_URL = "jdbc:sqlserver://127.0.0.1:1433;databaseName=OECS;encrypt=false;trustServerCertificate=true;";
    private final String DB_USER = "sa";     
    private final String DB_PWD = "123456";  

    public DBContext() {
        try {
            Class.forName("com.microsoft.sqlserver.jdbc.SQLServerDriver");
            this.conn = DriverManager.getConnection(DB_URL, DB_USER, DB_PWD);
        } catch (ClassNotFoundException | SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(DBContext.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi kết nối CSDL!", ex);
        }
    }

    public Connection getConnection() {
        try {
            if (conn == null || conn.isClosed()) {
                Class.forName("com.microsoft.sqlserver.jdbc.SQLServerDriver");
                conn = DriverManager.getConnection(DB_URL, DB_USER, DB_PWD);
            }
        } catch (ClassNotFoundException | SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(DBContext.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, null, ex);
        }
        return conn;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        DBContext db = new DBContext();
        if (db.getConnection() != null) {
            System.out.println("Kết nối OECS thành công!");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Kết nối thất bại!");
        }
    }
}package filter;

import jakarta.servlet.Filter;
import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import jakarta.servlet.FilterConfig;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebFilter;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

import model.User;

@WebFilter(
        filterName = "AuthFilter",
        urlPatterns = {"/*"}
)
public class AuthFilter implements Filter {

    private static final List<String> PUBLIC_URLS = Arrays.asList(
            "",
            "/",
            "/login",
            "/register",
            "/logout",
            "/home",
            "/shop",
            "/api/search",
            "/forgot-password",
            "/reset-password",
            "/favicon.ico",
            "/guide",
            "/payment/vnpay/ipn",
            "/payment/momo/ipn",
            "/payment/vnpay/return",
            "/payment/momo/return"
    );

    private static final List<String> CUSTOMER_URLS = Arrays.asList(
            "/cart",
            "/review",
            "/checkout",
            "/my-orders",
            "/my-orders/detail",
            "/my-orders/cancel",
            "/order-success",
            "/payment",
            "/payment/action",
            "/return-exchange",
            "/review/report"
    );

    private static final List<String> STAFF_URLS = Arrays.asList(
            "/brand",
            "/category",
            "/product",
            "/product-sku",
            "/sku-images",
            "/sku-bulk",
            "/admin/orders",
            "/staff/voucher",
            "/staff/banner",
            "/staff/return-exchange",
            "/staff/reviews",
            "/staff/payment-refunds",
            "/inventory"
    );

    private static final List<String> ADMIN_URLS = Arrays.asList(
            "/admin/dashboard",
            "/admin/report",
            "/admin/report/export",
            "/user",
            "/admin/audit-log"
    );

    private static final List<String> AUTHENTICATED_URLS
            = Arrays.asList(
                    "/profile",
                    "/notification"
            );

    private static final List<String> PUBLIC_PREFIXES
            = Arrays.asList(
                    "/assets/",
                    "/css/",
                    "/js/",
                    "/images/",
                    "/uploads/"
            );

    @Override
    public void init(FilterConfig filterConfig)
            throws ServletException {
    }

    @Override
    public void doFilter(
            ServletRequest request,
            ServletResponse response,
            FilterChain chain
    ) throws IOException, ServletException {

        HttpServletRequest httpRequest
                = (HttpServletRequest) request;

        HttpServletResponse httpResponse
                = (HttpServletResponse) response;

        HttpSession session = httpRequest.getSession(false);

        String requestURI = httpRequest.getRequestURI();
        String contextPath = httpRequest.getContextPath();

        String relativePath = requestURI.substring(
                contextPath.length()
        );

        User user = session == null
                ? null
                : (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        boolean isPublicUrl = PUBLIC_URLS.contains(relativePath);

        boolean isStaticResource = PUBLIC_PREFIXES.stream()
                .anyMatch(relativePath::startsWith);

        if (isPublicUrl || isStaticResource) {
            chain.doFilter(request, response);
            return;
        }

        if (user == null) {
            if (session == null) {
                session = httpRequest.getSession(true);
            }

            String queryString = httpRequest.getQueryString();

            String fullRedirectUrl = requestURI
                    + (queryString != null
                            ? "?" + queryString
                            : "");

            session.setAttribute(
                    "redirectUrl",
                    fullRedirectUrl
            );

            httpResponse.sendRedirect(
                    contextPath + "/login"
            );

            return;
        }

        if (AUTHENTICATED_URLS.contains(relativePath)) {
            chain.doFilter(request, response);
            return;
        }

        boolean isCustomerUrl
                = CUSTOMER_URLS.contains(relativePath);

        if (isCustomerUrl) {

            if (!user.isCustomer()) {
                session.setAttribute(
                        "toastMessage",
                        "Bạn không có quyền truy cập "
                        + "chức năng dành cho khách hàng!"
                );

                session.setAttribute("toastType", "error");

                httpResponse.sendRedirect(
                        contextPath + "/home"
                );

                return;
            }

            chain.doFilter(request, response);
            return;
        }

        boolean isStaffUrl
                = STAFF_URLS.contains(relativePath)
                || relativePath.startsWith("/admin/orders/")
                || relativePath.startsWith("/staff/voucher/");

        if (isStaffUrl) {
            if (!user.isStaff()) {
                session.setAttribute(
                        "toastMessage",
                        "Bạn không có quyền truy cập "
                        + "khu vực dành cho nhân viên!"
                );

                session.setAttribute("toastType", "error");

                httpResponse.sendRedirect(
                        contextPath + "/home"
                );

                return;
            }
            chain.doFilter(request, response);
            return;
        }

        boolean isAdminUrl
                = ADMIN_URLS.contains(relativePath);

        if (isAdminUrl) {
            if (!user.isAdmin()) {
                session.setAttribute(
                        "toastMessage",
                        "Bạn không có quyền truy cập "
                        + "khu vực quản trị!"
                );

                session.setAttribute("toastType", "error");

                httpResponse.sendRedirect(
                        contextPath + "/home"
                );

                return;
            }
            chain.doFilter(request, response);
            return;
        }

        session.setAttribute(
                "toastMessage",
                "Đường dẫn không hợp lệ hoặc bạn không có quyền truy cập!"
        );

        session.setAttribute(
                "toastType",
                "error"
        );

        httpResponse.sendRedirect(
                contextPath + "/home"
        );

        return;
    }

    @Override
    public void destroy() {
    }
}
package model;

public class Address {

    private int addressId;
    private int userId;
    private String recipientName;
    private String phoneNumber;
    private String addressLine;
    private boolean defaultAddress;

    public Address() {
    }

    public Address(int addressId, int userId, String recipientName,
                   String phoneNumber, String addressLine, boolean defaultAddress) {
        this.addressId = addressId;
        this.userId = userId;
        this.recipientName = recipientName;
        this.phoneNumber = phoneNumber;
        this.addressLine = addressLine;
        this.defaultAddress = defaultAddress;
    }

    public int getAddressId() {
        return addressId;
    }

    public void setAddressId(int addressId) {
        this.addressId = addressId;
    }

    public int getUserId() {
        return userId;
    }

    public void setUserId(int userId) {
        this.userId = userId;
    }

    public String getRecipientName() {
        return recipientName;
    }

public class PasswordResetToken {

    private int resetId;
    private int userId;
    private String tokenHash;
    private Timestamp expiresAt;
    private Timestamp usedAt;
    private Timestamp createdAt;

    public PasswordResetToken() {
    }

    public PasswordResetToken(int resetId, int userId, String tokenHash,
            Timestamp expiresAt, Timestamp usedAt, Timestamp createdAt) {
        this.resetId = resetId;
        this.userId = userId;
        this.tokenHash = tokenHash;
        this.expiresAt = expiresAt;
        this.usedAt = usedAt;
        this.createdAt = createdAt;
    }

    public PasswordResetToken(int userId, String tokenHash, Timestamp expiresAt) {
        this.userId = userId;
        this.tokenHash = tokenHash;
        this.expiresAt = expiresAt;
    }

    public int getResetId() {
        return resetId;
    }

    public void setResetId(int resetId) {
        this.resetId = resetId;
    }

    public int getUserId() {
        return userId;
    }

    public void setUserId(int userId) {
        this.userId = userId;
    }

    public String getTokenHash() {
        return tokenHash;
    }

    public void setTokenHash(String tokenHash) {
        this.tokenHash = tokenHash;
    }

    public Timestamp getExpiresAt() {
        return expiresAt;
    }

    public void setExpiresAt(Timestamp expiresAt) {
        this.expiresAt = expiresAt;
    }

    public Timestamp getUsedAt() {
        return usedAt;
    }

    public void setUsedAt(Timestamp usedAt) {
        this.usedAt = usedAt;
    }

    public Timestamp getCreatedAt() {
        return createdAt;
    }

    public void setCreatedAt(Timestamp createdAt) {
        this.createdAt = createdAt;
    }

    public boolean isUsed() {
        return usedAt != null;
    }

    public boolean isExpired() {
        return expiresAt != null
                && expiresAt.before(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
    }

    public boolean isValid() {
        return !isUsed() && !isExpired();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "PasswordResetToken{"
                + "resetId=" + resetId
                + ", userId=" + userId
                + ", expiresAt=" + expiresAt
                + ", usedAt=" + usedAt
                + ", createdAt=" + createdAt
                + '}';
    }

import java.math.BigDecimal;

public class SkuAttributeValue {

    private int skuId;
    private int attributeId;

    private String textValue;
    private BigDecimal numericValue;
    private Boolean booleanValue;

    private String attributeName;
    private String dataType;
    private String unit;

    public SkuAttributeValue() {
    }

    public SkuAttributeValue(int skuId,
            int attributeId,
            String textValue) {

        this.skuId = skuId;
        this.attributeId = attributeId;
        this.textValue = textValue;
    }

    public SkuAttributeValue(int skuId,
            int attributeId,
            String textValue,
            BigDecimal numericValue,
            Boolean booleanValue) {

        this.skuId = skuId;
        this.attributeId = attributeId;
        this.textValue = textValue;
        this.numericValue = numericValue;
        this.booleanValue = booleanValue;
    }

    public SkuAttributeValue(int skuId,
            int attributeId,
            String textValue,
            BigDecimal numericValue,
            Boolean booleanValue,
            String attributeName,
            String dataType,
            String unit) {

        this(skuId, attributeId,
                textValue, numericValue, booleanValue);

        this.attributeName = attributeName;
        this.dataType = dataType;
        this.unit = unit;
    }

    public int getSkuId() {
        return skuId;
    }

    public void setSkuId(int skuId) {
        this.skuId = skuId;
    }

    public int getAttributeId() {
        return attributeId;
    }

    public void setAttributeId(int attributeId) {
        this.attributeId = attributeId;
    }

    public String getTextValue() {
        return textValue;
    }

    public void setTextValue(String textValue) {
        this.textValue = textValue;
    }

    public BigDecimal getNumericValue() {
        return numericValue;
    }

    public void setNumericValue(BigDecimal numericValue) {
        this.numericValue = numericValue;
    }

    public Boolean getBooleanValue() {
        return booleanValue;
    }

    public void setBooleanValue(Boolean booleanValue) {
        this.booleanValue = booleanValue;
    }

    public String getAttributeName() {
        return attributeName;
    }

    public void setAttributeName(String attributeName) {
        this.attributeName = attributeName;
    }

    public String getDataType() {
        return dataType;
    }

    public void setDataType(String dataType) {
        this.dataType = dataType;
    }

    public String getUnit() {
        return unit;
    }

    public void setUnit(String unit) {
        this.unit = unit;
    }

    public String getDisplayValue() {

        if (textValue != null) {
            return textValue;
        }

        if (numericValue != null) {
            String number = numericValue
                    .stripTrailingZeros()
                    .toPlainString();

            if (unit != null && !unit.trim().isEmpty()) {
                return number + " " + unit;
            }

            return number;
        }

        if (booleanValue != null) {
            return booleanValue ? "Có" : "Không";
        }

        return "";
    }
}

    }

    public String getRoleName() {
        return roleName;
    }

    public void setRoleName(String roleName) {
        this.roleName = roleName;
    }

    public boolean isActive() {
        return active;
    }

    public void setActive(boolean active) {
        this.active = active;
    }

    public boolean hasRole(String role) {
        return this.roleName != null
                && this.roleName.equalsIgnoreCase(role);
    }

    public boolean isAdmin() {
        return hasRole("Admin");
    }

    public boolean isAdminOrStaff() {
        return hasRole("Admin") || hasRole("Staff");
    }

     public boolean isStaff() {
        return hasRole("Staff");
    }
    
    public boolean isCustomer() {
        return hasRole("Customer");
    }

    public boolean isLocked() {
        return !active;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "User{"
                + "userId=" + userId
                + ", username='" + username + '\''
                + ", email='" + email + '\''
                + ", phone='" + phone + '\''
                + ", roleName='" + roleName + '\''
                + ", active=" + active
                + '}';
    }
}

import java.sql.Timestamp;

public class Voucher {

    private int voucherId;
    private String code;
    private double minOrderValue;
    private Timestamp validFrom;
    private Timestamp validTo;
    private String discountType;
    private double discountValue;
    private Double maxDiscount;
    private Integer usageLimit;
    private Integer perUserLimit;
    private int usedCount;
    private String availabilityStatus;

    public Voucher() {
    }

    public Voucher(int voucherId, String code, double minOrderValue, Timestamp validFrom, Timestamp validTo,
            String discountType, double discountValue, Double maxDiscount, Integer usageLimit, Integer perUserLimit) {
        this.voucherId = voucherId;
        this.code = code;
        this.minOrderValue = minOrderValue;
        this.validFrom = validFrom;
        this.validTo = validTo;
        this.discountType = discountType;
        this.discountValue = discountValue;
        this.maxDiscount = maxDiscount;
        this.usageLimit = usageLimit;
        this.perUserLimit = perUserLimit;
    }

    public int getVoucherId() {
        return voucherId;
    }

    public void setVoucherId(int voucherId) {
        this.voucherId = voucherId;
    }

    public String getCode() {
        return code;
    }

    public void setCode(String code) {
        this.code = code;
    }

    public double getMinOrderValue() {
        return minOrderValue;
    }

    public void setMinOrderValue(double minOrderValue) {
        this.minOrderValue = minOrderValue;
    }

    public Timestamp getValidFrom() {
        return validFrom;
    }

    public void setValidFrom(Timestamp validFrom) {
        this.validFrom = validFrom;
    }

    public Timestamp getValidTo() {
        return validTo;
    }

    public void setValidTo(Timestamp validTo) {
        this.validTo = validTo;
    }

    public String getDiscountType() {
        return discountType;
    }

    public void setDiscountType(String discountType) {
        this.discountType = discountType;
    }

    public double getDiscountValue() {
        return discountValue;
    }

    public void setDiscountValue(double discountValue) {
        this.discountValue = discountValue;
    }

    public Double getMaxDiscount() {
        return maxDiscount;
    }

    public void setMaxDiscount(Double maxDiscount) {
        this.maxDiscount = maxDiscount;
    }

    public Integer getUsageLimit() {
        return usageLimit;
    }

    public void setUsageLimit(Integer usageLimit) {
        this.usageLimit = usageLimit;
    }

    public Integer getPerUserLimit() {
        return perUserLimit;
    }

    public void setPerUserLimit(Integer perUserLimit) {
        this.perUserLimit = perUserLimit;
    }

    public int getUsedCount() {
        return usedCount;
    }

    public void setUsedCount(int usedCount) {
        this.usedCount = usedCount;
    }

    public Integer getRemainingUses() {
        if (usageLimit == null) {
            return null;
        }

        return Math.max(0, usageLimit - usedCount);
    }

    public String getAvailabilityStatus() {
        return availabilityStatus;
    }

    public void setAvailabilityStatus(String availabilityStatus) {
        this.availabilityStatus = availabilityStatus;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "Voucher{"
                + "voucherId=" + voucherId
                + ", code='" + code + '\''
                + ", minOrderValue=" + minOrderValue
                + ", validFrom=" + validFrom
                + ", validTo=" + validTo
                + ", discountType='" + discountType + '\''
                + ", discountValue=" + discountValue
                + ", maxDiscount=" + maxDiscount
                + ", usageLimit=" + usageLimit
                + ", perUserLimit=" + perUserLimit
                + '}';
    }
}

package payment;

import dao.PaymentDAO;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletContextEvent;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletContextListener;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebListener;

import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebListener
public class PaymentExpiryListener
        implements ServletContextListener {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(
                    PaymentExpiryListener.class.getName()
            );

    private ScheduledExecutorService worker;

    @Override
    public void contextInitialized(ServletContextEvent event) {

        worker = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(
                runnable -> {
                    Thread thread = new Thread(
                            runnable,
                            "oecs-payment-expiry"
                    );

                    thread.setDaemon(true);

                    return thread;
                }
        );

        worker.scheduleWithFixedDelay(
                () -> {
                    try {
                        PaymentDAO paymentDAO =
                                new PaymentDAO();

                        paymentDAO.expireBatch();

                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        LOGGER.log(
                                Level.SEVERE,
                                "Không xử lý được đơn hết hạn. "
                                + "Sẽ thử lại ở lần quét tiếp theo.",
                                e
                        );
                    }
                },
                0,
                30,
                TimeUnit.SECONDS
        );
    }

    @Override
    public void contextDestroyed(ServletContextEvent event) {

        if (worker != null) {
            worker.shutdownNow();
        }
    }
}package payment;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.time.ZonedDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.StringJoiner;
import java.util.TreeMap;

import javax.crypto.Mac;
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;

public final class PaymentGateway {

    private PaymentGateway() {
    }

    public static String config(String key) {
        String value = System.getProperty(key, System.getenv(key));

        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Chưa cấu hình " + key
            );
        }

        return value.trim();
    }

    public static void requireConfigured(String method) {
        if ("COD".equals(method)) {
            return;
        }

        if (!Arrays.asList("VNPAY", "MOMO").contains(method)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Phương thức thanh toán không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        URI base = URI.create(config("PAYMENT_BASE_URL"));

        if (!"https".equals(base.getScheme())
                || base.getHost() == null
                || base.getQuery() != null
                || base.getFragment() != null) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "PAYMENT_BASE_URL phải là HTTPS, "
                    + "có context path và không có query."
            );
        }

        if ("VNPAY".equals(method)) {
            config("VNPAY_TMN_CODE");
            config("VNPAY_HASH_SECRET");
        } else {
            config("MOMO_PARTNER_CODE");
            config("MOMO_ACCESS_KEY");
            config("MOMO_SECRET_KEY");
        }
    }

    public static boolean available(String method) {
        try {
            requireConfigured(method);
            return true;
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    public static String hmac(
            String algorithm,
            String secret,
            String data
    ) {
        try {
            Mac mac = Mac.getInstance(algorithm);

            mac.init(new SecretKeySpec(
                    secret.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
                    algorithm
            ));

            byte[] hash = mac.doFinal(
                    data.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
            );

            StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();

            for (byte b : hash) {
                result.append(
                        String.format("%02x", b & 255)
                );
            }

            return result.toString();

        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Không tạo được chữ ký thanh toán.",
                    e
            );
        }
    }

    public static boolean equalSignature(
            String expected,
            String actual
    ) {
        return actual != null
                && MessageDigest.isEqual(
                        expected.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII),
                        actual.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
                                .getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
                );
    }

    public static String encode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(
                value,
                StandardCharsets.UTF_8
        );
    }

    public static String vnpCanonical(
            Map<String, String> params
    ) {
        StringJoiner result = new StringJoiner("&");

        new TreeMap<>(params).forEach((key, value) -> {
            if (key.startsWith("vnp_")
                    && !key.equals("vnp_SecureHash")
                    && !key.equals("vnp_SecureHashType")
                    && value != null
                    && !value.isEmpty()) {

                result.add(
                        encode(key) + "=" + encode(value)
                );
            }
        });

        return result.toString();
    }

    private static String base() {
        return config("PAYMENT_BASE_URL")
                .replaceAll("/+$", "");
    }

    public static String create(
            String method,
            String ref,
            BigDecimal amount,
            long remainingSeconds,
            String ip
    ) throws Exception {

        requireConfigured(method);

        long dong = amount.longValueExact();

        if (dong <= 0 || remainingSeconds <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Đơn đã hết hạn hoặc số tiền không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        if ("VNPAY".equals(method)) {
            ZonedDateTime now = ZonedDateTime.now(
                    ZoneId.of("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh")
            );

            DateTimeFormatter formatter =
                    DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(
                            "yyyyMMddHHmmss"
                    );

            Map<String, String> params = new TreeMap<>();

            params.put("vnp_Version", "2.1.0");
            params.put("vnp_Command", "pay");
            params.put(
                    "vnp_TmnCode",
                    config("VNPAY_TMN_CODE")
            );

            params.put(
                    "vnp_Amount",
                    Long.toString(
                            Math.multiplyExact(dong, 100)
                    )
            );

            params.put("vnp_CurrCode", "VND");
            params.put("vnp_TxnRef", ref);
            params.put(
                    "vnp_OrderInfo",
                    "Thanh toan OECS " + ref
            );
            params.put("vnp_OrderType", "other");
            params.put("vnp_Locale", "vn");
            params.put("vnp_IpAddr", ip);

            params.put(
                    "vnp_ReturnUrl",
                    base() + "/payment/vnpay/return"
            );

            params.put(
                    "vnp_CreateDate",
                    formatter.format(now)
            );

            params.put(
                    "vnp_ExpireDate",
                    formatter.format(
                            now.plusSeconds(remainingSeconds)
                    )
            );

            String query = vnpCanonical(params);

            String signature = hmac(
                    "HmacSHA512",
                    config("VNPAY_HASH_SECRET"),
                    query
            );

            return "https://sandbox.vnpayment.vn"
                    + "/paymentv2/vpcpay.html?"
                    + query
                    + "&vnp_SecureHash="
                    + signature;
        }

        Map<String, String> params = new TreeMap<>();

        params.put(
                "accessKey",
                config("MOMO_ACCESS_KEY")
        );
        params.put("amount", Long.toString(dong));
        params.put("extraData", "");
        params.put(
                "ipnUrl",
                base() + "/payment/momo/ipn"
        );
        params.put("orderId", ref);
        params.put(
                "orderInfo",
                "Thanh toan OECS " + ref
        );
        params.put(
                "partnerCode",
                config("MOMO_PARTNER_CODE")
        );
        params.put(
                "redirectUrl",
                base() + "/payment/momo/return"
        );
        params.put("requestId", ref);
        params.put("requestType", "captureWallet");

        String signature = hmac(
                "HmacSHA256",
                config("MOMO_SECRET_KEY"),
                raw(params)
        );

        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();

        params.forEach((key, value) -> {
            if (!key.equals("accessKey")
                    && !key.equals("amount")) {
                body.addProperty(key, value);
            }
        });

        body.addProperty("amount", dong);
        body.addProperty("signature", signature);
        body.addProperty("lang", "vi");
        body.addProperty("autoCapture", true);

        HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder(
                URI.create(
                        "https://test-payment.momo.vn"
                        + "/v2/gateway/api/create"
                )
        )
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
                .header(
                        "Content-Type",
                        "application/json"
                )
                .POST(
                        HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(
                                body.toString()
                        )
                )
                .build();

        HttpClient client = HttpClient.newBuilder()
                .connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10))
                .build();

        HttpResponse<String> response = client.send(
                request,
                HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString()
        );

        if (response.statusCode() != 200) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Cổng MoMo chưa phản hồi. "
                    + "Thử lại từ đơn hàng."
            );
        }

        JsonObject result = JsonParser.parseString(
                response.body()
        ).getAsJsonObject();

        if (!result.has("resultCode")
                || result.get("resultCode").getAsInt() != 0) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "MoMo chưa tạo được thanh toán. "
                    + "Kiểm tra tài khoản sandbox hoặc thử lại."
            );
        }

        URI paymentUrl = URI.create(
                result.get("payUrl").getAsString()
        );

        if (!"https".equals(paymentUrl.getScheme())
                || !"test-payment.momo.vn".equals(
                        paymentUrl.getHost()
                )) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "URL MoMo không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        return paymentUrl.toString();
    }

    public static String raw(Map<String, String> params) {
        StringJoiner result = new StringJoiner("&");

        new TreeMap<>(params).forEach(
                (key, value) ->
                        result.add(key + "=" + value)
        );

        return result.toString();
    }

    public static boolean verifyVnp(
            Map<String, String> params
    ) {
        return config("VNPAY_TMN_CODE").equals(
                params.get("vnp_TmnCode")
        ) && equalSignature(
                hmac(
                        "HmacSHA512",
                        config("VNPAY_HASH_SECRET"),
                        vnpCanonical(params)
                ),
                params.get("vnp_SecureHash")
        );
    }

    public static boolean verifyMomo(
            Map<String, String> params
    ) {
        if (!config("MOMO_PARTNER_CODE").equals(
                params.get("partnerCode")
        ) || !Objects.equals(
                params.get("orderId"),
                params.get("requestId")
        )) {
            return false;
        }

        Map<String, String> signed = new TreeMap<>();

        signed.put(
                "accessKey",
                config("MOMO_ACCESS_KEY")
        );

        for (String key : Arrays.asList(
                "amount",
                "extraData",
                "message",
                "orderId",
                "orderInfo",
                "orderType",
                "partnerCode",
                "payType",
                "requestId",
                "responseTime",
                "resultCode",
                "transId"
        )) {
            if (!params.containsKey(key)) {
                return false;
            }

            signed.put(key, params.get(key));
        }

        return equalSignature(
                hmac(
                        "HmacSHA256",
                        config("MOMO_SECRET_KEY"),
                        raw(signed)
                ),
                params.get("signature")
        );
    }
}package service;

import dao.AuditLogDAO;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import model.AuditLog;
import model.User;

public class AuditLogService {

    private final AuditLogDAO auditLogDAO;

    public AuditLogService() {
        auditLogDAO = new AuditLogDAO();
    }

    public boolean log(User actor,
            String action,
            String entityType,
            Long entityId,
            String description,
            HttpServletRequest request) {

        Integer actorUserId = null;
        String actorIdentifier = null;

        if (actor != null) {
            actorUserId = actor.getUserId();

            if (actor.getEmail() != null && !actor.getEmail().isEmpty()) {
                actorIdentifier = actor.getEmail();
            } else {
                actorIdentifier = actor.getUsername();
            }
        }

        String ipAddress = getClientIp(request);

        AuditLog auditLog = new AuditLog(
                actorUserId,
                actorIdentifier,
                action,
                entityType,
                entityId,
                description,
                ipAddress
        );

        return auditLogDAO.insert(auditLog);
    }

    public boolean log(String actorIdentifier,
            String action,
            String entityType,
            Long entityId,
            String description,
            HttpServletRequest request) {

        String ipAddress = getClientIp(request);

        AuditLog auditLog = new AuditLog(
                null,
                actorIdentifier,
                action,
                entityType,
                entityId,
                description,
                ipAddress
        );

        return auditLogDAO.insert(auditLog);
    }

    private String getClientIp(HttpServletRequest request) {

        if (request == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String ip = request.getHeader("X-Forwarded-For");

        if (ip == null || ip.isEmpty()) {
            ip = request.getRemoteAddr();
        }

        return ip;
    }
}
package service;

import dao.UserDAO;
import jakarta.mail.Authenticator;
import jakarta.mail.Message;
import jakarta.mail.MessagingException;
import jakarta.mail.PasswordAuthentication;
import jakarta.mail.Session;
import jakarta.mail.Transport;
import jakarta.mail.internet.InternetAddress;
import jakarta.mail.internet.MimeMessage;

import java.util.Properties;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import model.User;

public class EmailService {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(EmailService.class.getName());

    private static final String FROM_EMAIL = "oecs.store@gmail.com";
    private static final String APP_PASSWORD = "hkyfaiketbxbotad";

    public boolean emailExists(String email) throws Exception {

        if (email == null || email.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        UserDAO dao = new UserDAO();
        return dao.findByEmail(email.trim()) != null;
    }

    public boolean sendResetPasswordEmail(String toEmail, String resetLink) {

        if (FROM_EMAIL == null || FROM_EMAIL.isBlank()
                || APP_PASSWORD == null || APP_PASSWORD.isBlank()) {

            LOGGER.severe(
                    "Thiếu cấu hình OECS_MAIL_EMAIL hoặc OECS_MAIL_APP_PASSWORD!"
            );

            return false;
        }

        Properties properties = new Properties();

        properties.put("mail.smtp.auth", "true");
        properties.put("mail.smtp.starttls.enable", "true");
        properties.put("mail.smtp.host", "smtp.gmail.com");
        properties.put("mail.smtp.port", "587");

        Session session = Session.getInstance(
                properties,
                new Authenticator() {
            @Override
            protected PasswordAuthentication getPasswordAuthentication() {
                return new PasswordAuthentication(
                        FROM_EMAIL,
                        APP_PASSWORD
                );
            }
        }
        );

        try {

            Message message = new MimeMessage(session);

            message.setFrom(new InternetAddress(FROM_EMAIL));

            message.setRecipients(
                    Message.RecipientType.TO,
                    InternetAddress.parse(toEmail)
            );

            message.setSubject("Đặt lại mật khẩu - OECS");

            String content
                    = "<h2>Đặt lại mật khẩu</h2>"
                    + "<p>Bạn vừa yêu cầu đặt lại mật khẩu cho tài khoản OECS.</p>"
                    + "<p>Nhấn vào liên kết bên dưới để tạo mật khẩu mới:</p>"
                    + "<p>"
                    + "<a href=\"" + resetLink + "\">"
                    + "Đặt lại mật khẩu"
                    + "</a>"
                    + "</p>"
                    + "<p>Liên kết này có hiệu lực trong 15 phút.</p>"
                    + "<p>Nếu bạn không yêu cầu đặt lại mật khẩu, "
                    + "hãy bỏ qua email này.</p>";

            message.setContent(
                    content,
                    "text/html; charset=UTF-8"
            );

            Transport.send(message);

            return true;

        } catch (MessagingException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi gửi email reset password!",
                    ex
            );

            return false;
        }
    }

    public boolean sendAccountSetupEmail(
            String toEmail,
            String setupLink) {

        if (FROM_EMAIL == null
                || FROM_EMAIL.isBlank()
                || APP_PASSWORD == null
                || APP_PASSWORD.isBlank()) {

            LOGGER.severe(
                    "Thiếu cấu hình email!"
            );

            return false;
        }

        Properties properties
                = new Properties();

        properties.put(
                "mail.smtp.auth",
                "true"
        );

        properties.put(
                "mail.smtp.starttls.enable",
                "true"
        );

        properties.put(
                "mail.smtp.host",
                "smtp.gmail.com"
        );

        properties.put(
                "mail.smtp.port",
                "587"
        );

        Session session
                = Session.getInstance(
                        properties,
                        new Authenticator() {

                    @Override
                    protected PasswordAuthentication
                            getPasswordAuthentication() {

                        return new PasswordAuthentication(
                                FROM_EMAIL,
                                APP_PASSWORD
                        );
                    }
                });

        try {

            Message message
                    = new MimeMessage(session);

            message.setFrom(
                    new InternetAddress(
                            FROM_EMAIL
                    )
            );

            message.setRecipients(
                    Message.RecipientType.TO,
                    InternetAddress.parse(
                            toEmail
                    )
            );

            message.setSubject(
                    "Tài khoản OECS của bạn đã được tạo"
            );

            String content
                    = "<h2>Chào mừng bạn đến với OECS</h2>"
                    + "<p>Một tài khoản OECS đã được "
                    + "tạo cho địa chỉ email này.</p>"
                    + "<p>Vui lòng nhấn vào liên kết "
                    + "bên dưới để thiết lập mật khẩu:</p>"
                    + "<p>"
                    + "<a href=\""
                    + setupLink
                    + "\">"
                    + "Thiết lập mật khẩu"
                    + "</a>"
                    + "</p>"
                    + "<p>Liên kết này có hiệu lực "
                    + "trong 24h.</p>"
                    + "<p>Sau khi thiết lập mật khẩu, "
                    + "bạn có thể đăng nhập vào OECS.</p>";

            message.setContent(
                    content,
                    "text/html; charset=UTF-8"
            );

            Transport.send(message);

            return true;

        } catch (MessagingException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi gửi email thiết lập tài khoản!",
                    ex
            );

            return false;
        }
    }
}package service;

import dao.OrderPolicyDAO;
import dao.NotificationDAO;
import dao.OrderInventoryDAO;
import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import db.DBContext;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.*;
import java.util.*;

public class OrderCancellationService {

    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public OrderCancellationService() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public OrderCancellationService(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    public String staffCancel(int staffId, int orderId) throws SQLException {
        return cancel(staffId, orderId, false);
    }

    public boolean customerCancel(int userId, int orderId) throws SQLException {
        return "CANCELLED".equals(cancel(userId, orderId, true));
    }

    public static boolean canCancel(String status) {
        return Arrays.asList("PENDING_PAYMENT", "PENDING_CONFIRMATION", "CONFIRMED", "PACKING")
                .contains(OrderService.normalizeStatus(status));
    }

    private String cancel(int actorId, int orderId, boolean customer) throws SQLException {
        if (actorId <= 0 || orderId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Thông tin đơn hàng không hợp lệ.");
        }
        try (Connection c = connections.open()) {
            if (c == null) {
                throw new SQLException("Không kết nối được database.");
            }
            c.setAutoCommit(false);
            try {
                int owner;
                try (PreparedStatement p = c.prepareStatement("SELECT user_id FROM dbo.[ORDER] WHERE order_id=?")) {
                    p.setInt(1, orderId);
                    try (ResultSet r = p.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!r.next()) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Không tìm thấy đơn hàng.");
                        }
                        owner = r.getInt(1);
                    }
                }
                if (customer && owner != actorId) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Không tìm thấy đơn hàng.");
                }
                new OrderPolicyDAO().lockCustomer(c, owner);
                String status, payment;
                boolean timedOut;
                BigDecimal total;
                try (PreparedStatement p = c.prepareStatement("SELECT order_status,payment_status,total_amount,stock_restored_at, "
                        + "CASE WHEN payment_expires_at <= SYSUTCDATETIME() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS timed_out "
                        + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE order_id=?")) {
                    p.setInt(1, orderId);
                    try (ResultSet r = p.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!r.next()) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Không tìm thấy đơn hàng.");
                        }
                        status = OrderService.normalizeStatus(r.getString("order_status"));
                        if ("CANCELLED".equals(status)) {
                            c.commit();
                            return "UNCHANGED";
                        }
                        if (!canCancel(status)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Chỉ được hủy đơn hàng trước khi vận chuyển.");
                        }
                        if (r.getTimestamp("stock_restored_at") != null) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Đơn đã hoàn kho.");
                        }
                        payment = r.getString("payment_status");
                        total = r.getBigDecimal("total_amount");
                        timedOut = "PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(status) && !"PAID".equals(payment) && r.getBoolean("timed_out");
                    }
                }
                String cancellationReason = timedOut ? "Hết thời hạn thanh toán online"
                        : customer ? "Khách hàng hủy đơn hàng" : "Nhân viên hủy đơn hàng";
                boolean refund = false;
                try (PreparedStatement p = c.prepareStatement("SELECT t.transaction_id,t.amount FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION t WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE t.order_id=? AND t.status='SUCCESS' AND t.amount>0 ORDER BY t.transaction_id")) {
                    p.setInt(1, orderId);
                    List<Object[]> paid = new ArrayList<>();
                    try (ResultSet r = p.executeQuery()) {
                        while (r.next()) {
                            paid.add(new Object[]{r.getLong(1), r.getBigDecimal(2)});
                        }
                    }
                    if ("PAID".equals(payment) && total.signum() > 0 && paid.isEmpty()) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Chưa tìm thấy giao dịch thu tiền để hoàn. Cần đối soát trước khi hủy.");
                    }
                    for (Object[] tx : paid) {
                        update(c, "INSERT INTO dbo.PAYMENT_REFUND(transaction_id,refund_amount,reason) SELECT ?,?,? "
                                + "WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PAYMENT_REFUND WHERE transaction_id=?)",
                                tx[0], tx[1], cancellationReason, tx[0]);
                        refund = true;
                    }
                }
                boolean deducted = "CONFIRMED".equals(status) || "PACKING".equals(status);
                if (deducted) {
                    new OrderInventoryDAO().restore(c, orderId);
                }
                String cancellationSource = timedOut
                        ? "SYSTEM"
                        : customer ? "CUSTOMER" : "STAFF";

                update(c, "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] SET "
                        + "order_status='CANCELLED', "
                        + "cancellation_source=CASE WHEN ?='CUSTOMER' "
                        + "THEN NULL ELSE ? END, "
                        + "cancelled_at=CASE WHEN ?='CUSTOMER' "
                        + "THEN NULL ELSE SYSUTCDATETIME() END, "
                        + "stock_restored_at=CASE WHEN ?=1 "
                        + "THEN SYSDATETIME() ELSE stock_restored_at END, "
                        + "payment_expires_at=NULL, "
                        + "payment_status=? "
                        + "WHERE order_id=?",
                        cancellationSource,
                        cancellationSource,
                        cancellationSource,
                        deducted ? 1 : 0,
                        refund ? "REFUND_PENDING" : payment,
                        orderId);
                update(c, "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION SET status=? WHERE order_id=? AND status='PENDING'", timedOut ? "EXPIRED" : "CANCELLED", orderId);
                update(c, "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY(order_id,status) VALUES (?,'CANCELLED')", orderId);
                if (!NotificationDAO.createOrderStatusNotification(c, orderId, "CANCELLED")) {
                    throw new SQLException("Không tạo được thông báo hủy đơn.");
                }
                if (customer && !timedOut) {
                    new OrderPolicyDAO().recordCancellation(c, owner, orderId);
                }
                c.commit();
                return "CANCELLED";
            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                try {
                    c.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollback) {
                    e.addSuppressed(rollback);
                }
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    private static int update(Connection c, String sql, Object... values) throws SQLException {
        try (PreparedStatement p = c.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
                p.setObject(i + 1, values[i]);
            }
            return p.executeUpdate();
        }
    }
}
package service;

import dao.OrderDAO;
import dao.OrderPolicyDAO;
import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import db.DBContext;
import model.Order;
import payment.PaymentGateway;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

public class OrderService {

    private static final BigDecimal SHIPPING_FEE = new BigDecimal("30000");
    private static final BigDecimal FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD = new BigDecimal("5000000");

    public static BigDecimal calculateShippingFee(BigDecimal subtotal) {
        if (subtotal.compareTo(FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD) >= 0) {
            return BigDecimal.ZERO;
        }
        return SHIPPING_FEE;
    }

    private final OrderPolicyDAO policy = new OrderPolicyDAO();
    private final OrderDAO orderDAO;
    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public OrderService() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public OrderService(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
        this.orderDAO = new OrderDAO(connections);
    }

    private static final class CartLine {

        final int cartItemId;
        final int skuId;
        final int quantity;
        final BigDecimal price;

        CartLine(
                int cartItemId,
                int skuId,
                int quantity,
                BigDecimal price
        ) {
            this.cartItemId = cartItemId;
            this.skuId = skuId;
            this.quantity = quantity;
            this.price = price;
        }
    }

    private static final class VoucherResult {

        final Integer id;
        final BigDecimal discount;

        VoucherResult(Integer id, BigDecimal discount) {
            this.id = id;
            this.discount = discount;
        }
    }

    @Deprecated
    public int placeCodOrder(

            int addressId,

    ) throws SQLException {

        );

    public int placeCodOrder(

    public int placeCodOrder(

    public int placeCodOrder(
            int userId,
            int addressId,
            String checkoutToken,
            String voucherCode,
            List<Integer> selectedCartItemIds
    ) throws SQLException {
        return placeOrder(
                userId,
                addressId,
                checkoutToken,
                voucherCode,
                selectedCartItemIds,
                "COD"
        );
    }

    public int placeOrder(
            int userId,
            int addressId,
            String checkoutToken,
            String voucherCode,
            List<Integer> selectedCartItemIds,
            String paymentMethod
    ) throws SQLException {

        PaymentGateway.requireConfigured(paymentMethod);

        if (userId <= 0
                || addressId <= 0
                || checkoutToken == null
                || !checkoutToken.matches("[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}")) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Yêu cầu đặt hàng không hợp lệ. "
                    + "Vui lòng tải lại Checkout."
            );
        }

        boolean selectedMode = selectedCartItemIds != null;
        List<Integer> selectedIds = new ArrayList<>();

        if (selectedMode) {
            for (Integer id : selectedCartItemIds) {
                if (id != null
                        && id > 0
                        && !selectedIds.contains(id)) {
                    selectedIds.add(id);
                }
            }

            if (selectedIds.isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Vui lòng chọn sản phẩm để đặt hàng."
                );
            }
        }

        try (Connection conn = connections.open()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Không kết nối được database."
                );
            }

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                policy.lockCustomer(conn, userId);
                int cartId;

                String sql
                        = "SELECT cart_id "
                        + "FROM dbo.CART WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE user_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, userId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Giỏ hàng không tồn tại."
                            );
                        }

                        cartId = rs.getInt("cart_id");
                    }
                }

                Integer existingOrderId = orderDAO.findIdByToken(
                        conn,
                        userId,
                        checkoutToken
                );

                if (existingOrderId != null) {
                    conn.commit();
                    return existingOrderId;
                }

                policy.requireAllowed(conn, userId);

                Order order = new Order();
                order.setUserId(userId);
                order.setAddressId(addressId);

                sql
                        = "SELECT recipient_name, phone_number, address_line "
                        + "FROM dbo.ADDRESSBOOK WITH (HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE address_id = ? "
                        + "AND user_id = ? "
                        + "AND is_deleted = 0";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, addressId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Địa chỉ không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa."
                            );
                        }

                        order.setRecipientName(
                                rs.getString("recipient_name")
                        );
                        order.setRecipientPhone(
                                rs.getString("phone_number")
                        );
                        order.setShippingAddress(
                                rs.getString("address_line")
                        );
                    }
                }

                List<CartLine> lines = new ArrayList<>();
                BigDecimal subtotal = BigDecimal.ZERO;

                StringBuilder itemsSql = new StringBuilder(
                        "SELECT ci.cart_item_id, ci.sku_id, "
                        + "ci.quantity, s.price, s.stock_quantity "
                        + "FROM dbo.CART_ITEMS ci "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "ON s.sku_id = ci.sku_id "
                        + "WHERE ci.cart_id = ? "
                );

                if (selectedMode) {
                    itemsSql.append("AND ci.cart_item_id IN (");

                    for (int i = 0; i < selectedIds.size(); i++) {
                        if (i > 0) {
                            itemsSql.append(",");
                        }

                        itemsSql.append("?");
                    }

                    itemsSql.append(") ");
                }

                itemsSql.append("ORDER BY ci.cart_item_id");

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(itemsSql.toString())) {

                    int index = 1;
                    ps.setInt(index++, cartId);

                    if (selectedMode) {
                        for (Integer id : selectedIds) {
                            ps.setInt(index++, id);
                        }
                    }

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        while (rs.next()) {
                            int cartItemId = rs.getInt("cart_item_id");
                            int skuId = rs.getInt("sku_id");
                            int quantity = rs.getInt("quantity");
                            BigDecimal price = rs.getBigDecimal("price");
                            if (quantity > rs.getInt("stock_quantity")) {
                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sản phẩm SKU " + skuId + " không đủ tồn kho.");
                            }

                            if (quantity <= 0
                                    || price == null
                                    || price.signum() < 0) {

                                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Sản phẩm trong giỏ hàng "
                                        + "không hợp lệ."
                                );
                            }

                            lines.add(new CartLine(
                                    cartItemId,
                                    skuId,
                                    quantity,
                                    price
                            ));

                            subtotal = subtotal.add(
                                    price.multiply(
                                            BigDecimal.valueOf(quantity)
                                    )
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (lines.isEmpty()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            selectedMode
                                    ? "Không tìm thấy sản phẩm đã chọn."
                                    : "Giỏ hàng đang trống."
                    );
                }

                if (selectedMode && lines.size() != selectedIds.size()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Một số sản phẩm đã chọn "
                            + "không còn trong giỏ hàng."
                    );
                }

                long totalQuantity = 0;
                for (CartLine line : lines) {
                    totalQuantity += line.quantity;
                }
                if (totalQuantity > 5) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mỗi đơn được mua tối đa 5 sản phẩm tính theo tổng số lượng.");
                }

                VoucherResult voucher = lockAndCalculateVoucher(
                        conn,
                        userId,
                        voucherCode,
                        subtotal
                );

                BigDecimal shippingFee = calculateShippingFee(subtotal);

                BigDecimal totalAmount = subtotal
                        .add(shippingFee)
                        .subtract(voucher.discount)
                        .max(BigDecimal.ZERO);

                order.setShippingFee(shippingFee);
                order.setDiscountAmount(voucher.discount);
                order.setTotalAmount(totalAmount);
                order.setPaymentMethod(paymentMethod);

                boolean pendingPayment
                        = !"COD".equals(paymentMethod)
                        && totalAmount.signum() > 0;

                order.setOrderStatus(
                        pendingPayment
                                ? "PENDING_PAYMENT"
                                : "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                );

                order.setPaymentStatus(
                        totalAmount.signum() == 0
                        ? "PAID"
                        : "UNPAID"
                );

                int orderId = orderDAO.insert(
                        conn,
                        order,
                        checkoutToken
                );

                if (orderId <= 0) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Không thể tạo đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                if (pendingPayment) {
                    sql
                            = "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                            + "SET payment_expires_at = "
                            + "DATEADD(MINUTE, 15, SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ?";

                    try (PreparedStatement ps
                            = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                        ps.setInt(1, orderId);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không lưu được hạn thanh toán."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                for (CartLine line : lines) {
                    orderDAO.insertItem(
                            conn,
                            orderId,
                            line.skuId,
                            line.price,
                            line.quantity
                    );
                }

                orderDAO.addHistory(
                        conn,
                        orderId,
                        order.getOrderStatus()
                );

                if (voucher.id != null) {
                    sql
                            = "INSERT INTO dbo.VOUCHER_USAGES "
                            + "(voucher_id, order_id, user_id) "
                            + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

                    try (PreparedStatement ps
                            = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                        ps.setInt(1, voucher.id);
                        ps.setInt(2, orderId);
                        ps.setInt(3, userId);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không lưu được lượt sử dụng voucher."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                sql
                        = "DELETE FROM dbo.CART_ITEMS "
                        + "WHERE cart_id = ? AND cart_item_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    for (CartLine line : lines) {
                        ps.setInt(1, cartId);
                        ps.setInt(2, line.cartItemId);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không xóa được sản phẩm "
                                    + "đã đặt khỏi giỏ hàng."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                conn.commit();
                return orderId;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
                    e.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
                }

                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    private VoucherResult lockAndCalculateVoucher(
            Connection conn,
            int userId,
            String voucherCode,
            BigDecimal subtotal
    ) throws SQLException {

        if (voucherCode == null || voucherCode.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return new VoucherResult(null, BigDecimal.ZERO);
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT voucher_id, discount_type, discount_value, "
                + "max_discount, usage_limit, per_user_limit "
                + "FROM dbo.VOUCHER WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE UPPER(code) = UPPER(?) "
                + "AND GETDATE() BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to "
                + "AND min_order_value <= ?";

        int voucherId;
        String discountType;
        BigDecimal discountValue;
        BigDecimal maxDiscount;
        Integer usageLimit;
        Integer perUserLimit;

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setString(1, voucherCode.trim());
            ps.setBigDecimal(2, subtotal);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Voucher hết hạn hoặc đơn hàng "
                            + "chưa đủ điều kiện áp dụng."
                    );
                }

                voucherId = rs.getInt("voucher_id");
                discountType = rs.getString("discount_type");
                discountValue = rs.getBigDecimal("discount_value");
                maxDiscount = rs.getBigDecimal("max_discount");

                Object usageValue = rs.getObject("usage_limit");

                usageLimit = usageValue == null
                        ? null
                        : ((Number) usageValue).intValue();

                Object perUserValue = rs.getObject("per_user_limit");

                perUserLimit = perUserValue == null
                        ? null
                        : ((Number) perUserValue).intValue();
            }
        }

        if (discountValue == null || discountValue.signum() <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Voucher có giá trị giảm không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        sql
                = "SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_used, "
                + "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN user_id = ? "
                + "THEN CAST(1 AS bigint) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS user_used "
                + "FROM dbo.VOUCHER_USAGES "
                + "WHERE voucher_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.setInt(2, voucherId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                rs.next();

                long totalUsed = rs.getLong("total_used");
                long userUsed = rs.getLong("user_used");

                if (usageLimit != null && totalUsed >= usageLimit) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Voucher đã hết lượt sử dụng."
                    );
                }

                if (perUserLimit != null && userUsed >= perUserLimit) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Bạn đã dùng hết lượt của voucher này."
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        BigDecimal discount;

        if ("AMOUNT".equalsIgnoreCase(discountType)) {
            discount = discountValue;

        } else if ("PERCENT".equalsIgnoreCase(discountType)) {
            discount = subtotal
                    .multiply(discountValue)
                    .divide(
                            BigDecimal.valueOf(100),
                            2,
                            RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                    );

            if (maxDiscount != null) {
                discount = discount.min(maxDiscount);
            }

        } else {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Loại voucher không được hỗ trợ."
            );
        }

        discount = discount
                .max(BigDecimal.ZERO)
                .min(subtotal)
                .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);

        return new VoucherResult(voucherId, discount);
    }

    public boolean cancelOrderByCustomer(int userId, int orderId) throws SQLException {
        return new OrderCancellationService(connections).customerCancel(userId, orderId);
    }

    public String orderingRestriction(int userId) throws SQLException {
        try (Connection conn = connections.open()) {
            return policy.restriction(conn, userId);
        }
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> findHistory(
            int orderId,
            int userId
    ) throws SQLException {

        List<Map<String, Object>> history
                = orderDAO.findHistory(orderId, userId);

        for (Map<String, Object> entry : history) {
            entry.put(
                    "label",
                    statusLabel((String) entry.get("status"))
            );
        }

        return history;
    }

    public static String normalizeStatus(String status) {
        if (status == null) {
            return "";
        }

        String value = status
                .trim()
                .toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)
                .replace(' ', '_');

        return "PENDING".equals(value)
                ? "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                : value;
    }

    public static Map<String, String> statusLabels() {
        Map<String, String> labels = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        labels.put("PENDING_PAYMENT", "Chờ thanh toán");
        labels.put("PENDING_CONFIRMATION", "Chờ xác nhận");
        labels.put("CONFIRMED", "Đã xác nhận");
        labels.put("PACKING", "Đang đóng gói");
        labels.put("SHIPPING", "Đang giao hàng");
        labels.put("DELIVERED", "Đã giao hàng");
        labels.put("COMPLETED", "Hoàn tất");
        labels.put("CANCELLED", "Đã hủy");

        return labels;
    }

    public static String statusLabel(String status) {
        return statusLabels().getOrDefault(
                normalizeStatus(status),
                status
        );
    }

    public static Map<String, String> purchaseTabs() {
        Map<String, String> tabs = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        tabs.put("ALL", "Tất cả");
        tabs.put("PAYMENT", "Chờ thanh toán");
        tabs.put("PENDING", "Chờ xác nhận");
        tabs.put("PREPARING", "Đang chuẩn bị hàng");
        tabs.put("SHIPPING", "Đang giao");
        tabs.put("COMPLETED", "Hoàn thành");
        tabs.put("CANCELLED", "Đã hủy");

        return tabs;
    }

    public static List<String> statusesForTab(String tab) {
        switch (tab) {
            case "PAYMENT":
                return Collections.singletonList("PENDING_PAYMENT");

            case "PENDING":
                return Arrays.asList(
                        "PENDING",
                        "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                );

            case "PREPARING":
                return Arrays.asList("CONFIRMED", "PACKING");

            case "SHIPPING":
                return Collections.singletonList("SHIPPING");

            case "COMPLETED":
                return Arrays.asList("DELIVERED", "COMPLETED");

            case "CANCELLED":
                return Collections.singletonList("CANCELLED");

            default:
                return Collections.emptyList();
        }
    }

    public static Map<String, Long> purchaseTabCounts(
            Map<String, Long> statuses
    ) {
        Map<String, Long> counts = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (String tab : purchaseTabs().keySet()) {
            counts.put(tab, 0L);
        }

        for (Map.Entry<String, Long> entry : statuses.entrySet()) {
            counts.put(
                    "ALL",
                    counts.get("ALL") + entry.getValue()
            );

            for (String tab : purchaseTabs().keySet()) {
                if (statusesForTab(tab).contains(
                        normalizeStatus(entry.getKey())
                )) {
                    counts.put(
                            tab,
                            counts.get(tab) + entry.getValue()
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        return counts;
    }

    public static List<Map<String, Object>> trackingSteps(
            Order order,
            List<Map<String, Object>> history
    ) {
